job.title: Commercial Recruiter
job.description:
Connect great people with great opportunity. Looking for a job that keeps you moving? Where no two days are the same, but every day is a chance to make an impact? As a Commercial Recruiter with Nesco, you'll work daily to bridge the gap between talented, hardworking people and great employers ready to welcome them.

A day in the life:
  • Source resumes to establish candidate pools
  • Recruit and interview qualified candidates
  • Match candidates with appropriate opportunities and submit to the clients
  • Supervise contract employee activities
  • Build candidate and client relationships through extensive interaction and diligent follow up
  • Write job descriptions and post job ads
  • Negotiate and present employment offers
  • Assist with payroll, unemployment and worker's compensation as needed
  • Provide administrative and other branch office support
What you'll need:
  • High energy to match high volume
  • Tenacious approach to daily work and the grit to see it through
  • Proven ability to interact professionally and authentically with clients and candidates at all skill levels
  • Competitive spirit and roll-up-your-sleeves attitude
  • Exceptional organization and time management skills
Background in HR, recruiting, retail, or other fast-paced customer service industry – often successful in our business!

We work for you. And we work hard. With over 60 years of success in the staffing industry, taking care of our partners in all things talent is top priority here, and it shows.

Competitive Pay
Comprehensive Benefits
Training

We do the right thing… because it's the right thing to do.
At Nesco, no one is above ethics. No one is above the work. We work hard. We lead. We give. We serve. We strive always to do the right thing for our clients, candidates, community and each other.

job.title: Distribution Associate (QIC - Quality Inventory Control) - 3rd Shift
job.description:
Position: Distribution Associate (QIC - Quality Inventory Control) - 3rd Shift
Location: Rochester, NY

Summary: Nesco Resource is seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Distribution Associate – QIC to join a leading distribution and warehouse operation in Rochester, NY. This temp-to-perm opportunity offers candidates the chance to demonstrate their skills and transition into a permanent position based on performance and business needs. The Distribution Associate will play a key role in inventory control, product replenishment, cycle counting, and warehouse organization while ensuring inventory accuracy and compliance with FIFO requirements. This position is ideal for individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced warehouse environment, are comfortable using RF scanners and warehouse management systems, and take pride in maintaining accurate inventory records.

Pay Rate:

  • $18.00/Hour
    • + 15% Shift Differential for 3rd Shift

Shift(s):

  • 3rd Shift: 10:00 PM - 6:00 AM | Sunday - Thursday

Job Duties:

  • Perform inventory searches using warehouse management systems (WMS) and RF scanning equipment
  • Organize and maintain picking locations to ensure inventory availability and FIFO compliance
  • Complete product restocking and put-away activities accurately and efficiently
  • Retrieve products to resolve customer order shortages
  • Sort and stage products for proper put-away and storage
  • Conduct product location checks to maintain inventory accuracy
  • Participate in monthly cycle counts and assist with physical inventory activities
  • Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements
  • Report safety concerns, sanitation issues, equipment malfunctions, and quality concerns to leadership immediately
  • Maintain attendance standards, including working scheduled holidays and overtime when required
  • Support warehouse operations and perform additional duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • Previous warehouse, distribution, or receiving experience preferred
  • Basic math skills required for inventory and cycle counting activities
  • Basic computer proficiency required
  • Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) preferred
  • Forklift and/or man-up equipment experience preferred
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and adhere to safety procedures
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Reliable attendance and strong work ethic

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand for extended periods throughout the shift
  • Frequent walking, bending, stooping, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and pushing/pulling activities
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. regularly throughout the workday
  • Occasional stair climbing and overhead reaching
  • Ability to safely operate man-up equipment as required
  • Comfortable working in a warehouse environment with varying temperatures, noise levels, and dust exposure
  • Ability to work safely around moving mechanical equipment while following all PPE requirements

job.title: Raw Material
job.description:
Now hiring for a Raw Material weight Tech in a pharmacy like environment inside a manufacturing facility! Please see job details below.

Pay Rate: Starts at o $18.00 Hr.

Schedule: First Shift 7:00am-3:30pm

Position Purpose and Objectives

Responsible to the precise measurement and weighing of raw materials to be used in manufacturing high quality liquid dietary supplements and cosmetic products.

Essential Job Functions

- Pulls, weighs, and returns raw materials needed to produce batches.

- Verifies raw materials being weighed against official blending record.

- Records all pertinent raw material information on official blending record for traceability to include but not limited to lot numbers, expiration dates, and weight.

- Maintains accurate batch records required throughout process.

- Proficient in converting units to calculate batch requirements.

- Notifies appropriate management of documentation discrepancies.

- Effectively operates and maintains scales and various other equipment.

- Operates fork lifts and pallet jacks.

- Collect, label, and ship samples.

- Transfer from receiving approved raw materials accurately in and out of locations.

- Navigate and use Process Pro required screens to locate raw materials, find inventory quantity, check approval status, adjust inventory, or receive inventory.

- Actively participate in housekeeping responsibilities.

- Do annual and cycle count inventory.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required

- This individual must be able to read and apply the information contained in the SOP specifications for their operation.

- Problem solving skills.

- Maintain quality, and safety standards.

- Train and monitor line personnel in performance of their duties.

- Extreme attention to detail and accurate documentation.

Supervisory Responsibility

- Follow GMP Guidelines.

- Responsible for maintaining the quality of raw materials and work area.

- Reports all quality related issues.

- Maintain safe work environment.

- Support manufacturing compounders.

- Follow FIFO protocols when pulling raw materials for batches.

- Perform other duties as assigned by management.

- Follow the SOP's procedures.

Working Conditions

- Strong interaction with quality assurance and manufacturing.

Minimum Qualifications

- This individual must have 2 years similar position experience in a manufacturing environment or quality control background.

- Good communication skills both written and oral, basic math, and problem solving skills.

Success Factors

- Self-motivated team player and well organized

job.title: Dimensional Inspector
job.description:
DIMENSIONAL INSPECTOR – 2ND SHIFT

Location: North Royalton, OH | Manufacturing Opportunity

$24.00 PER HOUR | GREAT BENEFITS | STABLE WORK ENVIRONMENT!

Do you have an eye for detail and a passion for making sure things are done right the first time? Can you read a blueprint, work with precision measuring equipment, and spot even the smallest imperfections?

Nesco Resource is looking for an experienced Dimensional Inspector to join a manufacturing team in North Royalton, OH! If you have a background in machining, plastic injection molding, or quality inspection, this could be a great opportunity to put your skills to work with a company that values quality, teamwork, and its employees.

If precision is your specialty, we want to talk to you!

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

  • Perform visual and dimensional inspections to ensure parts meet customer specifications and quality standards.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and specifications to verify dimensional accuracy.

  • Inspect parts for dimensional accuracy and surface defects using calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and other precision measuring instruments.

  • Conduct inspections throughout the manufacturing process to identify potential quality concerns.

  • Accurately complete inspection records, reports, and required documentation.

  • Identify, document, and report non-conforming materials or products.

  • Follow established non-conformance procedures and document acceptance after approved rework or repairs.

  • Work with production teams to maintain quality standards and production efficiency.

  • Communicate professionally with team members and support company goals and initiatives.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 5–10 years of relevant inspection or manufacturing experience.

  • Machining and/or plastic injection molding experience is highly desired.

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering blueprints and technical drawings.

  • Experience using precision measuring equipment, including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and other inspection tools.

  • Intermediate technical skills and computer proficiency.

  • Experience with ERP systems, Microsoft Windows, and Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify quality issues.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.

  • High school diploma or GED required.

  • Ability to successfully pass a pre-employment screening.

SHIFT & SCHEDULE:

2nd Shift | Monday–Friday | 3:00 PM–11:30 PM

Overtime may be required as needed.

PAY:

$24.00 per hour

BENEFITS & PERKS:

This company believes in creating a positive work environment and rewarding employees for their hard work!

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • HSA/FSA options.

  • Paid time off and holiday pay.

  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance.

  • Company-paid basic life insurance.

  • 401(k) or Roth 401(k) with company contributions:

    • 100% match on contributions up to 3%.

    • 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5%.

  • Shoe and uniform allowance.

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Company-sponsored events, including holiday luncheons, associate contests, Christmas gifts, and Perfect Attendance Awards!

READY TO PUT YOUR EYE FOR QUALITY TO WORK?

If you have a strong manufacturing background, know your way around precision measuring equipment, and take pride in producing quality work, we'd love to connect with you!

Your next opportunity could be just one application away!

Apply TODAY through Indeed or contact Nesco Resource to learn more. Let's put your experience to work and find the opportunity that's right for you!

job.title: Fleet Administrative Coordinator
job.description:
Job Title: Fleet Administrative Coordinator
Location: Henrietta, NY

Summary: We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Fleet Administrative Coordinator to support vehicle fleet documentation and administrative processes. This role is ideal for someone with strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. The position will focus on tracking vehicle documentation, title and registration processes, and coordinating with financial institutions and leasing partners.

This is a temporary contract assignment with an expected duration of 3-5 months. There is no expectation of permanent employment at the conclusion of the contract.

Pay: $22.00-$25.00 per hour
Schedule:

  • Monday-Friday
  • Standard business hours

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and update Excel spreadsheets used to track vehicle fleet activities and status.
  • Filter, organize, and document vehicle data to ensure accurate tracking of work progression and outstanding items.
  • Manage documentation related to vehicle titles, liens, registrations, and associated administrative processes.
  • Track the status of title applications, registration requests, and related fleet records.
  • Complete fleet-related paperwork according to established procedures and supervisor direction.
  • Coordinate and obtain required documentation from lessors, banks, and other third-party partners.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure documentation is processed in a timely manner.
  • Support additional administrative and operational tasks as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

  • Previous administrative, clerical, fleet, transportation, automotive, banking, or related experience preferred.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including filtering, sorting, and data management.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage confidential documentation with accuracy.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while following established processes and instructions.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and meeting deadlines.

Additional Information:

  • Candidates will participate in a brief interview process prior to onboarding.
  • Hiring managers and department leaders will be involved in candidate interviews.
  • No drug screening required prior to hire.
  • No background check required prior to hire.
  • This is a contract assignment lasting approximately 3-5 months with no guarantee or expectation of full-time employment following completion of the assignment.

job.title: Torque Coverter Associate
job.description:
Torque Converter Associate

Location: Camelback Rd & 43rd Avenue, Phoenix, AZ
Shift: 1st Shift — 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM
Pay: $20.00 per hour
Urgent Need — Bilingual Preferred

Position Overview

We are seeking a dependable and mechanically inclined Torque Converter Associate to support production and assembly operations. This role involves hands-on work with components, tools, and equipment while following established production and quality standards. Light welding experience is a strong plus but is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assemble and work with torque converter components according to established procedures
  • Use hand tools and production equipment safely and accurately
  • Perform basic mechanical assembly and component fitting
  • Inspect parts and completed products for quality and accuracy
  • Follow written and visual work instructions
  • Assist with basic welding-related tasks when trained and qualified
  • Identify and report defective, damaged, or incorrect components
  • Meet daily production and quality expectations
  • Maintain an organized and clean workstation
  • Follow all safety procedures and required production standards
  • Work closely with leads and other team members to meet department goals

Requirements

  • Mechanical or hands-on production experience preferred
  • Light welding experience is a strong plus, but not required
  • Previous manufacturing, assembly, automotive, or production experience is preferred
  • Comfortable using basic hand tools and equipment
  • Ability to follow detailed work instructions
  • Strong attention to detail and quality
  • Reliable attendance and stable work history
  • Ability to perform repetitive hands-on tasks
  • Must be able to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Must be available to work Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–3:00 PM
  • Bilingual Spanish is preferred, but not required

Preferred Qualities

  • Mechanically inclined
  • Basic welding knowledge or experience
  • Automotive or manufacturing background
  • Strong hand-eye coordination
  • Willingness to learn new production processes and equipment
  • Consistent attendance and long-term job commitment

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician

Pay: $27.15–$33.90 per hour
Shift: 6:30 AM–3:00 PM

Nesco Resource is hiring an experienced Advanced Maintenance Technician!

This hands-on position is responsible for installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining manufacturing equipment and facility systems. The ideal candidate will have strong mechanical skills and experience working with electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and electronic systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install machinery and equipment using blueprints, layout plans, hoists, lift trucks, hand tools, and power tools.

  • Calibrate, align, and adjust production equipment.

  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems.

  • Repair, maintain, install, and improve manufacturing equipment.

  • Fabricate or machine components using lathes, drill presses, grinders, and other shop equipment.

  • Complete preventive maintenance and maintain accurate maintenance logs.

  • Assist with maintenance projects and repairs throughout the facility.

  • Work around production schedules as needed.

  • Follow all safety procedures, including Lockout/Tagout and Hot Work requirements.

Qualifications

  • Five to ten years of maintenance experience, preferably in manufacturing.

  • Vocational degree or equivalent training in machine repair, millwright work, or field machining.

  • Strong knowledge of mechanical, electronic, hydraulic, and millwright systems.

  • Ability to read blueprints and schematic drawings.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

  • Welding, plumbing, carpentry, electrical, and HVAC knowledge is preferred.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

  • Forklift certification or willingness to become certified after hire.

  • Availability for occasional overtime or emergency call-ins.

Physical and Work Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.

  • Comfortable working from ladders or man lifts.

  • Ability to work in confined spaces and occasional extreme heat or cold.

  • Comfortable working around manufacturing equipment, chemicals, fumes, noise, and vibration.

    COM035

Apply today through Nesco Resource to learn more about this Advanced Maintenance Technician opportunity!

job.title: Automation Engineer
job.description:
Work Schedule on site from Monday thru Friday 7am to 4pm

Work Schedule on site from Monday thru Friday 7am to 4pm
Please look for strong experience in design/build/integration of automation equipment using Allen Bradley, Fanuc, Studio 5000 & Solidworks electrical and mechanical modeling/drawing creation.

Senior Automation Engineer
Overview The Senior Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, supporting, and continuously improving automation systems that drive manufacturing efficiency and operational excellence. This position leads automation projects, troubleshoots complex controls issues, collaborates with cross-functional teams, and serves as a technical expert for automation technologies.

Key Responsibilities
Design, program, and support PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, robotics, vision systems, and process controls.
Lead automation projects from concept through commissioning.
Troubleshoot complex controls, automation, and integration issues.
Develop and maintain automation standards, documentation, and best practices.
Partner with manufacturing, quality, maintenance, IT, and external vendors.
Perform root cause analysis and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with safety, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership.
Support equipment upgrades, capacity expansions, and new product introductions.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent experience.
5+ years of industrial automation, controls engineering, or manufacturing engineering experience.
Strong PLC programming experience (Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or equivalent).
Experience with HMI/SCADA systems and industrial communication networks.
Proven automation system design and implementation experience.
Strong troubleshooting skills for electrical and control systems.
Ability to manage multiple projects independently.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with robotics, machine vision, and motion control.
MES (Manufacturing Execution System) experience.
Knowledge of NFPA, IEC, OSHA, and safety-rated controls.
Project leadership experience.
Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Kaizen experience.

job.title: Materials Handler
job.description:
Job Title: Materials Handler
Location: Rochester, NY

Summary:
Nesco Resource is partnering with a manufacturing company to hire a Materials Handler. This role is responsible for the safe and efficient movement, storage, and organization of raw materials, components, and finished goods throughout the facility. The ideal candidate has material handling or warehouse experience, is comfortable operating forklifts and pallet jacks, and can maintain accurate inventory records while supporting daily production needs.

Pay Rate:

  • $20–$23 per hour, based on experience.

Shift:

  • Monday – Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM.

Job Duties:

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment to move materials throughout the facility.

  • Stage and deliver materials, parts, and supplies to production lines and workstations.

  • Pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment, ensuring accuracy and proper labeling.

  • Store materials in designated locations and maintain organized storage areas.

  • Enter and update inventory transactions using warehouse management systems, ERP systems, or handheld scanners.

  • Participate in cycle counts and physical inventory while reporting discrepancies.

  • Identify and report damaged, defective, or incorrect materials.

  • Complete routine equipment inspections, including pre-shift forklift checks.

  • Follow all safety policies and procedures while maintaining a clean and organized work environment.

  • Provide additional support to shipping and receiving operations as needed.

Requirements:

  • Ability to safely operate a forklift and/or pallet jack.

  • Current forklift certification required, or willingness to obtain certification within 30 days of hire.

  • Basic computer skills, including data entry and the ability to learn inventory and scanning systems.

  • Ability to read and follow work orders, labels, and written instructions.

  • Basic math skills for counting and verifying inventory quantities.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work as part of a team.

  • Reliable attendance and a strong commitment to workplace safety.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand and walk throughout the entire shift, often on concrete floors.

  • Ability to regularly lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs.

  • Frequent bending, stooping, reaching, kneeling, and twisting.

  • Comfortable working in a manufacturing and warehouse environment with exposure to noise, dust, and varying temperatures.

Education/Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

job.title: Director of Operations
job.description:
Director of Operations Job in Naugatuck, CT:

Onsite Position in Naugatuck, CT
Full-Time, Direct Hire
Salary Range: $140,000-170,000
 

Our well-established client, a precision manufacturer, is seeking a hands-on Director of Operations to lead its manufacturing, purchasing, and supply chain functions. This is a traditional operations leadership role: production, planning, purchasing, procurement, supply chain, quality, and facilities all report to this position.

The team is already in place. The Director of Operations will provide the leadership, mentoring, and accountability needed to execute the company’s strategic plan, with an immediate focus on reducing past-due orders and improving on-time delivery. This is a player-coach role in a small, established manufacturer, ideal for a leader who enjoys being close to the work and can personally explain the steps behind the results they deliver.

Key Responsibilities of the Director of Operations Job in Naugatuck, CT:

Operations Leadership

  • Lead all manufacturing operations, including production, planning, scheduling, and shipping, to meet safety, quality, delivery, and cost goals.
  • Directly manage Quality, the Senior Buyer, the Planner, and production supervisors, providing mentorship and clear accountability.
  • Translate the company’s strategic plan into daily, weekly, and monthly priorities, and lead the team through execution.
  • Lead the past-due reduction plan and drive continuous improvement in on-time delivery.

Purchasing, Procurement, and Supply Chain

  • Lead the purchasing and procurement function, including supplier selection, sourcing strategy, and supplier performance management.
  • Develop domestic and international sourcing opportunities that improve cost, quality, and supply continuity.
  • Lead pricing and contract negotiations with suppliers.
  • Use MRP and ERP data to align material planning, purchasing, and production schedules.

Quality and Compliance

  • Oversee the quality function and maintain compliance with AS9100 and ISO standards.
  • Lead and support internal, customer, and registrar audits, and drive timely closure of corrective actions.
  • Reduce defects, rejects, and customer returns through root cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions.

KPI Management

  • Own and report on key performance indicators, including on-time delivery, past-due orders, PPM, PPV, reject rate, and RMAs.
  • Use data to identify problems, set priorities, and measure the impact of improvement initiatives.

Facilities

  • Manage the facility and related projects, including small construction projects, building maintenance, and grounds vendors such as landscaping and snow removal.
  • Oversee facility budgets, contractors, and service agreements.

Qualifications of the Director of Operations Job in Naugatuck, CT:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of manufacturing operations experience, with progressive leadership responsibility.
  • Experience directly leading buyers, planners, and quality personnel. Working alongside these functions is not sufficient.
  • Proven experience leading purchasing and procurement, including pricing and contract negotiations.
  • AS9100 or ISO experience, including participation in or leadership of audits.
  • Hands-on experience with MRP and ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated success improving on-time delivery and reducing past-due orders.
  • Ability to clearly explain the specific actions you personally took to achieve measurable results.

Preferred

  • Domestic and international sourcing experience.
  • Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems, and familiarity with IBM iSeries.
  • Experience in precision manufacturing environments.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, CPIM, or CSCP certification.
  • Experience managing facilities and small construction projects.

Benefits
Our client offers a competitive compensation package and a comprehensive benefits package.

Equal Employment Opportunity

job.title: Electrical Engineering Technician
job.description:
Electrical Engineering Technician Job in Stratford, CT:
 Direct Hire
Salary Range: $60,000 to $70,000 per year
 

Our well-established client is a leading designer and manufacturer of electronic controls for commercial equipment. The company is looking for a hands-on Electrical Engineering Technician to join its engineering team. This is a great opportunity for someone with an electronics background who enjoys figuring out why things aren’t working and fixing them. You’ll work alongside a seasoned senior technician, learning from decades of product knowledge while supporting new product development in an in-house test lab.

Key Responsibilities of the Electrical Engineering Technician:

  • Retrofit new commercial equipment with the company’s electronic controllers for customer programs.
  • Evaluate the existing wiring on new equipment and rewire it to integrate with the company’s control panels.
  • Install and verify electronic controls on equipment, testing heating performance, temperature control, and overall function.
  • Load and update firmware and software using USB and flashing tools (JTAG, SWD, DFU).
  • Work safely with high-voltage equipment, including 120V, 240V, and 480V machines.
  • Instrument equipment, collect performance data, and tune machines to optimize performance.
  • Perform DVP&R testing and data collection to confirm controls meet product requirements.
  • Build prototype electronic circuits from schematics and verify functionality.
  • Troubleshoot electronic circuits and systems to identify root causes and resolve issues.
  • Participate in design reviews, including MCU controller and PCB layout evaluations.
  • Create test plans, reports, and bills of material.
  • Maintain electronic lab equipment and calibrations.

Qualifications of the Electrical Engineering Technician:

Required:

  • Ability to read and trace schematics and work with PCBs, MCUs, and electronic components.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting with oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and probes.
  • Soldering experience, including surface-mount (SMT) components.
  • Comfort working with high-voltage equipment.
  • Ability to read and understand equipment manuals.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions precisely in a team environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience wiring or repairing commercial equipment, appliances, or similar electro-mechanical systems.
  • Experience with firmware flashing tools and bootloaders.
  • Familiarity with data collection and logging tools, such as serial terminals and CAN analyzers.
  • Exposure to circuit design or testing of power supplies, AC/DC converters, and filtering circuits.
  • DVP&R or design verification testing experience.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary of $60,000 to $70,000
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off
  • Employee assistance program

job.title: Prototyping and Testing Laboratory Scientist
job.description:
Position Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Testing and Prototyping Laboratory Scientist to support formulation development, prototype preparation, analytical testing, and material characterization activities within a dynamic research environment. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy hands-on laboratory work, working with analytical instrumentation, and supporting scientific innovation by generating accurate, reliable data.
The successful candidate will work under general guidance while independently executing established procedures and maintaining a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment.

Key Responsibilities
• Prepare liquid, solid, and other required formulations and prototypes according to established procedures and instructions.
• Prepare analytical samples and operate analytical instrumentation (LC/MS and GC/MS) according to SOPs and experimental protocols with minimal supervision, analyze and interpret the resulting data.
• Perform basic maintenance and troubleshooting of LC/MS, GC/MS, and other laboratory instruments.
• Perform in vitro/ex vivo absorption assessments using the required equipment according to SOPs.
• Assist in preparing and reviewing SOPs for biological and analytical testing.
• Conduct material characterization and prototype testing using established analytical methods.
• Document experimental activities and maintain accurate laboratory records.
• Assist in routine calibration, waste management, and upkeep of laboratory instruments, apparatus, and equipment.
• Maintain laboratory organization, cleanliness, and housekeeping standards.
• Support other laboratory activities and projects assigned.
• Adhere to all laboratory safety procedures, policies, and regulatory requirements.

Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biology, Food Science, Nutraceutical Science, Pharmaceutical Science, or related scientific discipline.
• Ability to follow SOPs and perform routine laboratory assignments with a high degree of accuracy.
• Ability to draft and revise laboratory procedures with minimal guidance.
• Strong willingness to learn new analytical techniques and develop additional laboratory skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
• Strong computer proficiency and scientific documentation skills.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
• Demonstrated ability to follow instructions and maintain compliance with laboratory procedures.
• Self-motivated, adaptable, and proactive.

Preferred Qualifications
• Hands-on experience operating LC/MS and/or GC/MS instrumentation.
• Experience preparing analytical samples and conducting routine chemical analyses.
• Strong pipetting skills and experience with accurate, precise liquid handling for sample and assay preparation.
• Ability to interpret chromatographic data and identify analytical trends.
• Experience organizing, summarizing, and presenting experimental data.
• Experience drafting technical reports or experimental summaries.

Desired Attributes
The ideal candidate will be:
• Detail-oriented and highly organized.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced laboratory setting.
• Curious, eager to learn, and adaptable to new challenges.
• Safety-focused and committed to maintaining high laboratory standards.
• Able to balance routine analytical work with evolving research priorities.

job.title: Paint QC
job.description:
Painter / Quality Control Technician

Schedule: Monday – Thursday, 6:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Overtime: Available as needed

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Painter / Quality Control Technician to join a manufacturing operation specializing in metal components and finished products. This position is responsible for applying protective and finish coatings, preparing metal surfaces, mixing paint according to specifications, and inspecting completed products to ensure they meet established quality standards.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with industrial or automotive painting, strong attention to detail, and the ability to identify and correct paint imperfections in a fast-paced production environment.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Apply primer, sub-coatings, and finish coatings to metal components and finished products.

  • Perform surface preparation, including cleaning, sanding, masking, and repairing imperfections before painting.

  • Mix paints and coatings according to manufacturer specifications and required color standards.

  • Inspect painted surfaces for defects such as runs, drips, scratches, uneven coverage, orange peel, and color inconsistencies.

  • Perform quality checks to ensure proper paint coverage, thickness, finish, and overall appearance.

  • Identify paint defects and perform necessary touch-ups, repairs, or rework.

  • Monitor painting processes and ensure proper application and curing procedures are followed.

  • Maintain painting equipment, spray guns, and work areas.

  • Document quality inspection results and communicate defects or concerns to supervisors and production teams.

  • Follow all safety procedures when handling paints, solvents, chemicals, and other hazardous materials.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in industrial painting, automotive painting, or manufacturing preferred.

  • Knowledge of paint mixing, surface preparation, coating applications, and finishing techniques.

  • Ability to identify paint defects and perform quality inspections.

  • Familiarity with spray guns, painting equipment, and industrial coatings.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.

  • Ability to work independently and maintain production standards.

  • Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment and standing for extended periods.

  • Knowledge of proper PPE and chemical safety procedures.

job.title: Publication Coordinator
job.description:
The Publication Coordinator will work closely with Publication Managers, agency partners, and internal and external stakeholders to support the planning, coordination, tracking, and reporting of scientific publications and related deliverables.

This role supports the Scientific Communications & Information Sciences (SCIS) Department by maintaining publication records, coordinating project updates, managing documentation, supporting budgets, and facilitating communication across publication teams.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects and competing deadlines while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion of deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

Meeting & Publication Planning Support

  • Attend monthly publication team meetings, take detailed notes, and prepare meeting summaries.

  • Proactively update publication meeting agendas and follow up with team members to obtain project updates before meetings.

  • Assist Publication Managers in developing, updating, and maintaining publication planning presentations and slide decks.

  • Support additional publication planning and coordination activities as needed.

Scientific Congress Support

  • Assist with congress planning activities, including developing and maintaining presentation trackers, coordinating document circulation, archiving final materials, and supporting QR code processes.

  • Support the development of congress compendia for major scientific conferences.

  • Assist with abstract planning presentations and study statement slides.

  • Prepare ad hoc presentation materials, including post-congress activity and metrics slides.

  • Update slide repositories following the completion of congress presentations.

  • Provide additional congress-related administrative and project coordination support as assigned.

Publication Review, Tracking & Reporting

  • Coordinate document flow between internal stakeholders, external service providers, and agency partners.

  • Support joint venture and collaborative partner reviews, clearance processes, and independent manuscript reviews.

  • Track and report on internal and external publication projects, including those involving:

    • Academic research organizations

    • Cooperative research groups

    • Joint ventures and collaborative partners

    • Independent study initiatives

  • Maintain accurate journal and congress listings to support publication planning, tracking, and reporting.

  • Monitor publication timelines, project updates, and deliverables to support timely completion.

Publication Systems & Records Management

  • Create, update, maintain, and reconcile publication records within Datavision, a publication management platform.

  • Manage publication status updates, document uploads, quarterly record maintenance, and reporting through final publication.

  • Maintain accurate publication databases, documentation repositories, and archives.

  • Support publication compliance activities and ensure records meet established company standards.

Budget, Contracting & Administrative Support

  • Assist with medical communications agency contracting and budget tracking.

  • Coordinate reference requests, bibliography management, and delivery of study data packages or protocol documents.

  • Support quarterly record reconciliation and other administrative reporting activities.

  • Assist Publication Managers with additional project coordination and operational requests.

Microsoft Teams & Stakeholder Communication

  • Develop and maintain Microsoft Teams sites and channels for assigned therapeutic areas.

  • Manage Teams access requests and ensure appropriate organization of shared materials.

  • Communicate proactively with Publication Managers, agency partners, and internal and external stakeholders.

  • Follow up on outstanding deliverables, project updates, and documentation requests to ensure publication activities remain on schedule.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree (BS or BA) required.

  • 1–2 years of professional experience.

  • Experience in medical communications, scientific affairs, scientific research, or knowledge management preferred.

job.title: perations Manager / Financial Controller
job.description:
Operations Manager / Financial Controller Job in Watertown, CT:

Position Type: Direct Hire
Compensation: $90,000+ base salary, plus a performance-based bonus
Schedule: Full-time, onsite

Our well-established client is a small, privately held manufacturer and distributor serving industrial customers across North America. The company has a straightforward philosophy: work hard, take care of customers, solve problems, and have some fun along the way. The culture is informal and results-focused, and the team takes the business seriously without taking itself too seriously. The company is seeking a hands-on Operations Manager / Financial Controller to oversee daily operations, lead a small team, and keep the financial and administrative sides of the business running smoothly. This is not a desk-only role. It’s an opportunity for an organized, financially savvy leader who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, bringing structure to a fast-paced environment, and helping build the business over the long term.

Key Responsibilities of the Operations Manager / Financial Controller:

  • Manage daily operations and lead a small team responsible for bookkeeping, customer service, shipping and receiving, and inventory management.
  • Oversee QuickBooks, financial reconciliations, vendor true-ups, and commodity position adjustments.
  • Manage the company’s asset-based lending (ABL) facility, including bank reporting, borrowing base requirements, and bank audits.
  • Coordinate production services and support financial, ISO, and other compliance-related audits.
  • Maintain strong customer and vendor relationships, resolving issues promptly while protecting profitability.
  • Identify and implement technology and process improvements to increase productivity, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Set priorities, manage competing demands, and hold team members accountable for performance.
  • Take a hands-on approach to problem-solving and keep the business moving when priorities shift or unexpected challenges arise.

Qualifications of the Operations Manager / Financial Controller:

Required:

  • Proficiency with QuickBooks and strong knowledge of bookkeeping and financial management.
  • Ability to reconcile vendor accounts and true up commodity positions.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and financial acumen.
  • Technology savvy, with experience implementing tools and processes that improve productivity.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to adapt to change, manage competing priorities, and stay calm and effective in a fast-paced, small-business environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience in a commodity-driven business, such as metals, chemicals, or other raw materials.
  • Experience supporting ISO 9001 audits.
  • Background in a small or family-owned company where you wore multiple hats.

Benefits:

  • $90,000+ base salary plus a performance-based bonus
  • Healthcare coverage
  • 401(k)-type retirement plan
  • Paid holidays
  • Paid time off

job.title: Senior Manufacturing Design Engineer
job.description:
Senior Manufacturing Design Engineer in Hauppauge, NY:
Direct Hire
Salary Range: $120- 170,000

We are seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Senior Manufacturing Design Engineer with strong experience in metalworking, CNC and precision machining to support new and existing products from concept through production.

This role requires deep technical knowledge of turn/mill machining centers, grinding to tight tolerances, and CAD/CAM tools such as SolidWorks and SolidCam. The ideal candidate will bring a strong design and innovation mindset, creating and refining designs for new and existing metal or CNC-machined products, lead cross-functional projects, improve product designs for manufacturability, develop robust manufacturing methods, and work closely with suppliers to source high-quality components and services.

This is a great opportunity to join one of Long Island’s most secure and diverse manufacturers servicing a wide variety of markets with excellent growth opportunity.

Key Responsibilities of the Senior Manufacturing Design Engineer in Hauppauge, NY:

  • Create innovative designs for new metal and CNC-machined products, and continuously refine and improve existing product designs for performance, manufacturability, and cost.
  • Develop, document, and optimize manufacturing processes for precision metal components and assemblies.
  • Provide technical expertise in turn/mill machining centers, grinding operations, tooling, fixturing, and precision inspection methods.
  • Create and maintain manufacturing methods, routings, work instructions, setup documentation, and process controls to support efficient, repeatable production.
  • Lead projects from concept through implementation, coordinating activities across engineering, production, quality, and supply chain teams.
  • Design and redesign products, tooling, and processes with a strong focus on ease of manufacturing, cost effectiveness, quality, and scalability.
  • Use SolidWorks to support product and fixture design, and SolidCam to develop machining strategies and improve CNC programming efficiency.
  • Drive design innovation by exploring new materials, geometries, and machining approaches that improve product performance while reducing production complexity and cost.
  • Analyze production challenges, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve throughput, yield, and product quality.
  • Support grinding and machining operations that require tight tolerances, fine surface finishes, and consistent process capability.
  • Collaborate with production teams to improve workflow, reduce setup time, and standardize best practices.
  • Source components, raw materials, tooling, and outside services from qualified suppliers; evaluate supplier capabilities, quality, cost, and lead time.
  • Work with vendors and suppliers to support prototype development, new part introduction, cost reduction, and ongoing supply continuity.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to safety, quality, delivery, and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications of the Senior Manufacturing Design Engineer in Hauppauge, NY:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in a metalworking or precision machining environment.
  • Strong knowledge of turn/mill machining centers, CNC machining practices, grinding processes, and tolerance-critical manufacturing.
  • Proven ability to design and innovate new metal or CNC-machined products, translating concepts into manufacturable, cost-effective designs.
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks and SolidCam or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and guide cross-functional teams through implementation and process improvement efforts.
  • Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM), process development, and new product introduction.
  • Experience developing comprehensive manufacturing methods and process documentation.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and individuals across all levels of the organization.

A comprehensive benefits package will be offered which includes Medical, Vision, Dental, 401K, and paid time off.

job.title: Press Brake Operator
job.description:
Position: Press Brake Operator
Location: Henrietta, NY

Summary: Nesco Resource is partnered with a top-tier manufacturing company in Henrietta, NY seeking a highly skilled and technically proficient Press Brake Operator with a strong background in metal fabrication and sheet metal processing. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience setting up and operating press brakes, selecting appropriate tooling, interpreting mechanical blueprints, and producing precision-formed metal components to exact specifications. This position requires strong measurement and mathematical skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety and quality. Qualified candidates will be considered for a temp-to-perm or direct hire opportunity!

Pay Rate:

  • $25.00 - $32.00/Hour (Based On Experience)

Shift(s):

  • 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM, Mon. - Fri.

Job Duties:

  • Set up and safely operate press brakes and other production machinery to manufacture high-quality metal components.
  • Interpret blueprints and mechanical engineering drawings to determine forming requirements and dimensional specifications.
  • Select appropriate punches and dies based on material type and thickness.
  • Perform press brake setups, including basic CNC setup and control adjustments.
  • Work with sheet metal materials, including aluminum, steel, stainless steel, copper, and brass.
  • Inspect tooling for damage and ensure all equipment is safe and suitable for use.
  • Use precision measuring instruments, including calipers, height gauges, and radius gauges, to verify dimensions.
  • Perform mathematical calculations and fraction-to-decimal conversions to ensure accurate production.
  • Assist with machine qualification activities using hand tools and fixtures as needed.
  • Maintain consistent product quality while meeting production requirements and changing priorities.
  • Keep the work area clean and organized while following company safety procedures, quality standards, and applicable OSHA requirements.
  • Collaborate with team members to maximize productivity and efficiency.
  • Lift materials and finished products weighing up to 33 pounds manually or with a hoist.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience setting up and operating press brakes.
  • Strong background in sheet metal fabrication and forming.
  • Knowledge of press brake tooling, tool selection, and tool maintenance.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and mechanical engineering drawings.
  • Strong measurement skills and proficiency with fractions, decimals, and related mathematical calculations.
  • Ability to identify and work with different metal types, including aluminum, steel, stainless steel, copper, and brass.
  • Basic CNC knowledge and the ability to perform press brake setups.
  • Ability to read and use calipers, height gauges, and radius gauges.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to consistently meet dimensional and quality specifications.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and adapt to changing production needs.
  • Commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience operating Amada press brakes and working with Amada controls.
  • Experience in a precision metal fabrication or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift materials and finished products weighing up to 33 pounds, manually or with a hoist.
  • Ability to handle sheet metal and operate production machinery safely.
  • Ability to perform detailed work requiring precision, focus, and consistent attention to quality.

job.title: Inside Sales Representative
job.description:
Inside Sales Specialist (Manufacturing) Job in Cleveland, OH
Direct Hire Salary Range: $50-70,000 per year

We are seeking a detail-oriented and driven Inside Sales Specialist to join our manufacturing sales team. In this role, you will serve as a critical link between customers, outside sales representatives, and internal operations, managing the full quote-to-order lifecycle with accuracy, urgency, and professionalism. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment and a solid understanding of pricing fundamentals including margin and markup.

Key Responsibilities of the Inside Sales Specialist (Manufacturing) Job in Cleveland, OH

  • Handle inbound quote requests received via phone and email promptly and accurately.
  • Prepare, review, and issue customer quotations in alignment with pricing strategies, factoring in both margin and markup.
  • Process customer purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in pricing, part numbers, lead times, and shipping details.
  • Perform timely follow-up on open quotes to drive conversions and maintain customer engagement.
  • Issue and manage purchase orders to suppliers and internal production teams as required.
  • Follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders to confirm order acknowledgments, delivery schedules, and any changes.
  • Proactively communicate delays or discrepancies to customers and outside sales before they become issues.
  • Monitor and track open orders from placement through delivery, ensuring on-time fulfillment.
  • Provide customers with shipment updates, tracking numbers, and estimated delivery information.
  • Identify and escalate potential shipping or fulfillment issues in a timely manner.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for inbound customer inquiries, maintaining a professional and responsive communication standard.
  • Collaborate closely with outside sales representatives to support their accounts, relay key customer information, and ensure seamless handoffs.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, including production, shipping, and purchasing to resolve order-related questions and issues.
  • Maintain thorough and accurate records of all customer interactions, quotes, and orders in the CRM or ERP system.
Qualifications of the Inside Sales Specialist (Manufacturing) Job in Cleveland, OH
Required
  • 2+ years of inside sales, customer service, or order management experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Demonstrated understanding of margin vs. markup pricing concepts and their application in quoting.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, able to manage multiple open orders and quotes simultaneously without errors.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset.
  • Proficiency with ERP or CRM systems, and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word).
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize workload, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred
  • Experience supporting outside sales teams in a team-selling environment.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing lead times, BOM structures, or technical product specifications.
  • Background in reading and interpreting purchase orders, RFQs, and commercial terms.

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Machine Operator to join our production team. The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring various types of manufacturing equipment, including CNC lathes, spline rollers, grinders, and induction heat-treating equipment.

The ideal candidate will have a strong commitment to quality, safety, and productivity, along with the ability to follow instructions and maintain accurate production records.

  • Inspect parts for defects and ensure products meet quality standards.
  • Change machine tools and make adjustments as needed.
  • Monitor equipment for malfunctions or operating issues.
  • Make necessary machine adjustments to maintain required specifications and tolerances.
  • Measure and inspect finished parts according to work instructions.
  • Perform production data entry and maintain accurate records.

job.title: R&D Engineer
job.description:
Research & Development (R&D) Engineer

Location: Tulsa, Oklahoma
Employment Type: Full-Time | Direct Hire
Industry: Industrial Manufacturing / Engineered Equipment

Position Overview

A well-established manufacturer of industrial and heavy equipment is seeking an R&D Engineer to join its engineering team, focused on materials evaluation, mechanical performance, and product testing. This role plays a key part in evaluating material and thermal performance, supporting product reliability, and driving continuous improvement across current and future product lines within a lean manufacturing environment. This is a great opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving technical problems and contributing to products that perform in demanding, real-world conditions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct material and mechanical testing to support new product development and existing product improvements
  • Design and execute test plans to evaluate material performance, durability, thermal behavior, and failure modes under various operating conditions
  • Apply mechanical engineering principles to evaluate component design, stress, and performance under load
  • Analyze thermal dynamics and heat-related performance factors affecting product design and material selection
  • Document and report testing results, providing data-driven recommendations to engineering and product teams
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including design, manufacturing, and quality to resolve material- and performance-related issues
  • Investigate material and component failures and field returns to determine root cause and recommend corrective action
  • Support lean manufacturing initiatives by identifying process improvements, reducing waste, and improving testing efficiency
  • Stay current on materials science and mechanical engineering advancements, recommending new materials or processes where applicable
  • Support compliance with relevant industry standards and internal quality requirements
  • Maintain detailed, organized documentation of test procedures, results, and specifications
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or related engineering discipline (or equivalent hands-on experience)
  • Experience in materials testing, mechanical testing, or R&D within a manufacturing or industrial environment
  • Working knowledge of thermal dynamics and heat transfer principles as they relate to material and product performance
  • Familiarity with mechanical testing methods (tensile, fatigue, hardness, thermal cycling, etc.) and related lab equipment
  • Exposure to lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to interpret technical data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proficiency with standard engineering and data analysis tools
  • Comfortable working in both lab/testing and shop-floor manufacturing environments
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Opportunity to contribute to the design and reliability of industrial-grade products
  • Collaborative engineering team and supportive company culture
  • Professional development and growth opportunities

job.title: Human Resource Representative
job.description:
The Contract HR Onsite professional serves as the primary Human Resources point of contact for a manufacturing facility. In this role, the individual is responsible for delivering comprehensive, day-to-day HR support to site leadership and employees, with a strong emphasis on employee relations, workplace investigations, HR policy administration, and operational HR functions.

This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, requiring sound judgment, confidentiality, and the ability to navigate complex interpersonal and organizational dynamics. The Contract HR Onsite professional partners closely with corporate HR centers of excellence — including Talent Acquisition, Benefits, Payroll, and Legal — to ensure consistent, compliant, and people-first HR service delivery across the site.

Key Responsibilities

  • Employee Relations
    • Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the first point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, and workplace conflicts at the site.
    • Manager Coaching: Guide and coach site managers on handling performance issues, conduct matters, corrective actions, and difficult conversations.
    • Conflict Resolution: Facilitate resolution of interpersonal disputes and team dynamics issues in a fair, timely, and legally compliant manner.
    • Policy Guidance: Interpret and advise employees and managers on HR policies, procedures, and applicable employment regulations.
  • Workplace Investigations
    • Investigation Ownership: Conduct thorough, objective, and timely workplace investigations involving allegations of harassment, discrimination, retaliation, policy violations, and ethics complaints.
    • Documentation: Prepare comprehensive investigation reports documenting findings, witness statements, and recommended corrective actions.
    • Corrective Action: Recommend and support implementation of appropriate disciplinary measures in partnership with site management and Legal.
    • Confidentiality: Maintain strict confidentiality throughout all phases of the investigation process.
  • HR Operations
    • Onboarding & Offboarding: Administer site-level onboarding programs and manage structured offboarding processes including exit interviews.
    • Leave Management: Coordinate FMLA, personal leave, and disability accommodations in compliance with federal and state law.
    • Attendance & Timekeeping: Support attendance tracking and partner with supervisors on progressive discipline for attendance issues.
    • HRIS Administration: Maintain accurate employee records; ensure data integrity for headcount, status changes, and personnel files.
  • Compliance
    • Legal Compliance: Ensure site HR practices comply with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws including FLSA, Title VII, ADA, ADEA, FMLA, and NLRA.
    • Policy Administration: Implement and reinforce corporate HR policies and procedures across the site.
    • Audit Readiness: Support HR audits, recordkeeping requirements, and governmental reporting obligations.
  • Performance Management
    • Review Cycles: Support annual and mid-year performance review processes, ensuring timely completion and quality documentation.
    • Performance Improvement Plans: Partner with managers to develop and monitor PIPs.
    • Disciplinary Actions: Advise on and assist with documentation of verbal warnings, written warnings, and terminations.
  • Engagement & Culture
    • Employee Engagement: Partner with site leadership to design and execute employee engagement surveys, town halls, and recognition initiatives.
    • Culture Champion: Promote and reinforce company values, DEI goals, and a culture of respect and accountability.
    • Communication: Develop and deliver clear, consistent workforce communications on HR programs and site initiatives.
  • Data & Reporting
    • HR Metrics: Prepare and distribute regular HR reports covering turnover, headcount, ER case metrics, and other key performance indicators.
    • Records Management: Maintain compliant personnel files and ensure documentation standards are met across all HR transactions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Corporate Partnership: Collaborate with corporate HR, Talent Acquisition, Benefits, Payroll, and Legal functions for seamless service delivery.
    • Vendor & Agency Coordination: Manage relationships with staffing agencies and contract labor providers as needed for site workforce flexibility.

Qualifications

  • Required
    • Education: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
    • Experience: 3–5 years of progressive HR experience with demonstrated emphasis on employee relations and workplace investigations.
    • Legal Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of federal employment law (FLSA, Title VII, ADA, ADEA, FMLA, NLRA) and state employment regulations.
    • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to deliver difficult messages with empathy and professionalism.
    • Industry: Experience in a manufacturing, industrial, or operations-intensive environment strongly preferred.
    • Technology: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with HRIS platforms.
  • Preferred
    • Certification: PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification.
    • HRIS Systems: Experience with Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar enterprise HRIS platforms.
    • Bilingual: Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is a significant plus given site workforce demographics.
    • Contract/Consulting Experience: Prior experience in a contract or consulting HR capacity supporting multi-shift manufacturing operations.

Core Competencies

  • Conflict Resolution & Mediation: Proven ability to de-escalate conflict and facilitate fair resolutions.
  • Organizational Agility: Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Confidentiality & Discretion: Highest standards of integrity when handling sensitive employee matters.
  • Analytical Thinking: Data-driven approach to diagnosing HR issues and recommending solutions.
  • Independent Judgment: Ability to operate with minimal supervision and escalate appropriately.
  • Influence & Collaboration: Builds trust and credibility with employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Communication Excellence: Clear, concise, and effective communicator across written and verbal channels.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Seeks opportunities to enhance HR processes and employee experience.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Onsite Role: This position is fully onsite at a manufacturing facility. Remote work is not available for this role.
  • Production Floor Access: Must be comfortable walking the production floor and engaging with employees across all shifts, including first, second, and third shift as needed.
  • Physical Activity: Moderate physical activity including walking, standing, and occasional lifting of up to 15 lbs in the plant environment.
  • Environment: Standard combination of climate-controlled office space and manufacturing plant environment; PPE required on the production floor per site safety standards.
  • Schedule: Core business hours with flexibility to address urgent employee relations matters outside of standard hours as business needs arise.

job.title: Sr Data Center Project Manager
job.description:
Nesco Data Center is seeking a Sr Data Center Project Manager in the Greater Elk Grove IL area.

POSITION PURPOSE

The Senior Project Manager will take a leadership role in managing complex data center development and construction projects from the early planning and design stages through construction, commissioning, and final project turnover.

Acting as an Owner's Representative, this individual will be responsible for helping ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with established quality and operational standards. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with internal leadership, customers, consultants, contractors, and other key stakeholders throughout the life of each project.

This person will also be responsible for identifying and managing potential project risks, monitoring financial performance, providing updates to executive leadership, and helping guide and develop other members of the project team. The ideal candidate is a strong leader who can successfully manage multiple large-scale projects while helping improve processes and project delivery across the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage multiple data center development and construction projects simultaneously, from initial planning through final completion and turnover.

  • Serve as a key point of contact between customers, contractors, consultants, internal departments, and other project stakeholders.

  • Develop, manage, and monitor project budgets, forecasts, cash flow, and overall financial performance.

  • Create and maintain detailed project schedules, identify potential delays or risks, and develop plans to keep projects on track.

  • Work closely with design teams to ensure project designs support operational needs, customer commitments, and overall project goals.

  • Participate in vendor and consultant selection, procurement activities, contract negotiations, and change-order management.

  • Monitor construction activities to ensure projects meet expectations for safety, quality, schedule, and performance.

  • Oversee and coordinate commissioning activities and help ensure projects are properly prepared for operational turnover.

  • Prepare regular project updates and presentations for executive leadership covering financial performance, schedules, risks, and overall project status.

  • Partner with internal teams, including Finance, Legal, Procurement, Construction, and Operations, to support successful project delivery.

  • Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to Project Managers, Project Coordinators, and other members of the project team.

  • Help establish and improve project management processes, procedures, and best practices.

  • Travel to project locations as needed.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

  • Eight or more years of experience managing construction, development, infrastructure, or mission-critical projects.

  • Previous experience working for a general contractor, developer, or as an Owner's Representative is strongly preferred.

  • Experience supporting or managing data center projects is highly desirable.

  • Proven experience managing large, complex construction projects involving multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND COMPETENCIES

  • Strong knowledge of construction project management, budgeting, scheduling, project controls, and contract administration.

  • Comfortable working with project management and construction software, including tools such as Yardi, Procore, Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and Bluebeam.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to effectively manage contractors, consultants, vendors, and internal project teams.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

  • Ability to manage several complex projects at different stages simultaneously.

  • Comfortable working with and presenting information to senior and executive-level leadership.

  • Strong business and financial understanding, with the ability to evaluate project performance and identify potential risks or opportunities.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work at a computer and in an office environment for extended periods.

  • Ability to read and review construction drawings, plans, schedules, reports, and other detailed project documentation.

  • Occasional ability to lift and carry materials weighing approximately 10–20 pounds, including plans, samples, or field equipment.

  • Ability to communicate effectively in office, virtual, and on-site environments.

  • Ability to regularly visit and navigate active construction sites, including walking on uneven surfaces and climbing stairs when necessary.

  • Ability to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) while visiting project and construction sites.

  • Ability to work in varying environmental conditions, including heat, cold, noise, and dusty construction environments.

  • Ability to visually inspect construction progress, installations, and general site conditions.

Pay: $22.00–$28.00 per hour, based on experience
Shift: 1st Shift | Monday–Friday | 7:00 AM–3:30 PM

Job Summary

Nesco Resource is seeking a detail-oriented Quality Floor Technician to support a manufacturing facility's Assembly/Welding Department. This position is responsible for performing in-process and final quality inspections of fabricated, welded, and assembled components to ensure products meet engineering specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in manufacturing quality control, welding inspection, metal fabrication, or mechanical assembly. This individual must have a strong eye for detail, the ability to read and interpret blueprints, and the confidence to identify and communicate quality concerns directly with production personnel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform in-process and final quality inspections of welded components, fabricated parts, and mechanical assemblies.

  • Inspect welds for proper appearance, consistency, workmanship, and conformance to specifications.

  • Verify dimensions, fit, alignment, and overall assembly quality against engineering drawings.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, fabrication drawings, and technical specifications.

  • Utilize precision measuring instruments, including calipers, micrometers, tape measures, and other inspection tools.

  • Identify, document, and communicate quality defects, dimensional discrepancies, and workmanship issues.

  • Verify assemblies and fabricated components meet established quality standards and customer requirements.

Qualifications

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, weld symbols, and technical drawings.

  • Knowledge of welding processes and general weld quality standards.

  • Experience using precision measuring instruments and inspection equipment.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify workmanship and dimensional issues.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with production personnel and management.

  • Basic computer skills and ability to complete quality inspection documentation.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a commitment to producing quality products.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on quality professional with experience in welding, fabrication, or mechanical assembly who understands the importance of dimensional accuracy, weld integrity, and overall product quality.
