job.title: Critical Facility Engineer
job.description:
Data Center Building Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time
Schedule: 10-hour shifts | 4 Days On / 4 Days Off
Reports To: Facility Manager

We are seeking a skilled Data Center Building Engineer to support the daily operations, maintenance, and reliability of critical infrastructure within a high-availability data center environment.

This position is responsible for monitoring, operating, troubleshooting, and maintaining essential mechanical, electrical, and facility systems to ensure continuous uptime and optimal performance. The Building Engineer will also coordinate with outside vendors and contractors on specialized maintenance, repairs, and facility improvement projects.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with critical facility infrastructure, strong troubleshooting capabilities, and an understanding of the operational requirements associated with mission-critical environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and maintain critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure to support uninterrupted data center operations and reliable service delivery to colocation customers.

  • Perform routine facility inspections, monitor equipment performance, and ensure critical systems remain within established operating parameters.

  • Operate, troubleshoot, and maintain mechanical and electrical systems with a focus on reliability, efficiency, and cost-effective operations.

  • Utilize building automation and control systems to monitor and manage chilled water plants, HVAC equipment, cooling towers, water distribution systems, and fire protection systems.

  • Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance on mechanical, electrical, and environmental systems, identifying potential issues before they impact operations.

  • Assist with minor facility repairs and improvement projects involving plumbing, HVAC equipment, electrical distribution, and building structures.

  • Support troubleshooting, equipment repairs, and maintenance activities involving critical power and cooling infrastructure.

  • Coordinate and oversee third-party vendors and contractors performing specialized maintenance, repairs, inspections, and facility projects.

  • Recommend improvements to maintenance procedures, equipment reliability, and overall facility operations.

  • Follow established safety protocols and participate in ongoing safety training, technical development, and operational improvement initiatives.

  • Provide limited assistance with facility security-related responsibilities as needed.

  • Work collaboratively with the Lead Building Engineer and facility management to support daily operational priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of hands-on mechanical and electrical maintenance experience in a high-availability or mission-critical environment, such as a data center, manufacturing facility, hospital, or similar operation.

  • Working knowledge of commercial or industrial HVAC systems, electrical distribution, and mechanical infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with building automation systems, electrical controls, and pneumatic control systems.

  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, control ladder diagrams, blueprints, and equipment flowcharts.

  • Experience using diagnostic and testing equipment, including volt/ohm meters, alignment and balancing tools, refrigerant leak detectors, and refrigerant recovery equipment.

  • Understanding of critical infrastructure systems, including:

    • Parallel redundant UPS systems

    • Standby diesel generators

    • Large-scale chilled water and cooling systems

    • Automated building controls and associated troubleshooting

  • Ability to follow established maintenance procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.

  • Ability to work from ladders, personnel lifts, and elevated work platforms and lift or carry equipment and materials weighing up to 50 pounds.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree, technical certification, or formal training in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.

  • Previous experience supporting data center critical facilities or colocation environments.

  • Experience with electrical and pneumatic control systems.

  • CFC/EPA refrigeration certification or license.

  • Previous military experience, particularly in mechanical, electrical, or technical maintenance disciplines.

  • Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs and continuous improvement initiatives.

Work Environment & Schedule

  • Full-time position supporting a mission-critical data center campus.

  • 10-hour shifts on a rotating 4-days-on / 4-days-off schedule.

  • Hands-on work involving mechanical rooms, electrical equipment, cooling infrastructure, and other critical facility systems.

  • Requires adherence to established safety procedures and the ability to perform physical maintenance activities, including climbing, lifting, and working around industrial equipment.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This opportunity offers the ability to work directly with complex mechanical and electrical infrastructure in a mission-critical data center environment. The Building Engineer will gain exposure to sophisticated power and cooling systems while contributing to the reliability, efficiency, and continued operation of essential infrastructure.

We encourage candidates with strong mechanical and electrical backgrounds from data centers, healthcare facilities, industrial manufacturing, and other high-availability environments to apply

job.title: Global R&D Engineering Manager
job.description:
Global Research & Development Manager

Location: Open
Employment Type: Full-Time | Direct Hire
Industry: Industrial Manufacturing / Engineered Equipment

Position Overview

A growing industrial equipment manufacturer is seeking an experienced Global Research & Development Manager to lead product innovation, engineering development, and the advancement of thermal management technologies.

This leadership position will oversee the development of new products, improvement of existing designs, and execution of strategic R&D initiatives. The successful candidate will combine advanced technical expertise in heat transfer and mechanical engineering with proven experience managing engineering teams, product development programs, and cross-functional projects.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Development Leadership

  • Develop and execute R&D strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives.
  • Lead engineering research, product innovation, and technology development initiatives.
  • Identify emerging technologies, materials, and market trends that create opportunities for product advancement.
  • Establish product development priorities, technical roadmaps, and performance objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering and product development teams.
  • Oversee multiple development projects while ensuring timelines, budgets, and technical requirements are met.

Product Development & Engineering

  • Direct the design and development of industrial heat transfer equipment, cooling systems, and engineered mechanical products.
  • Oversee thermal modeling, engineering calculations, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), finite element analysis (FEA), and product performance testing.
  • Lead initiatives to improve product efficiency, reliability, durability, and manufacturability.
  • Review and approve engineering designs, specifications, calculations, and testing procedures.
  • Guide new product development from concept and prototyping through validation and production.
  • Evaluate opportunities for product optimization, cost reduction, and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales and Applications Engineering to develop customer-specific technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing to ensure products are designed for efficient production and assembly.
  • Work with Supply Chain and Purchasing on material selection, supplier qualification, and component sourcing.
  • Support Quality and Field Service teams in resolving technical and product performance issues.
  • Coordinate engineering initiatives across departments and locations as needed.

Compliance & Technical Standards

  • Ensure engineering designs and products comply with applicable industry codes, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of ASME, API, TEMA, AHRI, ISO, and other relevant standards.
  • Oversee technical evaluations related to pressure vessels, thermal systems, product safety, and certification.
  • Support environmental compliance and energy efficiency initiatives.

Budget & Resource Management

  • Develop and manage research and development budgets.
  • Allocate engineering resources across multiple product development initiatives.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, technical risks, and return on investment.
  • Establish performance metrics to measure engineering productivity, innovation, and product development success.
  • Mentor and develop engineering personnel while promoting technical excellence and accountability.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in thermal system design, heat transfer equipment, or industrial mechanical engineering.
  • 5+ years of engineering leadership, research and development management, or technical team supervision.
  • Strong technical expertise in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and mechanical system design.
  • Experience with pressure vessels and applicable thermal system compliance standards.
  • Demonstrated success developing and launching engineered industrial products.
  • Experience utilizing CFD, FEA, and engineering simulation tools.
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including welding, brazing, machining, and fabrication.
  • Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Experience with heat exchangers, industrial cooling equipment, condensers, radiators, or related thermal management systems.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex product development programs.
  • Knowledge of ASME, API, TEMA, AHRI, and ISO standards.
  • Experience with new product introduction (NPI), product lifecycle management, and design for manufacturability.
  • Experience supporting engineering activities across multiple facilities or international locations.
  • Background in industrial OEM manufacturing, energy, power generation, or thermal equipment applications.

Work Environment

  • Combination of engineering office and manufacturing environments.
  • Regular collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and executive leadership teams.
  • Travel required based on business and project needs.
  • Occasional additional hours may be necessary to support project deadlines.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Leadership role with significant influence over product innovation and engineering strategy

  • Develop and implement quality control measures to ensure product quality
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve manufacturing issues
  • Develop and maintain manufacturing documentation, including work instructions and process flow diagrams

Requirements of the Manufacturing Engineer Job in Long Island, NY:

job.title: Assistant Designer

Position Overview

The Assistant Designer supports the design, development, and execution of seasonal collections across Wholesale, Specialty, and Value channels. This position assists in all stages of the product creation process, from initial concept development through production, while ensuring alignment with brand aesthetics, customer preferences, and business objectives.

Working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, the Assistant Designer partners with Design, Merchandising, Technical Design, Product Development, and Production teams to support seasonal product assortments.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, creatively driven, and eager to develop design and product development expertise within a dynamic apparel organization.

Key Responsibilities

Design & Creative Support

  • Assist in developing seasonal concepts, color palettes, prints, fabrics, washes, and silhouettes aligned with brand aesthetics and business objectives.

  • Create and update sketches, technical flats, and artwork using Adobe Illustrator and other design tools.

  • Utilize AI-powered applications and emerging design technologies to support ideation, rendering, and product visualization.

  • Develop mood boards, inspiration presentations, trend reports, and seasonal concept decks.

  • Conduct trend, market, cultural, and competitive research using industry resources, retail analysis, social platforms, and market shopping.

  • Support fabric, trim, wash, and color development under the direction of Design leadership.

  • Organize and maintain seasonal inspiration materials, design references, and competitive product archives.

Product Development & Technical Execution

  • Create, update, and maintain technical packages (tech packs), including construction details, specifications, bills of materials (BOMs), and design comments.

  • Manage style information and product data within FlexPLM, ensuring accuracy throughout the development process.

  • Support sample development by tracking submissions, organizing samples, and communicating updates with cross-functional partners.

  • Participate in fit sessions, document feedback, track revisions, and coordinate follow-up actions.

  • Review development samples to ensure consistency with design intent, quality standards, and product requirements.

  • Monitor development calendars and assist in meeting key milestone deadlines.

  • Maintain accurate product documentation and style tracking throughout the product lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Merchandising to support assortment planning and seasonal line development.

  • Collaborate with Technical Design and Product Development teams to achieve fit, construction, and costing objectives.

  • Communicate with overseas vendors and factories regarding design updates, sample feedback, and development requirements.

  • Participate in seasonal reviews, line presentations, and product development meetings.

  • Assist in preparing materials and presentations for milestone reviews and leadership meetings.

Operational & Administrative Support

  • Maintain organized design files, seasonal records, sample inventories, and fabric and trim libraries.

  • Ensure FlexPLM, line plans, and internal tracking documents are updated accurately and on schedule.

  • Support market preparation, sample setup, photo organization, and presentation logistics.

  • Assist with seasonal archive maintenance and product documentation management.

  • Ensure design deliverables are completed accurately and within established timelines.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Design, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • 0–2 years of apparel design experience, including internships.

  • Experience or coursework in women's apparel, sportswear, denim, contemporary fashion, or related categories preferred.

  • Portfolio demonstrating creative design ability, product development knowledge, and technical proficiency required.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.

  • Understanding of garment construction, fit, fabrics, washes, and apparel product development processes.

  • Strong sketching, visual communication, and presentation abilities.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

  • Familiarity with collaboration platforms such as Miro.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered design and ideation tools, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Vizcom, or similar applications.

Professional Skills

  • Strong organizational and project management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with FlexPLM or similar Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.

  • Background in women's apparel, denim, sportswear, or contemporary fashion.

  • Familiarity with technical design, tech packs, garment specifications, and sample development.

  • Experience supporting seasonal collections and apparel product development.

  • Knowledge of fashion trends, fabric development, washes, and garment construction.

  • Interest in denim, heritage-inspired fashion, craftsmanship, and evolving consumer trends.

job.title: FMLA Administrator
job.description:
FMLA Administrator

Position Title: FMLA Administrator
Work Arrangement: 100% On-site
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 1st Shift (40 Hours Per Week)
Overtime Classification: Non-Exempt
Security Clearance: None Required; Ability to Obtain Clearance

Position Overview

The FMLA Administrator is responsible for administering and managing all aspects of the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) process, ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations while providing exceptional support to employees and management.

This position oversees employee leave requests, eligibility determinations, medical certifications, documentation, and timekeeping activities. The FMLA Administrator works closely with Human Resources, management, and employees to ensure consistent application of leave policies and accurate recordkeeping.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of FMLA regulations, excellent communication and organizational skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

FMLA Administration & Leave Management

  • Administer and manage all aspects of the FMLA process, including employee leave requests, eligibility determinations, and certification requirements.

  • Review and process FMLA documentation, including medical certifications and employee notifications.

  • Ensure compliance with federal and state FMLA regulations, company policies, and established procedures.

  • Provide guidance to employees and management regarding FMLA leave eligibility, requirements, and related policies.

  • Monitor approved FMLA leave usage and assist with maintaining accurate leave balances and records.

Compliance & Recordkeeping

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of FMLA requests, medical certifications, employee notifications, and leave activity.

  • Assist with monitoring and updating timekeeping systems to ensure accurate tracking and utilization of approved FMLA hours.

  • Conduct periodic audits of FMLA records and administrative processes to ensure regulatory compliance.

  • Identify opportunities to improve leave administration processes, documentation accuracy, and compliance procedures.

  • Stay informed of changes to FMLA regulations, applicable state leave laws, and industry best practices.

  • Maintain strict confidentiality and protect sensitive employee medical information in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Employee & Management Support

  • Serve as a resource for employees and management regarding FMLA policies, procedures, and leave-related questions.

  • Provide timely and professional assistance throughout the leave request and administration process.

  • Collaborate with Human Resources team members and supervisors to ensure consistent interpretation and application of FMLA policies.

  • Communicate leave requirements, documentation needs, and process updates to appropriate stakeholders.

  • Support resolution of employee leave-related questions and administrative concerns.

Training & Process Improvement

  • Deliver FMLA training and awareness programs to employees and management as needed.

  • Provide guidance to HR team members and supervisors regarding regulatory updates and compliance requirements.

  • Assist in identifying and implementing improvements to leave administration processes.

  • Support consistent application of company leave policies and procedures across the organization.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent required.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Knowledge of the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and related federal and state regulations.

  • Understanding of employee leave administration, eligibility requirements, and compliance procedures.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to maintain accurate records and handle confidential employee information.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with employees, management, and HR teams.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

Work Environment & Additional Requirements

  • Work Location: Fully on-site, five days per week.

  • Schedule: First shift, 40 hours per week.

  • Overtime Status: Non-Exempt.

  • Timekeeping System: Fieldglass.

job.title: Sanitation Assistant
job.description:
Sanitation Assistant

Nesco Resource is currently seeking a Sanitation Assistant for a long-time client in Ferndale, MI.

Shift

  • 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM, Monday through Friday
  • Overtime available based on production needs

Job Summary

The Sanitation Assistant is responsible for cleaning and sanitizing production equipment, work areas, and facility spaces to maintain a safe, clean, and sanitary manufacturing environment. This position requires attention to detail and the ability to work in a cold production environment.

Essential Job Duties

  • Retrieve cleaning chemicals from the designated storage area and prepare the foamer/sprayer as needed.
  • Apply cleaning chemicals to appropriate equipment and production areas using a foaming unit.
  • Remove leftover packaging materials and food products from production areas.
  • Pre-rinse equipment and surfaces using a water hose to remove food residue.
  • Apply soap using a mobile foaming unit and scrub equipment with the appropriate color-coded brush.
  • Thoroughly rinse equipment and surfaces to remove all soap residue.
  • Inspect equipment and work areas for cleanliness and re-clean as necessary.
  • Apply sanitizer using the designated sanitizer hose.
  • Clean and maintain floors, drains, walls, production areas, and exterior areas of the facility as directed.
  • Monitor production and facility areas for sanitation issues and report deficiencies to the Sanitation Supervisor.
  • Complete required sanitation inspection and audit forms.
  • Remove plastic wrap and unlock equipment as part of the sanitation process.
  • Perform general janitorial duties, including sweeping, mopping, emptying trash, wiping down surfaces, and cleaning and stocking restrooms, breakrooms, and common areas.
  • Assist with routine facility cleaning, including dusting, cleaning windows, and maintaining clean entryways.
  • Follow all company safety, sanitation, and chemical handling procedures.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

  • Must be comfortable working in cold temperatures, typically 40 F or below.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to regularly bend, reach, stoop, and perform repetitive cleaning activities.
  • Ability to safely handle cleaning equipment and chemicals.
  • Must be able to maintain a consistent pace while performing physically demanding cleaning tasks.

Qualifications

  • Previous sanitation, janitorial, food production, or manufacturing experience is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Willingness to work in a cold production environment.

job.description:
Electrical Engineer

Location: Tulsa, Oklahoma
Employment Type: Full-Time | Direct Hire
Industry: Industrial Manufacturing

Position Overview

A growing industrial manufacturing company in the Tulsa area is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to support the design, development, maintenance, and improvement of electrical systems and manufacturing equipment.

This position will focus on electrical system reliability, industrial automation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in industrial electrical engineering, controls, and power distribution within a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain electrical systems, control circuits, and power distribution equipment supporting manufacturing operations.

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve electrical issues involving production equipment, machinery, and facility systems.

  • Develop and improve preventive and predictive maintenance programs for electrical equipment and systems.

  • Support installation, testing, startup, and commissioning of new manufacturing equipment and electrical systems.

  • Develop and maintain electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.

  • Work with PLCs, variable frequency drives (VFDs), human-machine interfaces (HMIs), and industrial automation systems.

  • Ensure electrical systems comply with applicable NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and other safety requirements.

  • Coordinate with equipment suppliers, contractors, and outside service providers on electrical projects.

  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to maintenance technicians and production personnel.

  • Participate in capital improvement projects, equipment upgrades, and facility expansion initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce equipment downtime, improve operational efficiency, and optimize energy consumption.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.

  • Minimum of 3 years of electrical engineering experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment.

  • Strong understanding of industrial electrical systems, power distribution, and electrical controls.

  • Experience working with PLCs, VFDs, HMIs, and industrial automation equipment.

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD Electrical or comparable electrical design software.

  • Ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.

  • Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and applicable electrical safety standards.

  • Strong electrical troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, maintenance, and production teams.

The Compounder I is responsible for accurately weighing raw materials and manufacturing product batches according to established formulas and written procedures. job.title: Quality Technician- 1st Shift
job.description:
Quality Technician – Manufacturing

Location: Dublin, OH
Industry: Automotive Sheet Metal Fabrication
Schedule: Mon-Fri 8am-4:30pm OT as needed

About the Position

We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented, and experienced Quality Technician to join an automotive sheet metal fabrication company in the Dublin, Ohio area.

This position is responsible for inspecting and testing manufactured parts throughout the production process to ensure they meet quality standards, engineering specifications, and customer requirements.

The ideal candidate will have previous quality control or inspection experience in a manufacturing environment, strong blueprint reading skills, and proficiency with precision measuring equipment, including calipers, micrometers, and Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM).

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform quality inspections on raw materials, components, and finished products throughout the manufacturing process.

  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, schematics, and technical specifications.

  • Use precision measuring equipment, including calipers, micrometers, and CMM equipment, to verify product dimensions and tolerances.

  • Measure and inspect component parts, assemblies, and fixtures to ensure compliance with specifications.

  • Conduct in-process and final inspections to identify defects, inconsistencies, or deviations from quality standards.

  • Perform dimensional, mechanical, and other required product testing.

  • Record inspection results, measurements, and test data accurately.

  • Analyze quality data and prepare inspection reports to identify trends or potential issues.

  • Assist with implementing, maintaining, and improving quality control procedures.

  • Perform destructive and nondestructive testing on materials and finished products as required.

  • Communicate quality concerns and nonconforming products to production supervisors and engineering teams.

  • Recommend improvements to production processes and quality standards to reduce defects.

  • Maintain accurate quality documentation, inspection records, and electronic reports.

  • Follow all company quality procedures and workplace safety standards.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience in quality control, quality inspection, or a related manufacturing environment preferred.

  • Must be able to read and interpret blueprints and engineering drawings.

  • Must be proficient with calipers and micrometers.

  • Experience using Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of dimensional measurements, tolerances, and inspection procedures.

  • Experience inspecting fabricated metal parts or automotive components is a plus.

  • Familiarity with statistical quality control methods and inspection documentation.

  • Ability to identify product defects and accurately document findings.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude, analytical skills, and attention to detail.

  • Good communication skills and the ability to work with production and engineering teams.

  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and data entry.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining accuracy and meeting production demands.

Education & Experience

  • Associate degree or technical certification in Quality Control, Manufacturing Technology, Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred.

  • Two to four years of related quality inspection experience or training.

  • Equivalent combinations of education, technical training, and hands-on manufacturing experience will be considered.

Technical & Computer Skills

  • Precision measuring instruments, including calipers, micrometers, and CMM equipment.

  • Blueprint reading and interpretation of engineering specifications.

  • Dimensional inspection and close-tolerance measurements.

  • Statistical quality control and inspection reporting.

  • Working knowledge of CAD/CAM software preferred.

  • Microsoft Excel, Word, and electronic quality documentation systems.

  • Ability to enter, analyze, and maintain accurate inspection data.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, kneel, and perform repetitive inspection tasks throughout the shift.

  • Ability to regularly lift and move up to 50 lbs and occasionally handle materials weighing up to 100 lbs, with appropriate assistance or equipment.

  • Ability to visually inspect small details, dimensions, and product defects.

  • Good hand-eye coordination and ability to operate precision measuring instruments.

  • Ability to work safely around industrial machinery and manufacturing equipment.

Work Environment

This is a hands-on quality inspection position within an automotive sheet metal fabrication facility. The technician will work closely with production, manufacturing, and engineering teams to ensure parts meet established quality standards.

The position requires accuracy, strong attention to detail, and the ability to identify and communicate quality concerns before products move to the next stage of production.

job.title: Quality Control (QC) Technician
job.description:
PROCESS – QUALITY CONTROL (3RD SHIFT)

Pay Rate: $26.00 per hour
3rd Shift Premium: Additional $1.50 per hour
Total Hourly Rate: $27.50 per hour
Work Schedule: Sunday Evening through Friday Morning
Hours: 10:45 PM – 7:15 AM

Position Summary

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented 3rd Shift Process Quality Control (QC) Technician to support and maintain product quality throughout our manufacturing processes.

The primary responsibility of this position is to monitor, evaluate, and maintain quality control standards throughout plant operations. This includes supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of quality control and quality assurance programs to ensure products and processes consistently meet established company, customer, and industry standards.

The position will also be responsible for monitoring product quality, managing color consistency, identifying and addressing process deviations, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Additional responsibilities may include providing coverage and assistance in Quality Assurance and Color Design as business needs require.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Monitor and maintain quality standards for all manufactured products.
  • Ensure compliance with established color difference and color management standards.
  • Identify, document, and manage lot and color deviations across all products.
  • Evaluate finished products and determine acceptance or rejection based on established quality standards.
  • Operate injection molding equipment to produce color chips and verify product color data.
  • Produce and maintain color chips for each serial number/lot number.
  • Perform routine testing and measurements of process properties, including foreign matter, melt index, and other applicable quality characteristics.
  • Monitor and maintain the cleanliness, organization, and working conditions of the QC laboratory.
  • Evaluate color consistency and measure chromatic differences between production samples and established standards.
  • Maintain proper storage, organization, and documentation of color chips, sheets, and related quality records.
  • Perform basic equipment cleaning, maintenance, and troubleshooting as needed.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable ISO, IATF, and plant safety policies and procedures.
  • Clean and maintain machines and work areas while properly managing and disposing of production scrap.
  • Follow all company safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment and OSHA compliance.
  • Uphold the company's Jeong-Do Management (Code of Ethics) principles.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Shift Supervisor or designee.

Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to operate quality control equipment, including color detectors, melt index testers, injection molding machines, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Understanding of quality control principles, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of products and manufacturing processes to accurately perform quality inspections and testing.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines without compromising quality standards.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively in a team environment.
  • Ability to read, understand, and follow work instructions, procedures, and technical drawings.
  • Willingness and ability to learn new laboratory equipment, systems, and processes required for daily operations.
  • Flexibility to work overtime and adjust schedules as needed to support production requirements.
  • Dependable, positive attitude with strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Basic to intermediate computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 quality management system requirements preferred.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing operations, production processes, and related equipment.
  • Experience with polymer compounding, mixing, blending, and packaging processes preferred.
  • Strong basic math skills and the ability to analyze quality data, identify problems, and make sound decisions.
  • Experience with pigment management, color formulations, and production recipes preferred.

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Two or more years of Quality Control experience in a polymer manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Previous experience in manufacturing or production environments is preferred.
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

job.title: Production Technician I - 1st Shift
job.description:
Production Operator – Dyneema Manufacturing

Location: Mesa, AZ
Schedule: Monday–Thursday (4 Days per Week)
Shift: 1st Shift | 4:00 AM – 2:30 PM

Position Summary

We are seeking a dependable, safety-conscious, and detail-oriented Production Operator to support Dyneema manufacturing operations in Mesa, AZ.

This position is responsible for setting up, operating, monitoring, adjusting, and maintaining production equipment to manufacture high-quality products according to established specifications, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

The ideal candidate has previous manufacturing experience, strong mechanical aptitude, and the ability to troubleshoot equipment, maintain accurate production records, and work safely in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Candidates must have at least one year of manufacturing experience or equivalent military technical experience or training.

Essential Responsibilities

Manufacturing & Equipment Operation

  • Set up, operate, monitor, adjust, and clean manufacturing equipment according to established work instructions and SOPs.

  • Monitor production processes to ensure equipment operates safely and efficiently while meeting quality and production standards.

  • Perform equipment changeovers, machine setups, and routine cleaning procedures.

  • Adjust process settings within established limits to maintain product quality and specifications.

  • Read and interpret gauges, meters, dials, and equipment controls.

  • Identify equipment malfunctions and perform basic troubleshooting to minimize production downtime.

  • Complete minor preventive maintenance and routine equipment inspections.

  • Operate assigned production equipment and maintain proficiency in required manufacturing processes.

Quality Control & Production Documentation

  • Perform in-process quality inspections to ensure products meet established standards.

  • Collect and prepare samples of intermediate and finished products for quality testing.

  • Identify product defects, process irregularities, and potential quality concerns.

  • Maintain accurate production records, work orders, and equipment logs.

  • Enter raw material, component, and finished product information into computerized tracking systems.

  • Follow established production recipes, specifications, and quality requirements.

  • Communicate equipment, material, and product quality concerns to the team lead or supervisor.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to improve product quality, productivity, and manufacturing efficiency.

Material Handling & Inventory

  • Move raw materials, intermediate products, and finished goods throughout the manufacturing facility.

  • Operate material-handling equipment, including pallet jacks, forklifts, and overhead cranes.

  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels of raw materials, components, and production supplies.

  • Ensure materials are properly handled, stored, and tracked according to company procedures.

  • Perform manual material handling and heavy lifting as required.

Safety, Compliance & Housekeeping

  • Follow all Safety, Health, Environment (SHE), security, and company operating procedures.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe manufacturing environment.

  • Identify and report unsafe conditions, near misses, incidents, and potential hazards.

  • Follow applicable regulatory requirements, safety procedures, and manufacturing standards.

  • Handle hazardous materials and waste according to established safety and environmental procedures, when assigned.

  • Maintain required hazardous waste documentation and support inspections or emergency response activities as applicable.

  • Participate in safety investigations, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Job Safety Analysis (JSA) activities.

  • Follow company confidentiality, security, and intellectual property protection policies.

  • Participate in safety, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Complete required training and maintain current training records.

  • Perform additional manufacturing duties as assigned.

Education & Experience

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Minimum of 1 year of manufacturing experience, or equivalent military technical experience or training.

  • Experience operating, setting up, cleaning, or maintaining manufacturing equipment.

  • Ability to follow detailed work instructions, SOPs, and production specifications.

  • Basic mechanical aptitude and equipment troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of manufacturing safety procedures and quality requirements.

  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Access.

  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.

  • Ability to read gauges, meters, dials, and equipment controls.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify product defects or equipment issues.

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.

  • Ability to maintain accurate production records and documentation.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in textile, composites, or similar manufacturing environments.

  • Experience with manufacturing equipment changeovers and preventive maintenance.

  • Experience operating forklifts, pallet jacks, or overhead cranes.

  • Experience handling hazardous materials or working in safety-regulated manufacturing environments.

  • Familiarity with computerized production tracking and inventory systems.

job.title: Quality Assurance Technician - Industrial
job.description:
Description
This self-motivated individual is responsible for inspection of all products at Motion AI operations and conducting testing processes during and after manufacturing build to ensure that products comply with quality standards. They perform the following duties personally or through non-supervisory direct reports. Essential Duties and

Responsibilities:
1. Interprets engineering drawings and diagrams, confers with management or engineering staff to determine quality and reliability standards.
2. Dimensionally inspect raw material, finished parts and tooling to drawings, purchase order and applicable documentation using calipers, gauges and other required tooling.
3. Coordinate compliance with all applicable standards such as ISO 9000, and other applicable customer requirements.
4. Review product and process non-conformance and recommend actions including but not limited to modifications of processes, products or QA standards where warranted. Report to management on quality issues, trends and losses.

8. Conducts receiving inspection and testing as required.
9. Utilize standard mechanical instruments, functional gauges and test rigs and testing equipment.
10. Process associated documentation including process tags, rework tags and nonconforming material documents.
11. Provide technical expertise and transfer knowledge to other members of the operations.
12. Communicate daily with all departments.
13. Performs related duties assigned by supervisor.
14. Attend work regularly and predictably and uphold Company values in all work aspects.

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, drawings, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
Ability to speak and write effectively.
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Manufacturing software; Spreadsheet software and Word Processing software.
Will have a thorough knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, process improvement, and warehouse methods.
Must have strong verbal and written communication skills.
Must be a highly organized, self-motivated individual who can work independently and accountably and inspire high performance from a team.
Must be able to manage multiple tasks and priorities and easily adapt to changing situations.

job.title: Tig Welder- 1st Shift
job.description:
TIG Welder – Manufacturing

Location: Dublin, OH
Industry: Automotive Sheet Metal Fabrication
Schedule: Mon-Fri 8am-4:30pm OT as needed

About the Position

We are seeking a skilled, dependable, and detail-oriented TIG Welder to join an automotive sheet metal fabrication company in the Dublin, Ohio area.

This position involves TIG welding of sheet metal components used in automotive manufacturing. The ideal candidate will have hands-on TIG welding experience in a manufacturing or job shop environment, strong blueprint reading skills, and the ability to produce high-quality welds that meet precise specifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform TIG welding on sheet metal components according to blueprints and production specifications.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and welding symbols to ensure accurate fabrication.

  • Use precision measuring tools, including Vernier calipers and micrometers, to verify dimensions and weld accuracy.

  • Prepare metal surfaces and materials for welding, including cleaning, grinding, and positioning components.

  • Set up and adjust TIG welding equipment to achieve proper weld quality and consistency.

  • Inspect completed welds for quality, accuracy, and compliance with specifications.

  • Identify and correct welding defects or inconsistencies as needed.

  • Work with various metals, including steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, based on production requirements.

  • Follow established welding procedures, production schedules, and workplace safety standards.

  • Maintain welding equipment, tools, and a clean, organized work area.

  • Collaborate with production team members and supervisors to meet quality and productivity goals.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a manufacturing or job shop environment.

  • TIG welding experience required.

  • Must be able to read blueprints and interpret welding symbols.

  • Must be proficient with Vernier calipers and micrometers.

  • Formal welding education or training (such as Hobart or Edison) or equivalent hands-on welding experience required.

  • Experience welding sheet metal components strongly preferred.

  • Experience working with stainless steel and aluminum is a plus.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.

  • Ability to produce consistent, high-quality welds while meeting production standards.

  • Good communication skills, a positive attitude, and reliable attendance.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a manufacturing team.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.

  • Formal welding education, certification, or equivalent practical welding experience required.

  • Previous experience in automotive manufacturing, metal fabrication, or a job shop environment preferred.

Work Environment

This is a hands-on welding position within an automotive sheet metal fabrication facility. Associates will work with industrial welding equipment, metal materials, and precision measuring tools.

The position requires standing for extended periods, repetitive hand movements, bending, reaching, and handling metal components. Employees must follow all required welding safety procedures and use appropriate personal protective equipment.

  • Experience with heat-shrink tooling systems and CNC tool presetters.

  • Understanding of tool stick-out, gauge length, and tooling assembly requirements.

  • Ability to read and interpret tool lists, setup sheets, and tooling specifications.

  • Ability to identify damaged, worn, or improperly assembled tooling.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

Education & Experience

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in CNC tooling, machining, tool crib operations, machine setup, or a related manufacturing role.

Location: Dublin, OH
Industry: Automotive Sheet Metal Fabrication

About the Position

We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Shipping & Receiving Associate to join an automotive sheet metal fabrication company in the Columbus, Ohio area.

This position is responsible for receiving, inspecting, organizing, and shipping materials and finished products. The ideal candidate will have experience in a warehouse or manufacturing environment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to operate material handling equipment while maintaining accurate inventory and shipping records.

job.title: Manual Mill Operator
job.description:
Manual Mill Operator
Pay: $17.00 – $21.00/hour
Openings: 1
Shifts: 1st

The Manual Mill Operator will observe milling and plaining machine operation and adjust controls to ensure conformance with specified tolerances. This position reports directly to the designated shift supervisor.

Job Duties
Position and secure workpieces on machines, using holding devices, measuring instruments, hand tools and hoists.
Remove workpieces from machines, and check to ensure that they conform to specifications, using measuring instruments such as microscopes, gauges, calipers, and micrometers.
Verify alignment of workpieces on machines, using measuring instruments such as rules, gauges, or calipers.
Move cutters or material manually or by turning handwheels or engage automatic feeding mechanisms to mill workpieces to specifications.
Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.
Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.
Controlling operations of equipment or systems.
Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.
Monitor equipment operation to ensure that products are not flawed.
Verify conformance of machined work to specifications, using measuring instruments, such as calipers, micrometers, or fixed or telescoping gauges.
Study machining instructions, job orders, or blueprints to determine dimensional or finish specifications, sequences of operations, setups, or tooling requirements.
Change worn cutting tools, using wrenches.
Select and set cutting speeds, feed rates, depths of cuts, and cutting tools, according to machining instructions or knowledge of metal properties.
Install tools in spindles.
Understanding of required PPE (how to select and why it is required)
Exhibit proper donning of PPE daily
Report safety hazards to supervision/mgt.
Attend monthly all shop meetings
Requirements
Experience using hand tools
Ability to follow oral and written work orders
Active listening skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Desire to be proactive while creating a positive work environment
Ability to multi task effectively and prioritize as needed
Ability to adapt to changes adequately
Strong organizational skills
Attention to detail
Critical Thinking Skills
High school diploma or equivalent
Physical Requirements:
o The ability to respond quickly to sounds.
o The ability to see and respond to dangerous situation.
o The ability to wear personal protective gear correctly.
o The ability to stand continuously throughout the duration of the shift.
o The ability to lift 70 lbs
o The ability to withstand working in varying temperatures.

job.description:

*This is an onsite role in the Framingham, MA office*



Role Summary:



We are seeking three highly motivated Customer Outreach Representatives for a four-month temporary project supporting a strategic customer adoption initiative within our Accounts Receivable organization. In this role, you will conduct high-volume outbound calls to customers who have already been enrolled in our online payment portal but are not actively using it.



Your primary objective will be to educate customers on the benefits of the portal, encourage adoption and engagement, answer basic questions, and assist customers with registration and initial navigation. job.title: Maintenance Technician- 1st Shift
job.description:
Maintenance Technician – Industrial Manufacturing

Location: Dublin, OH
Industry: Automotive Sheet Metal Fabrication
Schedule: 8am-4:30pm OT as needed

About the Position

We are seeking an experienced, dependable, and mechanically skilled Maintenance Technician to join an automotive sheet metal fabrication company in the Dublin, Ohio area.

This position is responsible for performing preventive maintenance, troubleshooting equipment issues, repairing industrial machinery, and maintaining facility operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in industrial maintenance, mechanical troubleshooting, and electrical systems, with the ability to diagnose and resolve equipment problems efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform routine preventive maintenance (PMs) on manufacturing machinery and equipment to minimize downtime.

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.

  • Inspect and test machinery to identify equipment malfunctions, wear, or potential failures.

  • Disassemble, repair, and replace defective machine components, including motors, bearings, gears, and other mechanical parts.

  • Clean, lubricate, and maintain machinery to ensure safe and efficient operation.

  • Install, maintain, and repair electrical components, wiring, and industrial equipment.

  • Troubleshoot and repair hydraulic and pneumatic systems, including valves, gauges, regulators, and related components.

  • Use voltmeters, hand tools, power tools, and other diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve maintenance issues.

  • Perform basic welding, cutting, and fabrication repairs as needed.

  • Assist with facility maintenance, including minor plumbing, interior painting, and general building repairs.

  • Coordinate with production supervisors to identify equipment issues and minimize interruptions to manufacturing operations.

  • Assist with production and manufacturing activities when needed.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while following all safety procedures.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Experience troubleshooting 480-volt industrial electrical systems.

  • Knowledge of Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), including troubleshooting and basic programming.

  • Experience maintaining automated machinery, robotic equipment, or industrial control systems.

  • Ability to operate machine shop equipment, including lathes, grinders, drill presses, and milling machines.

  • Experience fabricating or repairing machine parts, fixtures, and tooling.

  • Knowledge of industrial electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of industrial maintenance experience required.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and proven troubleshooting abilities.

  • Must be able to use a voltmeter and general shop tools.

  • Experience performing preventive maintenance and repairing industrial machinery.

  • Ability to identify equipment malfunctions and complete repairs efficiently.

  • Electrical experience with 480-volt systems is a plus.

  • PLC troubleshooting or programming experience is a plus.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to workplace safety.

  • Good communication skills, a positive attitude, and reliable attendance.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with production and maintenance teams.

  • Must be willing to assist with production and manufacturing operations when needed.

  • Must be able to meet applicable pre-employment drug screening and background check requirements.

  • Must be local to the Columbus, Ohio area.

Education & Experience

  • Technical school certification or training in industrial maintenance, electrical systems, or a related field preferred.

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on industrial maintenance experience required.

  • Equivalent combinations of technical education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, climb, and perform physical maintenance tasks throughout the shift.

job.title: Industrial/Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Engineer

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Thursday | On-Site
Eligible candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. WITHOUT current OR future sponsorship.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive Salary: $90,000–$130,000 annually, depending on experience

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

401(k) with Company Match

Paid Vacation, Personal Time & Holidays

Life & Disability Insurance

Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Ongoing Training & Career Growth Opportunities

Design the Process. Improve the Flow. Build for Growth.

We're seeking an experienced Industrial Engineer to improve manufacturing processes, production flow, facility layout, and equipment strategy within a high-volume industrial manufacturing environment.

This role has a strong focus on Manufacturing BOMs (MBOMs), plant and production-line layout, custom tooling, capacity planning, and capital equipment procurement. You'll work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, R&D, Quality, and Operations to improve productivity, eliminate bottlenecks, and prepare the operation for future growth.

What You'll Own

Manufacturing Flow & Layout

  • Analyze and optimize production-floor layouts to improve workflow, material movement, and overall efficiency.
  • Develop production-line and process layouts that support safe, efficient manufacturing.
  • Identify bottlenecks, unnecessary movement, capacity constraints, and other sources of production inefficiency.
  • Develop and improve process flows to reduce cycle time and material handling.
  • Plan the integration and placement of new machinery and equipment.
  • Maintain accurate layouts, process-flow documentation, and operational standards.

MBOM & Manufacturing Engineering

  • Develop and maintain Manufacturing Bills of Materials (MBOMs) and related manufacturing documentation.
  • Translate product requirements into practical manufacturing processes and production structures.
  • Work with Engineering and R&D to ensure new products can be efficiently manufactured.
  • Identify differences between engineering product structures and manufacturing requirements.
  • Support new product introduction activities by establishing manufacturing processes and readiness requirements.
  • Improve documentation, standard work, SOPs, and production guidelines.

Tooling & Equipment Engineering

  • Develop and support custom tooling, fixtures, and equipment used throughout manufacturing.
  • Evaluate equipment capabilities and identify opportunities for automation or process improvement.
  • Coordinate equipment installation and integration while minimizing disruption to production.
  • Research and evaluate machinery based on production requirements, capacity, capability, and long-term value.
  • Support vendor evaluations, equipment testing, and technical assessments.
  • Help establish FAT/SAT requirements for new automated or semi-automated equipment.

CAPEX & Capacity Planning

  • Evaluate future production requirements and identify equipment or facility investments needed to support growth.
  • Develop business cases and ROI analyses for capital equipment and manufacturing improvements.
  • Work with leadership to prioritize capital projects based on capacity, cost, productivity, and operational needs.
  • Coordinate with equipment vendors on technical requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify and manage risks associated with long-lead-time machinery.
  • Support equipment procurement strategies during new product introduction and expansion projects.

Lean & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead initiatives focused on improving productivity, reducing waste, and increasing manufacturing efficiency.
  • Apply Lean principles including 5S, Value Stream Mapping, and line balancing.
  • Analyze production data and investigate root causes of process inefficiencies.
  • Develop and implement corrective actions and process improvements.
  • Evaluate equipment utilization, labor efficiency, cycle times, and production capacity.
  • Measure improvement results and identify opportunities for additional gains.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, R&D, Quality, and Operations on process and equipment improvements.
  • Collaborate with product development teams to ensure new designs are practical to manufacture.
  • Provide technical input on manufacturing feasibility, equipment requirements, tooling, and production flow.
  • Help resolve production issues involving equipment, process flow, capacity, or manufacturability.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Support strategic manufacturing initiatives as the organization continues to grow.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline; Master's degree is a plus

5+ years of experience in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, process optimization, or a similar production-focused role

Strong experience with manufacturing layout, process flow, production systems, and capacity planning

Experience developing or managing MBOMs and understanding the differences between EBOM and MBOM structures

Experience with CAPEX projects, equipment ROI analysis, machinery procurement, and vendor management

Experience with custom tooling, fixtures, production equipment, or manufacturing equipment integration

Practical knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Value Stream Mapping, and line balancing

Experience managing long-lead-time equipment requirements during new product introduction or manufacturing expansion

Experience establishing or supporting FAT/SAT protocols for automated or semi-automated equipment

Familiarity with CAD and engineering tools used for facility layouts, process flow, and tooling design

Experience with PLM/ERP systems and manufacturing engineering documentation

Lean Six Sigma or other continuous-improvement experience is a plus

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project coordination skills

Ideal Industry Background

We're especially interested in professionals with experience in:

  • Industrial Manufacturing
  • Heat Exchanger Manufacturing
  • HVAC & Thermal Equipment
  • Metal Fabrication
  • Engineered Equipment
  • Custom Manufacturing
  • Heavy Manufacturing
  • Automated Production
  • Equipment Integration
  • New Product Introduction
  • Data Center Cooling Production
     

You'll Excel Here If You...

  • Enjoy figuring out how a manufacturing operation can run faster, smarter, and more efficiently.
  • Think in terms of flow, capacity, equipment, labor, and material movement.
  • Can take a manufacturing problem and turn it into a practical engineering solution.
  • Are comfortable working with both production personnel and senior leadership.
  • Understand that good manufacturing engineering has to work on the shop floor—not just on paper.
  • Enjoy managing projects involving equipment, vendors, tooling, and facility changes.
  • Naturally look ahead and identify capacity or equipment needs before they become production problems.

Work Environment

This position is based within an active industrial manufacturing environment and requires regular interaction with the production floor. The facility may include machinery, fabrication activities, elevated noise, dust, metal particles, and other typical manufacturing conditions.

Appropriate PPE is required in designated production areas. The role may involve extended periods of standing and walking throughout the facility, along with occasional bending, climbing, kneeling, stooping, and accessing production equipment.

Schedule & Travel

Schedule: Monday–Thursday, 5:00 AM–3:30 PM

Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on business needs.

Travel: Occasional travel may be required for vendor selection, equipment evaluations, audits, and related manufacturing projects.

job.title: Senior Cybersecurity Risk & Compliance Analyst
job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced cybersecurity professional to help identify, assess, and manage information security risks across the organization. This individual will work closely with IT teams, business leaders, security professionals, and third-party vendors to strengthen cybersecurity practices, maintain compliance, and support risk mitigation efforts.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in IT risk management, security assessments, regulatory compliance, and cybersecurity frameworks. This role requires someone who can understand technical security concerns and communicate their business impact to leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Risk Management

  • Conduct comprehensive cybersecurity risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies.

  • Identify security gaps across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and business systems.

  • Provide recommendations to reduce cybersecurity exposure and improve security controls.

  • Support security reviews for new applications, technologies, and system enhancements.

Security Governance & Compliance

  • Interpret and apply cybersecurity standards, including NIST, CIS, OWASP, and PCI DSS.

  • Support internal security assessments, corporate audits, and remediation activities.

  • Ensure security requirements are incorporated into business processes and technology initiatives.

  • Monitor compliance with internal security policies and industry regulations.

Business & Technology Collaboration

  • Partner with business executives, IT leadership, and technology teams to address cybersecurity risks.

  • Communicate security findings, recommendations, and outstanding risks to leadership.

  • Serve as a cybersecurity subject matter expert for assigned business units.

  • Participate in architectural reviews to identify security concerns before implementation.

Third-Party & Vendor Risk Management

  • Assess cybersecurity risks associated with third-party vendors and service providers.

  • Support supplier risk assessments and remediation efforts.

  • Assist with security-related contract reviews and vendor compliance requirements.

Vulnerability Management & Incident Response

  • Support threat and vulnerability management across applications, networks, and cloud environments.

  • Review vulnerability findings and work with technical teams to prioritize remediation.

  • Support cybersecurity incident response activities alongside the internal CSIRT.

  • Develop risk reports to help leadership understand vulnerabilities and remediation progress.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of overall professional experience, with at least 6 years in IT and 5 years in cybersecurity or IT risk management.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong experience conducting cybersecurity risk assessments and developing mitigation plans.

  • Experience with IT risk management, information security governance, and compliance.

  • Working knowledge of NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS, OWASP, and PCI DSS.

  • Understanding of network security, operating systems, applications, and security controls.

  • Experience evaluating security risks involving:

    • Azure cloud environments

    • SaaS platforms, including Salesforce

    • Web applications and eCommerce systems

    • Mobile applications

    • Agile and DevSecOps development environments

  • Experience supporting third-party risk assessments and vulnerability management.

  • Ability to communicate technical cybersecurity risks to business executives and IT leadership.

  • Strong written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Desired Certifications

  • CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional

  • CISM – Certified Information Security Manager

  • CRISC – Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control

  • Comparable cybersecurity or risk management certification

job.title: Production Associate- 3rd Shift
job.description:
Production Associate – 3rd Shift

Location: Dublin, OH
Industry: Automotive Sheet Metal Fabrication
Schedule: Sunday–Thursday | 11:30 PM – 8:00 AM
Training: Must be available to train on 1st shift for 1–2 months before transitioning to 3rd shift.

About the Position

We are seeking dependable, motivated, and detail-oriented Production Associates to join an automotive sheet metal fabrication company in the Dublin, Ohio area.

This position involves operating manufacturing equipment to produce sheet metal and light rail components according to specifications. The ideal candidate will have previous manufacturing or job shop experience, strong mechanical aptitude, and the ability to work safely in a fast-paced production environment.

Important: Candidates must be available to complete 1–2 months of training on 1st shift before transitioning to the regular 3rd shift schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate production equipment, including spot welders, presses, shears, and other metal fabrication machinery.

  • Load, position, and remove sheet metal and fabricated parts from machines.

  • Move, stack, and transport raw materials, tools, and finished products.

  • Assist with material handling using forklifts and overhead cranes, as trained and authorized.

  • Clean, grind, and prepare metal parts for fabrication, welding, painting, or shipping.

  • Inspect finished products for quality, accuracy, and compliance with specifications.

  • Read and follow work instructions, blueprints, and production documentation.

  • Remove scrap materials and maintain a clean, organized work area.

  • Follow all workplace safety procedures and production standards.

Additional responsibilities for experienced associates may include:

  • Setting up and adjusting fabrication equipment, including press brakes, drill presses, shears, and cutting machines.

  • Using hand tools, hammers, and grinders to modify fabricated metal parts.

  • Planning and organizing production sequences to meet specifications.

  • Operating specialized equipment, including plasma cutters, flame cutters, and bandsaws.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a manufacturing, production, or job shop environment.

  • Must be able to use calipers and micrometers to measure parts accurately.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.

  • Experience with sheet metal fabrication, stamping, welding, or blueprint reading is a plus.

  • Ability to follow instructions and work independently or as part of a team.

  • Good communication skills, a positive attitude, and reliable attendance.

  • Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive tasks.

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs consistently.

  • Must be available to train on 1st shift for 1–2 months before moving to 3rd shift.

  • Must be comfortable working overnight hours once training is completed.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.

  • One to three years of related manufacturing experience or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Work Environment

This is a hands-on manufacturing position within an automotive sheet metal fabrication facility. Associates will work with industrial machinery, sheet metal materials, and fabrication equipment.

The position requires standing, walking, bending, reaching, repetitive movements, and regular lifting throughout the shift. Employees must follow all required safety procedures and maintain a strong focus on quality and productivity.

job.title: Scrap Burner
job.description:
Scrap Burner

Pay: $18.00–$21.00 per hour

We are looking for a dependable, hardworking Scrap Metal Burner / Torch Operator to join our team!

The Burner is responsible for operating industrial cutting torches to dismantle and cut various sizes and shapes of unprepared steel into manageable scrap pieces. This position requires physical strength, attention to safety, and the ability to work outdoors year-round in changing weather conditions.

Job Responsibilities

  • Operate commercial cutting torches to cut and prepare scrap metal.
  • Cut and process steel of various sizes and shapes.
  • Perform general maintenance and upkeep of equipment and yard property.
  • Keep work areas clean, organized, and free of fire and trip hazards.
  • Inspect equipment and report abnormal conditions to supervisors.
  • Follow all company safety rules and regulations.
  • Properly select, wear, and maintain required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Report safety concerns and hazards to management.
  • Attend monthly safety and shop meetings.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Previous experience operating a commercial cutting torch is required.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding manual labor.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 80 pounds.
  • Ability to sort and move materials weighing between 3 and 80 pounds.

This position involves operating manufacturing equipment to produce sheet metal and light rail components according to specifications. Ideal candidates will have previous manufacturing or job shop experience, strong mechanical aptitude, and the ability to work safely in a fast-paced production environment.

job.title: Refugee Medical Assistance Claims and Eligibility Specialist
job.description:
Claims and Eligibility Specialist
Arizona Refugee Resettlement Program

Position Summary

The Claims and Eligibility Specialist supports the Arizona Refugee Resettlement Program (RRP) by processing medical, dental, and vision claims and determining eligibility for Refugee Medical Assistance (RMA) benefits. Reporting to the Human Services Program Development Supervisor, this position performs high-volume data entry, reviews claims and supporting documentation, coordinates with healthcare providers, and maintains accurate, confidential records.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process and adjudicate medical, dental, and vision claims using CMS-1500, UB-04, and ADA Dental claim forms in accordance with agency procedures and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services guidelines.

  • Review benefit eligibility and process prior authorization and dental pre-treatment estimate requests for consultant review.

  • Enter and verify high volumes of claims data from paper documents into electronic systems while meeting quality and production standards.

  • Research complex claims, review payment history for duplicates, identify third-party liability, and obtain missing documentation.

  • Request medical records, consent forms, explanations of benefits, and other supporting information from providers.

  • Link supplemental documentation to claims and process claim corrections, recoupments, voids, and prior authorization reprocessing.

  • Identify system processing issues and report potentially inappropriate billing patterns to the appropriate audit or fraud unit.

  • Communicate with providers regarding claims, billing, credentialing, eligibility, and RMA program requirements.

  • Use WellSky to generate remittance, payment voucher, and claims packets for Accounts Payable submission following authorized approval.

  • Prepare program reports and maintain data needed for assessment, analysis, and reporting.

  • Assist with developing or improving program procedures, forms, policies, and systems.

  • Coordinate administrative activities with other departments, community organizations, and external partners.

  • Support research into funding and resources for refugee resettlement and integration efforts.

Document and Records Management

  • Prepare paper documents for scanning by sorting, batching, removing staples and clips, and repairing pages as needed.

  • Scan documents, verify data and image quality, and rescan rejected or unclear images.

  • Record assigned document numbers and organize files for retrieval and archiving.

  • Maintain paper and electronic client records in accordance with confidentiality and HIPAA guidelines.

  • Report scanning equipment issues and route unprocessed mail appropriately.

Primary Areas of Responsibility

  • Claims processing, eligibility determinations, and provider communication: 65%

  • Reporting and procedure improvements: 15%

  • Confidential client records management: 10%

  • Funding and resource research: 5%

  • Additional RMA administrative support: 5%

Relevant Knowledge and Skills

  • Medical claims processing and supporting documentation

  • CMS-1500, UB-04, and ADA Dental claim forms

  • Eligibility review, prior authorizations, and third-party liability

  • Accurate, high-volume data entry

  • Electronic records management and document scanning

  • WellSky, Google Workspace, and departmental database systems

  • Research, report preparation, and written correspondence

  • Provider communication and cross-department coordination

  • HIPAA and client confidentiality requirements

Driving Requirements

If driving is an essential function of the position, applicable State driver’s license requirements apply.
