job.title: Laboratory Execution System (LES) Developer - BIOVIA
job.description:
Laboratory Execution System (LES) Developer – BIOVIA

Position Summary

We are seeking a Laboratory Execution System (LES) Developer to support an 18-month laboratory digital transformation project. This position will focus on implementing BIOVIA Laboratory Execution software to replace an existing legacy system and modernize laboratory testing processes.

The developer will work closely with laboratory Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Quality Control (QC), and Commercial teams to convert existing laboratory procedures, testing methods, and recipes into electronic workflows within BIOVIA.

The ideal candidate has a technical background, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to understand laboratory processes and translate them into structured system configurations. Previous BIOVIA experience is beneficial but not required.

Key Responsibilities

BIOVIA System Development and Configuration

  • Build and configure laboratory materials, testing assays, recipes, and master data within BIOVIA Laboratory Execution.

  • Convert existing laboratory procedures into standardized electronic workflows.

  • Support the transition from legacy laboratory systems to the new BIOVIA platform.

  • Develop logical data structures that support laboratory testing and QC operations.

Collaboration with Laboratory Teams

  • Work directly with laboratory SMEs to understand existing testing procedures.

  • Follow a structured three-step development process:

    1. Meet with SMEs to review and document laboratory procedures.

    2. Build and configure the corresponding master data and electronic workflows in BIOVIA.

    3. Review the electronic workflows with SMEs, make necessary adjustments, and support testing, approval, and deployment.

  • Coordinate with global QC and Commercial teams to ensure consistency across laboratory processes.

Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Develop and execute testing plans to validate electronic laboratory workflows.

  • Identify, document, and resolve system configuration issues.

  • Verify that electronic procedures accurately reflect approved laboratory methods.

  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT), final approvals, and deployment.

  • Maintain documentation of testing results, configurations, and process improvements.

  • Ensure workflows align with applicable laboratory quality standards and established procedures.

Additional Project Responsibilities

  • Support the development of reagent preparation workflows.

  • Configure cell culture procedures and related laboratory recipes.

  • Assist with additional laboratory processes as the BIOVIA implementation progresses.

Required Qualifications

  • 0–5 years of relevant technical or software experience.

  • Foundational knowledge of laboratory software environments or similar technical systems.

  • Strong logical thinking, analytical skills, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to understand processes and translate requirements into structured system configurations.

  • Experience working with data structures, system configurations, or software workflows.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Ability to work through an iterative development, testing, and deployment process.

  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with BIOVIA Laboratory Execution software.

  • Experience with other Laboratory Execution Systems (LES).

  • Familiarity with CISPRO reagent management.

  • Experience working in a laboratory, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or Quality Control environment.

  • Understanding of laboratory assays, reagent preparation, or cell culture processes.

  • Experience with software testing, automated testing tools, or UAT.

job.title: Maintenance Technician - Industrial
job.description:
Maintenance Technician

A well-established industrial manufacturing facility is hiring a Maintenance Technician/Mechanics to support production equipment, overhead crane systems, and facility operations. This is a highly hands-on role for a strong industrial maintenance tech who enjoys troubleshooting, repairing, and keeping heavy equipment running safely and reliably.

Pay & Benefits

  • Competitive Pay: $25–$30/hour

  • Type: Contract-To-Hire with conversion following 90+ days with company (based on attendance and performance) 

  • Benefits Following Conversion: Medical, Dental, Vision (MEC plan), plus EAP, 401(k)

What You’ll Do

  • Equipment Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnose and repair electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems on industrial production equipment and cranes.

  • Overhead Crane Support: Inspect, troubleshoot, and support crane systems and related components.

  • Preventive Maintenance: Perform scheduled PMs, inspections, and corrective actions.

  • Electrical Work: Troubleshoot industrial electrical systems, including 480V.

  • Mechanical & Fabrication: Repair components and fabricate parts using machine tools.

  • Pumps, Piping & Compressors: Repair and replace piping, fittings, pumps, and air systems.

  • Facility Maintenance: Support carpentry, plumbing, and general building maintenance as needed.

  • Documentation & CMMS: Complete work orders and maintain technical records (schematics, drawings, photos).

  • Safety & Production Support: Communicate equipment issues impacting safety, quality, or production and follow all PPE and safety standards.

  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with maintenance, engineering, quality, and operations to improve reliability and efficiency.

What We’re Looking For

  • Industrial Maintenance Experience: 4+ years in a heavy manufacturing or industrial environment.

  • Electrical Troubleshooting: Strong experience with industrial electrical systems (up to 480V).

  • Mechanical Systems: Hands-on experience with hydraulic and pneumatic systems.

  • Crane & Lifting Equipment: Experience working with overhead cranes and related controls.

  • Blueprints & Schematics: Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and manuals.

  • Welding & Fabrication: Comfortable using welding equipment and shop tools.

  • CMMS / Work Orders: Experience using a maintenance system to track work and PMs.

  • CNC Exposure (Preferred): Experience supporting CNC machines is a strong plus.

  • Material Handling: Forklift certification (or ability to obtain – company provided).

Available Shifts

  • Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:
    This is a full-time position with various shifts and locations (Tulsa/Claremore). Days, nights and weekend shifts available.

job.title: 1st Shift Production Operator
job.description:
A Production Operator for Webasto Roof Systems supporting BMW (operating on-site or just-in-sequence near the Greer/Greenville plant) is responsible for assembling, inspecting, and sequencing panoramic sunroof and roof modules before they are installed onto the vehicle line.

Because Webasto operates as a Tier-1 Just-in-Time (JIT) / Just-in-Sequence (JIS) supplier, work is fast-paced and directly tied to BMW's build schedule.

Core Assembly & Mechanical Work

  • Mechanical Sub-Assembly: Assemble sunroof cassettes, roller blinds/sunshades, drainage channels, mounting brackets, drive cables, and electric drive motors using torque-controlled screwdrivers and pneumatic tools.
  • Sealing & Priming: Apply weatherstripping, specialized seals, and urethane primers or adhesives along glass and frame edges.
  • Electrical Routing: Clip and secure wiring harnesses and connect sensors/actuators to ensure power and switch signals integrate smoothly with BMW's CAN bus network.
Testing, Alignment & Quality Control
  • Cycle & Function Testing: Place assembled roofs into automated test fixtures to cycle glass open/tilt/close motions, verify limit switches, and check motor amp draw for binding or noise.
  • Gap & Flushness Verification: Check that glass panels seat flush within tight automotive tolerances using feeler gauges, calipers, or optical laser gauges.
  • Leak & Cosmetic Inspection: Verify continuous seal placement to prevent water intrusion and inspect panoramic glass for scratches, delamination, or debris.
Sequencing & Material Handling
  • JIS Rack Loading: Load finished roof modules into specialized sequence racks or automated delivery carts, ensuring units precisely match the broadcast schedule of BMW's assembly line (VIN-to-VIN matching).
  • Material Management: Keep track of sub-components, scan barcodes into the production system (MES), and escalate part defects or non-conformities before delivery.
Work Environment & Expectations
  • Physical Requirements: Standing for 8- to 12-hour shifts, repetitive lifting (often 30–50 lbs assisted by overhead zero-gravity lifters/manipulators), and high-reach handling.
  • Standards: Strict adherence to Standard Process Instructions (SPIs), 5S workplace organization, and zero-defect automotive escalation protocols.

job.title: Senior SoC Performance Architect
job.description:
US Citizen Required

Job Summary

We are seeking two highly experienced Senior SoC Performance Analysis Engineers to support advanced processor performance monitoring, analysis, and optimization.

The ideal candidates will have extensive experience analyzing System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures, developing performance monitoring tools, and evaluating data movement across cache hierarchies and on-chip communication networks.

This position requires strong technical expertise in bandwidth allocation, Quality of Service (QoS), memory performance, and processor architecture, particularly Intel Tiger Lake, Ice Lake, and Alder Lake platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement tools and processes to monitor and analyze SoC performance.

  • Monitor traffic utilization, throughput, and contention across L2/L3 caches and network-on-chip (NoC) communication fabrics.

  • Analyze data movement between processor cores, caches, memory controllers, and other on-die components.

  • Identify performance bottlenecks, resource contention, and bandwidth limitations.

  • Characterize and establish performance limits for bandwidth allocation, QoS parameters, and channel priorities.

  • Develop and improve performance monitoring methodologies, software applications, and supporting tools.

  • Conduct detailed performance analysis of Intel Tiger Lake, Ice Lake, and Alder Lake processor architectures.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to troubleshoot complex hardware and software performance issues.

  • Provide technical guidance and support to project teams.

  • Coordinate engineering activities and contribute to complex technical projects.

  • Recommend improvements to system performance, efficiency, and resource utilization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering, processor architecture, or a related technical discipline.

  • 10+ years of hands-on SoC performance analysis experience, including building tools and processes for performance monitoring.

  • Experience monitoring usage, throughput, and traffic contention across L2/L3 cache and NoC communication fabrics.

  • Strong understanding of cache hierarchies, memory subsystems, interconnects, and on-chip data movement.

  • Demonstrated ability to characterize bandwidth allocation, QoS settings, and channel priorities.

  • Experience working with Intel Tiger Lake, Ice Lake, and Alder Lake processors.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.

  • Ability to work independently on complex engineering challenges and provide technical leadership.

job.title: Division Business Development Manager – Aerospace
job.description:
Position: Division Development Manager
Industry: Aerospace Manufacturing
Compensation: $200K–$230K Base + 25% Bonus + $90K+ Stock + Sign-On Bonus
Relocation: Available

Position Summary

The Division Development Manager is a senior leadership position responsible for developing and executing strategic growth initiatives that support the division's overall business objectives.

This individual will provide leadership and direction across division sales, marketing, business development, and customer service functions. The role requires a strategic business leader who understands the aerospace OEM market, can identify new growth opportunities, expand existing customer relationships, increase market share, and drive profitable business growth.

Working closely with the Division General Manager and cross-functional leadership teams, this individual will help establish and execute strategies to achieve long-term financial and operational goals.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated success scaling large aerospace or manufacturing businesses, ideally with experience growing a business from approximately $700 million to $1 billion in revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development & Growth

  • Develop and execute strategic business development and marketing plans aligned with divisional growth objectives.

  • Drive profitable revenue growth and establish strategies to increase market share within targeted aerospace markets.

  • Identify new business opportunities, emerging technologies, market trends, and potential areas for expansion.

  • Develop strategies to grow existing product lines while identifying opportunities for new products and services.

  • Establish measurable growth targets, timelines, and performance objectives.

  • Evaluate global competition, industry trends, customer demands, and market conditions to identify business opportunities.

  • Contribute to long-term strategic planning, acquisitions, and overall business expansion initiatives.

OEM & Customer Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with aerospace OEM customers and strategic accounts.

  • Serve as the business development liaison between division leadership, strategic account managers, aerospace group leadership, and other divisions.

  • Build strategies to strengthen customer relationships, increase market penetration, and secure new business.

  • Work directly with customers to understand business needs and develop solutions that align with customer and company objectives.

  • Manage escalated customer concerns and complaints while maintaining strong customer relationships.

  • Present business strategies, growth opportunities, and performance results to executive leadership and key customers.

Sales & Marketing Leadership

  • Provide strategic direction and leadership for division sales, marketing, and customer service organizations.

  • Lead the development and execution of marketing strategies, product commercialization, and promotional initiatives.

  • Oversee pricing strategies, market positioning, advertising programs, and competitive analysis.

  • Partner with engineering and operations to identify product development and commercialization opportunities.

  • Develop training programs and resources for field sales, inside sales, and distribution networks.

  • Monitor market performance and adjust strategies based on customer feedback and changing industry conditions.

Leadership & Financial Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop professional sales and marketing teams.

  • Establish departmental goals, evaluate performance, and drive accountability.

  • Partner with division leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between growth strategies and operational execution.

  • Manage departmental budgets and resources to achieve business objectives.

  • Recommend organizational improvements to strengthen the effectiveness and responsiveness of the sales and marketing organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field required.

  • MBA preferred.

  • 7–10 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development, or a technical field involving significant customer interaction.

  • 3–5 years of experience leading or supervising professional sales and marketing teams.

  • Strong experience within aerospace manufacturing, preferably working directly with aerospace OEM customers.

  • Demonstrated success developing and executing business growth strategies.

  • Experience managing strategic accounts, expanding market share, and developing new business opportunities.

  • Strong executive presence with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to work across multiple functions and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.

  • Strong analytical, strategic planning, and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office; Salesforce CRM, Power BI, and Outlook preferred.

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Senior-level aerospace business development, commercial, or sales executive.

  • Strong OEM aerospace manufacturing background.

  • Experience managing large revenue portfolios or business units.

  • Proven ability to scale a business significantly, ideally from $700M to $1B.

  • Experience with strategic account management, long-term OEM contracts, and customer growth strategies.

  • Experience leading large, professional sales and marketing organizations.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $200,000–$230,000

  • Annual incentive bonus: 25%

  • Stock compensation: $90,000+

  • Sign-on bonus available

  • Relocation assistance available

  • 401(k) with 100% company match on the first 5% of pay

  • Company retirement contribution of 3%

  • Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Tuition reimbursement and career development

  • Paid parental leave and additional wellness benefits

job.title: Senior Accountant - Cash Forecasting
job.description:
Senior Accountant - Cash Forecasting

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. | On-Site

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $70,000–$85,000, depending on experience
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement Planning: 401(k) with company match
Time Away: Paid time off, holidays, and personal days
Additional Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Bonus Incentive Program
Coverage: Life and disability insurance
Work Environment: Established manufacturing company with a stable weekday schedule and a collaborative accounting team

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Senior Accountant - Cash Forecasting to take ownership of daily cash activity, bank reconciliations, electronic payments, and cash-related accounting processes for an established manufacturing organization.

This is a great opportunity for an accountant who enjoys working with numbers, banking activity, reconciliations, and financial accuracy and wants a role with visibility across the organization. You’ll work closely with Accounting, AP, AR, Purchasing, Sales, and banking partners while helping ensure the company’s cash position and financial records remain accurate and well controlled.

If you’re organized, analytical, comfortable working independently, and have experience with cash accounting, treasury functions, or general ledger accounting, this could be a strong fit.

Key Responsibilities

Cash Management & Banking:

  • Monitor daily cash balances across company bank accounts and maintain accurate cash position reporting

  • Process and monitor ACH payments, wire transfers, positive pay, and other electronic banking transactions

  • Maintain banking records, account documentation, and authorized signer information

Bank Reconciliations & Accounting:

  • Perform daily, weekly, and monthly bank reconciliations, researching and resolving discrepancies

  • Prepare cash-related journal entries and ensure transactions are accurately recorded in the general ledger

  • Support month-end and year-end close through reconciliations, schedules, and supporting documentation

Cash Forecasting & Financial Planning:

  • Prepare short-term cash forecasts and assist with longer-term cash flow planning

  • Monitor upcoming receipts and disbursements to help maintain appropriate cash availability

  • Review bank fees and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs

AP/AR Coordination:

  • Work with Accounts Receivable on cash application and resolution of unapplied cash

  • Coordinate with Accounts Payable regarding payment timing and cash requirements

  • Partner with internal departments to resolve cash-related questions and discrepancies

Controls, Compliance & Process Improvement:

  • Help maintain effective controls over cash receipts, payments, and banking activity

  • Assist with internal and external audit requests related to cash and treasury accounts

  • Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, or automate cash-management processes

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of accounting experience, preferably with exposure to cash accounting, treasury, or general ledger functions

  • Experience with bank reconciliations and cash management is strongly preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office

  • Experience with an ERP system and online banking platforms is a plus

Work Style:

  • Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines

  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with other departments

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail

Core Strengths:

  • Accurate and analytical

  • Dependable and organized

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable handling confidential financial information

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based within a manufacturing environment and involves regular interaction with accounting and operational teams. The role requires extended periods working at a computer, with occasional movement throughout the office and manufacturing facility. Employees entering the shop environment are required to wear appropriate PPE.

job.description:
US Citizenship Required.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data platforms supporting enterprise analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and manufacturing operations.

This individual will work closely with data scientists, data analysts, IT teams, and business stakeholders to build reliable data solutions across cloud and on-premises environments.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Azure Synapse or Microsoft Fabric, ETL/ELT development, and Azure DevOps. Strong communication skills and the ability to manage projects independently or within a collaborative team are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines supporting Data Lakes, Lakehouses, Data Warehouses, and AI-driven platforms.

  • Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, and related technologies.

  • Develop Python scripts and SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, integration, and automation.

  • Use Azure DevOps to streamline pipeline deployments, version control, and development processes.

  • Design scalable data models to support enterprise reporting, analytics, and AI initiatives.

  • Integrate data from manufacturing systems, enterprise applications, and cloud-based platforms.

  • Experience with Azure Synapse or Microsoft Fabric for ETL/ELT development.

job.title: Tool and Die Maker
job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Tool & Die Maker with a strong background in traditional machining, tool building, fixture fabrication, and mechanical repair.

The ideal candidate will have at least five years of experience working with tools, dies, jigs, molds, and fixtures in a machine shop or manufacturing environment.

This position requires someone who understands traditional machining practices and is comfortable operating manual machining equipment, reading complex blueprints, fabricating and repairing tooling, and performing precision measurements.

The client is specifically looking for an old-school Tool & Die Maker—not someone whose experience is limited to CNC machining or programming. Candidates should have practical, hands-on experience building, modifying, repairing, and maintaining tooling from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

Tool & Die Making & Manual Machining

  • Operate manual machining equipment to build, modify, and repair fixtures, tools, dies, and machine components.

  • Repair and maintain molds, jigs, tools, and fixtures.

  • Disassemble, troubleshoot, repair, and reassemble molds and tooling.

  • Perform drilling, tapping, deburring, and other machining operations using appropriate equipment and techniques.

  • Modify machine settings and parameters to control speed, material feed, and cutting paths to ensure quality results.

  • Fabricate and modify machine parts and tooling to meet specifications.

Blueprint Reading & Precision Measurement

  • Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and complex schematics.

  • Understand and create basic technical drawings and prints.

  • Use precision measuring instruments, including micrometers, calipers, height gauges, scales, and tape measures.

  • Inspect completed tools and dies for imperfections, damage, and dimensional accuracy.

  • Apply mathematical principles, formulas, and trigonometry to machining and toolmaking processes.

Welding, Fabrication & Mechanical Skills

  • Utilize welding and fabrication skills to build and improve tooling and fixtures.

  • Demonstrate strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting abilities.

  • Identify appropriate tools and equipment for specific machining and fabrication tasks.

  • Plan machining and fabrication processes and prepare materials and equipment for the next stage of production.

Shop Maintenance & Safety

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe machine shop environment.

  • Regularly inspect and test equipment, tools, and machinery.

  • Ensure machines are properly configured and operating efficiently.

  • Follow established safety procedures and manufacturing practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Tool & Die Maker or in a closely related toolmaking position.

  • Proven experience machining, building, modifying, and repairing tools, dies, jigs, and fixtures.

  • Strong hands-on experience with manual machining equipment.

  • Thorough understanding of traditional machine shop practices and machining principles.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and schematics.

  • Experience using precision measurement equipment, including micrometers, calipers, and height gauges.

  • Understanding of machining mathematics, handbook formulas, and trigonometry.

  • Welding and fabrication experience.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

  • Good communication skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidates will be:

  • Traditional Tool & Die Makers with extensive manual machining experience.

  • Experienced in building tooling and fixtures from scratch.

  • Comfortable repairing and rebuilding molds, dies, and jigs.

  • Experienced with manual mills, lathes, grinders, drilling, and tapping.

  • Strong blueprint readers who understand tolerances and precision measurements.

  • Mechanically inclined individuals who can troubleshoot and determine how to repair or fabricate tooling.

job.title: Learning Content Audit Specialist(Fully Remote)
job.description:
Learning Content Audit Specialist

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Learning Content Audit Specialist to support a large-scale audit of enterprise learning and training content. This contract position will focus on reviewing, organizing, updating, and improving a portfolio of thousands of training courses to ensure content is current, accurate, accessible, high-quality, and properly maintained.

The role involves hands-on content remediation, including updating and rebuilding course materials such as text, images, quizzes, branding, and accessibility elements. The specialist will also coordinate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), manage review and approval processes, and track remediation activities through completion.

Major course redesign efforts will be transitioned to external vendors.

The ideal candidate enjoys working with large datasets, auditing learning content, utilizing eLearning authoring tools, and managing high-volume projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Position Details

  • Job Title: Learning Content Audit Specialist

  • Employment Type: Contract

  • Contract Duration: January 18, 2027 – July 15, 2027

  • Work Location: 100% Remote

  • Schedule: Monday – Friday

  • Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (8-hour workday)

Key Responsibilities

Learning Content Auditing & Quality Assurance

  • Conduct comprehensive audits of enterprise learning and training content using established evaluation criteria.

  • Review assigned courses for relevance, accuracy, quality, completeness, and accessibility.

  • Identify outdated, duplicate, incomplete, or irrelevant training materials.

  • Recommend appropriate actions for each course, including retention, updates, or removal.

  • Document audit findings and maintain accurate records to support stakeholder decisions.

  • Review and process approximately 25–40+ courses per week, while tracking completion of required content updates.

  • Apply consistent quality standards across a large portfolio of learning materials.

Data Management & Reporting

  • Review, update, and maintain course information within centralized tracking systems.

  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of course ownership, review dates, course details, and related metadata.

  • Utilize Microsoft Excel and other data management tools to organize and track large volumes of course information.

  • Maintain detailed audit records, remediation statuses, and workflow documentation.

  • Track content updates, outstanding actions, and project milestones to ensure timely completion.

  • Prepare reports and supporting documentation for stakeholder reviews and decision-making.

eLearning Content Development & Remediation

  • Update, revise, and rebuild existing learning content based on audit findings.

  • Modify course materials, including:

    • Written content and instructional text

    • Images and visual elements

    • Quizzes and knowledge assessments

    • Branding and formatting

    • Accessibility improvements

  • Utilize Articulate Rise, Storyline, and other Articulate tools to update and refresh eLearning courses.

  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and other approved AI-assisted tools to support content development and updates.

  • Apply learning best practices to improve course quality, consistency, and usability.

  • Analyze unfamiliar training topics and translate findings into practical content recommendations.

  • Ensure updated materials meet established learning and accessibility standards.

Stakeholder & SME Coordination

  • Collaborate with course owners, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and internal stakeholders to resolve content gaps.

  • Coordinate course reviews, feedback collection, and approval processes.

  • Manage review cycles using Articulate Review 360 or similar platforms.

  • Track stakeholder feedback, outstanding revisions, and final approvals.

  • Prepare and organize course materials for stakeholder evaluation.

  • Follow up with content owners and SMEs to ensure timely completion of reviews and approvals.

Vendor Coordination & Workflow Management

  • Identify courses requiring internal remediation versus major external redesign.

  • Track remediation pathways, project statuses, and vendor handoffs.

  • Coordinate with external vendors for courses requiring significant redesign.

  • Prepare and package course files and supporting documentation for vendor transitions.

  • Manage ownership transfers and ensure proper documentation of vendor assignments.

  • Monitor progress and maintain accurate records throughout the remediation process.

  • Support high-volume audit and remediation activities while meeting established deadlines.

job.title: Selector
job.description:
Primary Tasks:
The primary function of this position is to select cases, bags and other containers of refrigerated foods (meat, dairy, produce) to fill customer orders from multi-level rack storage systems. Items are placed on pallets and completed orders are moved to the loading dock staging area with an electric Power Jack, wrapped, labeled and readied for shipment.
Essential Functions:
Review work schedule, obtain Vox audio communication system, tools and supplies required to perform the work and prepare for operations. Perform a safety check on Power Jack / Forklift to be used and insure that all other safety devices are functioning properly. Place pallets on Forklift / Power Jack and operate along assigned multi-level racks and locate products according to order sheets or Vox Audio Communication System (where available). Manually place the appropriate stock items on pallet from 1st and 2nd level racks as required. Transport completed palletized customer order to shipping dock staging area. Ensure count accuracy, record counts on appropriate forms and visually inspect for damaged product. Hand wrap completed pallet / customer order, label and ready the order for shipment. Rotate date sensitive stock, keep work areas clear and clean, complete work sheets' documentation as required. Remove empty pallets, cardboard packing, and strapping to the proper area or receptacles. Inspect empty pallets for damage, stack and move pallets with Power Jack or Forklift to the proper storage area. Rotate between selecting orders and loading trailer as assigned. Perform general housekeeping duties and keep warehouse area, loading dock and trailers clear and clean as required. Remove batteries requiring recharging, replace with charged batteries, or attach re-charger and complete vehicle inspection checklist. Perform other similar duties as requested or assigned by supervisor. At the end of the shift secure all equipment and complete all necessary paperwork.

job.title: Automation Technician
job.description:
Description
We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Technician to support the field commissioning, testing, and startup of a state-of-the-art pharmaceutical biotechnology facility. The role will be instrumental in deploying, commissioning and testing critical automated equipment ,infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration across Building Automation Systems (Client), PLCs, EMS, HMIs, SCADA, Process Control Systems (PCS) and ITOT networks. This position requires hands-on electro-mechanical troubleshooting, precise instrument calibration, code review and troubleshooting, and strict adherence to the Engineering Change Notification (ECN) process and cGMP documentation standards to bring the facility online safely and efficiently.

Responsibilities Specific Platforms: Hands-on experience with Rockwell Automation (Allen-Bradley) Contrologix5000 PLCs, FactoryTalk, Siemens Desigo Client, Vaisala view Linc EMS and familiar with Emerson Delta V. Hardware & Software: High proficiency in using computer interfaces for system diagnostics, along with a deep understanding of industrial IT networks (Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, BacNet, etc.). System Maintenance & Optimization: Support, maintain, and troubleshoot Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Human Machine Interfaces (HMIs), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition(SCADA) systems, and Building Automation Systems (Client). System Commissioning & Testing: Execute field I/O checkout, loop checks, and functional testing for automated pharmaceutical process equipment, clean utilities, and HVAC systems. Electrical & Wiring Diagnostics: Troubleshoot low-voltage wiring, control loops, and field instrumentation. Utilize digital voltage multimeters and related diagnostic tools to identify and resolve electrical faults safely and efficiently. Blueprint & Schematic Navigation: Read, interpret, and redline schematic wiring diagrams, Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID), and Automation Flow & Instrumentation Diagrams (AF&ID)to execute repairs and modifications. Logic & Programming: Access and navigate ladder logic to diagnose machine faults, track system states, and support engineering in minor logic modifications or process improvements. Network Infrastructure: Troubleshoot and maintain the industrial IT network infrastructure connecting automation components, ensuring seamless data acquisition and system communication. Calibration & Instrumentation: Perform routine and non-routine instrument calibration using specialized calibration equipment to ensure process accuracy and regulatory compliance. Diagnostic Tools: Demonstrated proficiency operating digital voltage multimeters, loop calibrators, and other specialized instrument calibration equipment.
Perform and oversee loop checks, Signal verification, troubleshooting of instrumentation to ensure proper installation and functionality. Documentation & Compliance: Maintain accurate records of all maintenance, troubleshooting, and calibration activities in alignment with Engineering Change Notification (ECN) process, Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and site standard operating procedures. Ensure that instrumentation installation complies with project specifications. Where applicable organize testing and verification strategy for instrumentation. Support necessary functional testing of control systems, alarms, and safety systems. Review P&ID's , Loop Drawings / Wiring Diagrams, Technical Specifications and calibration records(As Applicable). Execute and document infield verification and resolve any discrepancies. Strong understanding of Instrumentation systems including pressure, temperature, flow, level, control valves, analyzers etc.… Maintain and organize tracker for identified discrepancies and issues and drive to resolution ensuring minimal impact to project timelines.

Education and Experience Requirements
Associate's degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, Automation, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent military/professional experience). Minimum 5 years of automation, instrumentation, or electrical controls experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries. Strong communication skills. Experience with Large Capital Project Execution Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and cross-communicate with project team, contract vendors, sub-contractors.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies
Describe critical skills and abilities needed to successfully perform the job, which should be representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Experience with ISA

job.title: Cybersecurity Compliance Facilitator
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Compliance Facilitator to support cybersecurity readiness, regulatory compliance, and cyber resilience initiatives for embedded software and associated hardware systems.

This role will work closely with software engineers, cybersecurity professionals, product managers, and engineering leadership to coordinate security activities, track compliance requirements, and ensure cybersecurity deliverables are completed throughout the software development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will have a background in cybersecurity compliance, knowledge of secure software development practices, and strong organizational and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in developing and maintaining cybersecurity project plans, schedules, and milestones for embedded software and associated hardware interfaces.

  • Create, maintain, and manage the cybersecurity backlog, ensuring security tasks, deliverables, and documentation are tracked and completed on schedule.

  • Coordinate cross-functional planning sessions, project reviews, and meetings with cybersecurity, engineering, product management, and leadership teams.

  • Monitor cybersecurity compliance activities and maintain traceability of security requirements throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Develop and maintain project metrics, dashboards, and status reports to track cybersecurity milestones, outstanding issues, and remediation activities.

  • Support compliance efforts while helping engineering teams maintain development schedules and delivery timelines.

  • Track security risks, action items, and remediation plans, following up with responsible teams to ensure timely resolution.

  • Provide administrative and technical coordination support to senior cybersecurity professionals and engineering managers.

  • Assist with maintaining cybersecurity documentation and supporting compliance reviews and assessments.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Cybersecurity.

  • Minimum of 2 years of professional cybersecurity experience, including knowledge of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) practices.

  • Recent experience supporting cybersecurity compliance programs or familiarity with IEC 62443 / EN 62443 standards for Industrial Automation and Control Systems (IACS).

  • Knowledge of Secure SDLC activities, including:

    • Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

    • Threat Modeling

    • SDElements

  • Experience coordinating cybersecurity activities, tracking deliverables, and managing security-related action items.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate with cybersecurity, software engineering, product management, and leadership teams in a fast-paced environment.

Key Areas of Focus

  • Cybersecurity Compliance and Regulatory Readiness

  • Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC)

  • IEC 62443 / EN 62443

  • Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

  • Threat Modeling

  • SDElements

  • Cybersecurity Backlog Management

job.title: Validation Engineer
job.description:
Validation Engineer – Equipment Validation & Cleaning Validation

Position Overview

Client is seeking an experienced Validation Engineer to support its Validation Engineering team at its Oceanside, CA manufacturing facility. This contractor will play a critical role in supporting equipment qualification and cleaning validation activities across both commercial stainless steel and single-use biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

The primary focus of this position is Equipment Validation and Cleaning Validation. The successful candidate will have extensive hands-on experience developing, authoring, executing, and documenting validation protocols within a highly regulated cGMP biopharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing environment.

This individual will work directly with manufacturing, engineering, quality, and other cross-functional teams to ensure manufacturing equipment and cleaning processes meet established performance, quality, and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can independently manage validation activities from protocol development through execution, troubleshooting, results evaluation, and final documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Equipment Qualification & Validation

  • Author, review, and execute equipment qualification protocols, including Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ).

  • Perform equipment qualification and validation activities for GMP manufacturing systems.

  • Support validation of biopharmaceutical manufacturing equipment, including:

    • Bioreactors.

    • Chromatography skids.

    • Tangential Flow Filtration (TFF) systems.

    • Autoclaves.

    • Stainless steel manufacturing equipment.

    • Single-use manufacturing systems and equipment.

  • Verify that equipment and systems operate according to approved specifications and established acceptance criteria.

  • Review equipment documentation, testing results, and qualification records.

  • Identify and troubleshoot equipment qualification discrepancies and execution issues.

  • Ensure equipment is appropriately qualified and documented before being released for manufacturing use.

2. Cleaning Validation & Cleaning Verification

  • Develop, author, review, and execute Cleaning Validation (CV) and cleaning verification protocols.

  • Support cleaning validation activities for commercial stainless steel manufacturing equipment and single-use manufacturing operations.

  • Demonstrate hands-on knowledge of Clean-in-Place (CIP) and Steam-in-Place (SIP) systems.

  • Develop and execute cleaning validation sampling plans.

  • Perform and document visual inspections and cleaning verification activities.

  • Coordinate and evaluate analytical testing results, including:

    • Total Organic Carbon (TOC).

    • Conductivity.

    • Bioburden.

    • Endotoxin.

  • Support residue limit assessments and cleaning recovery studies.

  • Evaluate cleaning validation data against established acceptance criteria.

  • Investigate cleaning validation discrepancies and support resolution of technical issues.

  • Ensure cleaning processes consistently meet established GMP and quality requirements.

3. Protocol Development, Execution & Documentation

  • Independently develop and author technical validation protocols and supporting documentation.

  • Execute validation protocols in accordance with approved procedures and project timelines.

  • Evaluate test results and determine whether acceptance criteria have been met.

  • Identify, investigate, and resolve protocol execution discrepancies.

  • Author protocol exceptions and work with cross-functional stakeholders to document and resolve issues.

  • Prepare validation summaries and final reports.

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and traceable validation documentation.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to validation processes and documentation.

4. Regulatory Compliance & GMP Standards

  • Ensure all validation activities comply with current cGMP requirements and applicable industry and regulatory standards.

  • Follow Client quality standards, procedures, and documentation requirements.

  • Maintain strong documentation practices and ensure validation records are accurate, complete, and audit-ready.

  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Engineering, and other departments to support compliant manufacturing operations.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in one of the following disciplines:

    • Chemical Engineering.

    • Biomedical Engineering.

    • Mechanical Engineering.

    • Biochemistry.

    • Related technical or engineering discipline.

Professional Experience

  • 8–10+ years of direct Validation Engineering experience within a cGMP biopharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing facility.

  • Extensive hands-on experience authoring and executing equipment qualification protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ).

  • Direct experience with Cleaning Validation and cleaning verification activities.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting commercial biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

  • Experience working with both stainless steel and single-use manufacturing equipment.

  • Ability to independently manage validation projects, timelines, protocol execution, and documentation.

Required Technical Experience

Candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience in BOTH areas:

Equipment Validation:

  • IQ/OQ/PQ protocol development and execution.

  • Bioreactors.

  • Chromatography skids.

  • TFF systems.

  • Autoclaves.

  • GMP manufacturing equipment qualification.

Cleaning Validation:

  • Cleaning Validation (CV) protocol development and execution.

  • Cleaning verification.

  • CIP/SIP systems.

  • Sampling plans and visual inspections.

  • Residue limits and recovery studies.

  • Analytical testing coordination, including TOC, conductivity, bioburden, and endotoxin.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.

  • Strong verbal and written communication.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Effective cross-functional collaboration.

  • Ability to manage multiple validation activities and meet established deadlines.

Work Authorization Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (Green Card holder).

  • Must be able to work onsite at the Oceanside, CA manufacturing facility five days per week.

Work Schedule & Location

  • Location: Oceanside, CA.

  • Work Arrangement: 100% onsite.

  • Days: Monday–Friday.

  • Hours: 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time.

  • Contract opportunity.

Interview Process

Round 1 – Hiring Manager Interview

  • Format: Virtual.

  • Duration: Approximately 30 minutes.

  • Focus: Technical background, relevant validation experience, communication skills, and overall alignment with the position.

Round 2 – Panel Interview

  • Format: Onsite at the Client Oceanside facility.

  • Duration: Approximately 1 hour.

  • Focus: In-depth technical evaluation, hands-on equipment validation and cleaning validation experience, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration.

Candidates must be comfortable participating in both interview rounds, including traveling onsite to Oceanside for the second-round panel interview.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior-level Validation Engineer coming directly from a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment. They should be capable of independently authoring and executing both equipment qualification and cleaning validation protocols, with strong practical experience in CIP/SIP systems, GMP manufacturing equipment, and validation documentation.

The strongest candidates will have a combination of:

  • 8–10+ years of direct biopharmaceutical validation experience.

  • Strong equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) background.

  • Extensive Cleaning Validation experience.

  • Hands-on CIP/SIP experience.

  • Experience with stainless steel and single-use manufacturing facilities.

  • Ability to independently manage validation activities from start to finish.

job.title: Shipping/Receiving Manager
job.description:
Shipping & Receiving Warehouse Manager

Location: Danville, KY
Employment Type: Direct Hire

Position Summary

The Shipping & Receiving Warehouse Manager is responsible for leading and transforming warehouse and logistics operations within a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This individual will oversee all aspects of incoming and outgoing materials, inventory management, shipping, receiving, transportation coordination, and warehouse personnel.

This position will play a critical role in improving operational efficiency, optimizing logistics costs, enhancing inventory accuracy, and implementing standardized processes throughout the warehouse.

The Warehouse Manager will lead a team of approximately 9–10 direct reports and provide leadership within a broader warehouse organization of approximately 34 employees. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading an established team, introducing new processes, challenging existing practices, and creating a culture focused on accountability, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, with the ability to evaluate current warehouse operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop a long-term vision for transforming the facility physically, digitally, and operationally.

Key Responsibilities

Warehouse & Distribution Operations

  • Oversee daily warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, picking, packing, shipping, and material distribution.

  • Manage incoming and outgoing logistics to ensure timely and accurate movement of products.

  • Oversee warehouse picking operations, supporting approximately eight pickers responsible for delivering materials to production assembly and customers.

  • Monitor daily production and shipping plans against actual performance, identifying gaps and implementing corrective actions.

  • Ensure materials are properly received, stored, organized, picked, and distributed.

  • Coordinate with production, procurement, customer service, and transportation teams to support business objectives.

  • Oversee the shipment of significant product volumes while maintaining accuracy, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Transportation & Logistics Optimization

  • Evaluate transportation methods, carrier performance, shipping lanes, and freight costs.

  • Manage relationships and coordination with multiple transportation carriers.

  • Optimize LTL, parcel, and other shipping methods based on shipment requirements, cost, and delivery expectations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve freight efficiency, carrier utilization, and overall logistics performance.

  • Evaluate current transportation practices and implement more effective processes.

  • Maintain appropriate knowledge of domestic and international shipping requirements, including import/export compliance.

Inventory Management & Systems

  • Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counting, inventory controls, and process improvements.

  • Develop and maintain standardized inventory management practices.

  • Identify and resolve inventory discrepancies and material flow issues.

  • Utilize warehouse management and ERP systems to improve operational visibility and reporting.

  • Leverage SAP and transportation execution software to improve warehouse and logistics performance.

  • Evaluate opportunities to digitally transform warehouse processes and improve reporting capabilities.

Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop warehouse supervisors and team members.

  • Manage approximately 9–10 direct reports within a larger warehouse organization.

  • Build a cohesive, collaborative, and accountable team environment.

  • Lead organizational and cultural change while gaining employee buy-in.

  • Develop employee capabilities through training, performance management, and leadership development.

  • Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and operational accountability.

  • Build strong working relationships across manufacturing, operations, supply chain, and leadership teams.

  • Promote positive employee relations and maintain a productive, respectful workplace culture.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Transformation

  • Lead warehouse transformation initiatives focused on physical layout, digital systems, and standardized operating procedures.

  • Implement Lean principles, including 5S, standard work, visual management, and waste reduction.

  • Evaluate warehouse workflows and material movement to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.

  • Improve productivity, space utilization, material flow, and overall warehouse efficiency.

  • Develop and implement measurable performance metrics and operational improvement plans.

  • Drive accountability through daily performance reviews and plan-versus-actual reporting.

Safety, Compliance & Financial Performance

  • Maintain a strong focus on workplace safety, ergonomics, and regulatory compliance.

  • Ensure warehouse employees follow established safety procedures and equipment operating standards.

  • Maintain awareness of import/export regulations, ITAR, and SOX compliance requirements.

  • Monitor warehouse labor, equipment, and supply costs.

  • Develop strategies to reduce operating expenses and improve transportation and warehouse efficiency.

  • Prepare and present operational reports, inventory metrics, and productivity results to leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • 5–7 years of manufacturing experience in shipping, receiving, warehouse operations, or materials management.

  • Previous experience as a Warehouse Manager or in a comparable warehouse leadership position.

  • Strong understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management, transportation, and logistics.

  • Experience managing warehouse personnel and developing high-performing teams.

  • Demonstrated experience implementing process improvements and operational standardization.

  • Strong knowledge of shipping methods, including LTL, parcel, and multiple-carrier logistics.

  • Experience with ERP or warehouse management systems.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, and PowerPoint.

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and team-building abilities.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and meet operational deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP experience.

  • Precision transportation execution software experience.

  • APICS certification.

  • Knowledge of ITAR, SOX, and import/export compliance.

  • Experience with Lean manufacturing, 5S, standard work, and continuous improvement.

  • Experience leading warehouse transformation or operational restructuring initiatives.

  • Experience optimizing transportation carriers, shipping lanes, and freight costs.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We need someone who is:

  • A proven manufacturing warehouse leader, not simply a warehouse supervisor.

  • Experienced managing larger teams and multiple warehouse functions.

  • Comfortable leading 9–10 direct reports and influencing a broader organization.

  • A change agent who can challenge traditional processes and introduce better ways of working.

  • Strong in transportation and logistics, especially LTL, parcel, carrier selection, and cost optimization.

  • Experienced with inventory accuracy, cycle counts, shipping, receiving, and production material flow.

  • A visionary leader who can see the big picture but is also comfortable getting into the details.

  • Capable of building relationships with long-tenured employees and creating a cohesive team culture.

job.title: Cost Accountant- Manufacturing
job.description:
Cost Accountant – Manufacturing

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. | On-Site

Pay & Benefits

Compensation: $75,000–$90,000, depending on experience
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement Planning: 401(k) with company match
Time Away: Paid time off, holidays, and personal days
Additional Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Bonus Incentive Program
Coverage: Life and disability insurance
Work Environment: Established manufacturing company with a stable weekday schedule and a collaborative team environment

About the Role

We’re looking for a Cost Accountant with manufacturing experience to help track, analyze, and improve the financial performance of a production operation.

This role is focused on manufacturing costs, inventory, standard costing, and variance analysis. You’ll work closely with Finance, Production, Procurement, and Project Management to understand where costs are coming from, identify discrepancies, and provide information that helps the business make better decisions.

This is a strong opportunity for an accountant who enjoys going beyond basic general ledger work and wants to understand how products are made, what they cost, and where the company can improve profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Cost Analysis:

  • Analyze material, labor, production, and overhead costs to help identify trends and areas for improvement

  • Prepare cost accounting reports and provide analysis to support operational and financial decisions

  • Review production costs and identify opportunities for improved efficiency and cost reduction

Standard Costing & Variance Analysis:

  • Calculate and maintain standard costs for products and manufacturing activities

  • Analyze cost variances and investigate the underlying causes

  • Work with operational teams to understand significant changes in material, labor, and overhead costs

Inventory Accounting & Reconciliation:

  • Monitor inventory transactions and ensure costs are accurately captured

  • Perform inventory reconciliations and research discrepancies

  • Support accurate inventory valuation and related financial reporting

Financial Analysis & Profitability:

  • Perform profitability and cost-benefit analysis on products, projects, and operational activities

  • Provide financial insight to help management evaluate costs and potential savings

  • Identify trends and communicate findings clearly to Finance and operational leadership

Month-End Close & Accounting:

  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to inventory and manufacturing costs

  • Prepare reconciliations, reports, and supporting schedules

  • Ensure accounting activity is accurate and consistent with company policies and applicable accounting standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Improvement:

  • Partner with Production, Procurement, Project Management, and Finance to improve cost visibility and efficiency

  • Help develop and maintain cost accounting processes and procedures

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, systems, and overall cost-accounting accuracy

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience:

  • 2+ years of cost accounting, manufacturing accounting, or financial analysis experience

  • Manufacturing or production-environment experience is strongly preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and U.S. GAAP

  • Experience with inventory accounting, standard costs, and variance analysis

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office

  • Experience with ERP systems is a plus

Analytical Skills:

  • Strong ability to analyze financial and operational data

  • Comfortable investigating variances and identifying the reasons behind cost changes

  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills

Work Style:

  • Detail-oriented and committed to financial accuracy

  • Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across departments

Communication:

  • Able to clearly communicate financial findings to both accounting and non-accounting team members

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based within a manufacturing environment, with regular interaction with production and operational teams. The role requires extended periods working at a computer, with occasional visits to the manufacturing floor. Employees entering the shop environment are required to wear appropriate PPE.

job.title: PCB Technician / Electronics Technician
job.description:
PCB Technician / Electronics Technician

Location: Stratford, CT
Pay: $21.00 -$24.00
Schedule: 7am to 3:30pm
Position Type: Temp-to-Hire or Direct Hire for the right candidate

Job Overview

Are you mechanically inclined with an interest or background in electronics? We are seeking a detail-oriented PCB Technician to join a growing manufacturing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with knowledge of electronic components who enjoys hands-on work and wants to continue developing their technical skills. Our client is willing to train the right person, so candidates with a solid foundation in electronics, electrical assembly, or related manufacturing experience are encouraged to apply.

An Associate's Degree in Electronics or a related technical field is preferred; however, equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.

This position offers an opportunity to grow professionally, with potential career advancement into areas such as Quality or Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Work with printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic components in a manufacturing environment.

  • Identify, recognize, and understand various electronic components.

  • Assist with electronic assembly, inspection, and testing activities.

  • Follow work instructions, drawings, and established procedures.

  • Perform detailed visual inspections to identify defects or inconsistencies.

job.title: Production Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Title: Production Maintenance Technician
Location: Dallas, TX
Shift: M-F 5:00 AM-3:30PM
Pay: $25-30 per hour

Requirements:
  • 1+ years of recent experience performing maintenance on production equipment

GENERAL DESCRIPTION: Perform maintenance and sanitation duties on the production line as required by the Standard Operating Procedures and Supervisor direction.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES/FUNCTIONS:
  • Create and maintain all robot and automation controls programs for all equipment.
  • Implement automation opportunities for cost savings.
  • Maintain robotic, control systems, and safety control systems including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems.
  • Maintain all PLC and software, plant wide. Integrate existing and new equipment, as needed.
  • Identify, maintain, and troubleshoot Motor Controls, including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components.
  • Troubleshoot industrial electrical, including 480V 3-phase, 110 VAC, and 24VDC systems.
  • Assist in the mechanical maintenance of equipment, as needed.
  • Disassemble production filling equipment (remove fill valves, cylinders, hopper, supply hoses).
  • Reassemble and setup production filling equipment (replace fill valves, cylinders, hopper, supply hoses) using hand tools.
  • Setup production lines for specific products (adjust fill volume, set cap height, set date code, and rail width).
  • Learns and begins to develop personal knowledge of proper basic troubleshooting techniques to diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical and control system problems
  • Troubleshoot and repair plant equipment (fillers, pumps, tanks, valves, cappers, conveyors, etc.) using their hands, hand tools, problem solving skills, computer, HVAC, boilers, chillers, bathroom fixtures, air compressors, etc.
  • Safely use appropriate equipment for each repair (welder, hand tools, electrical meter, grinders, etc.)
  • Maintain plant equipment in a technically perfect condition as per SOP's, Machine Service and Repair Manuals.
  • Log all work and wrench-time on daily work orders and/or in the CMMS
  • Clean equipment as directed using chemicals, spray hose, etc. after completing maintenance tasks.
  • Perform carpentry tasks to frame walls, install sheetrock and repair holes in the walls.
  • Paint company-owned equipment and facility as needed basis.
  • Use company approved personal protective equipment (PPE) as required for various tasks.
  • Operate a scissor lift to change lamps in high bay fixtures, assist with installing electrical conduits in an overhead ceiling, etc.
  • Perform work in Permitted and Non-Permitted Confined Space, Inside Mixing vessels, Storage Tanks etc.
  • Order equipment parts using a parts requisition form and return to Maintenance Supervisor or Designated Parts Coordinator
  • Work long hours and call-ins as needed.
  • Work in a safe manner always, complying with safety, health, environmental, food and drug regulations, GMPs and company policies.
  • Communicate corrective and preventive issues to managers and coworkers.
  • Cooperate with production personnel to ensure maximum quality and production.
  • Work cooperatively with co-workers and supervisors.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work .
  • All other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • Mechanical ability.
  • Knowledge of Lockout/Tagout procedures.
  • Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, mechanical and electrical.
  • Knowledge of MIG and TIG welding.
  • Knowledge of maintenance and repair of electrical, plumbing and HVAC.
  • Carpentry skills.
  • English reading ability for reading and understanding schematics, manuals, building plans, building codes and safety regulations.
  • Knowledge of building codes such as electrical, plumbing, and HVAC.
  • Ability to operate a forklift/scissor lift.
  • Ability to read and follow written instructions, reports, equipment manufacturer instructions and requirements.
  • Ability to follow verbal instructions.
  • Ability to use simple math to measure fill speed, fill rate, etc.
  • Ability to Communicate Clearly
  • Willing and able to work long hours and off-shift.
  • Ability to properly use hand tools.
  • Ability to properly use measuring devices (tape measure, depth gauge, calipers, micrometers, etc)
  • Willingness to perform tasks as required.
  • Ability to work with Supervision.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • Lift up to 50 pounds from the floor level to shoulder height or vise versa.
  • Stand for up to three hours at a time.
  • Visual acuity see set up, recognize problems, troubleshoot and make repairs.
  • Sit, bend, squat, reach, pull, twist, and turn.
  • Reach forward and overhead.
  • Manual dexterity skills to use hand tools, such as wrench, pliers, sockets, wrenches, socket sets, screwdrivers, etc.
  • Use of power equipment such as welder, hand tools, electrical meter, grinders, etc.
  • Able to use cleaning chemicals.
  • Good eye/hand coordination.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE REQUIRED TO PERFORM JOB DUTIES:
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Trade school or technical school training is preferred.
  • 1-2 years previous work experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
  • 1-2 years mechanical experience.
  • Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting is preferred.
  • Experience with preventative maintenance.
  • Experience with MIG and TIG welding.
  • Familiarity with high-speed packaging and filling equipment.

job.title: Buyer
job.description:

Location: Danville, KY  
Position Type Direct Hire  
Salary Range:$75,000–$80,000 annually  
Schedule: 100% Onsite 7:00 AM–3:30 PM  
Relocation Assistance: May be available for qualified candidates.

About Parker Aerospace

At Parker Aerospace, we develop innovative technologies and solutions that support reliable, efficient, and sustainable flight throughout the lifecycle of an aircraft, including aftermarket support.

Parker offers an opportunity to work alongside talented professionals and contribute to innovative aerospace solutions. Team members play an important role in supporting the company's mission of enabling engineering breakthroughs that lead to a better tomorrow.

Position Summary

Parker Aerospace is seeking a Buyer to support purchasing activities for manufacturing and plant operations at its Danville, KY facility. This individual will be responsible for purchasing materials, supplies, equipment, and services while ensuring production requirements are met efficiently, economically, and on schedule.

The Buyer will manage purchasing activities from requisition through purchase order placement, supplier negotiations, delivery coordination, and issue resolution. This position requires previous buying experience, strong supplier relationship management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with internal departments to support production objectives.

Key Responsibilities

- Process purchase requisitions into purchase orders accurately and within required timelines.
- Manage supplier delivery and quality performance while obtaining accurate delivery commitments.
- Solicit quotations from suppliers through formal requests for information and pricing.
- Review and evaluate supplier quotations to determine the best purchasing decisions.
- Negotiate pricing and contractual terms with suppliers to obtain competitive costs.
- Ensure purchase orders incorporate appropriate contractual, corporate, and government requirements.
- Manage purchase order changes and contractual modifications while maintaining compliance with applicable requirements.
- Identify supplier performance issues, delivery concerns, and purchasing problems while initiating corrective actions.
- Establish resolution timelines and follow through to ensure issues are addressed.
- Maintain compliance with corporate and divisional procurement policies, procedures, and purchasing guidelines.
- Prepare regular purchasing reports and provide updates to management.
- Work closely with internal departments to ensure materials and services are available to support production and operational requirements.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree required. No exceptions.
- Business or Engineering degree preferred.
- Minimum 2–3 years of buying/purchasing experience.
- Experience as a Buyer, Expeditor, or Material Planner.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and database management tools.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organizational, problem-solving, and negotiation abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive purchasing activities through completion.
- Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder.

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous aerospace, manufacturing, industrial, or engineering environment experience.
- SAP experience.
- Experience working with suppliers, negotiating pricing, managing purchase orders, and tracking material deliveries.

Compensation & Benefits

- Annual salary range of $75,000–$80,000.
- Participation in the Annual Incentive Program.
- Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision coverage.
- 401(k) plan with 100% company match on the first 5% of employee contributions.
- Company-provided retirement contribution equal to 3% annually.
- Career development and tuition reimbursement.
- Paid parental leave.
- Short- and long-term disability programs.
- Adoption assistance and additional voluntary benefits.
- Paid time off and 13 company-paid holidays.

Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates.**

Come join the Parker Aerospace team and contribute to the future of aerospace manufacturing!

job.title: Scientist - II (Associate)
job.description:
Qualifications
Education: Associate/BS/BA/Master's with minimum of 1 year of industry or academia experience. Strong knowledge in immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization including method development, optimization, and troubleshooting.

Must have:
• Processing and embedding formalin-fixed paraffin embedded (FFPE) tissues
• Sectioning FFPE and frozen blocks.
• Performing histology-based experiments such as IHC, IF, or RNAscope (manually or with autostainers).
• Interest and/or understanding of oncology, immune-oncology, and / or immunology.

Nice to haves:
• Performing image analysis using open source and/or commercially available software.
• Experience in image acquisition and basic microscopy skills.
• Strong data analysis skills including a practical knowledge of statistics
• Experience working with LIMS system
• Experience working with multiplex staining histology platforms (eg Phenocycler, COMET, etc)

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with automated immunostainers (e.g. Leica Bond).
• Experience with whole slide imaging.
• Tissue processing & embedding, microtome and cryostat sectioning.

Responsibilities
The In Vivo Pharmacology group within the Quantitative Biosciences Department is seeking a motivated and technically skilled scientist with immunohistochemistry expertise in oncology, immune-oncology, and / or immunology to join our Boston-based Exploratory Discovery team. Candidates will be able to work independently, but will also be expected to proactively collaborate with colleagues across disciplines. Primary responsibilities include design and execution of immunohistochemistry (IHC) and histology experiments of human and mouse tissues to support the preclinical and clinical development of Client targets and drugs developed by ***. The candidate will be an active participant in the positive and critical scientific dialogue that is necessary to progress our programs.

The responsibilities of the position include:
• Optimize, validate, and execute IHC assays using appropriate controls
• Build and manage a library of archival FFPE specimens
• Contribute to the characterization and validation of compound and/or antibody activity using biomarker histology.
