Location: Miami, FL
Position Type: Direct Hire

Position Overview

We are seeking a Customer Account Specialist to support aftermarket customer accounts within an aerospace MRO environment. This individual will serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned group of customers, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction while managing daily account activities, order processing, repair coordination, and customer communications.

The ideal candidate will have experience in MRO, aerospace/aviation aftermarket services, customer service, or inside sales. This position requires someone who is organized, customer-focused, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities while working closely with internal departments to ensure customer commitments are met.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned aftermarket customer accounts and serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and requests.

  • Review purchase orders, quotes, repair orders, bookings, credits, returns, and Return Material Authorizations (RMAs).

  • Coordinate customer orders and repair activities while ensuring accurate and timely processing.

  • Provide customers with regular updates regarding order status, repair progress, delivery expectations, and outstanding requests.

  • Proactively follow up on open items and work to resolve customer concerns, issues, and service-related challenges.

  • Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, and Trade Compliance teams to ensure customer requirements and commitments are fulfilled.

  • Prepare and maintain customer reports, account documentation, and related records.

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships while driving customer satisfaction and supporting overall business goals.

  • Identify opportunities for process improvements within assigned customer accounts.

  • Follow established Standard Work procedures and assist with maintaining and training others on documented processes.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in MRO, customer service, inside sales, aerospace/aviation aftermarket, or a combination of these areas.

  • Previous experience supporting customer accounts and managing customer-facing activities.

  • Familiarity with MRO products, repair processes, aftermarket services, or aviation-related operations.

  • Experience with purchase orders, quotations, order processing, returns, credits, or repair orders is highly desirable.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple customer requests simultaneously.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot customer or product-related issues.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal departments.

Must qualify as a U.S. Person, defined for this position as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent U.S. resident (Green Card holder).

The strongest candidates will have direct aerospace MRO or aviation aftermarket experience, understand repair and order management processes, and have a proven ability to manage customer accounts from initial inquiry through final resolution. job.title: Employer Shared Responsibility Specialist

Employer Shared Responsibility Specialist

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Employer Shared Responsibility (ESR) Specialist to support client onboarding, account administration, and ongoing service delivery for Employer Shared Responsibility Services.

This position serves as a primary point of contact for clients utilizing ESR services, responding to inquiries, providing technical product support, and assisting with questions related to Employer Shared Responsibility regulations, Analysis & Monitoring reports, and IRS 6056 tax filing requirements.

The ideal candidate will have experience in customer service, sales, or insurance, along with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

Key Responsibilities

Client Service & Account Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients utilizing Employer Shared Responsibility (ESR) services.

  • Respond to written and telephone inquiries from clients, Sales teams, and Operations partners.

  • Make outbound calls to clients and internal business partners as needed to resolve inquiries and support service delivery.

  • Assist with onboarding new ESR clients and establishing client accounts.

  • Provide clients with access to the company's Health & Benefits website.

  • Address client questions regarding Analysis & Monitoring reports, IRS 6056 tax filings, and Employer Shared Responsibility regulations.

  • Maintain positive and professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ensure client inquiries are resolved accurately and in a timely manner.

Employer Shared Responsibility & Regulatory Support

  • Provide guidance and technical product support related to Employer Shared Responsibility Services.

  • Research and interpret information related to Employer Shared Responsibility regulations and IRS reporting requirements.

  • Utilize internal resources and systems, including:

    • AskIt

    • iComm

    • Salesforce

  • Reference external regulatory resources, including:

    • Internal Revenue Service (IRS)

    • U.S. Department of the Treasury

  • Analyze information from multiple sources to identify and resolve client issues.

  • Provide appropriate recommendations to clients and internal business partners based on research and analysis.

Client Onboarding & System Administration

  • Support the setup and ongoing administration of ESR client accounts.

  • Develop and maintain knowledge of client account configurations, associated systems, and ESR processes.

  • Assist clients with system access, account setup, and product-related questions.

  • Troubleshoot client inquiries related to ESR services and reporting.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of client interactions, inquiries, and resolutions.

  • Record internal and external communications to ensure client needs and responses are properly documented.

Description:

Core Technical Competencies

•Technical Drawing & CAD – Experience with E-CAD tools, preferably Zuken E3; 3D wiring harness layouts; bill-of-materials (BOM) alignment; revision control and version management

•Owns end-to-end interconnect design and documentation for complex subsystems/systems

•Mentors junior engineers on harness design, routing best practices, and tool usage
•Collaborates across mechanical, firmware, systems, and test engineering to resolve signal-integrity and power-distribution issues
•Performs risk assessments for cable failure modes, thermal overload, and ESD/EMI susceptibility
•Manages revisions, configurations, and traceability throughout the product lifecycle

Frequently Used Standards & Toolsets
•MIL-STD-1513 (Interconnect diagrams), MIL-STD-461/464 (EMC)
•IPC/WHMA-A-620 (Cable and wire harness assembly requirements)
•Zuken E3, or equivalent
•Power system analysis tools (ETAP, SKM, or project-specific equivalents)

Candidates must possess Bachelor's degree and have 5 years of EE or ME experience in the aerospace industry.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cybersecurity Champion Lead
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to serve as a Cybersecurity Champion Lead, supporting the development and security of medical device instrument control software.

In this role, you will work closely with software development teams to provide guidance on secure software design, cybersecurity risk assessments, vulnerability management, and security best practices. You will also lead department-wide cybersecurity improvement initiatives and collaborate with the Product Security & Privacy Organization (PSPO) to strengthen security across the product portfolio.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in secure software development, cybersecurity risk management, and software security technologies, along with knowledge of medical device cybersecurity regulations and standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a cybersecurity subject matter expert (SME), supporting risk assessments across the RTD product portfolio, including risk identification, analysis, and verification of mitigation measures.

  • Partner with software development teams to identify vulnerabilities, evaluate potential security threats, and recommend appropriate remediation strategies.

  • Provide technical guidance on secure software design patterns, security technologies, and best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Develop and review cybersecurity documentation, including security concepts, secure designs, risk assessments, and plans to maintain product security throughout its lifecycle.

  • Coordinate and oversee penetration testing activities with internal development teams and external security providers.

  • Review penetration testing results, assess identified vulnerabilities, and track remediation efforts through resolution.

  • Collaborate with the Product Security & Privacy Organization (PSPO) to communicate cybersecurity process updates, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

  • Lead department-level cybersecurity improvement initiatives to strengthen the overall security posture of the product portfolio.

  • Prepare and present cybersecurity findings, risk assessments, and product security updates to technical teams, management, and other internal stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Education and Experience

Candidates must meet one of the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline with at least 8 years of relevant experience.

  • Master's degree in a related discipline with at least 4 years of relevant experience.

  • PhD in a related discipline with at least 2 years of relevant experience.

  • Equivalent combinations of education and directly related experience may be considered.

Technical Requirements

  • Professional experience in secure software development and cybersecurity practices.

  • Experience conducting cybersecurity risk assessments, identifying vulnerabilities, and implementing security mitigation strategies.

  • Knowledge of secure software design principles, security technologies, and vulnerability management.

  • Experience working with software development teams to address security concerns throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Knowledge of Windows operating systems and the .NET technology stack.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity regulations, laws, and industry standards applicable to medical devices.

  • Ability to develop, review, and maintain technical cybersecurity documentation.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain cybersecurity risks and technical findings to diverse audiences.

  • Strong organizational, planning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with medical device software, particularly in vitro diagnostic (IVD) systems.

  • Knowledge of cloud security concepts and technologies.

  • Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA.

  • Familiarity with Java and Linux environments.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on software security professional who understands how applications are developed and secured. This individual should be comfortable working directly with software engineers, evaluating cybersecurity risks, coordinating penetration testing, and recommending practical security improvements.

The position requires someone who can take ownership of cybersecurity initiatives, communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, and help ensure medical device software remains secure throughout its lifecycle.

Under general supervision, perform skilled duties in the soldering PCB components, testing, troubleshooting, repair, and calibration of equipment in the Electronics Laboratory; maintain, trouble shoot and repair high power electronics products (up to 8KW) such as 3 phase power supply, motor drives etc., and perform related work as required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide manufacturing test support, trouble-shooting, fault isolation and corrective actions

Maintains records on equipment repairs, warranties and schematics

  • Create ADCNs for minor electronics assembly rework instructions per IPC standards

  • Possess a strong work ethic, and commitment to excellence. Ability to communicate, ability to work in a team environment

job.title: Senior Materials Buyer
job.description:
Highly successful, cutting-edge, global electronics manufacturing company has an excellent career opportunity for a Senior Materials Buyer to join their Purchasing dept and take full advantage of everything this company has to offer in terms an exceptional  work culture, career progression and generous benefits package!
The Senior Materials Buyer oversees procurement activities to ensure the timely availability of all materials and services required to support operations. This includes sourcing and purchasing across multiple categories, including metals, plastics/resins, components, chemicals, packaging, critical MRO items, and outsourced processes.. 

Responsibilities of Senior Materials Buyer

  • Coordinate purchasing requirements by aligning material needs with production plans, customer orders, demand forecasts, and EDI releases.
  • Execute daily and weekly MRP runs to maintain adequate material supply, minimize shortages, and keep production schedules on track.
  • Evaluate MRP outputs and turn planned requirements into purchase orders, modifying delivery timelines through expedited orders, schedule adjustments, or cancellations as necessary.
  • Oversee and update ERP planning data, including supplier information, lead times, minimum order quantities (MOQ), lot sizing, safety stock, scrap and yield factors, and bills of material (BOMs).
  • Manage new product introductions, engineering changes, and material phase-in/phase-out activities to minimize shortages and obsolete inventory.
  • Work closely with warehouse personnel to ensure proper FIFO inventory rotation and compliance with material shelf-life requirements.
  • Issue and manage purchase orders, supplier schedules, and material call-offs.
  • Manage coordination of external processing activities, including plating, heat treatment, and coating, while ensuring materials are delivered to and returned from suppliers according to required timelines.
  • Monitor and track inbound and outsourced-process freight costs.
Qualifications of Senior Materials Buyer
  • Bachelor's or Associate's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of experience in materials planning, procurement, or supply chain operations within a manufacturing setting; experience in the automotive industry is a plus.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using ERP systems, with practical experience managing MRP processes, purchase orders, and maintaining planning-related master data.
  • Thorough understanding of MRP principles, inventory planning, lead times, safety stock management, and lot-sizing methodologies.
  • Experience managing supplier relationships, purchase orders, and outsourced manufacturing processes.
  • Knowledge of inventory control practices, including FIFO, cycle counting, and inventory accuracy management.
  • Experience working with metals, plastics/resins, and outsourced processes such as plating or coating.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills preferred.

job.title: Media Intelligence, Monitoring & Reporting Specialist
job.description:
Media Intelligence & Monitoring Specialist

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Media Intelligence & Monitoring Specialist to support the Corporate Communications team by managing day-to-day media intelligence, monitoring, issue escalation, and reporting across traditional, digital, and social media channels.

This position is responsible for providing hands-on oversight of media monitoring platforms and external intelligence services, identifying emerging issues, maintaining accurate real-time media coverage, and translating external information into actionable insights.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in media monitoring, social listening, reputation management, communications analytics, and executive reporting, along with experience supporting communications efforts within a regulated or reputation-sensitive corporate environment.

Key Responsibilities

Media Monitoring & Intelligence

  • Monitor traditional, digital, and social media coverage related to:

    • Company news and developments

    • Industry trends and emerging issues

    • Public policy and regulatory developments

    • Competitor activities

    • Executive leadership coverage

    • Corporate reputation and brand perception

  • Identify emerging issues, potential reputational risks, and significant media developments.

  • Maintain accurate and timely monitoring of priority topics across multiple media channels.

  • Provide human oversight of automated monitoring platforms and external intelligence services.

  • Ensure comprehensive media coverage and identify potential monitoring gaps.

Media Monitoring Platforms & Data Analysis

  • Develop, manage, and refine media monitoring queries, dashboards, alerts, and reporting frameworks.

  • Establish and maintain monitoring taxonomies to improve the organization and relevance of media intelligence.

  • Perform quality assurance (QA) reviews of monitoring results to evaluate:

    • Relevance and accuracy

    • Duplicate coverage

    • Missing or incomplete information

    • Coverage gaps

    • Emerging trends and issues

  • Optimize monitoring configurations to improve the quality and effectiveness of media intelligence.

  • Utilize media monitoring and social listening platforms, including Hootsuite and Talkwalker, when applicable.

Reporting & Executive Communications

  • Prepare and distribute media intelligence reports and updates, including:

    • Daily media briefings

    • Executive-level updates

    • Topic-specific analyses and deep dives

    • Recurring media monitoring reports

    • Emerging issue and reputation assessments

  • Analyze media coverage and external developments to identify meaningful trends and insights.

  • Translate complex media information into clear, concise, and actionable reporting for leadership and internal stakeholders.

  • Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and aligned with business and communications priorities.

Issue Identification & Escalation

  • Identify and escalate time-sensitive media developments and emerging reputational concerns.

  • Apply sound judgment when evaluating the significance and urgency of media coverage.

  • Communicate potential risks and developments to appropriate internal stakeholders.

  • Support issue management and crisis communications activities through timely monitoring and reporting.

  • Maintain consistent escalation practices to ensure critical information reaches the appropriate teams.

Vendor Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for external media intelligence suppliers and service providers.

  • Coordinate with monitoring vendors to maintain service quality, reporting accuracy, and coverage effectiveness.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including:

    • Earned Media and Public Relations

    • Social Media

    • Government Affairs

    • Regulatory Affairs

    • Enterprise Insights

    • Crisis Communications

  • Support cross-functional communications initiatives by providing relevant media intelligence and analysis.

  • Ensure media monitoring activities align with broader corporate communications and reputation management priorities.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field.

  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.

Professional Experience

  • 5–7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Media Monitoring

    • Media Intelligence

    • Social Listening

    • Reputation Management

    • Communications Analytics

  • Hands-on experience developing and managing media monitoring queries, dashboards, alerts, and recurring reports.

  • Experience analyzing media coverage and identifying emerging issues or reputational risks.

  • Experience preparing executive-level reports, briefings, and actionable insights.

  • Experience working within a regulated, reputation-sensitive, or complex corporate environment.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with media monitoring and social listening platforms.

  • Hootsuite and/or Talkwalker experience preferred.

  • Strong ability to develop and refine search queries, monitoring alerts, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.

  • Experience performing quality assurance reviews of media monitoring results.

  • Ability to analyze traditional, digital, and social media data.

  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.

Professional Skills

  • Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to translate complex information into concise, executive-ready reports.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

  • Ability to identify, prioritize, and escalate emerging issues.

  • Sound judgment when evaluating sensitive or time-critical information.

  • Ability to manage multiple monitoring priorities and deadlines.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced corporate environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Hootsuite, Talkwalker, or comparable media intelligence platforms.

job.description:

Nesco Resource has an exciting new career opportunity for you! Nesco Resource is currently hiring dependable and motivated Loader Machine Operators to join our client's team in Williamsport, PA. Multiple positions available with immediate start! If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, clean environment and take pride in quality work, we want to hear from you!

 Job Summary

The Loader Machine Operator is responsible for monitoring and operating an automated robotic system that feeds eggs into the grading machine. This position ensures smooth production by monitoring equipment performance, responding to alarms, performing basic troubleshooting, and working closely with maintenance and production teams to minimize downtime and maintain efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor the robotic loading system, conveyors, sensors, and related equipment to ensure consistent product flow.

  • Follow required safety procedures, PPE requirements, and lockout/tagout practices.

  • Support production goals by helping maintain equipment efficiency and reduce downtime.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Previous experience in machine operation, manufacturing, food production, or packaging is preferred.

  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and recognize equipment, product-quality, and safety concerns.

  • Basic math skills and the ability to accurately complete production documentation.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work safely and effectively in a fast-paced production environment.

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.

  • Flexibility to work overtime, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

  • Ability to wear required PPE and perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.

Physical & Work Environment

  • Ability to bend, stoop, reach, push, pull, and perform repetitive tasks.

  • Ability to lift and handle materials up to 50 pounds with assistance or approved equipment.

  • Must follow all safety, food-safety, and PPE requirements.

  • Must be available to work overtime as needed.

  • Schedule flexibility is required based on production and business needs.

job.title: CNC Machine Operator - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Job Overview

The CNC Operator is responsible for setting up and operating CNC mills and lathes to produce high-quality parts according to specifications. Operators will prepare machines, monitor production, and inspect finished components to ensure compliance with quality requirements.
Shift: 2nd Shift / 2pm - 10:30pm

A Day In The Life

Every day is different, and you'll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you'll make a difference by:

  • Preparing and operating CNC machines for tasks such as drilling and milling
  • Reading and interpreting blueprints and mechanical drawings
  • Loading raw materials and parts onto machines
  • Performing test runs and adjusting settings to meet specifications
  • Monitoring machine operations and adjusting for optimal results
  • Inspecting and measuring finished products for accuracy and quality
  • Performing routine maintenance and daily checks on equipment
  • Maintaining accurate job logs, routers, and related documentation
  • Keeping work areas clean and organized in compliance with safety standards
  • Supporting team scheduling, training, and workflow coordination as needed

What will help you thrive in this role?

  • High School Diploma or equivalent (required)
  • Certificate or diploma from a trade school (preferred)

job.title: Mechanical Designer
job.description:
Job Title: Mechanical Designer
Wilmington, NC, Onsite
M-F, 8-5pm. occasional overtime (10–20 hours per week) during peak project periods

Role Summary
We are seeking Mechanical Designer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating and refining mechanical equipment designs and layouts using advanced CAD tools, ensuring strict adherence to *** Machine Drafting Standards. Your work will directly contribute to optimizing production systems, resolving design challenges, and delivering innovative solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and deliver mechanical equipment designs and layouts using AutoCAD® and Inventor, ensuring compliance with *** drafting standards.
Produce and maintain detailed drawing packages, build packages, machine part lists, illustrations, and equipment specifications for production systems.
Redesign mechanical components to reduce installation costs, resolve equipment interferences, and correct design deficiencies.
Execute design changes to address equipment or process challenges, ensuring all designs meet functional and performance requirements.
Provide detailed sketches and marked-up drawings to address evolving project needs.
Perform elementary design calculations (e.g., statics, hydraulics, power transmission) to support both new designs and modifications of existing systems.

Required Education & Skills
Associate's degree (AAS) in Mechanical Engineering Technology or a Bachelor's degree (BS) in Mechanical Engineering Technology or Mechanical Engineering.
A minimum of 3–5 years of professional experience in mechanical design, preferably in an industrial or manufacturing setting. Ability to interpret electrical schematics and translate engineering solutions into equipment design requirements.
Demonstrated commitment to job site safety.
Familiarity with manufacturing processes, including machining and fabrication, to ensure efficient and practical designs.

Desired Skills
Highly motivated and results-oriented professional with excellent organizational skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing project requirements.
Comfortable working in small teams and collaborating across departments to meet deadlines.
Experience with precision measurement tools (e.g., tape measures, calipers, micrometers).
Travel Requirements
Occasional travel may be required to vendor locations to gather equipment-related information; travel is expected to be minimal.
Travel will be required to *** Optical Fiber and Cable Manufacturing sites in North Carolina.
Hours of Work/Work Schedule
40 hours/week. Flexibility is required, with occasional overtime (10–20 hours per week) during peak project periods.

job.title: Production Structures/Assembler - F16/C130
job.description:
Description:
You will be the Production Structures/Assembler, F16/C130 Technician for the *** Greenville Production Team. Our team is responsible for Production build, repair and delivery of F-16/C-130 aircraft to our customers.

What You Will Be Doing

As the Production Structures/Assembler, F16/C-130 Technician you will be responsible for interpreting blueprints, fabrication of assemblies, installation and repairs of various sheet metal and structural assemblies and sub-assemblies for F16/C-130 aircraft utilizing sheet metal tools.

The Production Structures/Assembler, F16/C-130 Technician will also need to be knowledgeable in aircraft structural assembly operation and maintenance to include:
• Precision Drilling/Reaming
• Riveting/installation of various fasteners

The candidate will be required to:

Comprehend documents such as safety rules, operating maintenance instructions and procedure manuals.

Use hands to grasp, handle, and/or feel, reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear.

Frequently stand, walk, stoop, kneel, squat, crawl, twist, and work on or in the aircraft.

Frequently lift and/or push or pull up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or push or pull up to 50 pounds.

Perform repetitive movements and work overhead.

Work in a safe and efficient manner while maintaining a clean, FOD-free work area.

Properly use, handle and dispose of hazardous materials, and toxic or caustic chemicals per Government regulations and company procedures

Mission essential functions and other duties may be assigned as required.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee will be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as needed to perform job tasks. The employee is regularly exposed to vibration.

Basic Qualifications:

C-130 specific structures experience or extensive experience with flight control work including ailerons, rudders, flaps, etc.

Light structure repair and replacement of thin skins

8+ years of aviation, heavy/light manufacturing/assembly or repair experience

Basic understanding of manufacturing process.

Ability to perform assembly and installation work using assembly, jigs, fixtures, test equipment, precision measuring instruments, and mechanics hand tools.

Experience reading and interpreting written specifications, blueprints and engineering drawings, understanding symbols, flags, and general notes.

Desired skills:

Heavy/Light Aircraft Structural Repair or Aircraft Sheet metal experience.

Aircraft structural modification or heavy/light structures overhaul experience.

Aircraft assembly, maintenance and/or modification experience preferred. Will consider commercial experience.

Experience with drill ream and countersink, hydraulic installs.

job.title: Production Associate - 2nd B1
job.description:
Performs typical manufacturing operations to support the press production and assembly operations in a lean manufacturing environment using a variety of equipment including but not limited to the set up machines including automated equipment and/or metal stamping presses by performing the following job responsibilities:

* Actively participates in lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives
* Adheres to all policies and procedures
* Maintains a neat and organized work area
* Set and change dies, adjust components, operate machines to shear, punch, crimp, notch, bend or straighten stainless steel to precise measurements.
* Start machines, monitor their operations, and record operational data.
* Set, test and/or adjust machines speeds and actions, according to product specifications, standardized work instructions and process cards.
* Clean and perform basic preventative maintenance on assigned equipment daily, weekly and monthly.
* Examine completed pieces for defects such as slugs, smears, scratches, burrs, etc. and sort defective pieces according to types of flaws.
* Install, align and set specified dies, robotic arms, or other fixtures in machines, using gauges, templates, shims, hand tools, etc.
* Load pieces or steel coils into machines for production processing.
* Measure completed parts to verify conformance to specifications, using micrometers, gauges, calipers, etc.
* Read, understand, and follow work orders and production schedules to determine specifications, such as material to be used, process card, work instructions to be used for processing needed parts.
* Enter data into computer either using MRP system using bar code scanners or manual entry or statistical data into other software as instructed.
* Detects and reports defective materials and/or questionable conditions to the department supervisor.
* Maintains the work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition and follows prescribed safety processes.
* Operate industrial power trucks, i.e. forktrucks, etc.
* Complete tasks as directed by manufacturing schedules with minimal supervision.
* Bring any discrepancies, production issues, quality concerns, and/or safety issues to the attention of immediate supervisor, or floor manager.
* Team Members assigned to the Coating/Mixing Lab are responsible for proper segregation and accumulation of both hazardous and non-hazardous waste coating and ancillary mixing wastes.
* Attend various training sessions including annual (RCRA) hazardous waste.
* Follows established methods and procedures.
* Other duties as assigned or needed.

job.title: Senior Network Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Nesco Data Center is seeking a Sr Network Solutions Engineer in the Greater Elk Grove IL area.

Network Engineer – Data Center & Critical Infrastructure

Position Overview

The Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, supporting, securing, and maintaining the network infrastructure that supports data center operations and critical facility systems.

This individual will provide technical ownership of the networks connecting operational technology (OT), facility management platforms, and critical infrastructure systems. These environments may include Building Management Systems (Client), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), environmental monitoring, physical security systems, access control, surveillance, and other technologies essential to the safe and reliable operation of mission-critical facilities.

The Network Engineer will work closely with Construction, Data Center Operations, Facilities Management, IT, Information Security, engineering teams, customers, vendors, and third-party service providers. The position will support network infrastructure throughout the lifecycle of a facility, from construction and commissioning through ongoing operations and compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Network Infrastructure

  • Design, install, configure, administer, and support network infrastructure within data center and critical facility environments.

  • Configure and maintain switches, routers, firewalls, wireless networks, VPNs, and other network technologies.

  • Support highly available and resilient network environments designed to meet operational, security, and compliance requirements.

  • Assist with network architecture, capacity planning, segmentation, and infrastructure upgrades.

  • Support environments subject to security and compliance standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other applicable requirements.

Operational Technology & Critical Facility Systems

Provide network engineering and technical support for operational technology and facility-related systems, including:

  • Building Management Systems (Client)

  • Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)

  • Environmental and facility monitoring platforms

  • Physical access control systems

  • Video surveillance and security systems

  • UPS, generator, cooling, and power monitoring platforms

  • Data center infrastructure monitoring and management systems

  • Other network-connected operational and facility equipment

Work closely with facility and engineering teams to ensure these systems maintain reliable, secure, and highly available connectivity.

Network Monitoring & Performance

  • Monitor network performance, traffic, bandwidth utilization, latency, packet loss, interface errors, and overall device health.

  • Identify potential network issues before they impact critical operations.

  • Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, and infrastructure issues across network and operational technology environments.

  • Utilize monitoring, logging, and traffic analysis tools to maintain visibility into network performance and availability.

  • Support continuous improvement efforts focused on reducing downtime and improving network reliability.

Network & Operational Technology Security

  • Implement and maintain security controls designed to protect network infrastructure, operational technology systems, and critical facility environments.

  • Support network segmentation, least-privilege access, secure authentication, remote access controls, and other cybersecurity best practices.

  • Assist with vulnerability identification, risk assessments, remediation planning, patch coordination, and validation activities.

  • Participate in security monitoring and incident response activities involving network and operational systems.

  • Balance cybersecurity requirements with the availability and operational needs of mission-critical infrastructure.

Vendor & Remote Access Management

  • Work directly with equipment manufacturers, vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.

  • Support secure third-party and vendor remote access to network and operational systems.

  • Ensure remote access is properly authenticated, authorized, segmented, monitored, and restricted to appropriate systems.

  • Assist with evaluating vendors and technical solutions supporting critical infrastructure.

Incident Response & Troubleshooting

  • Respond to network outages, connectivity issues, performance degradation, and other incidents impacting critical operations.

  • Assist with cybersecurity incidents affecting network or operational technology systems.

  • Support containment, investigation, recovery, and restoration efforts following technical or security incidents.

  • Participate in root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions to prevent recurring issues.

Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery

  • Participate in the development and maintenance of business continuity and disaster recovery procedures for critical network and operational systems.

  • Support testing and validation of recovery procedures.

  • Help identify single points of failure and recommend improvements to increase network resiliency and recoverability.

Change & Configuration Management

  • Develop implementation plans and technical procedures for significant network changes.

  • Perform risk assessments and establish testing, validation, and rollback procedures.

  • Maintain standardized network configurations and configuration baselines.

  • Follow established change management and incident management processes.

  • Ensure emergency network changes are properly documented and reviewed.

Documentation & Asset Management

  • Develop and maintain accurate network architecture and topology diagrams.

  • Maintain documentation for network configurations, connectivity, and critical systems.

  • Track network equipment and assets, including manufacturer, model, serial number, location, IP address, firmware version, warranty information, and lifecycle status where applicable.

  • Maintain records necessary to support troubleshooting, security reviews, compliance assessments, and audits.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Support technical risk assessments involving new and existing network and operational systems.

  • Identify potential risks and assist in developing practical remediation or risk-treatment plans.

  • Participate in security and compliance reviews for new systems and significant infrastructure changes.

  • Work with IT, Information Security, Compliance, and other stakeholders to ensure appropriate technical and security requirements are met.

  • Maintain documentation necessary to support internal and external audits.

Technical Support & Collaboration

  • Serve as a technical resource for network architecture, connectivity, cybersecurity, and operational technology requirements.

  • Work collaboratively with Construction, Operations, Facilities Management, IT, Information Security, engineering teams, customers, and vendors.

  • Participate in planning and technical reviews for new data center facilities, expansions, system replacements, and technology modernization initiatives.

  • Provide technical guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Stay informed on emerging networking technologies, cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, vendor advisories, and industry best practices relevant to data center and critical infrastructure environments.

Travel Requirements

This position may require travel to data center and customer locations as necessary to support installations, troubleshooting, project activities, and other business requirements.

Travel expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with company policies.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred.

  • Equivalent combinations of professional experience, technical training, and certifications will be considered.

  • Approximately 7–10 years of experience supporting and administering enterprise network environments.

  • Experience supporting networks within data centers, critical facilities, industrial environments, or other highly available environments strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Technical Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate experience with:

  • TCP/IP networking and Layer 2 and Layer 3 network architecture

  • Enterprise switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure

  • VPN technologies and secure remote connectivity

  • VLANs, ACLs, routing, switching, and network segmentation

  • Network troubleshooting and performance analysis

  • Network security principles and defense-in-depth strategies

  • Secure authentication and least-privilege access

  • Network monitoring and logging tools

  • Syslog, SNMP, NetFlow, and similar network analysis technologies

  • Vulnerability management and configuration hardening

  • Security monitoring and incident response

  • Formal change management and configuration management processes

  • Highly available and resilient network environments

  • Operational Technology (OT) and critical infrastructure environments

  • Cybersecurity frameworks and standards applicable to enterprise and OT systems

  • APIs, system integrations, and modern technology communication standards

  • Familiarity with emerging technologies, including AI-enabled platforms and communications, is a plus

Professional Skills

The successful candidate should possess:

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

  • The ability to evaluate technical risks and recommend practical solutions.

  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and technical issues simultaneously.

  • An understanding of the balance between cybersecurity requirements and the operational availability requirements of mission-critical facilities.

  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.

  • The ability to travel to customer and data center locations and install or support physical network equipment when required.

  • The ability to appropriately handle confidential and sensitive technical and business information.

Preferred Certifications

Relevant certifications are preferred but not required. Equivalent professional experience will be considered.

Preferred certifications may include:

  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)

  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP)

  • CompTIA Network+

  • CompTIA Security+

  • GIAC or other cybersecurity and OT security certifications

  • Fortinet certifications

  • Palo Alto Networks certifications

  • Check Point certifications

  • Cisco security or networking certifications

  • Other relevant certifications related to networking, cybersecurity, data centers, critical infrastructure, or Operational Technology

Role Summary
We are seeking a Mechanical Technician to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for providing mechanical discipline support in the construction, installation, debug, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and automated systems including hands-on to the point of turnover to operations at domestic manufacturing sites; majority of time is spent on the floor working on equipment. Provide directions to outside contract trades during all aspects of equipment installation and conversion such as demolition, construction, installation, testing, and debug of production equipment. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Key Responsibilities
Assist in developing and using project plans and timelines to achieve project goals without sacrificing safety, intellectual property, or quality.
Develop understanding of process and equipment functions in area of responsibility
Assess condition and usability of existing equipment for fit and function with new installation plans.
Execute initial equipment set-up and debug up to the point of turnover to operations.
Create, review, and update installation documentation and drawings as required.
Develop and use project plans and timelines to achieve project goals.

40 hours/week. Flexibility is required, with occasional overtime (10–20 hours per week) during peak project periods.
Overtime is not uncommon and is indeed expected at times, however the amount and duration will vary as a function of the job position, particular project, and point in the project life cycle.

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Overview

Join our dynamic aerospace manufacturing team in North Phoenix, AZ, as we seek an experienced leader to manage our Quality Management System (QMS). This role focuses on ensuring compliance with AS9100 standards, preparing for NADCAP audits, and driving continuous improvement across our operations. Collaborate closely with Manufacturing and Engineering teams to deliver products that meet or exceed customer and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor the Quality team to achieve departmental goals.
  • Maintain and enhance the AS9100 Quality Management System.
  • Coordinate and manage AS9100, NADCAP, customer, and internal audits.
  • Oversee AS9102 First Article Inspections, calibration, traceability, and management of quality records.
  • Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
  • Conduct root cause investigations and implement corrective actions.
  • Monitor quality metrics and spearhead continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Purchasing, and Operations to resolve quality issues.
  • Support supplier quality assurance and maintain quality documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience in aerospace quality management.

job.description:
Material Handler

Schedule:

2nd Shift: Monday through Friday 3:30 PM to 2:00 AM

Description:

Join our team as a Material Handler, a full-time production role equivalent to a Rigger classification. In this role, you'll begin with a compulsory Training Period, setting you up for success in our fast-paced environment. After completing training, you'll be assigned to a production shift and may be required to work overtime.

Essential Functions/Tasks:

As a Material Handler, you'll be essential to our production process. Your tasks will vary depending on your shift, production requirements, and supervisor instructions, including:

  • Operate Overhead Crane Systems: Handle steel beams, plates, and assemblies safely and efficiently.
  • Manage Steel and Equipment: Move and position small pieces of steel and shop equipment weighing between 10 to 50 pounds.

  • Drive Forklifts and Tractors: Use forklifts and tractors to move materials around the shop floor.
  • Load and Unload: Efficiently load and unload trucks and rail cars using the appropriate equipment and systems.
  • Maintain Cleanliness: Perform yard and building cleaning tasks, contributing to the overall maintenance of our facilities and equipment.

Physical Requirements:

You'll need adequate strength, mobility, dexterity, vision, hearing, and stamina to perform these tasks with minimal assistance.

Other Qualifications:

  • Education: A high school education is preferred.
  • Independence: Ability to follow instructions well and work without constant supervision.
  • Team Player: Willingness to collaborate and contribute to a positive work environment.

Why Join Us?

In this role, you'll find a supportive team environment where your skills and dedication are valued. You will work with advanced equipment and contribute to our production processes. With opportunities for overtime and growth, this position is both rewarding and fulfilling.

Join us and be part of a company that values hard work, precision, and teamwork. Apply now to start your journey as a Material Handler with us!

job.title: Production Associate- 3rd -B1
job.description:
Performs typical manufacturing operations to support the press production and assembly operations in a lean manufacturing environment using a variety of equipment including but not limited to the set up machines including automated equipment and/or metal stamping presses by performing the following job responsibilities:

* Actively participates in lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives
* Adheres to all policies and procedures
* Maintains a neat and organized work area
* Set and change dies, adjust components, operate machines to shear, punch, crimp, notch, bend or straighten stainless steel to precise measurements.
* Start machines, monitor their operations, and record operational data.
* Set, test and/or adjust machines speeds and actions, according to product specifications, standardized work instructions and process cards.
* Clean and perform basic preventative maintenance on assigned equipment daily, weekly and monthly.
* Examine completed pieces for defects such as slugs, smears, scratches, burrs, etc. and sort defective pieces according to types of flaws.
* Install, align and set specified dies, robotic arms, or other fixtures in machines, using gauges, templates, shims, hand tools, etc.
* Load pieces or steel coils into machines for production processing.
* Measure completed parts to verify conformance to specifications, using micrometers, gauges, calipers, etc.
* Read, understand, and follow work orders and production schedules to determine specifications, such as material to be used, process card, work instructions to be used for processing needed parts.
* Enter data into computer either using MRP system using bar code scanners or manual entry or statistical data into other software as instructed.
* Detects and reports defective materials and/or questionable conditions to the department supervisor.
* Maintains the work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition and follows prescribed safety processes.
* Operate industrial power trucks, i.e. forktrucks, etc.
* Complete tasks as directed by manufacturing schedules with minimal supervision.
* Bring any discrepancies, production issues, quality concerns, and/or safety issues to the attention of immediate supervisor, or floor manager.
* Team Members assigned to the Coating/Mixing Lab are responsible for proper segregation and accumulation of both hazardous and non-hazardous waste coating and ancillary mixing wastes.
* Attend various training sessions including annual (RCRA) hazardous waste.
* Follows established methods and procedures.
* Other duties as assigned or needed.
COM017

job.title: Electro-Mechanical Inspector
job.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Electro-Mechanical Inspector to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for conducting electrical inspections of assemblies and sub-assemblies using documented test procedures. The role involves documenting test and inspection results in accordance with company procedures and performing dimensional inspection on products using calipers, micrometers, and height gauges.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct electrical inspections of assemblies and sub-assemblies using documented test procedures.
  • Document test and inspection results in accordance with Company procedures.
  • Perform dimensional inspection on products using calipers, micrometers, and height gauges.
  • Perform visual and dimensional inspection on products per procedures.
  • Perform first piece inspection and in-process inspections.
  • Communicate with production supervisor / team leaders / operators regarding problems found during inspections.
  • Write non-conforming material reports for defective products.
  • Contribute to the continued development of test and troubleshooting techniques.

Qualifications:

  • Ability to conduct test procedures to published documents.
  • Ability to operate dedicated test rigs.
  • Ability to operate standard measuring equipment including DVM, Hi-Pot, Bonding resistance.
  • Ability to work with minimum technical and administrative supervision.
  • Background concerning the usage and care of precision measuring tools and equipment.
  • Ability to effectively read and understand blueprints, engineering documents, inspection manuals and procedures in English.
  • Must have experience using various mechanical inspection tools, such as micrometers and calipers.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in electrical / mechanical inspection.
  • Proficiency in using calipers, micrometers, and height gauges.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new procedures.

job.title: Lockbox Extractor(Banking)
job.description:
Lockbox Extractor 

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Banking Operations Specialist to support daily banking operations, document processing, data entry, and administrative functions.

Under direct supervision, this position is responsible for performing routine operational tasks in accordance with established procedures, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring timely processing of financial documents and transactions.

The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, proficiency in data entry and 10-key operations, and the ability to work efficiently in a high-volume, production-driven environment.

Position Details

  • Work Arrangement: 100% On-site, 5 days per week

  • Interview Process: On-site interview required

  • Required Testing: Candidates must complete sorting and data entry assessments during the interview.

  • Experience Required: 0–1 years

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; college degree preferred

Key Responsibilities

Banking Operations & Transaction Processing

  • Perform routine banking operations and administrative tasks following established procedures and guidelines.

  • Process, record, file, service, and organize documentation associated with banking products and operational processes.

  • Support operations across various banking functions, which may include:

    • Credit cards

    • Retail banking

    • Small business banking

    • Consumer lending

    • Mortgage banking

    • Collections and recovery

    • Loan origination

    • Auto finance

  • Complete assigned processing activities accurately and within established deadlines.

  • Maintain compliance with banking procedures, documentation standards, and operational requirements.

  • Escalate processing discrepancies, concerns, and issues to management as appropriate.

Mail Processing, Sorting & Document Handling

  • Open incoming mail and extract paper invoices, checks, and other financial documents.

  • Accurately sort payment and non-payment documents for processing.

  • Organize and batch documents according to established procedures.

  • Ensure documents are properly prepared and routed for processing.

  • Identify and communicate processing discrepancies to the Workflow Coordinator or Supervisor.

  • Maintain accuracy and efficiency when handling high volumes of mail and financial documents.

Data Entry & 10-Key Processing

  • Perform high-volume data entry with a strong emphasis on speed and accuracy.

  • Utilize 10-key data entry skills to process financial and transaction information.

  • Enter, verify, and maintain information across multiple computer systems.

  • Review data and documents to identify errors or discrepancies.

  • Meet established production goals, processing deadlines, and quality standards.

  • Maintain accuracy while performing repetitive, detail-oriented tasks.

Administrative & Operational Support

  • Prepare reports and maintain accurate operational records.

  • Complete routine filing, documentation, and recordkeeping activities.

  • Follow clearly defined procedures and instructions to complete assigned tasks.

  • Assist with reviewing documentation to ensure proper processing procedures are followed.

  • Perform basic scheduled and non-scheduled maintenance functions as required.

  • Support additional operational activities and administrative assignments as directed by management.

Customer Service & Team Collaboration

  • Assist with routine billing inquiries, service requests, customer suggestions, and complaints as needed.

  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, Workflow Coordinators, and team members.

  • Identify, assess, and escalate issues appropriately.

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues to maintain operational efficiency and meet department goals.

  • Participate in cross-training to provide coverage across critical department functions, including:

    • Mail sorting

    • Data entry and keying

    • Document reassociation

    • Transaction processing

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent work experience required.

  • College degree preferred.

  • 0–1 years of relevant work experience.

  • General office, administrative, banking operations, or transaction processing experience preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Strong 10-key data entry skills, with the ability to maintain speed and accuracy.

  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems and software applications.

  • Experience or ability to handle high-volume transaction processing.

job.title: Production Associate-1st - B1
job.description:
Performs typical manufacturing operations to support the press production and assembly operations in a lean manufacturing environment using a variety of equipment including but not limited to the set up machines including automated equipment and/or metal stamping presses by performing the following job responsibilities:

* Actively participates in lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives
* Adheres to all policies and procedures
* Maintains a neat and organized work area
* Set and change dies, adjust components, operate machines to shear, punch, crimp, notch, bend or straighten stainless steel to precise measurements.
* Start machines, monitor their operations, and record operational data.
* Set, test and/or adjust machines speeds and actions, according to product specifications, standardized work instructions and process cards.
* Clean and perform basic preventative maintenance on assigned equipment daily, weekly and monthly.
* Examine completed pieces for defects such as slugs, smears, scratches, burrs, etc. and sort defective pieces according to types of flaws.
* Install, align and set specified dies, robotic arms, or other fixtures in machines, using gauges, templates, shims, hand tools, etc.
* Load pieces or steel coils into machines for production processing.
* Measure completed parts to verify conformance to specifications, using micrometers, gauges, calipers, etc.
* Read, understand, and follow work orders and production schedules to determine specifications, such as material to be used, process card, work instructions to be used for processing needed parts.
* Enter data into computer either using MRP system using bar code scanners or manual entry or statistical data into other software as instructed.
* Detects and reports defective materials and/or questionable conditions to the department supervisor.
* Maintains the work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition and follows prescribed safety processes.
* Operate industrial power trucks, i.e. forktrucks, etc.
* Complete tasks as directed by manufacturing schedules with minimal supervision.
* Bring any discrepancies, production issues, quality concerns, and/or safety issues to the attention of immediate supervisor, or floor manager.
* Team Members assigned to the Coating/Mixing Lab are responsible for proper segregation and accumulation of both hazardous and non-hazardous waste coating and ancillary mixing wastes.
* Attend various training sessions including annual (RCRA) hazardous waste.
* Follows established methods and procedures.
* Other duties as assigned or needed.

job.description:

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative, detail-oriented, and experienced Graphic Designer to join a collaborative creative studio team supporting commercial marketing and medical strategy initiatives within the biotechnology and healthcare industry.

This position will focus heavily on the hands-on design, execution, and production of high-quality creative assets across digital and print platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong traditional graphic design fundamentals with expertise in modern design tools, including Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and emerging generative AI technologies.

Working closely with an Art Director, Project Manager, Copywriters, and Brand Marketing teams, the Graphic Designer will be responsible for developing both new and derivative creative materials while ensuring brand consistency, regulatory compliance, and exceptional design quality.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a strategic creative initiative, producing assets across multiple brands and marketing channels while exploring innovative tools and processes to improve creative efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Creative Production

  • Serve as the primary Graphic Designer, partnering directly with the Art Director and brand teams to develop a high volume of creative assets and promotional materials.

    • Email marketing campaigns

    • Social media advertisements

    • Digital banners and display ads

Brand Consistency & Regulatory Compliance

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Art Directors, Project Managers, Copywriters, Marketers, and Brand teams throughout the creative process.

Creative Innovation & Process Improvement

  • Support testing and implementation of innovative tools that accelerate production without compromising quality.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of creative processes and design execution.

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field.

Professional Experience

Technical Skills

job.title: UX Designer (Mid-Level)
job.description:
User Experience (UX) Designer – Mid-Level
Employment Type: Contract
Experience Level: Mid-Level (3+ Years)
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – Onsite Tuesday through Thursday; Remote Monday and Friday
Travel: Occasional travel may be required
 
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced User Experience (UX) Designer to support the development and improvement of our building automation software platform. This role focuses on creating intuitive, user-friendly experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile applications.
The UX Designer will work closely with product managers, software engineers, technical architects, researchers, and other UX professionals to develop practical design solutions that meet customer needs and business objectives.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with UX design tools, responsive web applications, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing. This individual should be comfortable working in a collaborative environment, incorporating feedback, and refining designs throughout the product development lifecycle.
 
Key Responsibilities
UX Design & Development
  • Create user flows, site maps, wireframes, interactive prototypes, journey maps, and conceptual designs.
  • Translate business requirements, stakeholder feedback, and user research into practical design solutions.
  • Design responsive user experiences for desktop, tablet, and mobile applications.
  • Develop low-fidelity and high-fidelity prototypes to communicate design concepts and functionality.
  • Apply established design systems, UX standards, and component libraries to maintain consistency across applications.
  • Improve existing UX/UI designs while contributing to future product enhancements.
User Research & Usability Testing
  • Participate in user research sessions to better understand customer needs, behaviors, and workflows.
  • Conduct, facilitate, or observe usability testing to evaluate design effectiveness.
  • Incorporate customer feedback and research findings into design improvements.
  • Identify usability challenges and recommend solutions that improve the overall user experience.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, technical leads, and UX team members throughout the design process.
  • Present design concepts, prototypes, and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Work with development teams to ensure designs are implemented accurately.
  • Adjust designs based on technical limitations, changing requirements, and business priorities.
  • Advocate for user-centered design while balancing functionality, technical feasibility, and business goals.
Required Qualifications
Education
- Bachelor's degree in User Experience Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design, Product Design, Computer Science, or a related field.
Professional Experience
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in UX Design, Product Design, User Research, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience designing responsive web applications for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Experience creating wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and other UX design deliverables.
  • Experience participating in usability testing, user research, and feedback sessions.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design, UX methodologies, and design thinking principles.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers, software engineers, technical architects, and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into clear, functional designs.
 Required Technical Skills
  • Figma: Creating wireframes, prototypes, and user interface designs.
  • Axure: Developing interactive prototypes and demonstrating application workflows.
  • Adobe Creative Suite: Creating and modifying visual design assets.
  • Miro: Supporting collaborative design sessions, brainstorming, journey mapping, and workflow visualization.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing SaaS products or enterprise software applications.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and React.
  • Experience with design systems, component libraries, and interaction design.
  • Familiarity with responsive design principles and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience with building automation systems, building controls, or HVAC technology.
  • Knowledge of Johnson Controls Metasys Server and Metasys Tools.
  • Ability to understand complex technical workflows and translate them into user-friendly designs.
  • Advanced degree in UX Design, HCI, Product Design, or a related discipline.
Key Competencies
  • Strong problem-solving and design thinking abilities.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.
  • Attention to detail and consistency in design execution.
  • Ability to manage multiple design assignments and meet deadlines.
  • Comfortable presenting design concepts and incorporating feedback.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with senior designers and technical teams.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies, applications, and industry-specific workflows.
Work Environment
  • Hybrid work schedule with onsite collaboration Tuesday through Thursday and remote work Monday and Friday.
  • Collaborative environment involving product management, UX design, software engineering, and technical leadership.
  • Occasional travel may be required for stakeholder meetings, customer engagement, and understanding product workflows.

job.title: Shipping Support Specialist
job.description:
RO L E OV E RV I E W
You'll sort, quality-check, and package thousands of e-commerce micro orders daily for one of our most demanding clients. This is high-volume, high-stakes work: orders ship same-day, quality tolerances are razor-thin, and the team stays until the day's work is done. You're the last quality gate before these packages reach customers worldwide.
R E S P O N S I B I L I T I E S
• Sort printed materials coming off bindery lines into individual e-commerce orders — handling thousands of units per day with zero-defect expectations
• Inspect each piece for quality issues (color shifts, alignment, damage) and flag defects immediately to production
• Use paper banders, tape machines, and scales to prepare orders for shipment according to exact client specifications
• Restock shipping consumables (boxes, tape, labels) proactively so the line never stops
• Track order completion in real-time via computer systems to maintain visibility on daily targets
• Stay until all e-commerce orders ship — end time varies based on volume, not the clock
• Adapt quickly when client specs change mid-shift or rush orders come in hot
W H AT W E ' R E L O O K I N G F O R
• 1+ years in a high-volume, automated production environment (fulfillment, manufacturing, food production, etc.) where accuracy and speed both mattered
• Proven track record of maintaining quality standards under pressure — not just meeting them when it's convenient
• Physical ability to lift 50lbs repeatedly and work on your feet for 8+ hours daily
• Comfort with computer systems for order tracking and basic data entry
• Willingness to stay late when the work demands it — this isn't a punch-out-at-4:30 role if orders are still running
N I C E TO H AV E
• Experience in e-commerce fulfillment, print finishing, or packaging environments
• Artistic hobbies or creative background (helps with visual QC and attention to aesthetic detail)
• Familiarity with shipping consumables inventory management
S C H E D U L E & C O N D I T I O N S
Monday–Friday, 10:00am start, typically ending around 6:30pm — but you stay until the day's orders ship, no exceptions. Louisville facility. You'll be on your feet the entire shift in a fast-paced production environment.

The Shipping & Receiving Clerk is responsible for the safe receipt, tracking, storage, movement, and shipment of customer samples, test articles, equipment, and materials within the laboratory. This position plays a critical role in maintaining sample traceability, supporting laboratory operations, and ensuring efficient material flow throughout the facility. job.title: Repair Station Technician
job.description:
1st Shift 6am - 2:30pm

POSITION SUMMARY
Reporting to the Production Supervisor of Parker Meggitt Danville, Kentucky Distribution Center. This position is responsible for day-to-day assembly of component pieces into aircraft wheels and brakes. With appropriate training the individual will be required to perform functional testing of finished assemblies and prepare product for shipping to customers.
This individual will also be responsible for participation in continuous improvement activities on a daily basis and on project teams.


RESPONSIBILITIES
• Responsible for inspecting, cleaning and assembling aerospace components into final assembly and performing required testing necessary for final product acceptance. The individual will read blueprints, specifications, and work instructions and perform mechanical assembly processes.

Documentation
• Will obtain the proper work instructions for assigned jobs and will interact with production planning personnel as required.
• Will be responsible for filling out documentation necessary to satisfy all MABS Kentucky government and customer requirements.
• Will inspect product and complete documentation as necessary whether manual or through the use of computer transactions.

Equipment
• This individual must be able to operate hydraulic test equipment after appropriate training. Ability to use power hand tools and will operate auxiliary machine tools as required.

Safety
• Responsible for working in a safe manner and observing all company procedures regarding environmental, health, and safety matters.

Miscellaneous
• Individual will do some frequent heavy lifting. Will be requited to walk throughout the work day. Regular, consistent and punctual attendance is required. May need to work variable schedules and additional hours as necessary.
• Other responsibilities as assigned.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS
• Skilled at routine mechanical and/or electromechanical assembly operations
• Able to operate a variety of hand tools and machinery.
• Ability to read and interpret company documents, such as safety rules, operating/manufacturing instructions, policies and procedures.
• Good manual dexterity required to work with small parts.
• Capable of recognizing and solving typical problems that can occur in own work area; evaluates and selects solutions from established options.
• Effective oral, written and interpersonal skills

QUALIFICATIONS
Education: A secondary certificate/High School Diploma is required. Technical training beyond high school is preferred.
Certifications: Vocational training, apprenticeships or the equivalent experience in related field
Years Experience: A minimum of two years' experience in a manufacturing environment is required. The individual must be able to read and interpret blueprints and must possess the necessary mathematic skills associated with discreet part manufacturing. They must be able to read product specifications and follow written work instructions.


This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S Permanent Resident (i.e 'Green Card Holder') Political Asylee, or Refugee.
