job.title: Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Engineer 

Tulsa, OK | Full-Time | Direct Hire | On-Site

Eligible candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. and must NOT require current or future sponsorship (including Student Visas).

Pay & Benefits

  • Salary: $100,000–$125,000 per year, depending on experience

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

  • 401(k) with Company Match

  • Paid Vacation, Personal Time & Holidays

  • Life & Disability Insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Training and Professional Development Opportunities

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to support the production of complex, custom-engineered electrical equipment. This role focuses on developing and improving manufacturing processes for engineered-to-order products, working closely with Engineering, Production, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to ensure designs can be efficiently and reliably built.

The ideal candidate has experience in electrical equipment manufacturing and understands how to translate engineering designs into practical production processes. This is a hands-on engineering opportunity for someone who enjoys solving manufacturing challenges, improving workflows, and taking ownership of projects from initial planning through final assembly.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Engineering & Process Development

  • Develop manufacturing plans, production workflows, assembly methods, and process requirements for custom-engineered electrical equipment.

  • Partner with Engineering to review designs and provide input on design for manufacturability (DFM), production efficiency, and cost reduction.

  • Evaluate existing manufacturing processes and identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, and production timelines.

  • Establish efficient work methods, workstation layouts, tooling requirements, and equipment needs.

  • Support the transition of new and modified designs into production.

Process Improvement & Quality

  • Identify and implement process improvements to reduce waste, minimize production delays, and improve manufacturing efficiency.

  • Develop and maintain manufacturing procedures, work instructions, standard operating procedures, and assembly documentation.

  • Partner with Quality to establish inspection procedures, testing requirements, and consistent production standards.

  • Investigate manufacturing issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across fabrication, assembly, and testing operations.

Engineering & Production Support

  • Work directly with production teams to resolve manufacturing challenges and improve assembly processes.

  • Review engineering drawings, specifications, and bills of material to identify potential production issues.

  • Collaborate with Procurement and Supply Chain on material requirements, component availability, and alternative sourcing options.

  • Evaluate tooling, equipment, and manufacturing resources needed to support production requirements.

  • Train and support production personnel on new processes, equipment, and updated work instructions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Project Management to support manufacturing goals.

  • Work with suppliers and vendors to address material, component, and production-related concerns.

  • Support manufacturing projects from initial planning through implementation.

  • Monitor process performance and recommend improvements to support delivery schedules, cost targets, and product quality.

Qualifications

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

  • Experience in manufacturing engineering within an electrical equipment, industrial equipment, or engineered-to-order manufacturing environment.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes involving complex electrical equipment, assemblies, and integrated systems.

  • Experience developing manufacturing workflows, assembly procedures, and production documentation.

  • Ability to review and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and bills of material.

Technical Skills

  • Knowledge of electrical systems, power distribution equipment, and manufacturing requirements.

  • Experience with CAD software for reviewing engineering designs and supporting manufacturing improvements.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, tooling, and equipment requirements.

  • Ability to identify process inefficiencies, troubleshoot production issues, and implement practical solutions.

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering and production teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with engineered-to-order (ETO) manufacturing or custom-built industrial equipment.

  • Background supporting the manufacturing of electrical distribution equipment, power systems, or complex electrical assemblies.

  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Experience with production testing, quality control, and manufacturing process validation.

Work Environment

This is a primarily on-site engineering role working closely with manufacturing and production teams. Occasional time in the production environment will be necessary to evaluate processes, troubleshoot issues, and support implementation of manufacturing improvements.

job.title: Clinical Data Manager - Python Scripting
job.description:
Clinical Data Manager II - Python Scripting
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – Minimum 3 Days Onsite Per Week
 
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Clinical Data Manager II with strong technical skills to support clinical trial data management, database development, and workflow automation.
This position is responsible for ensuring clinical trial data is accurate, complete, and compliant with regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with clinical data management, Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, and advanced Python scripting to automate data cleaning, validation, and reporting processes.
We are looking for someone who takes initiative, works independently, and can identify opportunities to improve data management processes while collaborating with clinical operations, biostatistics, and other cross-functional teams.
 
Key Responsibilities
Clinical Data Management & Database Development
  • Manage clinical trial data collection, cleaning, validation, and quality control activities.
  • Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of clinical databases and EDC systems.
  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), develop data validation specifications, and review edit checks.
  • Oversee data query generation, reconciliation, and resolution to maintain data accuracy and completeness.
  • Work with clinical trial sites and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) to resolve data discrepancies.
 Python Scripting & Process Automation
  • Develop and maintain Python scripts to automate data extraction, cleaning, validation, and reporting.
  • Identify inefficiencies in clinical data workflows and implement technical solutions to improve accuracy and processing time.
  • Create automated data quality checks and reporting tools to reduce manual processes.
  • Collaborate with technical and biostatistics teams to support data transformations and standardization, including CDISC SDTM and CDASH.
 Regulatory Compliance & Documentation
  • Ensure clinical data management activities comply with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, FDA regulations, and internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Maintain accurate documentation to support regulatory inspections, audits, and clinical trial milestones.
  • Follow 21 CFR Part 11 requirements related to electronic records and data integrity.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Quality Assurance, and Site Management teams to meet study objectives and timelines.
 Required Qualifications
Education & Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Health Informatics, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on clinical data management experience within clinical trials.
  • Experience managing clinical trial data, including data cleaning, validation, reconciliation, and query resolution.
 Technical Skills
  • Advanced hands-on Python programming experience, including scripting, data manipulation, and workflow automation.
  • Experience developing Python scripts to automate clinical data validation, cleaning, extraction, or reporting.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one EDC platform, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva Vault CDMS, REDCap, or Oracle InForm.
  • Experience supporting EDC database development, testing, data validation, or UAT.
  • Strong understanding of GCP, 21 CFR Part 11, and clinical trial regulatory requirements.
 Professional Skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and work independently.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional clinical trial teams.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and resolving data management challenges.
 Preferred Qualifications
  • Master's degree in a related field.
  • Experience with SQL, R, or SAS.
  • Familiarity with CDISC standards, including SDTM and CDASH.
  • Experience developing automated reporting tools or improving clinical data management workflows.
 Work Arrangement
This is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of three days onsite each week.

job.title: Medical Graphic Designer, Content Suite
job.description:
Graphic Designer – Medical Communications & Creative Production

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative, detail-oriented, and experienced Graphic Designer to join an internal creative studio team supporting medical communications, scientific content, and healthcare education initiatives.

This position will focus heavily on the hands-on design, execution, and production of high-quality creative assets supporting medical teams, healthcare providers, and patient education programs.

The ideal candidate combines strong traditional graphic design fundamentals with expertise in modern design tools, including Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, PowerPoint, Figma, and emerging generative AI technologies.

A key component of this role involves transforming complex scientific and medical information into visually engaging, easy-to-understand materials, including charts, graphs, presentations, infographics, and educational content.

Working directly with medical stakeholders, Project Managers, Copywriters, and Medical Reviewers, the Graphic Designer will help establish a consistent visual identity across medical education materials while ensuring brand consistency and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Creative Production

  • Serve as a primary hands-on Graphic Designer, producing a high volume of professional-quality creative assets.

  • Design and develop materials across multiple digital and print formats, including:

    • Digital campaign banners

    • Social media graphics

    • Print collateral and brochures

    • PowerPoint presentations

    • One-pagers and educational materials

    • Scientific charts, graphs, and data visualizations

    • Infographics and iconography

  • Translate creative briefs and scientific information into polished, visually engaging design deliverables.

  • Recreate and enhance scientific charts, graphs, and visual elements for use in presentations and educational materials.

  • Develop reusable design assets and templates to support medical and marketing teams.

  • Apply strong typography, layout, color theory, and visual design principles across all projects.

Medical Communications & Scientific Data Visualization

  • Transform complex medical and scientific data into clear, accurate, and visually accessible formats.

  • Support the development of educational materials for patients and healthcare providers (HCPs).

  • Collaborate with medical stakeholders to ensure scientific information is communicated effectively through visual design.

  • Create consistent visual elements, charts, diagrams, and infographics for medical presentations and documentation.

  • Ensure medical content is presented accurately while maintaining readability, engagement, and visual consistency.

Brand Consistency & Regulatory Compliance

  • Apply established medical brand guidelines and visual identity systems across all deliverables.

  • Ensure creative assets adhere to brand standards, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines.

  • Incorporate feedback from medical stakeholders and regulatory/compliance review teams, including CMLR reviews.

  • Revise and refine creative materials to meet medical, legal, regulatory, and quality standards.

  • Maintain exceptional attention to detail in typography, alignment, formatting, and design execution.

Asset Management & Production

  • Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital publishing and print production.

  • Organize and maintain design files, asset libraries, and reusable templates.

  • Develop scalable templates that enable marketing and medical strategy teams to create consistent content.

  • Ensure final artwork meets technical specifications and formatting requirements across multiple platforms.

  • Support efficient creative workflows through effective file management and asset organization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Project Managers, Copywriters, Medical Reviewers, and Medical Strategy teams throughout the creative development process.

  • Execute projects from initial creative brief through final approval and delivery.

  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback efficiently while maintaining design quality and project timelines.

  • Manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Creative Innovation & Process Improvement

  • Leverage Adobe Express to rapidly create, modify, and scale design assets in response to evolving medical research and strategic priorities.

  • Explore emerging design technologies, including generative AI tools, to improve creative production efficiency.

  • Utilize modern design platforms to develop scalable creative solutions.

  • Support continuous improvement of creative processes, templates, and design workflows.

Required Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field.

Professional Experience

  • 4–7 years of hands-on professional graphic design and creative production experience in an agency or in-house creative environment.

  • Demonstrated experience producing high-quality digital, print, and presentation materials.

  • Strong understanding of traditional graphic design principles, including typography, layout, color theory, and composition.

  • Experience managing multiple creative projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including:

    • Adobe InDesign

    • Adobe Illustrator

    • Adobe Photoshop

    • Adobe Express

  • Strong PowerPoint presentation design skills are essential.

  • Experience creating and recreating charts, graphs, infographics, and other visual assets.

  • Strong understanding of digital and print production requirements.

  • Ability to prepare polished, publication-ready artwork across multiple formats.

Portfolio Requirement

  • A professional design portfolio is required for consideration.

  • Portfolio must demonstrate:

    • Strong typography and layout skills

    • Effective use of color theory and visual composition

    • High-quality digital and print design work

    • Professional PowerPoint presentations

    • Polished, production-ready deliverables

  • Candidates without a portfolio link will not be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous graphic design experience within healthcare, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical communications, or another highly regulated industry.

  • Experience developing educational materials for patients and healthcare professionals.

  • Experience transforming scientific or medical information into charts, graphs, infographics, and presentations.

  • Familiarity with medical, legal, and regulatory review processes, including CMLR reviews.

  • Experience with Figma or other UI/UX design tools.

  • Familiarity with Adobe After Effects and basic motion graphics.

  • Experience leveraging generative AI tools to support creative production.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong graphic design and production capabilities.

  • Excellent PowerPoint presentation design skills.

  • Ability to visually communicate complex scientific information.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

  • Ability to incorporate creative and regulatory feedback.

  • Proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • Commitment to maintaining brand consistency and regulatory compliance.

This temp-to-perm opportunity is responsible for assembling, repairing, finishing, and painting fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) and composite components used in manufacturing. This role performs a variety of assembly, surface preparation, fiberglass repair, painting, and finishing tasks to ensure products meet company quality standards. Aircraft Maintenance Records Specialist – Digital Data

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Aircraft Maintenance Records Specialist to support the Digital Data department. This position is responsible for processing, reviewing, maintaining, and retaining aircraft maintenance records to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company policies and Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) regulations.

The ideal candidate will have strong data entry, document management, and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Previous records management experience is preferred, and aviation maintenance records experience is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Aircraft Maintenance Records Management

  • Learn and understand departmental policies and procedures related to aircraft maintenance records.

  • Process and review aircraft maintenance records to ensure accuracy and completeness.

  • Identify, track, and upload corrections to discrepant or incomplete records.

  • Reconcile aircraft log pages and resolve discrepancies.

  • Research and resolve unmatched aircraft data.

  • Prepare and scan aircraft maintenance records and paperwork, where applicable.

Data Processing & Systems

  • Ensure timely, accurate, and synchronized migration of aircraft maintenance data from existing formats into the AirVault system.

  • Maintain accurate electronic records and documentation in accordance with established procedures.

Skills & Abilities

  • Sound judgment and decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in records management, document control, data entry, or records processing.

  • Experience with aviation maintenance records or aircraft documentation.

job.title: Quality Inspector - Electronics Manufacturing
job.description:
Job Title: Quality Inspector - Electronics Manufacturing
Location: Rochester, NY

Job Summary: NESCO Resource seeking a detail-oriented Quality Inspector to verify that electronic components, printed circuit boards (PCBs), assemblies, and finished products meet established quality standards and specifications. The ideal candidate will have at least two years of quality inspection experience in electronics manufacturing, familiarity with IPC standards, and the ability to use inspection and testing equipment while maintaining accurate quality documentation. This role will be considered for a temp-to-perm contract.

Shift & Pay:

  • Shift: Monday – Friday, Day Shift (Flexible Scheduling Available)
  • Pay Range: $20.00 - $24.00/Hour (Based On Exp.)

Job Duties:

  • Conduct visual inspections of electronic assemblies, PCBs, and related components to identify defects such as soldering issues, misalignment, and contamination.
  • Perform functional testing on electronic products to verify performance against technical specifications.
  • Use inspection and measurement tools, including microscopes, magnifiers, calipers, micrometers, multimeters, and digital measurement devices.
  • Follow established inspection criteria, quality control procedures, and company standards.
  • Document inspection findings, maintain detailed quality records, and prepare reports for management.
  • Complete non-conformance reports (NCRs) and provide corrective action recommendations as appropriate.
  • Collaborate with production teams to identify defect root causes and support corrective actions.
  • Help ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, including IPC-A-610 and ISO 9001.
  • Participate in internal audits and support external audit activities as needed.
  • Train production team members on quality control best practices when required.
  • Support production schedules and overtime requirements as needed.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 2 years of quality inspection experience in an electronics manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of IPC standards for electronic assemblies.
  • Familiarity with electronic components, schematics, and assembly processes.
  • Ability to use microscopes, magnifiers, and measurement or testing equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with production and quality teams.
  • Ability to maintain focus while inspecting detailed electronic components and assemblies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Technical certification in electronics or quality control.
  • Experience with ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) control measures.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management requirements and audit processes.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements:

  • Frequent standing, walking, and handling of electronic assemblies.

job.title: Machinist Senior
job.description:
Position summary

We are seeking a skilled CNC Machinist with hands-on experience setting up and operating CNC lathes in a precision manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have experience interpreting blueprints, performing machine setups, adjusting feeds and speeds, installing tooling, and inspecting finished components to ensure they meet strict quality requirements.

Experience with Mazak machine controls is a major plus, particularly candidates with Y-axis machining experience.

Candidates should be comfortable working independently with limited guidance while contributing to a team-oriented production environment.

Primary responsibilities

  • Set up and operate CNC lathes and other conventional or numerically controlled machining equipment.

  • Perform machine setups, tooling installation, and machine adjustments.

  • Operate multiple production machines when needed.

  • Adjust feeds, speeds, and cutting depths to maintain part quality.

  • Machine, shape, cut, drill, ream, deburr, and rework precision components.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, sketches, engineering drawings, and production documentation.

  • Inspect machined components using micrometers, calipers, gauges, comparators, and other precision measuring equipment.

  • Perform in-process inspections and maintain tight manufacturing tolerances.

  • Identify tooling wear, machine issues, and production problems.

  • Perform routine equipment maintenance.

  • Follow manufacturing, quality, and safety procedures.

  • Participate in lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Maintain accurate production and quality documentation.

Required qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of related machining experience.

  • Hands-on CNC lathe setup and operating experience.

  • Ability to perform machine setups independently with limited guidance.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and engineering specifications.

  • Knowledge of machine shop mathematics, including basic trigonometry.

  • Experience with tooling installation and machine adjustments.

  • Familiarity with precision inspection equipment.

  • Ability to maintain quality and tight tolerances.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • Mazak machine control experience.

  • Y-axis machining experience.

  • Aerospace or high-precision manufacturing background.

  • G-code programming, editing, or troubleshooting.

  • Experience with Mastercam, NX, Fusion 360, or CATIA.

  • Experience machining titanium, Inconel, aluminum, or stainless steel.

  • Familiarity with GD&T, AS9100, FAI/AS9102, and SPC.

  • Experience with multi-axis machining.

Ideal candidate profile

The strongest candidates will have:

  1. Hands-on CNC lathe setup experience, not just machine operation.

  2. Experience with Mazak controls.

  3. Y-axis machining knowledge.

  4. Experience in aerospace or precision manufacturing.

  5. Ability to read blueprints and inspect tight-tolerance components.

Important distinction: Unlike the previous requisition, this role requires three years of machining experience, not five. Do not automatically screen out qualified three- or four-year machinists.

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Overview

Join a leading aerospace and defense manufacturer in Tempe, AZ, specializing in advanced electronic, avionics, and battery power systems. This full-time, direct-hire position offers long-term stability, professional development, and the chance to make a significant impact in a growing manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the Quality Assurance team, including Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, Final Inspection, In-Process Inspection, and Receiving Inspection.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality management systems in compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001, and FAA requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on product quality, safety, productivity, on-time delivery, and inventory reduction.
  • Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and root cause corrective action (RCCA) initiatives.
  • Oversee internal, external, customer, and regulatory audits, serving as the primary quality representative.
  • Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing to improve processes, resolve quality concerns, and support new product development.
  • Support FAA regulatory and product certification activities, including PMA, TSO, TC, and STC submissions.
  • Review engineering documentation to ensure quality requirements are incorporated throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Implement Lean manufacturing practices, process improvements, value stream mapping, and workflow optimization.
  • Establish departmental goals, performance metrics, and accountability standards.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop quality personnel while building a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to maintain high standards of product quality and customer satisfaction.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, or another related technical discipline.
  • 5–7 years of Quality Assurance experience within aerospace or defense manufacturing.
  • Previous leadership experience managing and developing quality teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 quality management systems.
  • Quality Systems Lead Auditor experience.
  • Strong understanding of FAA quality management system requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience with RCCA, CAPA, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience supporting customer, internal, and regulatory audits.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within aerospace electronics, avionics, battery manufacturing, or power distribution.
  • Experience supporting FAA PMA, TSO, TC, and STC certification activities.
  • Familiarity with software development, software code reviews, and test verification.

job.title: Plant Manager
job.description:
Plant Manager

Location: Binghamton, NY
Compensation: $100,000

Position Overview
The Plant Manager oversees daily manufacturing operations, production scheduling, employee supervision, and facility maintenance to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality production. This hands-on leadership role is responsible for coordinating precast concrete manufacturing activities, maintaining equipment and molds, managing workflow, and ensuring production schedules and quality standards are met.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Production Planning & Scheduling: Review daily production schedules, work orders, inspection documents, and concrete strength measurements. Lead daily production meetings, communicate priorities, assign responsibilities, and coordinate with scheduling and finishing personnel.
  • Manufacturing Operations: Oversee all phases of precast concrete production, including mold preparation, stripping, inspections, concrete pouring, vibrating, finishing, and product storage. Monitor workflow, allocate labor, minimize downtime, and ensure production targets are achieved.
  • Quality Control & Documentation: Ensure compliance with production and inspection requirements, maintain accurate work sheets and inspection records, monitor product quality, and complete Cost of Quality reports when issues arise.
  • Production Coordination: Communicate regularly with finishing personnel and the Master Production Scheduler to review completed work, address outstanding items, and establish upcoming production priorities. Ensure products are properly identified and production records are organized.
  • Equipment & Mold Maintenance: Oversee preventive maintenance, inspections, lubrication, and repairs of production molds, tools, and equipment. Maintain accurate maintenance records and ensure proper handling, cleaning, organization, and storage of equipment.
  • Facility Management: Maintain a clean, safe, and organized production environment while ensuring employees, equipment, and materials are positioned to support efficient daily operations.

job.title: Production Technician
job.description:
SUMMARY:
Precision Metal Works, a Bartell Global Company, manufactures metal stamped parts and components for the appliance and automotive industries. We have approximately 250 team members and two manufacturing facilities in Louisville, KY. Our facilities boast 36 stamping presses, a state-of-the-art powder coating line , robotic welding, cosmetic stainless-steel finishing and numerous assembly operations.

Precision Metal Works has an immediate opening for a Production Technician. The Production Technician operates production machinery consistent with established standards.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform manufacturing processes to complete assemblies using machines or presses
  • Report defective materials or questionable conditions to the department Lead
  • Complete tasks as directed by manufacturing schedules with minimal supervision
  • Maintain the work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition
  • Must understand and perform to the Fundamentals of Manufacturing
  • Work efficiently in a team environment
  • Must adhere to all safety and operational processes and company policy
  • Must operate using job specific PPE
  • Safe use of various equipment, follow process specifications, and meet production standards to manufacture products.
  • Perform various operations to supply products to meet customer requirements.
  • Use visual inspection, gauges and other measurement devices to ensure accurate output and quality of products.
  • Understand and utilize all guarding / protection.
  • Adhere to procedures relating to the proper use and care of equipment and materials.
  • Change machine setups and/or make minor adjustments to machines to produce product, which meets the designated product specifications for that particular workstation.
  • Communicate effectively in both oral and written formats
  • Other duties may be assigned

EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • High school diploma or its equivalent is required.
  • Previous experience in manufacturing plant preferred
  • Strong mechanical aptitude
  • Excellent attention to detail and organization required
  • Must possess strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Must be able to understand and follow all safety rules in facility and performs all safety checks within assigned area to ensure a safe working environment
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret business correspondences, Safety Notices, Control Plans, Quality Alerts, and Assembly/Packaging instructions.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Must regularly lift and move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to bend, stoop, and reach. Must be able to climb up and down, as well as work using a ladder.
  • Employee is regularly exposed to vibration, and occasionally works near moving mechanical parts.
  • Must be present on the job to perform the assigned duties and be able to work overtime which is often required to meet production schedules

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to vibration and may work near moving mechanical parts. The employee is regularly exposed to varied temperatures due to working in a non-air-conditioned facility. In addition, the employee is regularly exposed to dust, odors, oil, fumes and a very loud noise environment.

Nesco Resource is currently sourcing for an Automotive Finishing company located in Sterling Heights, MI. We are seeking reliable and mechanically inclined candidates for the Accessory Installer position.

Position: Accessory Installer
Location: Sterling Heights, MI
Shift: B Crew – Tuesday–Friday, 6:45 PM – 4:45 AM
Pay Rate: $17.85 per hour

Brief Description

The Accessory Installer is responsible for removing factory-installed components and installing new components on customer vehicles using power tools, measuring devices, and torque wrenches. This role requires accuracy, mechanical aptitude, and adherence to customer specifications and quality standards.

Key Job Tasks

  • Review the weekly installation schedule to determine daily build requirements.

    • Fender flares

    • Underbody skid plates

    • Fog light aiming

  • Perform Key Product Characteristics (KPCs) to verify proper torque on bolts per customer requirements.

  • Ensure all work is completed according to written work instructions and dimensional technical specifications (DTS).

  • Identify and report any non-conforming products.

  • Complete a Final Inspection Check Sheet for every completed vehicle.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Mechanically inclined and able to use a variety of hand tools, measuring devices, and torque wrenches.

  • Able to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Manufacturing experience and/or familiarity with TS16949 is an asset.

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs repeatedly and independently.

job.title: Systems Technician I
job.description:
.Job Description:

As the Systems Technician I, You will play a vital role in maintaining the functionality, reliability, and efficiency of manufacturing systems and equipment. This hands-on position is ideal for someone early in their technical career who is eager to learn, troubleshoot, and support production operations in a defense manufacturing environment. You will work closely with experienced team members while developing strong practical skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of manufacturing equipment, machinery, and systems to minimize downtime and keep production running smoothly.

  • Assist engineers and production teams in optimizing manufacturing processes to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

  • Support the installation, configuration, and testing of new manufacturing systems, machinery, or related software.

  • Conduct basic inspections and tests on equipment and systems to help ensure they meet quality standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, equipment configurations, and operational procedures.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify issues, implement improvements, and support manufacturing system needs.

  • Follow and help enforce safety protocols to ensure all systems and work practices comply with safety regulations.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. A degree or diploma in engineering, manufacturing technology, automation, or a related field is preferred but not required.

  • Relevant certifications in manufacturing systems or equipment are a plus.

  • Prior military experience in MOS 92W, 92F, 63S, 63B, 63Z, or 63Y is preferred but not required.

  • Basic technical aptitude and interest in manufacturing systems, machinery, automation, or control systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose and help resolve technical issues.

  • Willingness to learn data analysis and process improvement techniques.

  • High attention to detail in maintenance work, documentation, quality, and safety.

  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and methods in a manufacturing environment.

  • Reliable, team-oriented, and eager to grow in a hands-on technical role.

About Us:

T.J. Clark International is a small family-owned business that designs and manufactures the leading expeditionary tactical fuel/water pumps and distribution systems for the forward projection of power and resources in austere environments for the defense industry. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and excellence in everything we do

If you're someone who's good at building relationships with suppliers, knows how to hunt down a hard-to-find part, and can keep purchasing in step with what production actually needs, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now by sending your resume and cover letter to human.resources@tjclarkintl.com.

T.J. Clark International LLC is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. We will consider all U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents. We will not consider any individual who requires visa sponsorship.

job.title: Electronics Assembler
job.description:
Location: South Tucson
Pay Rate/Salary: $19.00/hourly
Shift/Hours: 7a-3:30p
Employment Type: Temp-to-Hire
Requirements: At least 1 year of experience in electronics assembly, electromechanical assembly, manufacturing, or a similar production environment.

Position Summary

The Electronics Assembler is responsible for assembling, inspecting, and supporting the testing of electronic and electromechanical products used in mining technology applications. This position requires working with printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs), electronic components, cables, connectors, sensors, displays, mechanical components, and related hardware while following established work instructions, engineering drawings, quality requirements, and electrostatic discharge (ESD) procedures.

The employee is expected to work inside an ESD-controlled production area and must consistently follow all ESD, safety, quality, and manufacturing requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Assemble electronic and electromechanical products according to work instructions, drawings, visual aids, bills of materials (BOMs), and other approved manufacturing documentation.

· Install and handle PCBAs, electronic components, connectors, cables, sensors, displays, housings, brackets, fasteners, and other mechanical or electrical components.

· Properly handle ESD-sensitive devices and follow all requirements while working within an ESD-controlled area.

· Use hand and power tools, such as electric or pneumatic screwdrivers, torque-controlled drivers, pliers, wire cutters, crimping tools, and other assembly equipment.

· Perform mechanical fastening and controlled-torque operations according to specified requirements.

· Perform cable and connector installation and other basic electrical assembly operations as required.

· Support product programming, functional testing, inspection, labeling, and packaging activities as required by the applicable process.

· Perform visual inspections to identify workmanship issues, damage, missing components, incorrect components, or other nonconformances.

· Follow established quality standards and immediately report defects, discrepancies, or unclear manufacturing instructions to the appropriate Production or Quality personnel.

· Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area using 5S and established manufacturing practices.

· Accurately complete required production and quality records.

· Work effectively with Production, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and other support functions.

· Perform other manufacturing or assembly activities as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

· At least 1 year of experience in electronics assembly, electromechanical assembly, manufacturing, or a similar production environment.

· Experience working with hand and power tools in a manufacturing or assembly environment.

· Ability to work safely in an ESD-controlled environment and follow ESD handling requirements.

· Ability to read and follow work instructions, assembly drawings, visual aids, and basic manufacturing documentation.

· Basic understanding of electronic and mechanical components.

· Ability to perform detailed assembly work requiring good manual dexterity and attention to detail.

· Ability to identify obvious workmanship or component defects and escalate issues appropriately.

· Ability to work independently and as part of a manufacturing team.

· Basic computer skills and the ability to enter or retrieve production information as required.

Preferred Qualifications

· Previous experience assembling PCBAs or electronic and electromechanical products.

· Experience with cables, connectors, crimping, torque-controlled tools, and electronic components.

· Experience performing basic functional testing or product inspection.

· Familiarity with ESD controls and electronic manufacturing workmanship standards.

job.title: Line Mechanic
job.description:
Line Mechanic


Shift: 2:00pm - 2:00am (Monday - Thursday)

Pay: $19-$28/hr

Location: Phoenix, AZ


Job Overview

The Line Mechanic is responsible for the troubleshooting, repair, and preventative maintenance of tile plant machinery and auxiliary equipment under the direction of the maintenance supervisor or line supervisor. This role requires adherence to all safety policies, including lockout procedures, and involves assisting in training other mechanics. The mechanic must perform accurate and timely repairs, report needs to supervisors, and uphold the organization's vision, values, and objectives with integrity and respect for coworkers.

Essential Functions

  • Safety Compliance: Implement lockout procedures before any cleaning, maintenance, or repair work. Failure to comply will result in disciplinary action.
  • Follow checklist procedures and read downtime reports to conduct necessary repairs and adjustments.
  • Troubleshoot, identify problems, and perform proper repairs.
  • Remove, replace, and rebuild motors and parts.
  • Identify and repair or replace worn components (e.g., chains, sprockets, gearboxes, ropes, pulleys).
  • Maintain and repair all parts of the production line (e.g., tile machine, grouper, racker, cars, packager).
  • Clean the line prior to maintenance or repairs.
  • Adhere to all safety guidelines at all times.
  • Assist and train personnel as assigned.

Communication Responsibilities

  • Follow directions from the supervisor or line supervisor.
  • Report repairs and required parts verbally or in writing to the supervisor.
  • Collaborate with and train other mechanics.
  • Work with line workers to identify malfunctions.
  • Read and interpret downtime reports, checklists, and settings in English.

Requirements

  • Experience: Preferably three years in mechanical work on production machinery.
  • Productivity: Meet standards, complete work timely, and strive to increase efficiency.
  • Tools: Provide own hand tools (e.g., wrenches, hammer, screwdrivers—refer to list).
  • Proficiency: Perform with minimal supervision in:
    • Welding and gas torch cutting.
    • Removing and replacing motors.
    • Fundamental electrical work.
    • Experience with conveyors, mixing systems, and extrusion.
    • Troubleshooting, alignment, and adjustment.
    • Using hand tools, air tools, and electrical hand tools.
    • Knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic systems, clutch brakes, and motorized systems.

Physical Demands

  • Lift/carry 35-50 pounds, up to 100 pounds.
  • Bend, kneel, and twist throughout shifts.
  • Apply torque up to 50 pounds.
  • Stand for 8-10 hours daily, 6-7 days a week.
  • Properly lift and use all tools.
  • Hear machine malfunctions and perceive production alarms/forklift signals above ambient noise.
  • Visually identify worn parts.

Work Environment

  • Wear issued uniform properly.
  • Work with loud, heavy machinery in an unair-conditioned, unheated indoor facility.
  • Perform some outdoor repairs on sand conveyor systems.
  • Expect up to 4 hours overtime daily, 6-7 day workweeks, and varying shifts (day/night).
  • Be available for on-call duty.
  • Tolerate dusty conditions with cement and sand.
  • Adapt to uncomfortable working situations.

Safety Requirements

  • Wear helmet, safety goggles, and steel-toed shoes at all times; use ear plugs, back brace, and gloves as needed.
  • Know safety procedures for all machines, tools, and chemicals.
  • Attend all safety training and monthly meetings.
  • Immediately report safety issues to the supervisor.
  • Understand and follow lockout procedures fully.
  • Report accidents/injuries to management within 24 hours.

job.title: Staff Accountant
job.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an analytical Staff Accountant to maintain the integrity of our financial records and drive our monthly close process. This role takes ownership of core general ledger functions, fixed asset tracking, variance analysis, and standard cost reconciliations to provide management with accurate, timely financial reporting.


Core Responsibilities
  • Month-End Close: Prepare and post journal entries, execute balance sheet reconciliations, and compile monthly financial statement packages.
  • Manufacturing & Cost Support: Analyze standard vs. actual manufacturing variances, monitor inventory valuation adjustments, and review bill of materials (BOM) cost accuracy.
  • Asset & Ledger Management: Maintain the fixed asset subledger, calculating monthly depreciation and tracking capital expenditure (CapEx) tracking budgets.
  • Treasury & Tax Reconciliations: Perform regular bank reconciliations across multi-currency accounts and assist with local sales/use tax filings.
  • Audit & Reporting Support: Prepare audit schedules for year-end reviews and run ad-hoc financial analysis reports for plant management.

Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance required.
  • Experience: 2+ years of general accounting experience, ideally within a manufacturing, production, or cost-accounting setting.
  • Tech Skills: Intermediate-to-advanced Excel skills (data tables, complex formulas) and familiarity with mainstream ERP environments.
  • Core Skills: Comprehensive understanding of US GAAP, general ledger structures, and operational variance reporting.

job.title: Senior Banner Technical Consultant - Managed Services & Platform Solutions
job.description:
Senior Technical Consultant – Managed Services & Platform Solutions
Location: 100% Remote
Work Schedule: Eastern Standard Time (EST) preferred
Position Level: Senior Consultant / Technical Lead
 
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Consultant to provide technical leadership, application development, integration, and consulting services to Managed Services clients. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role that combines strong programming skills, solution architecture, troubleshooting, and technical consulting.
The ideal candidate will have experience designing, developing, implementing, and supporting modern platform solutions. This includes application development, system integrations, platform extensions, APIs, reporting, automation, and business process improvements.
This individual will work directly with customers to understand their business needs, recommend technical solutions, and lead projects from initial planning through implementation and ongoing support. The role also involves resolving complex technical issues, improving existing applications, and helping customers adopt new technologies.
Strong communication skills, technical leadership, and the ability to work independently in a remote consulting environment are essential.
 
Key Responsibilities
Technical Consulting & Solution Design

  • Serve as a technical lead and trusted advisor for Managed Services clients.
  • Work directly with customers to understand business requirements, technical challenges, and project objectives.
  • Design and recommend solutions that align with customer needs and industry best practices.
  • Lead technical discussions, business process reviews, and solution planning sessions.
  • Develop proof-of-concepts and application prototypes to demonstrate proposed solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance throughout solution design, development, testing, and implementation.
 
Application Development & Platform Integration
  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications, integrations, interfaces, and platform extensions.
  • Build and support custom APIs, reports, automation processes, and application functionality.
  • Develop integrations using REST APIs, GraphQL, Serverless APIs, and event-driven architecture.
  • Implement platform capabilities involving extensibility, experience solutions, data connectivity, intelligent processes, and forms.
  • Create custom solutions that address business requirements beyond standard application functionality.
  • Follow development standards and upgrade-safe practices when building platform extensions.
  • Test, debug, and optimize applications and integrations to ensure performance and reliability.
 
Technical Support & Troubleshooting
  • Provide advanced technical support for applications, integrations, and platform services.
  • Investigate complex system issues, identify root causes, and implement long-term solutions.
  • Handle software troubleshooting, break/fix support, and application enhancements.
  • Support customers with platform configuration, integration issues, and system functionality.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and customers to resolve technical challenges.
  • Maintain customer satisfaction through timely issue resolution and clear communication.
 
Project Delivery & Documentation
  • Lead technical activities throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment.
  • Assist with project planning, technical estimates, and implementation timelines.
  • Prepare technical documentation covering system requirements, specifications, integrations, APIs, interfaces, and custom applications.
  • Develop installation guides, operational procedures, and support documentation.
  • Review technical deliverables to ensure quality, accuracy, and alignment with customer requirements.
  • Support modernization initiatives and help customers adopt new platform capabilities.
 
Technical Leadership & Mentorship
  • Provide technical direction and guidance to junior consultants and development team members.
  • Review code, solution designs, and technical documentation.
  • Share development best practices and promote consistent technical standards.
  • Mentor and train less experienced consultants.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with customers, project teams, and internal stakeholders.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Strong experience in technical consulting, application development, systems integration, or related technical roles.
  • Advanced programming and software development skills across multiple application tiers.
  • Hands-on experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise applications.
  • Experience developing and integrating REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, or serverless solutions.
  • Knowledge of application extensibility, system integration, data connectivity, and automation.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex application and integration issues.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Experience with solution architecture, technical design, and application implementation.
  • Strong understanding of software development best practices, testing, debugging, and technical documentation.
  • Experience working directly with customers in a consulting or technical support environment.
  • Ability to lead technical discussions, manage deliverables, and provide guidance to other developers.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while supporting multiple customer priorities in a remote environment.

  • Ideal Candidate Profile
    The ideal candidate is a senior-level technical consultant who enjoys both hands-on development and working directly with customers. They should be comfortable moving between application development, integration projects, technical troubleshooting, and solution design.
    This position requires someone who can understand a customer's business problem, determine the best technical approach, build or enhance the solution, and support it after implementation.
    We are looking for someone who can take ownership of technical challenges, communicate effectively with customers, and provide leadership without stepping away from hands-on development.

Full-time, Career Opportunity

LIMITED OPENINGS - APPLY NOW IF INTERESTED

Greensburg, PA
 

In this role, you will assist with finishing metal castings by removing excess material, cutting gates, operating saws, grinding and performing deburring and cosmetic finishing work. Training will be provided on equipment and job-specific processes.
This position starts at $18.00 per hour, with the opportunity to transition into a union position after 90 calendar days and earn additional pay increases.

  • Potential opportunities to reach $25.00–$26.00/hour.

  • High school diploma or GED required.

  • Familiarity with deburring, metal finishing, or cosmetic inspection is beneficial.

  • Dependable attendance and willingness to work overtime when needed.

  • Standard 7-year background check.
  • 10-panel saliva drug screening.

  • Gloves and safety glasses.

This position is a safety-sensitive position. Safety-sensitive positions are defined as positions where the employee operates, repairs, maintains or monitors the performance or operation of a motor vehicle, equipment, machinery, or power tools. Safety-sensitive positions also include jobs where the tasks or duties required of the employee could affect the safety or health of the employee performing the task or others.

job.title: Combo Welder
job.description:
Combo Welder / Fabricator

Phoenix, AZ 85041
Shift: (Monday - Friday -1:30PM - 10:00PM)
Pay: $25-$38/hr (Depending on Experience)

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Combo Welder / Fabricator to join our growing team. This is a hands-on role supporting a variety of custom and industrial fabrication projects, including structural steel, piping, tanks, heavy ductwork, and specialty fabrications.

The ideal candidate will have experience with TIG (GTAW) and Flux-Core (FCAW) welding, along with the ability to fit, fabricate, and assemble components from drawings. This role offers the opportunity to work on a wide range of materials, projects, and fabrication challenges rather than repetitive production work.

What You'll Do

Welding & Fabrication

  • Perform TIG (GTAW) and Flux-Core / Dual Shield (FCAW) welding in all positions on structural components, piping, tanks, ductwork, and other custom fabrications.

  • Weld and fabricate structural components, piping, tanks, ductwork, hoppers, chutes, and other custom assemblies.

  • Perform multi-pass welding on materials and thicknesses required for each project.

  • Work from fabrication drawings, blueprints, weld symbols, and specifications to complete projects accurately.

  • Produce quality welds that meet company and project requirements.

Fit-Up, Layout & Assembly

  • Client out, fit, and assemble structural and custom fabrication components from drawings.

  • Perform accurate tack welding and weld sequencing on a variety of materials and geometries.

  • Prepare materials and joints using grinders, wire wheels, flap discs, and other hand and power tools.

  • Identify and communicate fit-up, dimensional, or drawing issues before proceeding with fabrication.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum of 3 years of welding and/or fabrication experience, preferably in structural steel, piping, tanks, plate work, ductwork, or industrial fabrication.

  • Hands-on experience with TIG (GTAW) and Flux-Core (FCAW) welding.

  • Ability to perform fit-up and fabrication work from blueprints and drawings.

  • Strong understanding of weld symbols, dimensions, and fabrication requirements.

  • Experience using grinders, hand tools, and fabrication equipment for material preparation and finishing.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining quality and safety standards.

  • Reliable attendance, strong work ethic, and attention to detail.

Weld Test

Candidates should be prepared to complete a weld test prior to placement, including:

  • TIG: 6G pipe weld test
  • Dual Shield / Flux-Core: 3/8-inch open-root plate weld in the 3G position

job.title: Contracts Administrator
job.description:
Position Summary

The temporary Defense Quality Engineer (DQE) will support the business in the areas of Material Review Board (MRB), new product development, lean implementation, process capability improvement, and daily production support. This includes in-process and final inspection, process and product auditing, and technical data interpretation/analysis such as engineering drawings, specifications, technical publications, purchase orders review, and quality system management. The DQE must be knowledgeable of statistical process controls, dimensional inspection metrology, and Quality Management Systems such as ISO 9001:2015, AS9100, IATF, TS16949, etc. The DQE primarily interfaces with Customers, Suppliers, Sales/Contracts, Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Operations.

Principal Activities

  • Material Review Board (MRB) Support:
    • Lead and participate in MRB meetings to evaluate non-conforming materials, components, and products.
    • Identify and document root causes of non-conformances in products or materials.
    • Approve, reject, or recommend rework for materials that don't meet quality standards.
  • Non-Conformance Management:
    • Coordinate and drive the investigation of SIRs in conjunction with manufacturing and engineering teams.
    • Ensure that proper documentation is in place for all non-conformances, including dispositions, corrective actions, and preventive actions.
  • Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action:
    • Conduct root cause analysis for quality issues, including failure analysis and the implementation of corrective actions.
    • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure that corrective actions are effectively implemented and tracked to completion.
  • Compliance and Documentation:
    • Ensure compliance with industry standards (e.g., ISO 9001), regulatory requirements, and customer specifications.
    • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to MRB activities, including SIRs, audits, and corrective actions.
  • Collaboration:
    • Collaborate with quality peers, manufacturing, engineering, and procurement teams to resolve quality issues.
    • Provide support and guidance to suppliers regarding quality requirements and resolve any material-related issues.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen, to enhance overall quality and reduce non-conformances.
    • Recommend improvements to processes, materials, or procedures to minimize the occurrence of defects or quality issues.
    • Collect and analyze data to identify and prioritize opportunities for improvement of product and process quality.
    • Provide quality witness on tear down of customer returned material.
    • Conduct and participate in quality system, process, and product audits.
    • Provide technical leadership to inspection team members.
    • Comply with all company policies/procedures.
    • Comply with all military and contractual requirements.
    • Examine/audit finished product before customer source inspection/shipment to test conformance to ATP.
    • "In-Line” examination/audit of production line confirming adherence to ATP and testing methodology.
    • Review all documentation/drawings, ATP sign-off sheets, visual conformance, finish, etc.
    • Ensure that product identification marking or labeling requirements are set out in drawings or associated specifications properly observed.
    • Perform in-process and final source inspections including First Article inspections.
    • Perform other job-related duties as assigned by management.

Candidate Requirements

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to create and implement statistically valid control plans and audit plans.
  • Working knowledge of inspection metrology and proper application of automated measuring equipment.
  • Excellent working knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing.
  • Ability to create and/or review failure analysis reports.
  • Thorough knowledge of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Project, and other applicable tools.
  • Approximately 10% travel required.

Education & Experience

  • Typically requires a minimum level of knowledge that is acquired through a two-year college degree in an applicable field and three years related experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience.

job.title: Quality Lab Technician
job.description:
Quality Lab Technician

Nesco Resource is seeking a Quality Lab Technician for our client in the automotive manufacturing industry. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in quality assurance, laboratory testing, and inspection processes.

Position Details

  • Pay Rate: $20.00 per hour

  • Shift: 1st Shift

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM

  • Industry: Automotive Manufacturing

Job Summary

The Quality Lab Technician is responsible for performing laboratory testing, material verification, inspections, and quality checks to ensure products meet customer specifications and industry standards. This position also maintains testing equipment, calibration records, quality documentation, and supports continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform annual and in-process functional testing.

  • Assemble functional test samples and PPAP samples.

  • Generate and maintain laboratory test reports.

  • Perform receiving inspections and material verification.

  • Maintain certified receiving lists and receiving documentation.

  • Manage inspection and measurement equipment calibration and certification systems.

  • Develop and maintain laboratory procedures, documentation, and forms.

  • Perform Gage Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R) studies and ongoing gauge testing.

  • Coordinate gauge calibration and certification.

  • Apply Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA) principles, including variable and attribute Gage R&R.

  • Understand and follow customer-specific requirements, Quality Management Systems, and AIAG standards.

  • Conduct quality system audits to ensure compliance with internal and industry standards.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Quality Manager.

Qualifications & Skills

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience.

  • Previous experience in quality assurance, laboratory testing, or automotive manufacturing preferred.

  • AIAG Core Tools certification.

  • IATF Lead Auditor certification.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, including Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

  • Ability to interpret customer specifications, equipment prints, and technical documentation.

  • Knowledge of automotive quality standards and customer-specific requirements.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Reliable attendance and a professional approach when working with coworkers, customers, and vendors.

Preferred Certifications & Technical Knowledge

Knowledge or certification in the following areas is required as applicable to the position:

  • Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP)

  • Statistical Process Control (SPC)

  • Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA)

  • Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)

  • Production Part Approval Process (PPAP)

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, sit, bend, reach, and climb stairs.

  • Frequent use of hands, fingers, and wrists for repetitive movements.

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs.

  • Ability to push and pull up to 50 lbs.

  • Ability to coordinate manual movements and operate inspection equipment.

  • Ability to communicate clearly and hear conversations in a manufacturing environment.

Working Environment & Safety

  • Work is performed in an automotive component manufacturing and laboratory environment.

  • May be exposed to varying temperatures, chemicals, fumes, grease, oils, machinery, and moving vehicles.

  • Manufacturing noise levels may consistently exceed 85 decibels.

  • Eye protection and hearing protection are required.

  • Must follow all applicable workplace safety procedures and guidelines.

job.title: Desktop Support Technician
job.description:
Digital & IT Associate – Tier 2 IT Support
Schedule: Monday–Friday | 7:00 AM–3:00 PM (1st Shift)
Experience Required: 1–2 Years
Work Environment: Manufacturing / Plant IT Support

Position Overview
We are seeking a Digital & IT Associate to provide hands-on technical support to employees in a manufacturing environment. This is an entry-level IT position ideal for someone with 1–2 years of experience supporting computers, software, networks, and end users.

The Digital & IT Associate will be responsible for troubleshooting technical issues, installing and maintaining hardware and software, and providing Tier 2 desktop support. This individual will also assist with basic network infrastructure, IT security compliance, and technical issues involving manufacturing equipment.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, organized, comfortable working directly with employees, and able to manage multiple technical requests in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
Desktop & End-User Support
- Provide daily, hands-on Tier 2 technical support to employees at one or more manufacturing locations.
- Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving desktops, laptops, printers, software, network connectivity, and user accounts.
- Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computer hardware, software, and peripheral devices.
- Assist with employee and contractor onboarding, including workstation setup, system access, and basic IT training.
- Serve as the primary point of contact for deskside technical support.

IT Infrastructure & Network Support
- Assist with basic troubleshooting of servers, firewalls, network switches, circuits, endpoints, and Wi-Fi connectivity.
- Support network connectivity issues involving DNS, internet service providers (ISPs), and related infrastructure.
- Work with internal IT teams to identify and resolve technical problems.
- Assist with troubleshooting IT-related issues involving manufacturing equipment and systems.

Ticket Management & Documentation
- Use ServiceNow to create, track, update, and resolve IT support tickets.
- Investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and escalate complex problems when necessary.
- Document troubleshooting steps, solutions, and resolutions accurately.
- Monitor open support requests to ensure timely resolution.

IT Security & Collaboration
- Follow established IT security policies, procedures, and compliance requirements.
- Support security best practices related to user access, devices, and network connectivity.
- Collaborate with IT infrastructure teams, business users, and manufacturing personnel.
- Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to both technical and nontechnical employees.
- Provide after-hours technical support when needed.

Required Qualifications
Education & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; or relevant work experience while pursuing a degree.
- Minimum of 1 year of professional IT support experience.
- Experience providing desktop, deskside, helpdesk, or Tier 2 technical support.
- Previous experience using ServiceNow for IT ticket management.
- Experience with Azure DevOps.

Technical Skills
- Hands-on experience troubleshooting PCs, laptops, printers, software, and user access issues.
- General understanding of IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, switches, DNS, ISPs, and connectivity.
- Basic knowledge of network troubleshooting and hardware/software installation.
- Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues in a business environment.

Communication & Organizational Skills
- Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.
- Ability to manage multiple support requests and shifting priorities.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate with multiple IT teams.
- Willingness to provide after-hours technical support as needed.

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician

$28–$36/hour + $3,000 Sign-On Bonus | 2nd & 3rd Shifts | Direct Hire | Excellent Benefits

Build your career with a stable, team-oriented food manufacturing company! KanPak is seeking experienced Maintenance Technicians to keep critical processing and packaging equipment running safely and efficiently in a 24/7 manufacturing environment. If you're strong mechanically, enjoy troubleshooting, and can diagnose and repair industrial equipment, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work with a company that offers competitive pay, overtime opportunities, training, and room for growth.

Pay & Schedule

  • Pay: $28–$36 per hour, based on experience
  • Sign-On Bonus: $3,000, paid after 30 days
  • Shift Differential: Currently $0.25/hour for 2nd shift and $0.50/hour for 3rd shift, with plans to increase to approximately $1/hour
  • Schedule: Full-time, permanent
  • Schedule options: Sunday–Thursday or Tuesday–Saturday
  • 2nd Shift: 3:00 PM–11:00 PM
  • 3rd Shift: 11:00 PM–7:00 AM
  • Initial Training: Approximately 90 days on 1st shift, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM
  • Must be available for weekends and overtime as needed
  • Most schedules are 12-hour shifts, depending on plant needs

About the Position

The Maintenance Technician is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing production and facility equipment in a 24/7 food and beverage manufacturing facility. This position works closely with production to minimize downtime, maintain equipment reliability, and ensure machinery operates safely and efficiently.

The ideal candidate has at least two years of industrial maintenance experience and a strong mechanical background. Experience troubleshooting mechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems is highly valued. Food manufacturing experience is a plus, but strong industrial maintenance candidates from other manufacturing environments are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic equipment.
  • Perform preventive and predictive maintenance on production and packaging equipment.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot conveyors, mixers, fillers, and packaging machinery.
  • Diagnose equipment problems and make necessary repairs and adjustments.
  • Perform machine setup, testing, rebuilds, and emergency repairs.
  • Troubleshoot sensors, photoelectric eyes, and Allen-Bradley controls.
  • Read and interpret schematics, technical drawings, and equipment manuals.
  • Perform basic welding, and facility repairs as needed.
  • Complete maintenance work orders and communicate equipment issues to leadership.

Nesco Resource is looking for a 2 nd Shift Operator located in Bethel, CT. This is a temp to perm opportunity for the right candidate.

Shift: Monday-Friday 3PM-11PM

Pay: $22.40/hour ($20 + 12% shift differential)

Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled Manufacturing Operator to perform various stages of precision tube and wire manufacturing. Responsibilities include operating and setting up production equipment, performing quality inspections, maintaining production standards, and ensuring all work is completed according to established procedures and specifications. The ideal candidate has mechanical aptitude, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining high standards for quality, safety, and efficiency.

Responsibilities:

  • Set up, operate, and maintain production machinery to ensure maximum efficiency and product quality.
  • Configure and operate wire and tube processing equipment according to production schedules and specifications, making minor adjustments as needed.
  • Operate multiple pieces of equipment within an assigned production area.
  • Perform in-process quality inspections and analyze results based on work instructions and production specifications.
  • Use precision measuring instruments, pin gauges, laser micrometers, and other inspection tools to verify product dimensions and quality.
  • Monitor and document production processes, including dimensional changes, tooling conditions, and equipment performance.
  • Perform routine preventative maintenance on production equipment.
  • Inspect drawing dies, tooling, and fixtures before and after use.
  • Maintain inventory of tools, fixtures, and production supplies.
  • Work with team members to meet production schedules, delivery deadlines, and quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce scrap, and increase productivity.
  • Complete and maintain accurate production documentation and required paperwork.
  • Follow established safety procedures, housekeeping standards, and quality control requirements.
  • Monitor work order status and maintain accurate production records within an electronic ERP system.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.
