job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
The Maintenance Technician is responsible for performing all assigned maintenance duties safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company policies and procedures.

This position requires strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills, independent decision-making, flexibility, and the ability to adapt to changing priorities, including working different shifts and overtime as needed.

The technician must manage time effectively while communicating progress and maintenance needs with supervisors.

Essential Functions:

  • Demonstrate the mechanical and electrical skills necessary to maintain efficient plant operations.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, repair, and rebuild plant equipment and systems to minimize downtime.
  • Repair and rebuild vacuum pumps, gearboxes, valves, steam regulating valves, pneumatic cylinders, and other pumps used throughout the facility.
  • Repair forklifts and other material handling equipment.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and repairs on Clean-in-Place (CIP) systems, conveying systems, mixing and drying equipment, chemical injection systems, air compressors, boiler systems, water systems, ammonia systems, packaging equipment, and material handling systems.
  • Troubleshoot and perform industrial electrical testing on 4–20 mA circuits, 12V, 24V, 48V, 120V, 240V, and 480V electrical systems, including switches, relays, motors, and control components.
  • Repair and maintain packaging systems, pressure systems, boilers, process equipment, and plant fixtures according to manufacturer specifications.
  • Monitor equipment performance and determine appropriate repairs or replacements.
  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance using maintenance management systems and equipment specifications.
  • Fabricate equipment and piping by interpreting equipment drawings, piping diagrams, and specifications.
  • Read and apply information from equipment manuals, technical documentation, and manufacturer resources.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas.
  • Follow all workplace safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Assist with equipment installations, plant improvement projects, and system upgrades.
  • Perform equipment calibrations, including PLCs, valves, sensors, and related instrumentation.
  • Complete additional duties as assigned.
  • Work effectively with minimal supervision.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in industrial maintenance practices.
  • Successfully pass a required written maintenance assessment with a minimum passing score of 75%.
  • Successfully complete required on-the-job qualification requirements within the designated training period.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering, operations, maintenance personnel, and outside vendors.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and able to respond effectively during emergency situations.
  • Maintain personal cleanliness and follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
  • Demonstrate initiative and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Experience rebuilding pumps, valves, gearboxes, and other industrial equipment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair boilers, compressed air systems, water systems, ammonia systems, dryers, packaging equipment, and production machinery.
  • Proficient in using electrical testing equipment, multimeters, and diagnostic tools.
  • Advanced knowledge of industrial electrical systems and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, piping diagrams, electrical schematics, construction drawings, and technical manuals.
  • Welding experience with stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel.

Working Conditions:

  • Frequent standing, walking, climbing, bending, reaching, lifting, pushing, pulling, and repetitive motion throughout the workday.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Routine stair climbing and work at varying heights.
  • Use of computers, measuring instruments, testing devices, and diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to distinguish colors for electrical and instrumentation work.
  • Work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to elevated temperatures, high noise levels, moving machinery, chemicals, steam, and wet or slippery surfaces.
  • Required use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, safety shoes, gloves, respirators, and hearing protection as required.
  • May be required to work in confined spaces.
  • Exposure to live steam, heated water, and other industrial process equipment.

job.title: AP/AR Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a part time (25-30/hrs a week) AP/AR Specialist to manage daily transactional workflows and support our period-end close. This role owns the complete cycle of cash coming in and going out, while bridging the gap between daily bookkeeping and general ledger reporting by handling baseline month-end reconciliations and journal entries.


Core Responsibilities
  • Accounts Payable: Execute three-way matching of vendor invoices, purchase orders, and receiving logs; resolve pricing or freight discrepancies; and prepare weekly payment runs.
  • Accounts Receivable: Generate customer invoices from shipping data, apply daily cash receipts, investigate customer short-payments, and manage B2B collection outreach.
  • Month-End Close: Reconcile AP/AR subledgers to the general ledger, perform bank reconciliations, and post basic closing journals (e.g., accrued freight, unbilled receipts).
  • Manufacturing Support: Review inventory transaction logs and clearings, including Received Not Invoiced (RNI) accounts.

Qualifications
  • Experience: 2+ years of combined AP/AR experience inside a manufacturing or distribution environment.
  • Education: Degree or certificate in Accounting/Finance preferred, or equivalent work experience.
  • Tech Skills: Experience using ERP systems and intermediate Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups).
  • Core Skills: Solid understanding of general ledger accounting, debits/credits, and matching principles

job.title: BI Business Analyst
job.description:
Position Overview

We're looking for an experienced Business Intelligence Business Analyst who enjoys working with people, understanding business challenges, and turning reporting needs into practical solutions.

This is a cross between a Business Analysis & Data Analysis role where you'll work directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, investigate data, and help technical teams deliver accurate, useful reporting solutions.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can work independently, ask the right questions, and translate business needs into clear requirements for developers. You'll need hands-on SQL experience and a solid understanding of business intelligence tools, but you won't be responsible for building dashboards or developing complex SQL queries.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Work directly with business stakeholders to understand their reporting needs, identify challenges, and define requirements for new or improved reporting solutions.
  • Lead requirements-gathering sessions with business leaders, department managers, and other stakeholders to clarify objectives and expectations.
  • Develop clear, organized documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and business process flows.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable specifications that BI developers, data engineers, and QA teams can use to build and test reporting solutions.
  • Use SQL to research information, retrieve data, investigate discrepancies, and support reporting requirements and mockups.
  • Create reporting mockups and help stakeholders understand available features and functionality within Power BI or similar visualization tools.
  • Collaborate with project managers, developers, data engineers, and testers throughout the development process to ensure requirements are understood and delivered accurately.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, requirements discussions, and project planning meetings.
  • Present requirements and findings to project teams, answer questions, resolve gaps, and obtain stakeholder approval before development.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by reviewing dashboards and reports with business users to confirm data accuracy and ensure the final solution meets their needs.
  • Contribute to projects focused on improving data consistency, standardizing reporting processes, and building scalable analytics solutions across multiple business functions.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of Business Analyst experience, preferably supporting technology, data, business intelligence, or reporting initiatives.
  • Strong experience independently leading stakeholder meetings, gathering business requirements, and translating those needs into technical documentation.
  • Hands-on experience creating BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and reporting specifications.
  • 3+ years of SQL experience, with the ability to independently query databases, retrieve information, research data, and validate reporting results.
  • Experience working with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or comparable BI/reporting platforms, with an understanding of dashboard capabilities and reporting functionality.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including experience working with both senior business leaders and technical development teams.
  • Experience collaborating with BI developers, data engineers, QA testers, and project managers throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, including sprint activities, requirements refinement, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience participating in UAT and validating reports or dashboards against documented business requirements.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and contribute to active projects with minimal ramp-up time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting, data modernization, or data standardization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and/or Microsoft Power Apps.
  • Experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
  • Experience developing reporting mockups, defining KPIs, or documenting business reporting logic.
  • Exposure to projects involving multiple data sources, different business units, or varying levels of data quality.
  • Experience supporting reporting and analytics initiatives within insurance, financial services, or other data-intensive industries.

job.title: Senior Buyer - Procurement
job.description:
Position: Senior Buyer (Senior Sourcing Engineer)

We are looking for a Senior Buyer in Client Technologies Business. The location will be in Cleveland, USA, this incumbent will collaborate with cross function leaders, lead the development and execution of sourcing plans/strategy to improve competitive position, supply resilience and achieve business goals.

Your Key Responsibilities:
Work with businesses and other functions to fully understand business needs and develop/select reliable suppliers to deliver high quality products at lowest total cost to Laird.

The position requires the capability to analyze, understand and interpret market dynamics and drivers, supplier capability and constraints, quantity leverage, regional regulations, and best sourcing practices to develop and implement sourcing strategies to achieve long term competitive advantages for the business.

Effectively utilize Laird Global Procurement processes, procedures and tools to achieve Procurement functional goals and corporate governance requirements, whilst delivering business needs. Have a disciplined approach to ensure system data remains accurate, up to date, and consistent.

Develop, negotiate, implement and manage Supply Agreements through understanding:
• Implications of contract language
• Laird demand forecast and critical growth objectives
• Quality, responsible care, regulatory and supply chain requirements
• Industry supply/demand dynamics and applying to sourcing strategies
• Laird and general market price history and drivers

Manage supply risk. Work with Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, PM, Quality, and other functions to mitigate supply risks and ensure supply security.

Initiate and drive results for cost saving and working capital improvement, manage effectively cost headwind.

Manage supplier relationship. Develop Supplier Relationship Management plans for critical suppliers to instill continuous improvement approach, maximize value generation, and minimize supply risk.

Your Qualification Profile:
• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Supply Chain or a related field is required
• 5-10 years of sourcing, operations or supply chain experience including at least 3 years in raw material strategic sourcing role
• Strong negotiation skills.
• Good communication and relationship skills (internal clients, external suppliers).
• High degree of competency in data and value analysis, combined with excellent IT skills.
• Good understanding of Legal fundamentals (as relates to contracts).
• High level of understanding of Supply Chain fundamentals and the integration with Sourcing.
• Good understanding of Finance fundamentals.
• High ethical standards.
• Good understanding of Regulatory requirements.
• Ability to work independently and manage conflicting priorities.
• Travel may be required depending on project needs

This is for one Senior Buyer with 5-10 years' experience.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Position Summary

The temporary Defense Quality Engineer (DQE) will support the business in the areas of Material Review Board (MRB), new product development, lean implementation, process capability improvement, and daily production support. This includes in-process and final inspection, process and product auditing, and technical data interpretation/analysis such as engineering drawings, specifications, technical publications, purchase orders review, and quality system management. The DQE must be knowledgeable of statistical process controls, dimensional inspection metrology, and Quality Management Systems such as ISO 9001:2015, AS9100, IATF, TS16949, etc. The DQE primarily interfaces with Customers, Suppliers, Sales/Contracts, Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Operations.

Principal Activities

  • Material Review Board (MRB) Support:
    • Lead and participate in MRB meetings to evaluate non-conforming materials, components, and products.
    • Identify and document root causes of non-conformances in products or materials.
    • Approve, reject, or recommend rework for materials that don't meet quality standards.
  • Non-Conformance Management:
    • Coordinate and drive the investigation of SIRs in conjunction with manufacturing and engineering teams.
    • Ensure that proper documentation is in place for all non-conformances, including dispositions, corrective actions, and preventive actions.
  • Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action:
    • Conduct root cause analysis for quality issues, including failure analysis and the implementation of corrective actions.
    • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure that corrective actions are effectively implemented and tracked to completion.
  • Compliance and Documentation:
    • Ensure compliance with industry standards (e.g., ISO 9001), regulatory requirements, and customer specifications.
    • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to MRB activities, including SIRs, audits, and corrective actions.
  • Collaboration:
    • Collaborate with quality peers, manufacturing, engineering, and procurement teams to resolve quality issues.
    • Provide support and guidance to suppliers regarding quality requirements and resolve any material-related issues.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen, to enhance overall quality and reduce non-conformances.
    • Recommend improvements to processes, materials, or procedures to minimize the occurrence of defects or quality issues.
    • Collect and analyze data to identify and prioritize opportunities for improvement of product and process quality.
    • Provide quality witness on tear down of customer returned material.
    • Conduct and participate in quality system, process, and product audits.
    • Provide technical leadership to inspection team members.
    • Comply with all company policies/procedures.
    • Comply with all military and contractual requirements.
    • Examine/audit finished product before customer source inspection/shipment to test conformance to ATP.
    • "In-Line” examination/audit of production line confirming adherence to ATP and testing methodology.
    • Review all documentation/drawings, ATP sign-off sheets, visual conformance, finish, etc.
    • Ensure that product identification marking or labeling requirements are set out in drawings or associated specifications properly observed.
    • Perform in-process and final source inspections including First Article inspections.
    • Perform other job-related duties as assigned by management.

Candidate Requirements

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to create and implement statistically valid control plans and audit plans.
  • Working knowledge of inspection metrology and proper application of automated measuring equipment.
  • Excellent working knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing.
  • Ability to create and/or review failure analysis reports.
  • Thorough knowledge of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Project, and other applicable tools.
  • Approximately 10% travel required.

Education & Experience

  • Typically requires a minimum level of knowledge that is acquired through a two-year college degree in an applicable field and three years related experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience.

job.description:
Sr. Account Manager, Automotive Job (Remote):

Remote Position with travel to Evansville, IN, Detroit, MI, and customer sites as needed
Full-Time, Direct Hire
Salary Range: $120-140,000 base, plus commission and annual bonus eligibility
Please no 3rd party or c2c candidates

Our well-established client, a specialty materials manufacturer serving the automotive industry, is seeking an experienced Key Account Manager to lead and grow strategic automotive OEM and Tier 1 customer accounts. Many of their solutions are proprietary and patented, and the company has ambitious growth goals over the next several years. This person will serve as the primary commercial representative for assigned customers, building long-term relationships, driving profitable growth, and coordinating cross-functional efforts to support customer programs.

The Key Account Manager will work closely with the R&D team, who join customer visits to answer technical questions. The ideal candidate is a strong salesperson who is down to earth and just as comfortable on the plant floor as in a purchasing or leadership meeting.

Responsibilities of the Account Manager, Automotive Job (Remote):

Account Management

  • Serve as the primary commercial contact for assigned OEM and Tier 1 customer accounts.
  • Build strategic relationships with decision-makers across purchasing, engineering, manufacturing, quality, program management, and leadership.
  • Develop and execute account strategies, and lead customer business reviews and planning discussions.
  • Monitor customer satisfaction and resolve commercial and operational issues promptly.

Business Development and Commercial Leadership

  • Achieve annual sales, profitability, and growth objectives for assigned accounts.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing business and secure new program awards.
  • Lead commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, contract reviews, and proposals.
  • Present the company’s technologies, capabilities, and value to customers.

Customer Program and Technical Support

  • Understand customer technical requirements, product specifications, and performance expectations.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, R&D, Quality, Operations, and Supply Chain to support product launches and production programs.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer and support issue resolution throughout the product lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Market Analysis

  • Lead internal teams to meet customer commitments for quality, delivery, cost, and service.
  • Monitor automotive industry trends, OEM initiatives, and competitive activity.
  • Share customer priorities and market intelligence with leadership to support strategic planning.

Qualifications of the Account Manager, Automotive Job (Remote):

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Account management experience in automotive OEM, Tier 1, specialty chemicals, adhesives, manufacturing, or a related industrial field.
  • Proven success managing strategic accounts and achieving growth objectives.
  • Strong understanding of automotive OEM purchasing processes, vehicle development cycles, and launch management.
  • Ability to build relationships at all levels, from the plant floor to executive leadership.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required.

This role requires regular interaction with office, laboratory, and manufacturing environments as well as customer locations. Team members may occasionally be exposed to manufacturing conditions, including moving equipment, noise, fumes, dust, and temperature variations.

Benefits
Our client offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, commission, annual bonus eligibility, and a comprehensive benefits package.

job.title: Scheduling Coordinator
job.description:
Scheduling Coordinator

Position Overview

The Sleep Scheduling Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for scheduling sleep-related appointments for new and existing patients. This role supports practices, hospital departments, and ancillary services across the health system. The Coordinator relays patient concerns, processes medication refill requests, and communicates with clinical and office staff per protocol through the designated EMR system.

This position requires a strong customer service mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex scheduling requests while maintaining compliance with HIPAA and regulatory standards. Coordinators must remain calm in stressful situations, prioritize patient needs effectively, and ensure accuracy when entering patient information, verifying insurance, and coordinating care.

Clerical medical experience is a plus but not required.

Essential Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling & Coordination

  • Coordinate and schedule appointments for sleep consults, sleep studies, follow-ups, daytime studies, and home sleep testing.

  • Utilize department software systems (Cerner Scheduling, Excel, PowerChart, PowerChart Ambulatory, RevCycle, and other systems as required).

  • Manage cancellations, reschedules, and related communication with patients and providers.

  • Fill open and same-day appointment slots in accordance with department guidelines.

  • Collaborate with clinical team leaders to identify appropriate scheduling options.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Use ICD-10 and CPT codes to verify medical necessity.

  • Coordinate with internal teams regarding insurance authorizations.

  • Process medical record requests and maintain accurate documentation.

2. Customer Service & Communication

  • Deliver high-quality customer service to patients, community members, and internal teams.

  • Answer incoming calls and respond to inquiries professionally.

  • Greet patients courteously in person and over the phone.

  • Use appropriate tone and clearly identify oneself during phone communication.

  • De-escalate difficult situations and escalate concerns appropriately.

  • Demonstrate strong active listening and clear verbal/written communication skills.

  • Meet or exceed established service standards and patient satisfaction guidelines.

3. Medical Records Management

  • Process medical record requests and release of information forms.

  • Adhere to regulatory standards regarding medical record releases.

  • Document all communication and actions related to medical record requests.

4. Patient Check-In & Check-Out

  • Ensure all required paperwork is completed and properly documented.

  • Confirm and update patient demographics and insurance information.

  • Register patients and obtain required consents.

  • Ensure patient understanding of rights, responsibilities, and privacy policies.

  • Prepare provider charts with updated documentation and records.

  • Schedule follow-up appointments per provider orders.

5. Insurance Authorization Support

  • Work closely with the authorization team to ensure sleep studies are approved.

  • Provide necessary documentation and information for authorization.

  • Schedule and reschedule appointments according to authorization guidelines.

  • Communicate authorization updates or changes to patients.

  • Verify and update insurance information as needed.

6. Additional Responsibilities

  • Support departmental operations by completing additional duties as assigned.

Workplace & Behavioral Expectations

Workplace Standards

  • Maintain professional appearance and demeanor.

  • Demonstrate safety awareness and adhere to workplace safety guidelines.

  • Uphold corporate compliance and confidentiality standards.

Behavioral Standards

  • Practice professional workplace etiquette.

  • Communicate with clarity, courtesy, and respect.

  • Foster positive customer and coworker relationships.

  • Demonstrate teamwork and a strong sense of ownership.

Qualifications

Required Education

  • High School Diploma or GED

Preferred Education

  • None specified

Required Experience

  • One (1) year of experience in a customer service role or healthcare setting

Preferred Experience

  • Two (2) years of experience in customer service or healthcare

  • Experience working with practice management software, including scheduling and registration systems

Licenses & Certifications

  • None required

Working Conditions

  • Standard office environment

  • OSHA Category: No potential exposure to blood or body fluids

job.title: Senior Digital Delivery Lead - Enterprise Website Migration
job.description:
Senior Digital Delivery Lead – Enterprise Website Migration

Location: Westerville, OH
Work Arrangement: Onsite, minimum 3 days per week; up to 5 days during critical project phases
Start Date: Within 2–3 weeks

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Digital Delivery Lead to manage the complete rebuild and migration of a global corporate website to a modern, composable Digital Experience Platform (DXP).

This is a high-visibility initiative for a $10 billion global organization, requiring someone who has successfully delivered large-scale enterprise website migrations from initial planning through go-live.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing website launches, content migration, technical dependencies, global stakeholders, and external vendors.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role, not a traditional PMO position. The individual will be responsible for driving decisions, resolving challenges, managing timelines, and ensuring a successful launch.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Website Migration & Delivery

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of a global corporate website migration, from project kickoff through launch.

  • Develop and manage project plans, milestones, timelines, budgets, dependencies, and deliverables.

  • Coordinate platform migration activities across technical, content, marketing, and business teams.

  • Identify project risks, resolve issues, and maintain progress toward established deadlines.

  • Ensure all project activities align with business objectives and launch requirements.

Content Migration & Digital Platforms

  • Oversee the complete content migration process, including content audits, classification, production, approvals, and publishing.

  • Ensure 100% of required editorial content is reviewed, prepared, and migrated accurately before launch.

  • Coordinate content workflows across CMS, DXP, Product Information Management (PIM), and Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems.

  • Manage content localization, regional requirements, and editorial governance.

  • Partner with technical teams to ensure content is properly integrated into the new platform.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Serve as the primary delivery lead across Marketing, IT, Product, regional teams, and executive leadership.

  • Work directly with senior executives, including CMO/CIO-level stakeholders and steering committees.

  • Manage relationships with internal teams, external agencies, localization vendors, and technical implementation partners.

  • Coordinate multiple stakeholders and vendors to ensure deliverables remain aligned with project timelines.

  • Facilitate decisions, address competing priorities, and escalate issues when necessary.

Global Coordination & Governance

  • Establish and maintain project governance, reporting structures, and decision-making processes.

  • Coordinate regional approval workflows across multiple markets.

  • Ensure regional content meets localization, compliance, and business requirements.

  • Conduct project meetings focused on progress, accountability, issue resolution, and decision-making.

  • Maintain visibility into project status, dependencies, risks, and outstanding approvals.

Website Launch & Go-Live Readiness

  • Lead launch readiness activities, including quality assurance, content validation, and technical testing.

  • Coordinate SEO migration activities, URL mapping, and 301 redirects.

  • Develop and oversee go-live plans, rollback procedures, and launch-day execution.

  • Work with technical teams to identify and resolve issues before deployment.

  • Ensure website functionality, content accuracy, SEO performance, and user experience are maintained throughout the transition.

  • Manage final approvals and coordinate a successful production launch.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in digital project delivery, enterprise website launches, or digital transformation.

  • Proven experience leading at least two full-scale corporate website launches or platform migrations involving 500+ pages and multiple markets.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise website migration projects on time and within budget.

  • Strong understanding of composable Digital Experience Platforms (DXP), headless CMS architecture, and enterprise content management systems.

job.title: Data Conversion Analyst - Insurance
job.description:
Position Overview

We're looking for an experienced Data Conversion Analyst to support data migration and system conversion projects within the insurance industry. This person will work with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external vendors to extract, transform, map, and validate data as information moves between systems.

The ideal candidate is hands-on with SQL and Excel, understands the complexities of data conversions, and can independently manage projects from initial data analysis through post-conversion validation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Extract, analyze, clean, and transform data from various source systems using SQL, Excel, Alteryx, and other data technologies.
  • Perform source-to-target data mapping, prepare conversion templates, and support data imports into destination systems.
  • Validate and reconcile converted data, troubleshoot discrepancies, and resolve data quality issues.
  • Identify opportunities for custom scripting, automation, and improved conversion processes.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, technical teams, and vendors to define requirements, resolve mapping issues, and coordinate conversion activities.
  • Lead data review meetings, track conversion milestones, and maintain documentation throughout the migration process.
  • Support occasional on-site customer visits during key implementation activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • At least 5 years of experience in data analysis, data transformation, data conversion, or similar technical data-focused positions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL, including querying, analyzing, and working with complex datasets.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, lookup functions, PivotTables, VBA, and data manipulation techniques.
  • Experience examining large datasets, identifying errors or inconsistencies, and determining appropriate corrective actions.
  • Understanding of data structures, field mapping, and the steps involved in preparing information for migration between systems.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate and resolve complex data-related problems.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple assignments, prioritize competing deadlines, and follow projects through completion.
  • Comfortable working in environments where project needs, timelines, and technical requirements may change.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data-related findings and technical concepts to both business users and technical teams.
  • Experience collaborating across different departments, working with external partners, and participating in customer-facing discussions.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accountability for assigned work.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally, approximately 10%.
  • Flexibility to support limited evening or weekend activities during important conversion or implementation milestones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in the insurance industry, particularly Property & Casualty insurance, brokerage operations, or related technology environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, particularly Dataflows Gen2, or other Microsoft-based data integration technologies.
  • Experience using Alteryx or similar tools to prepare, transform, and automate data workflows.
  • Knowledge of insurance agency management platforms or comparable enterprise business applications.
  • Experience migrating data between enterprise applications, particularly when consolidating information from multiple systems.
  • Practical experience with source-to-target mapping, data transformation, reconciliation, and conversion validation.
  • Involvement in enterprise technology implementations, platform migrations, acquisitions, or system consolidation projects.
  • Experience creating or supporting scripts, automated processes, or custom solutions that improve data preparation and conversion efficiency.

job.description:
Overview

Location: Tempe, AZ

Department: Manufacturing

Schedule: Monday–Friday | Standard Business Hours

Industry: Aerospace / Defense Manufacturing

Employment Type: Direct Hire

Join a leading aerospace manufacturer specializing in advanced battery systems and energy storage electronics for commercial, military, and general aviation. This position offers the stability of an established business and opportunities for professional growth and long-term career advancement. We are seeking an experienced professional to lead manufacturing process improvements, support new product introductions, and drive operational excellence in our electronics and battery product lines.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve manufacturing processes to enhance quality, efficiency, and production output.
  • Design and develop production tooling, jigs, and fixtures to support precision assembly and machining operations.

  • Proven experience supporting New Product Introductions (NPI).
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, process routings, work instructions, and PFMEAs.
  • Experience with Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
  • Experience with statistical analysis and manufacturing data utilization.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects from development through implementation.

Plan, direct, and coordinate manufacturing processes.
Develop, evaluate, and improve manufacturing methods, utilizing knowledge of product design, materials, parts, and fabrication processes, as well as tooling and production equipment capabilities, assembly methods, and quality control standards.
Analyze and plan work force utilization, space requirements, and workflow, and design layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Confer with planning, production and design staff concerning product design and tooling to ensure efficient production methods.
Confer with vendors to determine product specifications and arrange for purchase of equipment, materials, or parts, and evaluate products according to specifications and quality standards.
Estimate production times, staffing requirements, and related costs to provide information for management decisions.
Confer with management, engineering, and other staff regarding manufacturing capabilities, production schedules, and other considerations to facilitate production processes.
Apply statistical methods to estimate future manufacturing requirements and potential.

Responsible for supporting the current manufacturing and facilitating the continuous improvement processes associated with the manufacturing methods and processes in the plant facility. Also develops solutions for production problems related to materials, processes, and tooling. Supports new products and programs by developing new processes, designing tooling and machinery, and developing production controls. Responsible for set-up of new equipment, ensures proper operation of the new equipment, and to teach others the proper use of this equipment. Accountable for applying sound economic methods to equipment and space utilization to meet design and quality criteria with the lowest expense and consistent with the facilities financial and non-financial objectives.

job.title: Network Cabling & Installation Technician
job.description:
Nesco Resource is seeking an experienced Network Cabling & Installation Technician for a 3-month contract opportunity in Watertown, MA. This position will support a network infrastructure installation and upgrade project within a professional corporate office environment.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with structured cabling, network switch installations, network node connectivity, and troubleshooting Layer 1 network infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical position requiring attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work efficiently in an active office setting.

Employment Type: Temporary Contract – 3 Months
Work Environment: Onsite | Corporate Office Environment
Schedule: Full-Time | Day Shift (Project-Based)

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, route, terminate, label, and organize structured network cabling, including Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6A as required.

  • Install, mount, and physically connect network access switches, network nodes, and associated networking equipment.

  • Perform cable patching and connectivity work between network switches, patch panels, wall outlets, and endpoint devices.

  • Support network infrastructure upgrades, equipment replacements, and new network deployments throughout corporate office spaces.

  • Assist with installation and connectivity of network nodes and related devices across office workstations, conference rooms, and telecommunications closets.

  • Test and validate network cabling and connectivity using appropriate testing equipment.

  • Troubleshoot Layer 1 connectivity issues, including faulty cabling, incorrect patching, damaged connectors, and physical port issues.

  • Maintain clean, organized cabling within network racks, IDF/MDF closets, and office work areas.

  • Follow network diagrams, installation instructions, labeling standards, and project documentation.

Project Manager – Enterprise Data & Analytics

Department: Enterprise Data & Analytics Services (EDAS)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to support enterprise data and analytics initiatives within the Enterprise Data & Analytics Services (EDAS) organization. This role is responsible for coordinating project activities, managing timelines and dependencies, tracking deliverables, and ensuring projects remain on schedule and aligned with business objectives.

The Project Manager will work closely with Business Analysts, Data Analysts, Engineers, Architects, Data Governance teams, business stakeholders, and other Project Managers to support successful project delivery. This individual will serve as a central point of coordination across multiple teams, providing visibility into project status, risks, milestones, and implementation readiness.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in banking or financial services, experience managing enterprise data initiatives, and advanced hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery

  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, RAID logs, action-item trackers, and supporting documentation.

  • Manage multiple concurrent projects, ensuring deliverables, timelines, and dependencies remain on track.

  • Facilitate project meetings, implementation planning, readiness reviews, and milestone checkpoints.

  • Monitor project health and provide clear visibility into delivery progress and implementation readiness.

Cross-Functional Team Coordination

  • Serve as the primary coordination point across EDAS project teams and workstreams.

  • Facilitate cross-functional meetings to address dependencies, resolve issues, and maintain project momentum.

  • Promote communication, accountability, and collaboration across teams.

Project Reporting & Communication

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, executive reports, and governance documentation.

  • Communicate project accomplishments, milestones, risks, issues, and delivery concerns to leadership and stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate project documentation, decision logs, and action-item trackers.

  • Provide leadership and partner Project Managers with visibility into project progress, dependencies, and implementation readiness.

  • Ensure Jira and Confluence are consistently updated and used as primary tools for project tracking and reporting.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Technology, Project Management, Analytics, Finance, or a related field.

  • An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Project Management, Technology Delivery, PMO, or a related field.

  • Experience working in Banking or Financial Services, supporting technology, data, analytics, governance, regulatory, risk, or modernization initiatives.

  • Demonstrated experience managing enterprise data projects involving one or more of the following:

    • Data Warehousing and Data Integration

    • ETL processes

    • Data Governance and Data Management

    • Data Quality and Data Lineage

    • Analytics and Reporting

    • Regulatory Data

    • Data Modernization

  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously within a large enterprise environment.

  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage stakeholders across business and technology organizations.

  • Strong hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence for project execution, tracking, reporting, and documentation.

  • Experience developing project plans, RAID logs, dashboards, executive reports, and project documentation.

  • Experience working within Agile, Kanban, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery environments.

Technical & Project Management Skills

  • Advanced proficiency with Jira and Confluence, including Jira boards, Kanban boards, dashboards, delivery metrics, and documentation.

  • Strong project planning, scheduling, organization, and execution skills.

  • Knowledge of Data Governance, Data Management, Data Quality, Data Lineage, Metadata Management, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs).

  • Ability to identify and manage risks, issues, dependencies, and competing priorities.

  • Strong stakeholder management, follow-up, and accountability skills.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

  • Ability to prepare clear project reports and communicate effectively with technical teams and executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

  • Scrum Master certification.

  • Experience supporting Enterprise Data & Analytics organizations.

  • Experience with Alation, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, or similar enterprise data platforms.

  • Experience supporting large-scale technology modernization or transformation initiatives.

  • Familiarity with banking functions such as lending, collateral management, and regulatory reporting.

What Success Looks Like

  • Project deliverables, commitments, and action items are completed on time.

job.description:
Wilmington, NC, Onsite
M-F, 8-5pm. Possibility for OT

Role Summary
We are seeking a Electrical Engineer to provide hands-on engineering support for equipment construction, installation, debugging, and startup at both domestic and international locations. This role plays a key part in overseeing internal teams and contract personnel during installation and conversion projects, ensuring safe, efficient, and high quality execution.

Key Responsibilities
Learn & understand process & equipment functions in area of responsibility, including system analog and digital I/O requirements, control sequence logic, fail safe states and recovery sequences.
Interface with external system integrators and machine builders to successfully deliver fully integrated process equipment systems to plants on time, on-budget and that satisfy performance measures.
Assist in developing integrated industrial control systems for new manufacturing equipment and modification of existing equipment.
Work closely with the Technology Development, Manufacturing Engineering and Operations groups to industrialize and reduce cost of new equipment designs.
Support initial equipment set-up and debug up to the point of turnover to operations.
Supervise and provide direction to internal or contract engineering techs, internal maintenance, and outside contract trades during all aspects of equipment installation and conversion such as demolition, construction, installation, testing, and debug of production equipment.
Perform hands-on troubleshooting, direct engineering techs and trades as necessary to replace defective components and execute changes to solve equipment/process issues.
Review, "redline , and modify existing installation checklists, machine part lists, illustrations, machine specs, schedules, and complete drawing packages including follow-up with drafting services.

Required Education & Skills
Bachelor's or higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
At least 5 - 7 years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
Experience working on a manufacturing floor or construction environment, with a strong focus on job site safety and proactive safety approach.
Knowledge of power systems for 480VAC and below .
Ability to work hands-on with the equipment using typical hand tools, instruments, and measurement/alignment devices.
Ability to interpret engineering requirements and translate them into equipment designs and schematics.

Desired Skills
Experience using AutoCAD , AutoCAD Electrical, Windows, MS Office suite including Power Point, Excel, Word. PLC and PC based systems, Beckhoff PLC / Motion Control, B&R PLC Control, Automated equipment systems experience.
Background in manufacturing or construction environments.
Strong communication, presentation, and project management capabilities.
PLC code development to achieve desired operation/throughput of new and existing production equipment.
SCADA/HMI development, PID control theory knowledge, Electro/mechanical technical understanding.
Experience in optical fiber manufacturing is a plus.

Travel Requirements
Typical travel can range from a few days to a few weeks during the project initiation phase. During the deployment phase of the project, travel may be full-time.

Hours of Work/Work Schedule
40 hours+ M-F, adjusted hours and weekends may be required based on where the project is in the project life cycle.

job.title: Data Center Facility Manager
job.description:
Nesco Data Center & Infrastructure is seeking a Data Center Facility Manager in the Greater Dallas/Allen area.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Center Facility Manager to oversee the daily operations, maintenance, and overall performance of a mission-critical, multi-tenant colocation data center facility in Dallas, Texas.

This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Mission-Critical Engineers and facility technicians while ensuring the reliability, safety, efficiency, and operational integrity of the facility and its supporting infrastructure. The facility houses multiple colocation customers, ranging from individual rack deployments to customers occupying multiple cabinets, suites, and dedicated cages. The successful candidate must understand the importance of maintaining exceptional operational standards while supporting the unique requirements and expectations of multiple tenants.

A key component of this position will be developing and implementing a cross-training program for the facility engineering team, designed to strengthen employees' mechanical and electrical competencies. The goal is to create a more versatile, knowledgeable, and effective engineering workforce capable of supporting a broader range of critical facility systems and responsibilities.

The Facility Manager will report directly to the Regional Director of Data Center Operations and serve as the primary operational leader for the facility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Facility Operations & Infrastructure Management

  • Oversee all day-to-day operations of the data center facility, ensuring maximum uptime, reliability, and operational efficiency.

  • Maintain and monitor critical infrastructure, including:

    • Electrical distribution systems, UPS systems, generators, and backup power.

    • Mechanical and HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAC/CRAH units, and associated cooling infrastructure.

    • Building management systems (Client) and electrical power monitoring systems (EPMS).

    • Fire suppression, life safety, and environmental monitoring systems.

  • Ensure preventive and predictive maintenance programs are consistently executed.

  • Oversee scheduled maintenance, emergency repairs, infrastructure upgrades, and equipment replacements.

  • Maintain operational readiness and ensure adherence to established facility procedures and service-level expectations.

  • Participate in incident management, root-cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

2. Team Leadership & Cross-Training Development

  • Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of Mission-Critical Engineers and facility technicians.

  • Establish a collaborative engineering environment focused on accountability, technical development, and continuous improvement.

  • Develop and implement a formal mechanical and electrical cross-training program for facility personnel.

  • Encourage engineers with primarily mechanical backgrounds to develop electrical competencies and vice versa.

  • Establish training objectives, competency benchmarks, and development plans for individual team members.

  • Identify knowledge gaps and create opportunities for employees to expand their technical capabilities.

  • Promote knowledge sharing, shadowing, hands-on training, and collaborative troubleshooting between engineering disciplines.

  • Improve staffing flexibility and operational coverage by developing a team capable of supporting multiple disciplines.

  • Conduct regular performance reviews, team meetings, scheduling, and employee development discussions.

3. Multi-Tenant Colocation Customer Management

  • Oversee facility operations supporting multiple colocation tenants, ranging from single-rack customers to customers occupying multiple cages and dedicated data center spaces.

  • Ensure the facility team delivers consistent, professional, and responsive operational support to all tenants.

  • Coordinate maintenance activities, facility access, vendor visits, and operational work that may impact tenant environments.

  • Maintain awareness of tenant-specific requirements, service agreements, and operational expectations.

  • Support customer escalations and coordinate with internal departments to resolve facility-related concerns.

  • Ensure proper communication surrounding planned maintenance, unplanned outages, facility incidents, and other operational events.

  • Maintain a customer-first mindset while protecting the integrity and security of the facility.

4. Vendor & Contractor Management

  • Manage third-party vendors, service providers, and contractors responsible for facility maintenance and ancillary services.

  • Oversee vendor relationships and performance, including:

    • HVAC and mechanical maintenance contractors.

    • Electrical contractors and generator/UPS service providers.

    • Fire suppression and life safety vendors.

    • Landscaping and lawn care services.

    • Janitorial and cleaning contractors.

    • Security, pest control, waste management, and other ancillary facility providers.

  • Coordinate vendor scheduling, site access, work permits, and maintenance activities.

  • Review vendor performance, ensure contractual obligations are met, and maintain appropriate service standards.

  • Monitor vendor expenses and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies.

5. Safety, Compliance & Operational Standards

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA requirements, applicable building codes, and relevant safety regulations.

  • Maintain accurate facility documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), emergency operating procedures (EOPs), and maintenance procedures (MOPs).

  • Oversee change management processes and ensure appropriate approvals and risk assessments are completed before critical work.

  • Conduct regular facility inspections, safety reviews, and operational audits.

  • Ensure employees and contractors follow established safety protocols and critical facility procedures.

  • Support customer audits, compliance assessments, and internal operational reviews.

6. Reporting & Regional Operations Support

  • Report directly to the Regional Director of Data Center Operations.

  • Provide regular reporting on facility performance, staffing, maintenance activities, operational incidents, and infrastructure conditions.

  • Develop and monitor operational KPIs, including uptime, preventive maintenance completion, incident response, and team development.

  • Communicate staffing requirements, capital improvement needs, vendor concerns, and operational risks to regional leadership.

  • Assist with annual budgeting, forecasting, expense management, and operational planning.

  • Participate in regional management meetings and support the implementation of broader company operational initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data center facility operations, critical facilities management, or mission-critical infrastructure environments.

  • Prior experience managing, supervising, or leading a team of Mission-Critical Engineers, Critical Facilities Engineers, or facility technicians.

  • Strong working knowledge of both mechanical and electrical infrastructure supporting mission-critical environments.

  • Experience with UPS systems, generators, electrical distribution, HVAC, cooling systems, and building management systems.

  • Experience managing preventive maintenance programs, vendors, contractors, and facility service providers.

  • Previous experience in a colocation or multi-tenant data center environment strongly preferred.

  • Understanding of data center operational procedures, maintenance protocols, and change management.

  • Strong organizational, communication, leadership, and customer-facing skills.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of operational discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing technical training, mentorship, or cross-training programs.

  • Experience developing engineering teams with both mechanical and electrical competencies.

  • Familiarity with Uptime Institute standards, Tier-rated facilities, and mission-critical operational best practices.

  • Experience with Client, EPMS, CMMS, and other facility monitoring or maintenance management platforms.

  • Familiarity with NFPA standards, OSHA regulations, and applicable electrical and mechanical safety requirements.

  • Relevant technical certifications, trade licenses, or facilities management credentials are beneficial.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, operationally focused leader who understands that successful data center management requires more than simply maintaining infrastructure. They must be capable of building a strong engineering team, developing employee skill sets, improving operational efficiencies, and maintaining an exceptional level of service for multiple colocation customers.

We are particularly interested in someone who has the leadership ability to introduce a structured mechanical and electrical cross-training initiative, creating a more well-rounded engineering workforce that can better support the facility's operational requirements.

This individual should be equally comfortable managing critical infrastructure, developing employees, coordinating outside vendors, addressing tenant concerns, and communicating operational performance to regional leadership.

job.title: Quality Inspector
job.description:
Quality Inspector
Pay rate: $20.00-$24.00
Location: South
Requirements: Basic understanding of GD&T & knowledge of IPC-A-610 standards is preferred.

Job Description: Responsible for the incoming quality inspection of electronic, electro mechanical, microprocessor based systems, radio communication equipment, cables, harnesses, and mechanical components used in mining safety products. Ensures that all incoming materials meet quality, safety, and regulatory requirements before being released to production, recognizing the safety critical nature of mining applications.

  • Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspections of PCBAs, cable assemblies, subassemblies, finished products, aluminum housings, casted housings, machined components, plastic parts, and other purchased materials.
  • Verify product compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, quality standards, and customer requirements.
  • Conduct visual inspections of electronic assemblies in accordance with IPC-A-610 workmanship standards.
  • Perform dimensional inspections using precision measuring equipment including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, thread gauges, pin gauges, and other inspection tools.
  • Verify cosmetic appearance, dimensional accuracy, labeling, markings, surface finishes, and overall product workmanship.
  • Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming materials following established quality procedures.
  • Complete inspection reports, First Article Inspection (FAI) documentation, inspection records, and nonconformance reports accurately and on time.
  • Support Material Review Board (MRB) activities by providing inspection results and objective evidence.
  • Verify product traceability and ensure proper identification throughout the inspection process.
  • Ensure compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, company procedures, and applicable industry standards.
  • Assist Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supplier Quality teams in investigating product quality issues and implementing corrective actions.
  • Maintain inspection equipment in good condition and ensure only calibrated equipment is used.
  • Follow ESD, safety, and housekeeping requirements while handling electronic components and assemblies.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring quality issues and recommending process improvements.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent. (pre-requisite)
  • Driver license
  • Experience in QC Inspection of electro-mechanical assemblies or cable fabrication (favorable)
  • Current or past IPC-A-610 certification (favorable)
  • Working knowledge of computers, ability to support data collection and daily operations as needed; any additional requirements as implemented. (Microsoft word, excel, computer file system navigation, and ability to save data in multiple forms)

We are seeking an experienced Senior C# Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance Windows applications that support critical business operations. This role requires strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, Windows application development, and software installation and deployment technologies.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with WiX Toolset, Advanced Installer, MSI packaging, and Release Engineering. This individual will work closely with development, QA, and product teams to deliver reliable software solutions while ensuring smooth installation, upgrades, patching, and deployment processes.

In addition to hands-on development, this role will contribute to technical design decisions, troubleshoot complex application and installation issues, participate in code reviews, and provide guidance to junior developers.

Key Responsibilities
Software Development & Application Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, production, and installation-related issues.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Installer Development & Software Packaging

- Develop and support silent installation and automated deployment processes.
- Design and implement software upgrade, rollback, patching, and migration strategies.
- Troubleshoot Windows Installer issues and ensure reliable software installation and upgrade processes.
Release Engineering & CI/CD
- Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support automated builds, testing, packaging, and software releases.
- Utilize GitHub Actions and PowerShell scripting to automate release and deployment activities.
- Work closely with QA and development teams to validate software builds and ensure release readiness.
- Identify and resolve build, packaging, installation, and deployment issues.
- Support release management processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
Technical Collaboration & Mentorship
- Partner with developers, QA engineers, and product teams to support successful software delivery.

- Participate in architectural discussions and recommend improvements to development and release processes.
- Promote coding standards, best practices, and software quality.
Required Qualifications
Experience
- 5–6+ years of professional software development experience using C# and .NET technologies.

- Hands-on experience with software installer development, packaging, and Release Engineering.
Technical Skills
- Programming & Frameworks: C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core
- Windows Development: Windows Applications, Windows Services
- Installer Technologies: WiX Toolset, Advanced Installer, Windows Installer (MSI)
- Software Packaging: MSI Packages, Bootstrapper Applications, Upgrade Packages, Patches, Hotfix Installers, Silent Installations
- Installation Management: Software Upgrades, Rollbacks, Patching, Migration, Installation Troubleshooting
- Release Engineering: CI/CD Pipelines, Build Automation, Release Management
- Automation & Scripting: GitHub Actions, PowerShell
- Troubleshooting: Windows Installer Internals, Application Debugging, Installation and Deployment Issues

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.

  • Knowledge of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, or distributed applications.

  • Familiarity with frontend technologies such as Angular, React, or Blazor.

  • Experience with containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Understanding of DevOps practices, infrastructure as code, and automated testing.

  • Previous experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring small development teams.

job.title: Accountant Analyst(Aerospace/Defense)
job.description:
Accountant Analyst

Department: Finance / Accounting
 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accountant Analyst to support financial reporting, general accounting, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), payroll accounting, and data management activities within a manufacturing environment.

This position plays an important role in maintaining financial accuracy, supporting operational performance, and providing meaningful financial insights to business leaders.

The Accountant Analyst will assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities, prepare and analyze financial reports, support budgeting and forecasting processes, and investigate financial variances.

The ideal candidate will have 3–5+ years of accounting or financial analysis experience, strong Microsoft Excel skills, experience working with ERP systems, and a solid understanding of balance sheet and profit and loss (P&L) accounting.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes.

  • Prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and supporting financial schedules.

  • Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, investigating and resolving aged, unusual, or unreconciled items.

  • Assist with preparing internal financial statements, management reports, and divisional reporting packages.

  • Analyze actual financial results against budgets, forecasts, prior-year performance, and operational drivers.

  • Identify significant financial variances and prepare explanations for management.

  • Maintain accurate supporting documentation for financial transactions.

  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, and record-retention requirements.

  • Assist with internal and external audits by preparing schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.

  • Support cost accounting, fixed-asset accounting, engineering-related accounting, payroll accounting, and revenue recognition.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to investigate financial discrepancies and resolve issues.

  • Ensure financial transactions are recorded accurately and within the appropriate accounting period.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Support annual operating plans, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic financial planning activities.

  • Prepare financial models, reports, and schedules to support financial projections.

  • Analyze revenue, profit margins, operating expenses, working capital, engineering expenditures, labor costs, and capital expenditures.

  • Monitor financial and operational performance against established budgets and forecasts.

  • Identify financial trends, potential risks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Analyze cost structures, spending patterns, labor expenses, material costs, overhead, and other key business drivers.

  • Assist with developing and maintaining financial dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and recurring management reports.

  • Provide financial analysis to support business decisions, operational performance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with functional leaders to validate financial assumptions and improve forecasting accuracy.

Cost Accounting & Financial Analysis

  • Support manufacturing cost accounting and financial analysis activities.

  • Analyze labor, materials, overhead, and other operational expenses.

  • Review financial results and investigate cost variances.

  • Assist with standard costing, inventory accounting, and fixed-asset accounting activities.

  • Prepare reports evaluating financial performance, profitability, and operational efficiency.

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting and cost management processes.

Data Management & Reporting

  • Maintain the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of financial master data.

  • Extract, validate, reconcile, and analyze data from ERP, financial reporting, payroll, and other business systems.

  • Develop and maintain standardized financial reports, spreadsheets, and analytical tools.

  • Identify data discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions with appropriate departments.

  • Respond to financial data requests and provide timely, accurate reporting support.

  • Assist with process documentation, reporting automation, workflow improvements, and financial system enhancements.

  • Support divisional, Aerospace Group, and corporate financial reporting requirements.

Payroll & Cross-Functional Support

  • Assist with payroll-related accounting, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

  • Support labor cost analysis and payroll data validation.

  • Partner with Human Resources, Finance, Operations, and other functional teams to investigate and resolve discrepancies.

  • Maintain appropriate internal controls and confidentiality when handling financial and employee information.

  • Provide timely financial information and support to internal stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Internal Controls

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

  • Support financial process automation and reporting enhancements.

  • Assist with maintaining effective internal controls and compliance with company accounting policies.

  • Recommend improvements to financial reporting workflows and data management procedures.

  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives across Finance and Operations.

Required Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Professional Experience

  • 3–5+ years of relevant experience in accounting, financial analysis, FP&A, cost accounting, or a comparable finance role.

  • Experience supporting financial close processes, general ledger accounting, and account reconciliations.

  • Strong understanding of balance sheet and profit and loss (P&L) general ledger accounts.

  • Ability to explain how accounting transactions affect financial statements.

  • Experience preparing journal entries, accruals, financial reports, and supporting schedules.

  • Experience analyzing financial results, investigating variances, and preparing management-level reporting.

  • Experience working with ERP systems and financial reporting tools.

Technical Skills

  • Strong Microsoft Excel proficiency, including:

    • Pivot tables

    • VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP or similar lookup functions

    • Formulas and calculations

    • Data analysis

    • Financial reporting and spreadsheet preparation

  • Working knowledge of general accounting principles and financial reporting practices.

  • Ability to extract, analyze, and reconcile financial data.

  • Familiarity with financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet recurring deadlines.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong accountability and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

  • Ability to handle confidential financial and employee information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA, CMA, MBA, or progress toward a relevant professional certification.

  • Experience in manufacturing, industrial, aerospace, or multi-site business environments.

  • Experience with standard costing, inventory accounting, fixed assets, or manufacturing cost analysis.

  • Experience supporting financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.

  • Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, Power Query, or other data analytics and visualization tools.

  • Familiarity with payroll processes, labor reporting, and payroll-related accounting.

  • Experience supporting internal or external audits.

  • Understanding of internal controls and financial compliance requirements.

  • Experience with financial reporting automation or process improvement initiatives.

Key Competencies

Competency

Description

Financial Acumen

Applies accounting principles and financial judgment to support accurate reporting and business decisions.

Analytical Thinking

Evaluates financial data, identifies trends and variances, and develops actionable recommendations.

Attention to Detail

Ensures accuracy in financial reporting, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.

Business Partnership

Collaborates effectively with Finance, Operations, HR, and other departments.

Accountability

Takes ownership of responsibilities, meets deadlines, and communicates potential issues.

Communication

Clearly presents financial information to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

Identifies opportunities to streamline processes and improve reporting efficiency.

Integrity & Confidentiality

Protects sensitive financial and employee information.

job.title: Composites Technician
job.description:
INTRODUCTION
Client R&F Products in Carlsbad designs and manufactures RF Absorbing Materials, Electrically Conductive Elastomers and Maxair vent panels. The primary markets served are Aerospace, Automotive and Defense related industries.

Client R&F Products' manufacturing facility in Carlsbad, California, includes state-of-the-art testing, measurement, and engineering capabilities. From rigorous mechanical testing to advanced materials and particle research to RF modeling, the facility has all the tools in-house to develop precise, high-performance electromagnetic solutions. Further, Laird R&F Products taps the full network of Qnity facilities and experts to develop innovative solutions for customers.

ROLE DEFINITION
The Carlsbad, CA site is looking for a skilled Composites Technician to join our advanced manufacturing team. The successful candidate will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, and repairing composite components. This role requires precision, attention to detail, and the ability to follow strict process controls in support of aerospace, defense, and high-performance product manufacturing.
NOTE: This is an ITAR facility, so US Citizen is required. Someone with an active/inactive secret clearance or can obtain a clearance is desirable.

RESPONSIBILITIES DESCRIPTION
Your key responsibilities will be/what you'll do:
• Perform prepreg layups according to detailed work instructions, engineering drawings, and manufacturing specifications.
• Prepare molds, tooling, and work surfaces for composite layup, ensuring cleanliness and proper release application.
• Accurately measure, mix, and apply resins, hardeners, and other materials following strict process parameters.
• Set up and operate vacuum bagging equipment, ensuring correct pressure, sealing, and leak detection prior to cure.
• Trim, drill, and finish composite parts using hand tools, power tools, and precision measuring instruments.
• Seal, prime and paint composite parts with high quality results.
• Conduct in-process and final inspections to verify conformance to specifications.
• Operate autoclaves and ovens safely.
• Lead a team of technicians to ensure parts are manufactured correctly and efficiently to meet the customer's requirements.
• Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work area, following all safety and environmental guidelines.
• Document work performed, including material traceability, process steps, and quality control data.

Requirements:
• Must be a U.S. citizen.
• High school diploma or equivalent; technical training or certifications in composites manufacturing preferred.
• Minimum of 5 years hands-on experience with prepregs, wet layup and vacuum resin infusion techniques.
• Familiarity with aerospace and/or defense manufacturing standards and quality systems (e.g., AS9100, NADCAP) is highly desirable.
• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and process documentation.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work in a standing position for extended periods.
• Process and continuous improvement experience are highly desirable (Six Sigma Green or Black belt is desirable)
• Experience with composite repair techniques.
• Knowledge of autoclave and oven cure processes.
• Proficiency with precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges).
• Previous experience in a regulated manufacturing environment.
• Must be self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
• Good written and oral communication skills.
• Interpersonal, people development, and training skills.
• Ability to work as a team member in a respectful manner in a diverse work environment.
