job.title: Hose Former
job.description:
GENERAL SUMMARY
Responsible for the efficient manufacture and quality forming of production parts within the assigned department.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Duties required for successful job performance):
  1. Check specifications as to job and perform numbers.
  2. Retrieve proper pre-form and guide onto mandrel using lubricant as necessary.
  3. Position loaded mandrels in curing rack for curing. Move curing rack into autoclave when full.
  4. Remove curing rack from autoclave to proper work area.
  5. Position mandrel bars for unloading. Remove formed hose from mandrel, place into proper container.
  6. Position full baskets with proper job and employee clock numbers.
  7. Identify parts baskets with proper job and employee clock numbers.
  8. Set up curing racks per production and supervisor guidance.
  9. Replenish lubricant in trough as needed.
  10. Perform all operations according to standard practice or as directed by supervisor to produce quality parts.
  11. Fill out required paperwork as necessary.
  12. Record cure charts as required.
  13. Perform other miscellaneous duties required but not listed above.





REQUIRED EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE (These are the traditional minimum, or required, bona-fide occupational qualifications and other requirements of most people in this job).
  1. High School Diploma or GED required. Previous manufacturing experience preferred (particularly in a team environment).
  2. NCRC certified preferred.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those needed to perform the essential functions of the job).
  1. Interpersonal Skills Must be able to read and write at a medium level for the purpose of understanding and applying quality documentation and standard operating procedures, along with completion of job / time reporting.
  2. Problem-solving May be asked to participate in continuous improvement activities and perform basic mathematics.
  3. Physical / Mental / Visual abilities Duties of job require periods of standing, use of hands (pushing and pulling > 50 lbs.) and fingers, bending and reaching, lifting (> 50lbs.) and movement of materials frequently. Must be able to visually interpret work instructions.
REQUIRED DECISION-MAKING AND ORGANIZATION IMPACT (Describe the typical types of decisions made by employees in this job and the likely impact of those decisions on the Company).
  1. The position will decide on a daily basis the acceptable level of quality for finished product to be shipped to the customer.
  2. This determination will be based upon interpretation of the customer specifications and past experience.
  3. Customer rejections of finished product could incur additional costs and may jeopardize the sourcing of business to the company.
REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS (Indicate job titles for this job's supervisor and direct reports).
  1. Directly Reports To: Group Leader / Shift Supervisor
  2. Indirectly Reports To: Business Unit Manager- II

WORKING CONDITIONS (Describe the environment within which the work is performed).
  1. Work time will be spent in general factory floor environments.
  2. Temperature and noise may vary depending on external environmental conditions.
  3. Lack of attention and carelessness may result in personal injury to self or others

job.title: Quality Lab Technician
job.description:
Quality Control (QC) Laboratory Technician

Location: Saratoga Springs, NY
Schedule: Full-Time, Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Control (QC) Laboratory Technician to support our client's quality operations and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. This role is critical in maintaining product quality, data integrity, and laboratory efficiency across all stages of production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead timely investigations and implement corrective actions for quality-related complaints and issues, ensuring excellent internal and external customer service
  • Manage QC laboratory operations, including prioritization, service levels, and resource allocation
  • Perform sampling, inspection, and testing to ensure productivity, technical accuracy, and data integrity
  • Analyze statistical data, test results, and product specifications to maintain quality and reliability standards
  • Ensure full compliance with cGMP, federal/state regulations, internal standards, and ALCOA+ data integrity principles
  • Oversee testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products to confirm specification conformance
  • Review and approve Certificates of Analysis (COAs), ensuring completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance
  • Maintain calibration, qualification, and performance of laboratory equipment
  • Manage raw material qualification processes and supplier quality expectations
  • Collaborate with R&D, Production, and Quality Assurance on method development, sampling plans, and risk-based testing strategies

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in Chemistry or a related field
  • 1–3 years of experience in a GMP-regulated QC laboratory
  • Hands-on experience with UPLC, ion chromatography, Metrohm titration, and spectrophotometry
  • Strong understanding of investigations, CAPA, change control, and data integrity (ALCOA+)
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., Chempax, Oracle, or similar)

Core Competencies

  • Strong customer focus and cross-functional collaboration
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills
  • Proven problem-solving and root cause analysis abilities
  • Critical thinking and operational awareness
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in laboratory work
  • Technical proficiency with laboratory instrumentation and software
  • Ability to work with precision and dexterity in a lab environment
  • Physical stamina to stand and work for extended period

job.description:

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and professional Human Resources Administrative Assistant / HR Coordinator to provide administrative and operational support to the Human Resources department.

This position will assist with recruitment, onboarding, employee records management, HR reporting, HRIS data entry, employee relations support, and general administrative functions.

The ideal candidate will have previous administrative or Human Resources experience, strong communication skills, proficiency in Microsoft Office, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities

Human Resources & Recruitment Support

  • Provide administrative assistance and support for daily Human Resources operations.

  • Coordinate hiring, employee recall, orientation, and onboarding activities.

  • Assist with internal job postings, bid sheets, and employee staffing processes.

  • Schedule candidate interviews, drug screenings, reference checks, and travel arrangements.

  • Support applicant tracking activities and respond to candidate status inquiries.

  • Maintain staffing reports, monthly turnover reports, and other HR-related documentation.

  • Previous experience within the organization preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including:

    • Microsoft Word

    • Microsoft Excel

    • Microsoft Outlook

  • Strong computer and data entry skills.

  • Ability to maintain accurate electronic and physical records.

  • Experience preparing reports, spreadsheets, and administrative documentation.

  • Ability to learn and utilize HRIS and applicant tracking systems.

Professional Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet competing deadlines.

  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.

job.description:
Customer Service & Production Planner

Salary: $72,000 per year
Schedule: Monday–Friday
Location: Irwin, PA
Employment Type: Direct Hire

Job Summary

Nesco Resource is seeking an experienced Customer Service & Production Planner for a manufacturing opportunity. This position is responsible for coordinating customer orders, production schedules, material purchasing, and inventory management to support on-time delivery and customer satisfaction.

The Customer Service & Production Planner serves as a key liaison between customers, sales, production, purchasing, and other internal departments. This role manages the customer order process from initial order entry through production planning and delivery, ensuring customer requirements are met while maintaining efficient material flow and inventory levels.

The ideal candidate has experience in manufacturing, production planning, materials management, or industrial customer service, along with strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Coordinate customer orders and production requirements to establish accurate manufacturing routes and delivery dates.

  • Manage customer order entry, order acknowledgments, contract reviews, and system updates to ensure accurate and timely order processing.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Customer Service teams to provide exceptional service to key accounts and maintain strong customer relationships.

  • Communicate proactively with customers regarding order status, delivery schedules, shipping requirements, and potential delays.

  • Review incoming customer orders to ensure all specifications, requirements, and contractual obligations are accurately documented.

  • Coordinate material purchasing, special tooling, and fixturing requirements to support production schedules.

  • Create and issue purchase orders based on production plans, material requirements, and purchasing requests.

  • Monitor open purchase orders and expedite materials as needed to prevent production delays.

  • Work closely with Production, Planning, Quality, Sales, and other departments to resolve customer inquiries and operational issues.

  • Ensure purchasing activities comply with applicable procurement policies and established supplier agreements.

  • Coordinate and support safety audits and other operational initiatives as needed.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  • Ability to identify and resolve issues related to production schedules, inventory, purchasing, and customer orders.

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
Title: Material Handler
Location: Cleveland, OH 44135
Pay: $18.00 to $20.00
Schedule: 12-hour rotating shifts, Days and Nights are available!

Keep Production Moving!

Are you dependable, hands-on, and comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse and manufacturing environment? Do you enjoy staying active and take pride in keeping things organized and moving in the right direction?

Nesco Resource is hiring Material Handlers for US Cotton in Cleveland!

As a Material Handler, you'll play an important role in keeping production running smoothly. You'll move finished products, deliver raw materials and supplies to production areas, load trucks, help maintain inventory, and make sure materials get where they need to be when they need to be there.

This is a hands-on position that combines forklift operation, warehouse work, inventory tracking, and material movement. If you like staying busy and being an important part of a production team, this could be a great opportunity for you.

What You'll Do:

• Operate a forklift to move materials and finished products throughout the warehouse and production areas.
• Retrieve daily work orders and gather the materials needed for production.
• Review daily checklists and make sure required materials are available.
• Transport raw materials from the warehouse to the appropriate production areas.
• Load materials onto pallets by hand or with a forklift, including materials weighing up to 35 lbs.
• Move finished pallets out of receiving areas using a pallet jack.
• Enter material information into the company's computer/database system.
• Scan finished products and prepare shipments for loading.
• Load finished products onto trucks using a forklift.
• Manually enter product and shipment information into the computer system.
• Inspect trucks for damage and report any issues before loading.
• Check industrial truck wheels and locks as part of routine loading procedures.
• Enter bills of lading into the computer for shipments.
• Wrap finished-product pallets with plastic wrap and prepare them for shipment.
• Use an order picker and ladder when retrieving products from designated storage areas.
• Maintain an organized and clean warehouse and work area.
• Use an air hose, broom, dustpan, and other cleaning equipment to remove debris and production remnants.
• Communicate with maintenance when equipment or wrapping equipment requires attention.
• Assist with forklift battery changes and other warehouse tasks as needed.
• Follow all required safety procedures and wear appropriate PPE.

The ideal candidate will:

• Be comfortable operating or learning to operate a forklift.
• Be able to work safely around moving equipment, forklifts, production areas, and warehouse traffic.
• Have good attention to detail when handling materials and preparing shipments.
• Be comfortable using a computer, keyboard, scanner, and other basic warehouse technology.
• Be able to follow work orders, checklists, and established procedures.
• Be comfortable lifting boxes and materials weighing up to approximately 35 lbs.
• Be comfortable frequently getting on and off a forklift.
• Be able to bend, reach, push, pull, and move materials throughout the workday.
• Be dependable and able to work as part of a team.
• Be willing to maintain a clean and organized work area.
• Have a strong commitment to workplace safety.

job.title: Quality Technician
job.description:
This position will operate CMM and NDT equipment, perform dimensional and visual inspections, inspect welds using microscopes, and use precision measurement tools such as calipers and micrometers. The Quality Technician will work closely with Production and Engineering to ensure parts meet specifications and that quality issues are identified, documented, and addressed promptly.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Set up, calibrate, and operate Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM).
  • Develop and modify CMM programs using 3D CAD models and 2D engineering drawings.
  • Set up, calibrate, and operate Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) equipment as required.
  • Perform first-article, in-process, and final inspections.
  • Use precision measurement equipment, including micrometers, calipers, and other inspection tools.
  • Inspect welds using a microscope and perform visual inspections before and after E-coat.
  • Use weld maps and inspection criteria to verify product quality.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and 3D CAD models.
  • Apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles to ensure parts meet design requirements.
  • Prepare inspection reports and document non-conformances (NCRs).
  • Communicate inspection results and quality concerns to Production and Engineering.
  • Assist with troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions (CAPA).
  • Complete required quality documentation accurately and on time.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor or manager.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Associate degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Engineering degree is a plus.

Experience & Technical Skills

  • 2–5 years of experience in a precision manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Automotive manufacturing experience is a plus.
  • Experience operating and programming CMM equipment.
  • Experience with CMM inspection software preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, blueprints, and 3D CAD models.
  • Strong knowledge of GD&T and ASME Y14.5 standards.
  • Experience using precision inspection and measurement equipment.
  • Comfortable using algebra, geometry, and trigonometry to calculate dimensions and tolerances.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office.

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with Production and Engineering teams.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

Working Conditions

This is a shop-floor position in a manufacturing environment. The successful candidate must be able to:

  • Lift up to 30 lbs.
  • Stand and walk for most of the work shift.
  • Bend, crouch, reach, and move around equipment and parts as required.
  • Work effectively in a team environment.
  • Work in varying seasonal temperatures.
  • Work in an environment with production-floor noise.
  • Follow all safety procedures and PPE requirements.
  • Wear required safety equipment, including safety glasses, steel-toed shoes, sleeves, pants, and gloves.

Why Join Us?

This is an excellent opportunity for a quality professional who enjoys hands-on inspection work and wants to contribute directly to manufacturing quality, process improvement, and customer satisfaction.

job.description:
Welder — Pipe (Stainless and Carbon)
Phoenix, AZ 85041
Shift: M-F 5am-1:30pm | M-F 1:30pm - 10:00pm

The role
This is a production pipe-welding job. You will weld stainless and carbon pipe to shop drawings and a welding procedure. Day and night shifts are open. All new welders train on first shift, then move to the assigned shift.

What you'll do

  • Weld stainless pipe with flux-core to AWS D1.6 and full TIG (GTAW), including 3/8-inch open-root joints

  • Fit, tack, and weld your own joints from shop drawings, isometrics, and a WPS

  • Pipe welding experience on stainless and carbon. Three or more years preferred
  • Able to pass Capitol's weld test before placement:

    • Carbon: 6G open-root pipe
    • Carbon Super Coupon, 2-inch extra-heavy wall
  • Able to read prints, weld symbols, and a WPS

job.title: Datacenter Team Lead
job.description:
Data Center Team Lead / Engineer in Charge (EIC)

Smart Hands & Eyes (SH&E) Operations

Location: Grafton, MA
Employment Type: Full-Time, W2
Annual Salary: $72,000–$75,000, depending on experience
Coverage: Five data center locations across Massachusetts (3), Connecticut (1), and New Jersey (1)

Work Schedule

Day Hours
Wednesday 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Thursday 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM
Friday 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Saturday 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Total 44 hours per week

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Center Team Lead / Engineer in Charge (EIC) to provide hands-on technical leadership and operational oversight for Smart Hands & Eyes (SH&E) services across five data center facilities in the Northeast.

This position combines technical troubleshooting, team leadership, ticket management, and operational coordination to ensure reliable service delivery and adherence to established service-level agreements (SLAs).

Reporting to the Account Manager, the Team Lead/EIC will serve as a primary technical resource for onsite technicians, support escalations, monitor daily operations, and assist with training and performance management. This individual will also provide backup leadership coverage during planned or unplanned absences.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Daily Operations

  • Oversee daily Smart Hands & Eyes operations across five data center locations, providing technical direction and operational support.

  • Mentor junior and less-experienced technicians, strengthening troubleshooting capabilities and technical independence.

  • Assist with technician onboarding, training, performance monitoring, and staffing coordination.

  • Provide backup coverage for fellow Team Leads to maintain consistent operational support.

  • Ensure compliance with established data center policies, codes of conduct, safety procedures, and timekeeping requirements.

  • Identify and address performance or policy concerns, escalating recurring issues to the Account Manager.

  • Maintain clear, professional written and verbal communication, responding promptly to emails and operational escalations.

Ticket Management & Service Delivery

  • Participate in scheduled daily operational calls at 7:00 AM ET to review open tickets, outstanding issues, and past-due service requests.

  • Monitor ServiceNow ticket queues, aging tickets, and potential SLA breaches to ensure timely follow-up and resolution.

  • Coordinate incident response, technical escalations, and troubleshooting assistance across supported locations.

  • Ensure accurate ticket documentation, detailed work notes, and timely status updates.

  • Communicate service delays, unresolved technical issues, and operational concerns to appropriate stakeholders.

Hands-On Data Center Technical Support

  • Install, test, trace, and troubleshoot single-mode and multi-mode fiber optic cabling and Cat 5e/Cat 6 copper network connections.

  • Diagnose network connectivity issues, down links, and patch panel problems using Fluke testers, optical power meters, visual fault locators (VFLs), and other diagnostic equipment.

  • Support the installation and connectivity of network infrastructure, including switches, routers, and SFP/QSFP transceivers.

  • Collaborate with remote engineering teams through PuTTY console sessions, Microsoft Teams, and technical incident bridges.

  • Perform data center walkthroughs, equipment status and amber light checks, inventory verification, audits, and compliance-related activities.

  • Provide hands-on troubleshooting and technical backline support to onsite technicians as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data center operations, Smart Hands & Eyes, or a closely related technical environment.

  • Strong working knowledge of fiber optic and copper cabling, network connectivity, and Layer 1 troubleshooting.

  • Experience utilizing network diagnostic equipment, testing connectivity, and troubleshooting patch panels and physical network infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or comparable ticketing platforms, including incident tracking, ticket management, and SLA monitoring.

  • Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to mentor technicians, manage competing priorities, and coordinate technical support across multiple facilities.

  • Comfortable working independently while maintaining communication with management and technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Data Center Team Lead, Senior Data Center Technician, Engineer in Charge, or similar technical leadership role.

  • Experience supporting enterprise, colocation, or multi-site data center environments.

  • Relevant industry certifications are beneficial but not required.

  • Demonstrated hands-on technical experience and leadership capabilities will be prioritized over certifications.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and move equipment weighing approximately 20–40 pounds.

  • Ability to safely operate an A-frame ladder.

  • Comfortable performing physical tasks in active data center environments, including equipment installation, cabling, and infrastructure troubleshooting.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a technically strong, hands-on data center professional who is ready to take ownership of daily operations while supporting and developing other technicians. This individual should be comfortable balancing technical troubleshooting with team coordination, service ticket oversight, and communication with management and stakeholders.

This opportunity is well suited for an experienced Senior Data Center Technician or Smart Hands Engineer looking to expand into a formal technical leadership role.

job.title: Sales Support Specialist
job.description:
Sales Support Specialist

Location: North Canton, OH
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – 2–3 Days Onsite Per Week
Department: Sales / Sales Operations

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Sales Support Specialist to support revenue generation through accurate product and service order entry, sales documentation, account reconciliation, invoice research, reporting, and task management.

This position will work closely with the Inside Sales and Renewal Sales teams to support customer accounts throughout the sales and renewal cycle, ensuring timely processing of service renewals, accurate documentation, and effective customer communication.

The Sales Support Specialist will be assigned to a specific territory and interact with internal leadership, sales representatives, business partners, and small to mid-sized financial institutions throughout the United States and Canada.

The ideal candidate will have experience in sales support, customer service, order processing, data entry, and CRM systems, along with strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Support & Revenue Operations

  • Support Inside Sales and Renewal Sales teams in achieving and exceeding annual sales quotas.

  • Accurately process product and service orders, renewals, and related documentation.

  • Prioritize weekly and monthly product and service renewal activities to support quarterly revenue and cash flow targets.

  • Assist with account reconciliations, invoice research, reporting, and sales-related administrative tasks.

  • Track and manage multiple sales support activities throughout the selling cycle.

  • Collaborate with sales representatives to prepare and maintain accurate working documents.

  • Ensure timely completion of product and service-related tasks.

Customer Renewals & Account Management

  • Support customer service renewal activities and ensure renewals are processed accurately and on time.

  • Respond promptly to customer emails and inquiries regarding service renewals.

  • Prepare and distribute customer proposals, supporting documentation, and product brochures.

  • Create and maintain detailed customer equipment lists identifying equipment currently under contract.

  • Update customer equipment records based on customer feedback and account changes.

  • Submit customer changes and renewal requests to the Global Business Services team.

  • Monitor renewal requests through completion, ensuring accuracy and timely processing.

  • Maintain accurate customer account information and renewal documentation.

Salesforce & CRM Management

  • Maintain accurate customer records, sales activities, and renewal information within CRM systems.

  • Track customer interactions, outstanding tasks, and follow-up activities.

  • Generate reports to support sales performance, account management, and renewal forecasting.

  • Ensure data accuracy and completeness across sales systems and documentation.

Customer Service & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales teams, business partners, and internal departments to resolve customer inquiries.

  • Build and maintain positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Stay informed about renewal processes, marketing campaigns, product updates, and technology changes.

  • Support customer account management activities and ensure a positive customer experience.

Sales & Marketing Campaign Support

  • Make outbound customer calls to support marketing initiatives and generate leads for sales teams.

  • Follow up with customers regarding renewal opportunities, product offerings, and service-related inquiries.

  • Support additional sales and marketing initiatives as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in sales support, data entry, customer service, or a related field.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced sales support, inside sales, or customer service environment.

  • Experience managing multiple tasks, maintaining accurate records, and meeting deadlines.

  • Strong customer service background with experience communicating professionally with customers.

Technical Skills

    • Microsoft Excel

    • Microsoft Outlook

  • Experience with data entry, reporting, and maintaining accurate customer records.

  • Strong mathematical skills, particularly in accounting or financial calculations.

  • Ability to research invoices, reconcile account information, and maintain detailed documentation.

  • Comfort using business applications, sales systems, and technology platforms.

  • Ability to quickly learn new software applications and internal systems.

Professional Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Professional demeanor when communicating with customers by telephone or video.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and manage a high volume of tasks.

  • Excellent time management and independent follow-through.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to exceptional service.

  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

  • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.

  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and results-oriented approach.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce.com or other Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.

  • Previous experience supporting inside sales, account management, or customer renewals.

  • Background in account reconciliation, invoice research, or financial administration.

Key Competencies

  • Sales Support: Ability to support sales representatives with order processing, documentation, reporting, and renewal activities.

job.title: Maintenance Technician -3rd shift
job.description:
Position is responsible for ensuring equipment integrity and timely repair.
- Effectively support the Preventative Maintenance (PM) program with a goal of continually reducing unscheduled downtime.
- Analyze problems and interpret technical information necessary to make required repairs (troubleshooting of equipment issues).
- Perform mechanical and electrical maintenance and repairs on production machinery and facility support equipment.
- Inspect, operate and test machinery or equipment to diagnose machine malfunction and validate work performed.
- Ensure safety by following all company policies including safety rules, procedures and Lock-out / Tag-out procedures, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP's), personal safety standards, food safety standards as well as OSHA standards.
- Troubleshoot PLC controlled equipment as well as all plant electrical and mechanical systems including motors, instrumentation, distribution, feed control systems and develop sustainable solutions accordingly.
- Complete all assigned work orders within the time allotted. Maintain complete records of work performed using software, work orders and detailed logs and have good communication skills across all groups/departments.
- Assist with equipment change overs and line startups, troubleshooting issues as needed.
- Identify required parts and maintain current inventories, and parts reorder lists.
- Assure that all products are manufactured to the highest standard of quality.
- Participates in Continuous Improvement, also provides suggestions to improve processes and participates on team projects.Physical RequirementsThe physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
- Ability to lift 50-80 lbs. Performs highly repetitive motions, stand for eight plus hours, talk, and hear.
- Ability to Climb ladders, stairways, use a manlift/scissorlift at ceiling heights or above with proper safety equipment and work in non-air conditioned environment.
- While performing job duties, the associate will frequently walk, use hands to feel or handle, and to reach with hands and arms. Frequent exposure to oils and greases or coolants.

job.title: Pricing Analyst(Aerospace/Defense)
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Pricing Analyst I to support pricing strategies, market analysis, and profitability initiatives within a manufacturing environment.

This entry-level position will be responsible for analyzing pricing data, evaluating competitive market conditions, assessing product costs, and providing recommendations to improve business performance and profitability.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Access, and a general understanding of manufacturing processes and cost accounting principles.

This role will collaborate with product management, sales, marketing, and other business functions to support pricing decisions, implement process improvements, and develop reporting tools that drive long-term business success.

Key Responsibilities

Pricing Analysis & Strategy

  • Analyze pricing data and provide recommendations based on customer value, competitive market conditions, and company costs.

  • Evaluate product markets to determine appropriate ceiling and floor pricing.

  • Analyze the relationships between pricing, sales volume, costs, competition, distribution, and market segmentation.

  • Recommend pricing levels that support profitability and business objectives.

  • Support the development and implementation of strategic pricing initiatives.

  • Monitor pricing effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Assist with evaluating and updating product pricing structures.

Product Pricing & Profitability

  • Partner with business divisions to determine appropriate product list prices, standard discounts, and rebates.

  • Assist with restructuring, updating, communicating, and publishing price increases.

  • Analyze product costs, market trends, and competitive positioning to support pricing decisions.

  • Evaluate the impact of pricing changes on sales volume and profitability.

  • Support pricing strategies that align with long-term business goals.

Pricing Processes & Continuous Improvement

  • Design and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance pricing processes and systems.

  • Identify opportunities to eliminate waste, improve efficiency, and streamline workflows.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve pricing systems, reporting tools, and business processes.

  • Develop and implement tools to support product managers and field sales teams.

  • Establish feedback mechanisms to evaluate and improve pricing models.

  • Support consistent implementation of corporate pricing strategies across business divisions.

Exception Pricing & Pricing Controls

  • Analyze exception pricing processes and recommend appropriate guidelines and approval authority levels.

  • Support a structured and disciplined approach to pricing exceptions.

  • Evaluate pricing requests and identify potential risks or profitability concerns.

  • Assist with maintaining pricing consistency and adherence to established guidelines.

Reporting & Business Analysis

  • Prepare pricing reports and analyses to support management decision-making.

  • Monitor pricing performance and effectiveness through ongoing reporting and measurement.

  • Analyze changing economic conditions, competitive markets, and business trends.

  • Provide recommendations to management based on pricing performance and market analysis.

  • Develop reporting improvements that enhance visibility into pricing effectiveness and operational efficiency.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales, marketing, product management, finance, and other business functions.

  • Support pricing-related projects and strategic initiatives.

  • Communicate pricing recommendations and analytical findings to internal stakeholders.

  • Assist with implementing pricing tools, systems, and process improvements.

  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive customer and pricing information.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in one of the following disciplines:

  • Business Administration

  • Finance

  • Economics

  • Engineering

  • Data Analytics

  • Related field

Technical Skills

  • Strong analytical and quantitative abilities.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Access.

  • Strong computer skills and the ability to work with pricing data and reporting tools.

  • Ability to analyze financial information, market trends, and business performance.

  • General understanding of manufacturing processes, practices, and cost accounting principles.

job.title: Industrial Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to support the ongoing operation and reliability of manufacturing equipment, facility systems, and utilities within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. This position will be responsible for performing preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting equipment issues, and supporting equipment installations and facility improvement projects.

The ideal candidate is mechanically strong, comfortable troubleshooting independently, and able to work safely within a highly regulated cGMP manufacturing environment. This role requires someone who can identify the root cause of equipment problems, make effective repairs, and clearly document maintenance activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance on production, facility, and utility equipment.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical and electromechanical equipment to identify the cause of equipment failures and determine appropriate repairs.
  • Maintain manufacturing equipment used in the production of pharmaceutical products, including pumps, agitators, mechanical seals, gaskets, compression equipment, encapsulation machinery, compactors, coating equipment, and related systems.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot facility and utility systems, including HVAC, compressed air, dust collection, refrigeration, boilers, electrical systems, purified water/RO systems, and other supporting utilities.
  • Read and interpret equipment manuals, mechanical drawings, layouts, specifications, and electrical/wiring diagrams.
  • Use precision measuring equipment such as calipers, micrometers, levels, and other diagnostic tools to evaluate equipment and components.
  • Make equipment adjustments, alignments, repairs, and component replacements using appropriate hand and power tools.
  • Fabricate or modify replacement components when necessary using machine shop equipment.
  • Assist with the installation, startup, modification, and maintenance of new equipment and facility systems.
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment conditions, repairs, and follow-up requirements.
  • Provide technical information to assist with identifying and ordering replacement parts and maintaining appropriate spare-parts inventory.
  • Communicate equipment issues, maintenance needs, and ongoing work clearly with team members and other departments.
  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests while maintaining a strong focus on production needs and internal customer service.
  • Follow established SOPs, manufacturer recommendations, maintenance procedures, and cGMP requirements.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all site safety policies and procedures, including proper lockout/tagout practices.
  • Perform confined-space work when required and in accordance with applicable safety procedures.
  • Complete assigned maintenance work safely, accurately, and efficiently with minimal supervision.

Qualifications

  • Previous maintenance experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, food, chemical, or other highly regulated manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting and repair skills.
  • Experience maintaining pumps, seals, gaskets, agitators, production machinery, and other industrial equipment.
  • Working knowledge of facility and utility systems such as HVAC, compressed air, dust collection, boilers, refrigeration, and water purification systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, equipment layouts, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
  • Experience using precision measuring tools and common maintenance equipment.
  • Familiarity with Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures.
  • Confined-space training or experience is preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize maintenance needs, and resolve equipment problems with limited supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to accurately document work performed and communicate equipment conditions and outstanding issues.
  • Commitment to following safety procedures, quality standards, and established maintenance practices.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be a hands-on maintenance professional who enjoys troubleshooting problems and keeping equipment operating reliably. You should be comfortable working independently, but also able to communicate effectively with production, engineering, and other maintenance team members.

Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment is highly valued, particularly for candidates who understand the importance of documentation, safety, preventive maintenance, and cGMP compliance.

job.title: CNC Setup Machinist
job.description:
Nesco Resource has partnered with a growing manufacturer to identify a CNC Setup Machinist


Ronkonkoma location

salary: 25-35 hour flexible depending on expereince

CNC Setup Machinist (or CNC Set-Up Operator) is responsible for preparing, calibrating, and tooling computer numerical control machines—such as mills or lathes—so they can run production jobs safely and accurately. [1, 2, 3]

Key Responsibilities

  • Read Blueprints & Setup Sheets: Interpret engineering drawings, digital work instructions, and tool lists to understand part specs and tolerances. [1]
  • Install Tooling & Fixtures: Load cutting tools, toolholders, vises, chucks, or custom soft jaws into the machine. [1, 2, 3]
  • Set Offsets & Zero Points: Establish tool length offsets, tool diameter compensations, and part zero (work coordinate system like G54) using edge finders, tool setters, or probes. [1, 2]
  • Load & Verify Programs: Transfer G-code part programs into the controller and run dry cycles or single-block checks to prevent tool crashes. [1, 2, 3]
  • First Article Inspection: Machine the first piece, measure it using precision instruments (micrometers, calipers, height gages), and adjust tool wear or geometry offsets to hold tight tolerances. [1, 2]
  • Machine Maintenance: Monitor coolant concentration, lubrication levels, and check for mechanical or air/hydraulic pressure issues. [1, 2]


Step-by-Step CNC Setup Workflow
  • Clean & Inspect: Clear chips and debris from the machine table, bed, or vise surfaces.
  • Pre-check Levels: Verify machine warm-up, way lube, pneumatic pressure, and coolant concentration (typically 5–8%).
  • Load Tooling: Insert required tools into toolholders and place them in the automatic tool changer (ATC) or spindle.
  • Set Tool & Work Offsets: Measure tool lengths/diameters and touch off or probe your part zero (X, Y, and Z axes).
  • Install Workholding: Secure the raw material blank or casting using vices, clamps, or vacuum fixtures.
  • Load & Test G-Code: Upload the program file, run a graphics simulation or a slow dry run above the part, and keep a hand on the feed hold button. [1, 2, 3, 4]

job.title: Environmental Health & Safety Specialist
job.description:
Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist

Position Summary

Nesco Resource is seeking an Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist to support manufacturing operations by promoting a safe workplace, minimizing operational risks, and ensuring compliance with environmental and safety regulations. This individual will partner with site leadership, operations teams, and EHS professionals to strengthen safety practices, investigate incidents, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

The EHS Specialist will provide technical guidance, support the development and implementation of safety programs, and help ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal regulations, as well as company policies and standards. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with employees and leaders across multiple locations and departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with operations leadership and other stakeholders to identify workplace hazards, evaluate risks, and implement effective risk-reduction strategies.
  • Assist managers with incident investigations, root cause analysis, and the development and follow-up of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Analyze workplace incidents, accidents, and operational failures to identify trends, determine contributing factors, and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure incidents and reportable events are documented and submitted to the appropriate regulatory agencies in accordance with applicable requirements.
  • Conduct and coordinate EHS inspections at manufacturing facilities, document findings, and work with responsible parties to resolve identified concerns.
  • Support the use and maintenance of the company's incident management system, including VelocityEHS.
  • Review EHS data and performance trends to help leadership make informed decisions regarding workplace safety and operational practices.
  • Assist with workers' compensation claims, return-to-work planning, and restricted-duty arrangements in collaboration with appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Support site Safety Committees and encourage employee engagement in workplace safety initiatives.
  • Participate in new employee orientation, safety training, qualification tracking, and related onboarding activities.
  • Work with Production, Maintenance, and EHS personnel to ensure environmental reporting is completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies on environmental compliance reporting, permitting, and related requirements.
  • Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS), review new chemicals before they are introduced into the workplace, and coordinate appropriate employee communication and protective measures.
  • Prepare routine EHS reports and maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned.
  • Travel between regional company locations as needed to support business and compliance requirements.

Qualifications and Experience

  • At least three years of experience in an Environmental, Health & Safety role, or an equivalent combination of education, training, experience, and certifications.
  • Experience with environmental compliance reporting and regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis methods, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams, TapRooT, FMEA, or Fault Tree Analysis.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees, management, contractors, and external organizations.
  • Ability to coach and mentor leaders and employees, encourage thorough incident investigations, and promote accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to completing work accurately and on time.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to handle confidential employee and medical-related information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Ability to influence decisions and encourage compliance without relying on direct supervisory authority.
  • Familiarity with OSHA recordkeeping requirements and basic medical terminology is preferred.

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Relevant professional certifications, such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST), or other recognized EHS credentials, are preferred.

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to participate in company-sponsored continuing education as needed.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25–50% between regional company locations, depending on business needs.

Employment Type: Contract Assignment with Potential for Direct-Hire Conversion
Security Clearance: Active Secret Clearance Required
Overtime Classification: Exempt

Position Overview

We are seeking a creative and technically skilled Videographer / Multimedia Producer to join a video production team responsible for developing high-quality instructional videos, technical demonstrations, and multimedia training content.

This position combines professional videography, cinematography, video editing, motion graphics, and multimedia production to create engaging and effective technical training materials.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Illustrator, along with professional camera operation, lighting, audio recording, and post-production techniques.

Candidates must be capable of independently managing video projects from initial planning and filming through editing, quality assurance, and final delivery.

Important: Candidates must possess an active Secret security clearance before starting the assignment. The clearance is required for access to the worksite; the position does not involve handling classified documents.

Key Responsibilities

Video Production & Cinematography

  • Produce, shoot, and edit professional instructional videos, technical demonstrations, and multimedia training content.

  • Capture high-quality video footage in studio and field environments.

  • Film interviews, instructional demonstrations, and supplemental B-roll footage.

    • Camera composition and framing

    • Lighting setup and control

    • Camera movement and stabilization

    • Professional audio recording

  • Operate professional Sony and Blackmagic Design cinema and DSLR cameras.

  • Utilize gimbals, stabilizers, sliders, and other camera movement equipment to capture cinematic footage.

  • Maintain consistent production quality across all video projects.

Video Editing & Post-Production

  • Perform post-production activities, including video sequencing, transitions, audio synchronization, and visual enhancements.

  • Apply color correction and color grading techniques to achieve consistent visual quality.

  • Utilize green screen production and chroma keying techniques when required.

  • Ensure final video content meets established technical, creative, and instructional standards.

job.title: Principal Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Exciting career opportunity to jump on board with a very well-established, yet rapidly growing electronics manufacturer due to a recent acquisition. If you are a senior Manufacturing Engineer who is looking to apply your knowledge and skills to an organization that will recognize and reward your hard work and efforts, you'll want to apply and interview for this role!

Job Purpose

The Principal Manufacturing Engineer is a key technical leader responsible for developing, optimizing, and sustaining manufacturing processes for production in a defense environment. This role focuses on driving operational excellence through advanced failure analysis, continuous process improvement, and rigorous adherence to military-grade quality standards. The Principal Manufacturing Engineer will ensure efficient process transitions, maintain product integrity, reduce production costs, and uphold strict compliance with defense manufacturing protocols.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary manufacturing representative on cross-functional engineering teams to lead and coordinate the smooth transition of new products from design to production.
  • Design, organize, and continuously improve product assembly areas to meet evolving product specifications, Department of Defense (DoD) requirements, and production throughput goals.
  • Lead initiatives to streamline and optimize manufacturing workflows, enhancing product quality, reducing cycle time, minimizing scrap, and maximizing output.
  • Define requirements for specialized production equipment, tooling, fixtures, and test setups specific to high-reliability, mission-critical manufacturing.
  • Drive compliance with defense quality standards (e.g., MIL-STD, AS9100, IPC) across all manufacturing processes and work instructions.
  • Develop and deliver technical training to production teams to ensure full compliance with documented procedures, quality standards, and engineering requirements.
  • Manage manufacturing engineering and act as a subject matter expert for product-specific manufacturing processes, materials, and technologies.
  • Support audits, customer inspections, and quality assurance activities as needed to maintain defense manufacturing certifications.
  • Determine the requirements for equipment, tools, fixtures and fulfill real-time production needs for our manufacture operations.
  • Monitor rework and repair operations, consistently monitor and report yield issues, and regularly highlight significant findings.
  • Conduct failure analysis, identify root causes, and pursue effective solutions to minimize in-process defects.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, with 3+ years specifically in electronic products production, defense manufacturing, or other mission-critical industries strongly preferred.
  • In-depth experience with root cause analysis methodologies (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram, FMEA) and corrective action implementation (CAPA).
  • Hands-on experience with designing and optimizing manufacturing processes, production lines, tooling, and fixtures.
  • Familiarity with defense manufacturing standards and compliance requirements (e.g., MIL-STD, AS9100, ITAR).

job.title: Rotoweld 3.0 Operator
job.description:
Rotoweld 3.0 Operator
Phoenix, AZ 85041

About the Role

This is a hands-on production role focused on operating the Rotoweld 3.0 automated pipe spool welding workstation. You will set up, load, and run the machine to produce high-quality, full-penetration 1G girth welds on industrial pipe spools and related components (typically 3" to 48" diameter range). The system uses advanced robotic torch positioning, vision/adaptive control (including PerfectPass-iQ technology), and processes such as GMAW (MIG) for root passes, with options for fill passes using GMAW, FCAW, or other qualified processes. The role emphasizes efficient throughput, consistent quality, and safe operation of this high-productivity automated cell.

What You'll Do

Rotoweld 3.0 Operation

  • Set up and operate the Rotoweld 3.0 workstation according to work orders, drawings, and welding procedures (WPS).
  • Load, position, align, and secure pipe spools and components into the rotator/support system for accurate welding.
  • Select and run appropriate programs; monitor and adjust parameters (including via the system's adaptive controls and vision systems) for root, fill, and cap passes as required.
  • Ensure proper joint preparation, fit-up, and alignment before initiating automated welding cycles.
  • Monitor the welding process in real time, verify weld quality (penetration, consistency, appearance), and make necessary adjustments or reworks.
  • Perform root-pass (typically GMAW short-circuit) and fill/cap operations efficiently to maximize arc-on time and daily diameter-inch output.
  • Unload completed spools, inspect welds against acceptance criteria, and document production as required.
  • Perform routine pre-use checks, basic maintenance, and housekeeping on the Rotoweld cell; report issues promptly.

Supporting Duties

  • Assist with material handling, positioning (using appropriate lifting equipment as qualified), and joint preparation.
  • Read and interpret fabrication drawings, weld symbols, dimensions, and work instructions.
  • Collaborate with fitters, supervisors, and other welders to maintain production flow and quality.
  • Follow all safety protocols, including PPE, lockout/tagout, and machine-specific procedures.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned in support of pipe fabrication and shop operations.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of production welding and/or automated/robotic welding machine operation experience in a fabrication environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate automated or robotic welding equipment (Rotoweld or similar pipe/spool welding systems strongly preferred).
  • Basic understanding of pipe welding processes (especially GMAW/MIG) and weld quality requirements.
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, weld symbols, and work instructions.
  • Reliable attendance, strong work ethic, attention to detail, and commitment to safety and quality.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Rotoweld 3.0 or similar automated pipe welding cells.
  • Experience with industrial pipe spool fabrication, 1G girth welds, or pressure-related work.
  • Familiarity with GMAW root passes and fill processes (including FCAW or related).
  • Exposure to carbon steel and stainless steel pipe.
  • Ability to operate overhead cranes, forklifts, or material handling equipment.
  • OSHA 10 or similar safety training.
  • Experience in a custom industrial fabrication environment.

job.title: Network Security Engineer
job.description:
US CITIZENS ONLY
Hybrid 3 Days a week onsite.

Position Overview

We are seeking two experienced Network Security Engineers to support Information Security team. This is a hands-on engineering and administration role focused on maintaining, securing, and improving enterprise network security systems.

The engineers will be responsible for day-to-day network security operations, troubleshooting, firewall administration, network access controls, and supporting security infrastructure projects.

This position requires someone who is comfortable working directly with security technologies, resolving technical issues, implementing approved changes, and maintaining production environments.

The selected candidates will work under the direction of Information Security team and follow established change management processes.

Key Responsibilities

Network Security Operations & Administration

  • Administer and maintain next-generation firewall (NGFW) and Unified Threat Management (UTM) platforms.

  • Manage firewall policies, security rules, rule lifecycle management, and cleanup activities.

  • Perform software updates, security signature updates, and certificate renewals.

  • Configure and maintain URL filtering and Layer 7 application inspection policies.

  • Manage URL category tuning, application controls, and security policy exceptions.

  • Monitor and tune Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), including signature management and false-positive reduction.

  • Investigate and escalate confirmed security detections to the Security Operations team.

  • Support and troubleshoot 802.1X wired and wireless Network Access Control (NAC) environments.

  • Resolve authentication, supplicant, certificate, and network access policy issues.

  • Assist with onboarding new devices and device types into NAC environments.

  • Administer and troubleshoot enterprise remote access VPN solutions.

  • Manage VPN client connectivity, access policies, split-tunneling configurations, and availability monitoring.

  • Respond to service tickets within established SLAs and provide clear updates to requesters.

  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and operational runbooks.

Network Security Projects & Implementation

In addition to daily operational responsibilities, the engineers will support defined network security projects, including:

802.1X Network Access Control Expansion

  • Expand 802.1X capabilities across additional sites and device types.

  • Support solution design, testing, pilot deployments, and phased implementations.

  • Troubleshoot deployment issues and provide documentation for operational handoff.

Network Segmentation & SSL Decryption

  • Support network segmentation initiatives to improve security and access controls.

  • Assist with designing and implementing segmentation policies.

  • Configure and enforce SSL/TLS decryption policies.

  • Validate security configurations and ensure compliance with approved security requirements.

All project work will follow documented scopes, acceptance criteria, established timelines, and approved change management procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in network security engineering supporting enterprise production environments.

  • 5+ years of experience in IT systems or application engineering and administration.

  • Strong understanding of all seven layers of the OSI model.

  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise next-generation firewalls (NGFW) and UTM platforms.

  • Strong experience with Layer 7 security technologies, including:

    • Application control

    • TLS/SSL inspection and decryption

    • Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS)

    • URL filtering

    • DNS filtering

  • Experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting 802.1X wired and wireless Network Access Control (NAC).

  • Experience supporting enterprise remote access VPN solutions.

  • Knowledge of firewall security policies, rule management, network segmentation, and access controls.

  • Experience troubleshooting authentication, certificates, and network connectivity issues.

  • Proven experience working within formal IT change management processes.

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Information Security, IT, Product, and Operations teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant industry certifications, such as:

    • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)

    • CompTIA Security+

    • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

  • Experience with infrastructure automation, scripting, or Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including:

    • Python

    • Ansible

    • Terraform

  • Experience supporting network security infrastructure in regulated or safety-critical environments.

  • Experience automating security configurations, reporting, and routine administrative tasks.

Security Governance & Change Management

  • Follow security policies, standards, and procedures established by Information Security.

  • Provide technical recommendations and implementation support while ensuring architecture decisions receive appropriate approval.

  • Perform production changes only during approved change management windows.

  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation for all implemented changes.

  • Ensure all configurations, scripts, and technical deliverables are properly documented and transferred.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Meeting established service ticket SLAs and maintaining requester satisfaction.

  • Successfully implementing production changes without introducing avoidable incidents.

  • Delivering assigned project milestones within agreed timelines.

  • Maintaining accurate and complete technical documentation.

  • Supporting reliable, secure, and stable enterprise network operations.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Network Security Engineer who has spent several years directly managing firewalls, network access controls, VPN environments, and enterprise security infrastructure.

We are looking for someone who can troubleshoot real-world production issues, make approved configuration changes, support security deployments, and work effectively with internal technical teams.

job.title: Cost/Price Analyst(Aerospace/Defense)
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cost/Pricing Analyst to support complex cost accounting, pricing analysis, proposal development, and contract negotiation activities within a manufacturing environment.

This position is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting historical and estimated cost data to develop competitive and economically feasible bids and proposals. The Senior Cost/Pricing Analyst will evaluate manufacturing costs, assess profitability, perform risk analyses, and provide pricing recommendations to management.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in manufacturing cost analysis, government contract pricing, TINA proposals, Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR).

This role will also support government audits, continuous improvement initiatives, and cross-functional projects while serving as a subject matter expert in cost and pricing activities.

Key Responsibilities

Cost Accounting & Financial Analysis

  • Apply cost accounting principles to collect, evaluate, and analyze complex historical and estimated cost data.

  • Analyze production cost performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability.

  • Determine the costs of complex products and services using historical and estimated operational data.

  • Analyze actual manufacturing costs and prepare periodic reports comparing standard costs to actual production costs.

  • Evaluate cost trends, financial performance, and operational data to identify potential risks and opportunities.

  • Analyze proposed changes in manufacturing methods, materials, and processes.

  • Conduct make-or-buy analyses for major components.

  • Prepare financial analyses and management reports identifying factors affecting product pricing and profitability.

Pricing Strategy & Proposal Development

  • Develop competitive and economically feasible bids, estimates, and cost proposals.

  • Prepare detailed cost breakdowns, pricing justifications, and supporting documentation.

  • Utilize historical data, program knowledge, and complex databases to support pricing decisions.

  • Identify key cost drivers and factors influencing pricing strategies.

  • Analyze cost data to determine projected profits, potential losses, and financial risks.

  • Perform risk assessments and recommend pricing strategies to management.

  • Support pricing activities for new and continuing business opportunities.

  • Prepare and support Truth in Negotiations Act (TINA) proposals, as required.

Contract Negotiations & Government Compliance

  • Support contract negotiations by providing detailed cost and pricing analyses.

  • Represent the organization in pricing discussions and negotiations to protect profitability objectives.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and other pricing laws, regulations, and guidelines.

  • Apply knowledge of Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) and Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR).

  • Support government audits involving pricing policies, procedures, and supporting financial documentation.

  • Work with government agencies and auditors, including:

    • Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA)

    • Defense Contract Audit Agency (DCAA)

    • Military and other government representatives

  • Respond to inquiries from customers, regulatory agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Manufacturing Cost Analysis

  • Evaluate manufacturing, engineering, fabrication, and assembly processes to determine cost implications.

  • Analyze material, labor, and production costs associated with products and services.

  • Review standard versus actual production costs and investigate variances.

  • Evaluate manufacturing processes and proposed operational changes to identify cost-saving opportunities.

  • Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, operations, and finance teams to develop accurate cost estimates.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare specialized reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing complex financial and operational information.

  • Provide management with cost trends, forecasts, profitability analyses, and pricing recommendations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve estimating, pricing, and cost accounting processes.

  • Lead or support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.

  • Recommend process improvements based on financial analysis and business performance.

  • Participate in cross-functional and interdivisional projects.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a primary contact for high-level cost and pricing projects.

  • Establish project goals, objectives, and deliverables.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business and pricing initiatives.

  • Provide technical guidance and specialized knowledge to team members.

  • Train and mentor less experienced employees, as needed.

  • Represent the pricing team in interdivisional projects, analyses, and government audits.

  • Communicate complex financial information and recommendations to senior management.

  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive financial and business information.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 6 years of related experience in cost accounting, pricing analysis, estimating, or a comparable financial discipline.

  • Experience developing and evaluating cost estimates and pricing proposals for new and existing business opportunities.

  • Experience supporting government contract proposals, including TINA proposals and government audits.

Cost Accounting & Government Contracting

  • Advanced knowledge of accounting principles, laws, and regulations.

  • Strong understanding of Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) and/or Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR).

  • Experience analyzing manufacturing costs, standard costs, actual costs, and profitability.

  • Ability to develop complex cost estimates and pricing proposals.

  • Experience evaluating cost structures, financial risks, and pricing strategies.

  • Familiarity with government audit requirements, including DCMA and DCAA.

Manufacturing & Technical Knowledge

  • Advanced understanding of manufacturing, engineering, fabrication, and assembly processes.

  • Ability to evaluate manufacturing cost drivers and operational efficiencies.

  • Experience analyzing material, labor, and production costs.

  • Ability to interpret complex financial reports, cost estimates, and pricing documentation.

Systems & Software

  • Proficiency with automated estimating, pricing, and accounting systems.

  • Advanced spreadsheet and database application skills.

  • Proficiency with standard business software applications.

  • Ability to analyze and organize large volumes of complex financial and operational data.

Analytical & Communication Skills

  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Ability to interpret complex estimates, pricing proposals, and financial reports.

  • Ability to identify problems, collect relevant data, evaluate findings, and recommend solutions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to prepare professional reports and business correspondence.

  • Strong presentation skills and the ability to communicate effectively with team members, management, and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and high-impact projects.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, or government-contract manufacturing environments.

  • Direct experience preparing TINA-compliant cost proposals.

  • Experience supporting DCMA, DCAA, or military audits.

  • Extensive knowledge of CAS and FAR regulations.

  • Experience with complex manufacturing cost estimating and pricing systems.

  • Previous experience leading pricing initiatives or mentoring junior analysts.

  • Experience supporting government contract negotiations and profitability assessments.

job.title: Subarc Operator/Welder
job.description:
Subarc Operator/Welder
Phoenix, AZ 85041

About the Role

This is a hands-on production role focused on operating submerged arc (SAW / Subarc) welding equipment for heavy plate, tanks, structural components, large-diameter fabrications, and other industrial products. You will set up and run Subarc processes for high-deposition, high-quality welds on thick materials, while also performing Dual Shield (gas-shielded flux-cored) welding and supporting material preparation with saws as needed. The work is primarily flat and horizontal position on heavy sections typical of custom industrial fabrication.

What You'll Do

Subarc (SAW) Operation & Welding

  • Set up, operate, and monitor submerged arc welding equipment (including tractors, carriages, turning rolls, and multi-head systems as applicable) to produce high-quality welds on heavy plate, tanks, cylinders, structural members, and large fabrications.
  • Select and set proper parameters (amperage, voltage, travel speed, wire feed, flux type and depth) according to WPS and job requirements.
  • Thread electrode wire, fill and direct flux hoppers, and maintain proper flux coverage and recovery.
  • Perform long seam, circumferential, and other production welds meeting penetration, size, and quality standards.
  • Visually inspect welds, remove slag/flux as needed, and rework or repair defects using hand processes when required.
  • Maintain consistent production quality with minimal supervision.

Dual Shield (FCAW-G) Welding

  • Perform Dual Shield / gas-shielded flux-cored arc welding (FCAW-G) in required positions on carbon steel, stainless, and other materials as assigned.
  • Select correct wire, gas, and parameters per WPS for Dual Shield applications.

Saw Operation & Material Preparation

  • Operate bandsaws, cold saws, and similar production saws to accurately cut plate, pipe, structural shapes, and other materials to length and specification.
  • Set up saws, select appropriate blades, and perform pre-use checks for clean, accurate, and safe cuts.
  • Assist with material handling, positioning (including use of cranes, forklifts, or turning equipment as qualified), and joint preparation.

Quality, Safety & Team Support

  • Read and interpret fabrication drawings, weld symbols, dimensions, tolerances, and work orders.
  • Self-inspect completed welds and assemblies against drawings and acceptance criteria.
  • Operate equipment safely, perform pre-use checks, and report issues promptly.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area and follow all PPE, lockout/tagout, fume extraction (where applicable), and shop safety protocols.
  • Provide informal guidance to less-experienced personnel as needed.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 3 years of production welding and/or heavy fabrication experience, including hands-on Subarc (SAW) operation.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with Dual Shield (gas-shielded flux-cored / FCAW-G) welding.
  • Experience operating bandsaws, cold saws, or similar production saws in a fabrication environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret fabrication drawings, weld symbols, and WPS documents.
  • Strong work ethic, reliable attendance, and commitment to quality and safety.

Extensive computer use.
