job.title: Manufacturing Technical Trainee
job.description:
Work for a well-regarded pharmaceutical company in Fall River, MA as Manufacturing Technical Trainee. This is a full time, permanent position with benefits starting on day 1!
What you need to know:

  • Starting Pay:  $28/hour plus shift differential
  • 100% Onsite role
  • 12-hour shifts, either 7:00 AM–7:00 PM or 7:00 PM–7:00 AM, following a rotating 3-4-4-3 schedule (3 days on, 4 days off, followed by 4 days on, 3 days off)
The Manufacturing Technical Trainee supports the production of respiratory pharmaceutical products in a highly regulated manufacturing environment. This role requires hands-on experience operating, setting up, adjusting, and troubleshooting automated manufacturing equipment while maintaining compliance with cGMP, quality, safety, and production requirements.
Key Responsibilities
  • Execute manufacturing and packaging processes in accordance with Batch Manufacturing Records (BMRs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), cGMP regulations, safety requirements, and established work instructions.
  • Operate, set up, adjust, monitor, and troubleshoot Respiratory Metered Dose Inhaler (MDI) manufacturing and packaging equipment, including filling, crimping, propellant charging, leak testing, inspection, and packaging systems.
  • Perform equipment startup, changeovers, line clearances, disassembly, reassembly, cleaning, and routine adjustments to maintain production readiness.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, pneumatic, electromechanical, equipment, and process-related issues, including jams, blockages, alarms, and material flow interruptions, using approved procedures and equipment manuals.
  • Perform minor equipment repairs within established procedures and operating parameters; investigate recurring issues and escalate complex electrical, automation, engineering, validation, or maintenance concerns.
  • Prepare manufacturing rooms and equipment by verifying calibration status, pressure differentials, environmental conditions, and equipment readiness.
  • Receive, transfer, verify, and reconcile manufacturing materials according to approved procedures and batch documentation.
  • Complete production and equipment documentation accurately, legibly, and contemporaneously in compliance with cGMP requirements.
  • Monitor equipment performance, support root cause investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives, and communicate opportunities for operational improvements.
Qualifications and Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, Manufacturing Technology, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
Physical and Environmental Requirements
  • Ability to work in classified and controlled pharmaceutical manufacturing environments, including areas using hydrofluoroalkane (HFA) propellants, compressed gases, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients, cleaning agents, and other respiratory product components, while following established safety procedures and training requirements.
  • Ability to wear required PPE, including safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, protective footwear, cleanroom gowning, and respirators when required, for extended periods.
  • Must be medically qualified to wear respiratory protection when applicable and able to work safely with manufacturing materials using required engineering controls and PPE.
  • Ability to stand and walk continuously for up to 12 hours per shift.
  • Ability to frequently bend, stoop, crouch, kneel, reach, climb stairs, and work around manufacturing equipment.
  • Ability to operate equipment controls, perform machine adjustments, assemble and disassemble equipment components, install change parts, and complete routine maintenance and documentation tasks.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 50 pounds unassisted and handle heavier loads using approved material-handling equipment.
  • Ability to move pallets, drums, components, and equipment using pallet jacks, drum-handling devices, carts, and other approved equipment.
  • Ability to safely ascend and descend ladders and work platforms during equipment setup, inspections, cleaning, and changeovers.
  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks requiring manual dexterity and work in varying temperatures, noise levels, and humidity conditions consistent with pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer to lead complex and innovative research, development, and engineering initiatives within an aerospace environment. This role will focus on developing and improving products, technologies, processes, analytical methods, and engineering solutions with significant product, customer, and business impact.

The Principal Engineer will serve as a technical subject matter expert, providing advanced engineering guidance across multidisciplinary teams while leading major projects and technology initiatives from concept through implementation.

Preferred:

Our client is a $500M+ revenue company with a diverse business across retail, e-commerce, wholesale, and licensing. They are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join their finance team and play a key role in forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and financial analysis.

job.title: Mil Spec Painter
job.description:
Mil- Spec - Industrial Painter 1st shift

Schedule: Monday–Thursday, 6:00 AM–4:30 PM Overtime: Optional Fridays available, with occasional mandatory Fridays work permitting

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mil-Spec-Industrial Painter in Pinellas County to join our team in an industrial manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have hands-on spray gun painting experience, a strong understanding of paint mixing and application techniques, and the ability to work efficiently while maintaining high-quality standards.

Candidates with experience in aerospace, military specifications, are strongly preferred. This position is ideal for someone who takes pride in their craftsmanship, works with a sense of urgency, and is looking for long-term career growth and advancement opportunities. This candidate would apply specialized protective and decorative coatings to aerospace, defense, and industrial metal components in strict compliance with U.S. Department of Defense and engineering standard processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate HVLP spray guns to apply paints and coatings according to required specifications.
  • Mix paints and coatings accurately using proper ratios and established procedures.
  • Prepare surfaces and equipment for painting to ensure proper adhesion and finish quality.
  • Follow technical specifications, safety procedures, and quality control standards.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Meet production deadlines while maintaining attention to detail and consistent workmanship.
  • Work efficiently in a fast-paced industrial or manufacturing settin
  • 3+ years of hands-on spray gun painting experience.
  • Mix and apply military-grade coatings—including epoxies, polyurethanes, enamels, and solid film lubricants—using spray equipment
  • Read and follow technical blueprints, engineering drawings, and MIL-SPEC technical data sheets
  • Experience mixing paints and accurately following paint ratios.
  • Previous experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • A strong sense of urgency and the ability to keep production moving efficiently.
  • Inspect finished parts for proper adhesion, dry film thickness, finish consistency, and stencil/lettering accuracy
  • Reliable attendance and flexibility to work occasional Fridays work permitted.
  • Ability to follow instructions, technical specifications, and workplace safety requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with aerospace painting or coatings.
  • Familiarity with military specifications (MIL-SPEC) and quality standards.
  • Experience working with specialized paint systems, coatings, and paint ratios.
  • Previous experience painting military, aerospace, or other precision-manufactured components.
  • Standard schedule: Monday through Thursday, 6:00 AM–4:30 PM.
  • Overtime: Opportunity to work Fridays for additional hours and overtime pay.
  • Flexibility: Occasional Fridays will be mandatory based on production needs.
  • Why Join Our Team?
  • Competitive pay based on experience.
  • A consistent four-day workweek.
  • Opportunities to earn additional income through overtime.
  • A chance to apply specialized painting skills in a manufacturing environment.
  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement.

If you have strong spray gun painting experience, understand paint mixing and ratios, and take pride in producing quality work without sacrificing efficiency, we want to hear from you!

Description:
•Hours: Mon-Fri, 7:00am-3:30pm with 30 min unpaid lunch
• Must be a US citizen.

• Steel toe shoes required.

Position Summary:

Storeroom Attendant is an individual contributor positioned within a customer's location to fulfil daily receiving, stocking, issuing, and cycle counting of customer and/or inventory. They are responsible for maintaining a professional, clean and organized work environment.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:
•Unloads, receives and puts away incoming product, goods, tools and/or equipment; unpacks bales, crates, and other containers; checks for damage and for discrepancies between goods and invoices.
•Accurately sorts, labels, moves and stores items; places material or items on racks, shelves, or in bins according to predetermined sequence such as size, style, or product codes; arranges storage to optimize crib space.
•Issues product, goods, tools and/or equipment to site employees; documents and maintains accurate records for issued and returned items.
•Enters data into a database or other computerized system to maintain up-to-date stock records; retrieves stored information to respond to inquiries (e.g., inventory levels or delivery schedules.); documents discrepancies on an error log and seeks management advice on appropriate corrective action.
•Requests requisitions to replenish inventory.
•Assists with inventory level maintenance; performs cycle counts and prepares report results.
•Inspects and measures tools/equipment for defects, wear and tear and reports damage or wear to supervisors.
•Prepares periodic inventory or maintains perpetual inventory of supplies and equipment.
•Delivers tools or equipment to associate work locations.
•Investigates and locates lost or misplaced equipment or safety supplies.
•May repair, service and lubricate tools and equipment as required.
•Performs other related duties as requested.

Job Qualifications:
3+ months relevant experience and/or training. High school diploma or equivalent preferred (not required).
Relevant experience and/or aptitude should include:
•Loading, unloading, picking, packing or moving goods in a warehouse environment; forklift / cherry picker experience preferred.
•Demonstrated ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, work orders, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
•Basic computer knowledge and proficiency and/or a demonstrated technical aptitude to learn; preferred technical skills to include but not limited to MS-Office products, Vista, Control, SX.e, Prophet 21.
•Demonstration of basic mathematical skills (add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units to measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals); ability to compute rate*** ratio, and percent preferred.
•Strong communication and customer service skills.
•Ability to work in a team environment and be self-motivated to accomplish assigned tasks and goals.
•Demonstration of attention to detail and is safety minded.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:
•May be required to wear various forms of protective equipment (shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.)
•May be required to pass forklift and/or other warehouse equipment certifications (written and/or driving).
•Assigned work shifts may vary and/or rotate.
•Overtime may be required; extended day, evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand and may include little to no advanced notice.
•Must be able to handle and work physical inventory; required to lift up to 25 lbs or greater with assistance following standard operating and safety procedures. Other physical requirements including, regularly being required to stand, walk, kneel, bend, crouch, crawl, climb and balance.
•Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus are required.

We are seeking a hands-on, people-focused Production Supervisor to lead approximately 20 assemblers and testers across two production cells within a specialized aerospace and industrial manufacturing environment. This leader will drive production throughput, employee development, safety, quality, and continuous improvement while fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and empowerment.

job.title: Active Directory Security Engineer
job.description:
Active Directory Administrator – Security Focus
Contract Duration: 6–9 Months
Location: New York City, NY
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite – Monday through Friday
Office Locations: Lexington Avenue, Park Avenue, or 3rd Avenue, Manhattan, NY

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Active Directory Administrator with a strong background in security to manage, maintain, and protect enterprise Active Directory and hybrid identity environments.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), forest and domain architecture, security hardening, privileged access management, and Microsoft Entra ID.

This position requires someone who can identify and remediate security vulnerabilities, strengthen authentication controls, manage complex Active Directory environments, and support identity infrastructure across on-premises and cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities
  • Active Directory Administration & InfrastructureAdminister and maintain Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) across multiple forests, domains, and sites.
  • Design, configure, and maintain forest and domain architecture, domain controllers, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), and AD replication.
  • Manage AD-integrated DNS, Sites and Services, domain trusts, and multi-forest environments.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, replication, and directory services issues.
  • Maintain the availability, performance, and reliability of enterprise Active Directory infrastructure.
Active Directory Security & Privileged Access
  • Conduct Active Directory security assessments and implement security hardening measures.
  • Implement and maintain Tier 0 security and privileged access models.
  • Identify, investigate, and remediate attack paths, excessive permissions, and privilege escalation risks.
  • Configure and secure Kerberos and NTLM authentication, LDAP signing, and channel binding.
  • Deploy and manage Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) and Group Managed Service Accounts (gMSA).
  • Review and manage delegation, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and administrative permissions to enforce least-privilege access.
  • Strengthen authentication controls and reduce identity-related security vulnerabilities.
Identity Security, PKI & Disaster Recovery
  • Administer Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
  • Develop, maintain, and execute Active Directory forest recovery and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Support identity-related security incidents, investigations, and remediation activities.
  • Partner with security and infrastructure teams to improve identity protection and meet security requirements.
Microsoft Entra ID & Hybrid Identity
  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Entra Connect.
  • Manage hybrid identity synchronization between on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Configure and maintain Conditional Access policies, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
  • Troubleshoot identity synchronization, authentication, and access-related issues.
Automation, Documentation & Collaboration
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate Active Directory administration, security checks, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations teams on identity-related projects, incidents, and audits.
  • Maintain technical documentation, security standards, operational procedures, and architecture diagrams.
Required Qualifications
Active Directory & Infrastructure
  • Strong enterprise-level experience administering Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS).
  • Hands-on experience with forest and domain architecture, domain controllers, and Group Policy (GPO).
  • Experience managing AD replication, DNS, Sites and Services, domain trusts, and multi-forest environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across enterprise Active Directory environments.
Active Directory Security
  • Hands-on experience performing Active Directory security assessments and hardening.
  • Knowledge of Tier 0 security architecture and privileged access management.
  • Experience securing Kerberos, NTLM, LDAP signing, and LDAP channel binding.
  • Experience implementing and managing LAPS and gMSA.
  • Strong understanding of delegation, ACLs, least-privilege access, and authentication hardening.
  • Ability to identify and remediate attack paths, excessive permissions, and privilege escalation vulnerabilities.
Identity Management & Disaster Recovery
  • Experience administering Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) and PKI.
  • Knowledge of Active Directory forest recovery and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Entra Connect, and hybrid identity synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience with Conditional Access, MFA, and PIM.

Scripting & Automation

  • Strong PowerShell scripting skills for Active Directory administration, automation, troubleshooting, and reporting.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work at a computer for extended periods, typically 6–8 hours per day.
  • Ability to perform repetitive keyboard, mouse, and monitor tasks.
  • Ability to lift and carry equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to occasionally access server rooms or data centers, including standing, bending, or climbing stairs.
  • Ability to read information displayed on computer screens, equipment labels, and hardware components.

We are seeking an experienced Project Engineer to join the Parker Aerospace team in Kalamazoo, MI. This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role responsible for leading complex product development and engineering projects involving electromagnetic design of AC/DC motors, gear design, gear manufacturing, and design-for-manufacturing/assembly.

The Project Engineer will serve as the technical leader for assigned projects, overseeing design planning, verification, development, testing, manufacturing integration, and project execution. This individual will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Designers, Vendors, Customers, Parker divisions, and other technical resources to deliver innovative products that meet technical, cost, quality, and schedule objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex engineering and product-development projects from planning through completion.
  • Develop project goals, objectives, technical requirements, schedules, milestones, and resource plans.
  • Provide technical leadership for the design, verification, development, and improvement of aerospace products and processes.
  • Apply advanced engineering principles to gear design, manufacturing, product development, and design optimization.
  • Work closely with Product Engineering and Manufacturing to ensure designs are optimized for DFM/DFA, manufacturability, assembly, cost, and performance.
  • Develop and review system schematics, layouts, sketches, algorithms, transfer functions, engineering drawings, and test plans.
  • Determine product specifications based on customer requirements, performance requirements, technical studies, and engineering analysis.
  • Coordinate project activities, monitor schedules, resolve technical issues, and develop alternative solutions when necessary.
  • Prepare project status reports, milestones, technical presentations, and recommendations for management and customers.
  • Design and execute product verification plans using analysis, similarity, testing, and other appropriate engineering methods.
  • Review and approve technical work completed by other engineers, designers, and technical personnel.
  • Coordinate detailed drawings and schematics with Designers, Drafters, and other Engineering personnel.
  • Develop tooling and fixtures for new products and manufacturing processes.
  • Work directly with tooling vendors to develop and deliver required designs.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across Design and Process Engineering.
  • Analyze engineering and manufacturing data to identify trends, opportunities, and process improvements.
  • Develop documentation for new manufacturing processes and engineering procedures.
  • Maintain engineering project files, technical histories, databases, and project documentation.
  • Work with customers and external technical resources to communicate project status and technical solutions.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers and serve as a functional technical expert.
  • Represent the company on assigned technical projects and cross-functional teams.
  • Ensure compliance with Parker policies, aerospace industry regulations, engineering standards, and documentation requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of related engineering experience.
  • Extensive experience in Gear Design AND Gear Manufacturing – REQUIRED.
  • Strong understanding of engineering design and manufacturing principles.
  • Experience working on complex product development or engineering projects.
  • Strong knowledge of DFM/DFA principles.
  • Ability to lead technical projects and coordinate multidisciplinary resources.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently on complex engineering problems involving multiple variables.
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively to engineering teams, management, customers, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong technical documentation and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with solid-model CAD systems.
  • Experience with FEA and engineering simulation software.
  • Aerospace, aviation, motors, actuation, gearing, or electromechanical product experience.
  • Experience with continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience developing tooling and fixtures.
  • Experience working directly with manufacturing and external vendors.
  • Experience with AC/DC motor design or electromagnetic engineering.

The individual will work closely with production employees to understand operational procedures and ensure training processes are effective and consistent.

Approximately 80% of the role will be spent on the production floor, and the individual must be willing and able to learn and perform all production positions within the facility.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Computer proficiency and ability to maintain accurate training documentation.

  • Ability and willingness to learn and perform all production positions within the bakery.

Candidates must be able to perform the physical responsibilities associated with production positions, including:

  • Standing for extended periods.

  • Pushing and pulling materials or equipment.

  • Lifting up to 50 pounds.

  • Stacking boxes up to 7 feet high.

job.title: Digital Marketing Specialist (Remote)
job.description:
Digital Marketing Specialist – CRO & Website Operations
Reports To: Manager, Digital Marketing Optimization  
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote – United States  
Employment Type: 6-Month Contract with Option to Extend

Position Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented Digital Marketing Specialist to support our Digital Marketing Optimization team with website management, content publishing, conversion rate optimization (CRO), website testing, quality assurance (QA), and digital analytics support.

In this role, you will help maintain and improve website content, support A/B testing and website experiments, test new website features, and ensure digital experiences function correctly before launch. You will work closely with teams across Digital Marketing, Analytics, User Experience (UX), Design, SEO, and Web Development.

The ideal candidate has experience managing website content, working with content management systems (CMS), performing website testing, and supporting digital marketing initiatives. This position is well suited for someone who is organized, technically comfortable, and able to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

Key Responsibilities
1. Website Content Management & Publishing (30%)
- Create, update, and maintain website content and landing pages using a content management system (CMS), preferably Drupal.
- Publish website updates and ensure content is accurate, properly formatted, and consistent with brand guidelines.
- Coordinate with content, SEO, and marketing teams to deliver website updates on schedule.
- Conduct content audits and assist with routine website maintenance.
- Support website enhancements that improve usability and customer engagement.

2. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Support (25%)
- Assist with A/B testing, multivariate testing, and website personalization initiatives.
- Support experiment setup, quality assurance, launch, and performance monitoring.
- Work with CRO strategists, analysts, designers, and developers to ensure website tests are implemented correctly.
- Validate test variations across different browsers, devices, and screen sizes.
- Document testing procedures, experiment configurations, and results.

3. Website Quality Assurance & Testing (20%)
- Test website releases, landing pages, new components, and optimization initiatives before launch.
- Verify website functionality, content accuracy, design implementation, and overall user experience.
- Identify, document, and communicate defects to the appropriate teams.
- Perform regression testing to ensure website updates do not negatively affect existing functionality.
- Help ensure website experiences meet quality, usability, and accessibility standards.

4. Digital Marketing Program Support (25%)
- Support digital marketing initiatives involving SEO, paid search (SEM), content marketing, and website optimization.
- Coordinate tasks, timelines, and deliverables across multiple marketing projects.
- Assist with digital analytics and marketing tracking activities.
- Identify opportunities to improve website performance, workflows, and operational efficiency.
- Stay current with digital marketing trends, website optimization techniques, and industry best practices.

Education
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Business, Web Development, or a related field preferred.
- Equivalent relevant education and work experience may be considered.

Required Qualifications
- 1–4 years of experience in digital marketing, website management, web content publishing, or a related field.
- Experience working with a content management system (CMS).
- Experience supporting website updates, digital campaigns, or website optimization initiatives.
- Experience performing website quality assurance (QA) and functional testing.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.
- Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications & Technical Skills
- Experience with Drupal CMS.
- Experience supporting conversion rate optimization (CRO) programs or A/B testing.
- Familiarity with Optimizely or similar experimentation platforms.
- Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and website analytics.
- Familiarity with TestMu (formerly LambdaTest), or similar cross-browser testing platforms.
- Understanding of marketing analytics, website tracking, and campaign measurement.
- Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS.
- Familiarity with SEO principles and digital marketing best practices.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on digital marketing professional who enjoys working with website content, testing website functionality, and helping improve the online customer experience. They should be comfortable using digital tools, identifying issues, coordinating with different teams, and ensuring website updates and experiments are accurate before going live.

job.title: Data Analyst
job.description:
Data Analyst – Supply Chain & Master Data Management

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Interview Process: Virtual Interview via Microsoft Teams

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to support supply chain operations, master data management, data quality initiatives, and business process improvements.

This position will work closely with supply chain planners, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of critical business data.

The ideal candidate will have strong Microsoft Excel, data analysis, reporting, and problem-solving skills, along with experience working with data in a manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, procurement, or related business environment.

The successful candidate must be self-motivated, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities while building strong working relationships across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Data Management & Data Quality

  • Work closely with supply chain planners and cross-functional teams to understand business processes and data requirements.

  • Manage, maintain, and update master data elements across business systems.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned master data elements, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and consistency.

  • Identify and resolve data quality issues, including:

    • Duplicate records

    • Missing or incomplete data

    • Incorrect data formats

    • Conflicting data ownership

    • Inconsistent data definitions

  • Perform data cleansing, validation, and maintenance activities to improve overall data quality.

  • Collaborate with data owners to ensure accurate and timely data collection, entry, and updates.

  • Follow established business processes and policies when collecting, maintaining, and uploading data into business systems.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Utilize Microsoft Excel and other business applications to analyze, manipulate, and report on operational data.

  • Review data for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.

  • Identify data trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Support business reporting requirements through accurate data management and analysis.

  • Monitor data quality and compliance metrics to ensure business requirements are met.

Business Process Improvement

  • Participate in process improvement initiatives focused on data quality, accuracy, and operational efficiency.

  • Identify opportunities to standardize and streamline data management processes.

  • Define and clarify data definitions, process flows, and policies with functional data owners.

  • Review and update master data definitions and data entry procedures to support evolving business needs.

  • Lead small-scale data analysis and process improvement projects.

  • Support larger cross-functional projects and digital transformation initiatives.

  • Recommend improvements to existing workflows, systems, and data management practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with supply chain planners, procurement, warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, quality assurance, and customer service teams.

  • Establish strong working relationships with business leaders, data owners, and internal stakeholders.

  • Communicate data requirements, issues, and process improvements clearly and effectively.

  • Support the implementation of critical digital initiatives and business process standardization.

  • Work collaboratively across multiple departments to ensure data supports operational objectives.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.

  • Bachelor's degree (BA or BS) preferred.

Professional Experience

  • 1+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Supply Chain Planning

    • Procurement

    • Warehouse Operations

    • Logistics

    • Customer Service

    • Quality Assurance

    • Manufacturing

  • Demonstrated experience managing, maintaining, analyzing, or manipulating data within business systems or analytical applications.

  • Experience working with data accuracy, reporting, or business process requirements.

Technical Skills

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including data manipulation, analysis, and reporting.

job.title: System Integration Engineer - Secret Clearance
job.description:
Description:
This effort is a fast paced, highly dynamic environment.
This is for a role responsible for integration of an EO/IR COTS camera to an over the shoulder missile launch product.
The EO/IR effort would entail integration, calibration, alignment and/or characterization of the sensor.
This role will entail utilization of an oscilloscope, DMM, reading schematics and interpreting the COTS ICD to integrate the comms and imagery from the camera with our custom electronics suite.
This role will be primarily in a development lab space on site at LM MFC Orlando, Florida.
The candidate will be responsible for integration and verifying hardware, electricial and software interfaces between tactical/flight hardware subsystems and the test set.
The candidate should be proficient in troubleshooting and assessing system functionality.

Required Experience
6 years- Subsystem integration using equipment such as oscillosclopes, DMMs, power supplies, network analyzers
6 years -Hands on testing
6 years- Familiarity with systems engineering –
6 years - Hardware troubleshooting
3 years Working familiarity with standard tactical communication and telemetry protocols (e.g., MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet, RS-422/485, PCIe, Camera Link, or ARINC)
3 years – familiarity with EO/IR technology

Active Secret Clearance is required to start. Please only submit candidates that currently hold an active secret clearance.

job.title: CNC Swiss Process Specialist: Direct Hire | Gilbert, AZ | $70,000 – $95,000 per year
job.description:
CNC Process Specialist: Direct Hire | Gilbert, AZ | $70,000 – $95,000 per year

  • Direct hire with a stable employer
  • $70,000 – $95,000 per year, depending on experience
  • Great benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and EAP
  • A role with real influence on how the shop runs, without the headaches of managing people
  • Room to grow in a precision manufacturing environment
 

Nesco Resource is hiring a CNC Process Specialist for our client, a precision machining company in Gilbert, AZ. This is a direct hire position with great benefits and long-term growth. If you're a machinist who loves making parts run faster, cleaner, and more profitably, this role is for you.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, process-focused position. You'll work alongside the machinists who program, set up, and run multi-axis Swiss screw machines and CNC lathes, and your focus is making their processes better. You'll dig into cycle times, tooling, and setups, and you'll help lead continuous improvement on the shop floor. You'll mentor and support the team, but this is not a formal supervisory role.

What You'll Do

  • Provide technical guidance and process support for machinists running multi-axis Swiss screw machines (Citizen, Tsugami, Tornos Deco, Escomatic) and multi-axis CNC lathes (DMG Mori Seki NLX2500)
  • Determine the best tooling, feeds, and speeds for complex parts, cutting cycle times while holding tight tolerances
  • Specify and manage cutting tools, collets, and guide bushings, and monitor tool wear and wear offsets to prevent defects
  • Troubleshoot G-code, chatter, tool wear, and dimensional drift during live runs
  • Interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and GD&T to develop and refine machining processes
  • Lead or support Kaizen events and projects that reduce cycle times and setup times
  • Apply Lean principles (5S, standard work, SMED) to machine cells and eliminate shop-floor waste
  • Write and update SOPs and setup sheets so work is repeatable across shifts
  • Work with engineering and quality to improve fixtures, toolpaths, and cutting parameters
  • Help quote custom parts by estimating machining time and cost
  • Perform preventative maintenance and diagnose and repair machine tool problems
  • Train and informally mentor machinists and operators on best-practice setups and process controls

What We're Looking For

  • Machining experience on Swiss screw machines and/or multi-axis CNC lathes
  • Strong G-code, tooling, and blueprint/GD&T skills
  • A process mindset, with a track record of reducing cycle times, setup times, or scrap
  • Lean manufacturing knowledge (5S, SMED, Kaizen)
  • Comfort mentoring and training others without needing a supervisor title
  • Good communication with engineering, quality, and production teams

What We Offer

  • Direct hire with a stable employer
  • $70,000 – $95,000 per year, depending on experience
  • Great benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and EAP
  • A role with real influence on how the shop runs, without the headaches of managing people
  • Room to grow in a precision manufacturing environment

Ready to apply? Send your resume to Nesco Resource today.

job.title: Payroll and Billing Support Specialist
job.description:
Payroll & Billing Support Specialist

Position Focus: Payroll Processing, Billing, Accounting & Client Support

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Payroll & Billing Support Specialist to provide financial, accounting, payroll, and billing support to clients.

This position is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing, maintaining customer records, processing billing adjustments, and supporting payroll funding activities. The role also involves responding to client inquiries, reconciling financial information, and assisting customers with payroll and billing software.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of payroll processing, accounting principles, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reconciliation, along with excellent organizational and customer service skills.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing & Billing Administration

  • Verify that all required payroll and billing information has been entered accurately to ensure timely processing.

  • Process and maintain client payroll and billing data in accordance with established procedures.

  • Review payroll and billing information for completeness and accuracy.

  • Update customer files and records to reflect current weekly payroll and billing instructions.

  • Process billing adjustments, including credits and rebills.

  • Assist clients in developing effective procedures for submitting payroll and billing information accurately and on time.

  • Identify discrepancies in payroll and billing records and assist with reconciliation.

Client Support & Customer Service

  • Respond to customer inquiries in a timely, professional, and courteous manner.

  • Serve as a point of contact for clients regarding payroll processing, billing, and account-related questions.

  • Assist with new customer setup, including data entry and account information verification.

  • Provide guidance and repeat training to customers on payroll and billing software.

  • Troubleshoot basic technical questions related to payroll and billing platforms.

  • Build and maintain positive customer relationships through responsive and accurate service.

  • Escalate complex issues or potential problems to management as appropriate.

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Support financial and accounting activities associated with payroll funding and client billing.

  • Prepare and transmit accounting and payment reports accurately and on time.

  • Process and monitor reporting related to:

    • Wire transfers

    • Automated Clearing House (ACH) transactions

    • Accounts Receivable (AR) credits and debits

  • Assist with reconciling discrepancies across payroll, billing, and accounting records.

  • Apply basic accounting principles to support accurate financial transactions.

  • Review financial data across multiple databases to identify inconsistencies and resolve discrepancies.

Data Management & Administrative Support

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer databases, including payroll and billing information.

  • Enter and update customer account information in applicable systems.

  • Ensure customer records reflect the most current payroll and billing instructions.

  • Organize and maintain financial documentation and supporting records.

  • Utilize multiple software applications to process transactions, maintain data, and generate reports.

  • Notify management promptly of processing issues, discrepancies, or potential risks.

  • Support ongoing improvements to payroll, billing, and administrative processes.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field preferred.

  • Consideration may be given to candidates with a relevant degree in lieu of work experience.

Experience

  • Previous experience in payroll processing preferred.

  • Comparable work experience in accounting, payroll, billing, or financial administration preferred.

  • Experience supporting customers with payroll, billing, or accounting-related inquiries is beneficial.

Required Skills & Competencies

Accounting & Payroll Knowledge

  • Understanding of basic accounting principles, including:

    • Payroll processing

    • Payroll taxes

    • Accounts Payable (AP)

    • Accounts Receivable (AR)

    • Cash posting

  • Ability to review and reconcile financial data accurately.

  • Strong numerical aptitude and ability to identify discrepancies.

  • Understanding of relationships between financial data maintained across multiple databases.

Technical & Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to learn and navigate multiple software systems.

  • Experience using standard office equipment.

  • Strong data entry skills with an emphasis on accuracy.

  • Ability to work with customer databases and financial records.

The Manufacturing Technical Associate supports the production of respiratory pharmaceutical products in a highly regulated manufacturing environment. This role requires hands-on experience operating, setting up, adjusting, and troubleshooting automated manufacturing equipment while maintaining compliance with cGMP, quality, safety, and production requirements.
Key Responsibilities
  • Execute manufacturing and packaging processes in accordance with Batch Manufacturing Records (BMRs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), cGMP regulations, safety requirements, and established work instructions.

job.title: Maintenance Mechanic
job.description:
Nesco Resource is now hiring for A Packaging Maintenance Mechanic I, II, or III

Department: Maintenance

Schedule: 2 nd shift

Pay Rate: To be determined based on qualification and experience

 

Position Purpose and Objectives

The Packaging Maintenance Mechanic supports reliable packaging and manufacturing operations by performing equipment troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, repairs, line setups, changeovers, and equipment installations. The position works with liquid, topical, and powder-filling equipment, as well as other manufacturing and packaging machinery. The selected level will be based on the candidate's relevant experience, technical knowledge, troubleshooting ability, and demonstrated ability to work independently

Essential Job Functions

  • Follow applicable current Good Manufacturing Practices, company procedures, and Occupational Safety and Health Administration safety requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and repair packaging and manufacturing machines and equipment.
  • Perform line setups, equipment changeovers, adjustments, repairs, and installations.
  • Perform assigned preventive-maintenance work according to manufacturer specifications.
  • Accurately and promptly document maintenance activities, including work orders and parts requests, in the computerized maintenance management system.
  • Maintain packaging equipment and changeover tooling in safe, functional condition.
  • Verify that equipment safety components and guards are operational and properly used.
  • Complete maintenance, changeovers, setups, and repairs safely and efficiently to support production.
  • Monitor and report equipment, parts, and spare-parts needs.
  • Use hand tools, power tools, and appropriate machine-shop equipment.
  • Read and interpret applicable instructions, schematics, drawings, and blueprints based on the position level.
  • Work collaboratively with maintenance, production, packaging, and other supporting departments.
  • Perform additional maintenance responsibilities consistent with the position level and operational needs.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required

  • Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems appropriate to the position level.
  • Knowledge of programmable controller systems for Mechanic II and Mechanic III positions.
  • Ability to perform basic arithmetic necessary for maintenance assignments.
  • Ability to read and understand job-related instructions, safety information, procedures, equipment documentation, and required records, and to communicate effectively with appropriate personnel.
  • Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, and applicable machine-shop equipment.
  • Ability to recognize equipment problems, identify possible causes, and complete appropriate corrective actions.
  • Ability to maintain accurate maintenance records.
  • Ability to learn and apply new technical skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain quality and safety standards.
  • Ability to manage assigned work accurately and effectively in an active manufacturing environment.

Position Levels

Packaging Maintenance Mechanic I: Entry Level

  • Performs basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting with guidance and supervision.
  • Completes minor equipment repairs, line setups, changeovers, and assigned preventive-maintenance work.
  • Demonstrates basic knowledge of machine-shop equipment and power tools.
  • Requires approximately 0–2 years of maintenance experience in a manufacturing or packaging environment.
  • Demonstrates the ability and willingness to develop the skills required for advancement to Mechanic II.

Packaging Maintenance Mechanic II: Intermediate Level

  • Performs intermediate mechanical and electrical troubleshooting and basic programmable-controller troubleshooting.
  • Reads and interprets applicable schematics, drawings, and blueprints.
  • Performs equipment repairs, installations, line setups, changeovers, and preventive maintenance with limited supervision.
  • Demonstrates working knowledge of machine-shop equipment, including drill presses, vertical or horizontal band saws, and milling machines.
  • Requires approximately 3–5 years of maintenance experience in a manufacturing facility, preferably within packaging, cosmetics, personal care, food, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrates the technical ability and judgment required for advancement to Mechanic III.

Packaging Maintenance Mechanic III: Advanced Level

  • Performs advanced mechanical, electrical, and programmable-controller troubleshooting.
  • Independently diagnoses complex equipment problems and completes advanced repairs, upgrades, installations, and system integrations.
  • Reads and interprets schematics, drawings, and blueprints.
  • Demonstrates advanced machine-shop knowledge and effective use of applicable tools and equipment.
  • Requires approximately 6–8 or more years of maintenance experience in a manufacturing facility, preferably within packaging, cosmetics, personal care, food, or a related industry.
  • Performs complex assignments with minimal supervision and provides technical support as needed.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility.
  • Mechanic III employees may provide technical guidance or assistance to less-experienced team members when requested.

The original descriptions list no formal supervisory responsibility. The Mechanic III technical-guidance sentence is recommended job-ad language and should be retained only if it reflects actual expectations.

Working Conditions

  • Work is generally performed in packaging, manufacturing, and machine-shop areas.
  • The work environment may be busy, active, noisy, dusty, or powdery.
  • The position requires interaction with maintenance leadership, line personnel, production supervisors, shift managers, and other supporting departments.
  • The position may involve extended periods of standing, bending, climbing ladders, and working from approved lifts or elevated work platforms.
  • The position requires the ability to safely move, position, and handle job-related tools, parts, materials, and equipment using appropriate assistance or material-handling equipment when applicable.
  • A qualified individual must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law.
  • Required safety procedures and personal protective equipment must be followed in designated work areas.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma, General Educational Development credential, or equivalent.
  • Maintenance experience appropriate to the Mechanic I, II, or III level.
  • Mechanical and electrical aptitude appropriate to the position level.
  • Machine-shop knowledge and experience using tools appropriate to the position level.
  • Effective communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to accurately complete required maintenance documentation.
  • Ability to work independently or with guidance, depending on the assigned position level.
  • Ability to work first or second shift based on the position opening.
  • Ability to work additional hours when necessary to support production requirements, subject to applicable company policy and law.

Success Factors

Demonstrates dependability, initiative, accountability, adaptability, sound judgment, teamwork, and effective problem-solving while completing assigned maintenance responsibilities safely, accurately, and in accordance with established procedures.

job.title: Maintenance Manager

Location: Fayetteville, TN
Pay: $100,000–$105,000 per year
Schedule: 1st Shift
Employment Type: Direct Hire

Lead Maintenance. Drive Reliability. Make an Impact.

We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Manager to lead the maintenance function for a manufacturing operation in Fayetteville, TN. This is a key leadership position responsible for the overall direction of plant maintenance, equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, projects, budgets, and maintenance personnel.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, results-driven maintenance leader with experience in an automotive or manufacturing environment who understands how to reduce downtime, improve equipment reliability, develop maintenance teams, and support a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and oversee all plant maintenance activities, ensuring equipment and facilities operate safely, efficiently, and reliably.

  • Direct, coordinate, and prioritize daily maintenance activities, projects, and staffing requirements.

  • Develop and manage Preventive Maintenance (PM) and asset-care programs to improve equipment reliability and minimize unplanned downtime.

  • Analyze equipment downtime, recurring failures, and maintenance issues to identify root causes and implement effective countermeasures.

  • Partner with Operations and other departments to improve equipment performance, production efficiency, and overall plant results.

  • Lead, mentor, train, and develop maintenance supervisors and technicians while establishing clear expectations and accountability.

  • Manage maintenance staffing, schedules, workload, performance evaluations, and departmental objectives.

  • Develop project plans, obtain bids, review proposals, and oversee outside contractors and service providers.

  • Manage the maintenance department budget, approve expenses, monitor costs, and identify opportunities for cost reduction.

  • Manage spare-parts inventory, purchasing, and equipment/supply needs.

  • Support equipment installations, modifications, improvement projects, and troubleshooting efforts.

  • Read and interpret mechanical/electrical blueprints, specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Support robotics and automated production equipment, including training maintenance personnel on robot operation and improvement activities.

  • Utilize or work with CAD/CAM and 2D/3D design systems as needed.

  • Support welding process improvements and maintain appropriate welding conditions to promote quality and consistency.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable safety, quality, and environmental standards.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance, safety, project, expense, and equipment records.

  • Support 5S, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Safety initiatives.

  • Provide technical guidance, review work instructions and progress, and recommend improvements when needed.

  • Support administrative and IT-related activities associated with plant operations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve maintenance processes, equipment performance, and overall departmental efficiency.

Leadership Responsibilities

This position provides overall direction, coordination, and leadership for the maintenance organization, including subordinate supervisors and maintenance personnel.

Responsibilities include:

  • Interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and training maintenance personnel

  • Planning and assigning work

  • Establishing performance expectations

  • Coaching, mentoring, and developing employees

  • Conducting performance evaluations

  • Addressing employee concerns and resolving problems

  • Promoting accountability and teamwork

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Industrial Maintenance Technician – 3rd Shift

Location: Shelbyville, TN
Salary: $62,000–$72,000 annually, based on experience
Schedule: 3rd Shift | 11:00 PM–7:00 AM
Job Type: Direct Hire

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Industrial Maintenance Technician to join a manufacturing team in Shelbyville, TN. This is a direct-hire opportunity for a hands-on maintenance professional with strong mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical troubleshooting skills.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining and repairing production equipment, performing preventive maintenance, and responding to equipment breakdowns to minimize downtime and keep operations running efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair production machinery and facility equipment.

  • Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues and perform timely repairs.

  • Disassemble, repair, reassemble, test, and adjust equipment to restore proper operation.

  • Ability to read equipment manuals, follow work orders, and diagnose maintenance issues.

  • Knowledge of material flow and inventory control.

job.description:
Contract Hire - Possible temp to perm for right candidate. Open due to LOA.

May go higher on salary for someone with direct aerospace experience and certifications - (Looking around max salary ***K)
At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers.
As a member of our team, you are instrumental in fulfilling our mission: 'Enabling Engineering Breakthroughs that Lead to a Better Tomorrow.' Pursuing a career at Parker presents unlimited opportunities for both professional and personal development. Working with some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, your contributions will be pivotal in developing innovative technologies and products, significantly contributing to Parker s goal of addressing the world s most pressing engineering challenges. At Parker, our team members belong, matter and make a difference.
The vision of Gas Turbine Fuel Systems Division is to be the global leader in the design, development, manufacture, and service of engine fuel, lubrication, and thermal management systems and components for aerospace/defense and industrial applications. By leveraging our expertise in analysis, atomization, combustion, fluid metering, and control coupled with enterprise excellence we will exceed customer expectations and achieve our business objectives.
POSITION SUMMARY
Obtains the best quality, service, and value for products and services through effective bidding, negotiation, and supplier management. Identifies manufacturing needs, identifies and selects suppliers, negotiates contracts, and arranges delivery. Purchases critical, complex and/or high dollar parts, equipment, services, and materials. Reviews key supplier metrics, hosts quarterly business reviews, travels to suppliers when needed, drives supplier improvement activities to improve the key metrics of quality, delivery, competitiveness, and customer service.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Identifies and recommends suppliers by investigating potential suppliers, researching parts, equipment, machinery, services, and materials availability. Prepares statements of work for items proposed for procurement. Develops potential bidders lists and formal requests for quotation or proposal.
Performs Supplier risk assessments for near and long-term capacity
Conducts supplier site visits and evaluates them as to production capability, performance, delivery, and other key business criteria. May support or lead supplier certification surveys as part of a technical and/or quality team.
Evaluates proposals from potential suppliers. Selects suppliers for a variety of highly complex or technical materials, supplies or services and negotiates price, delivery, quality and service. Develops alternate sources of supply by identifying and researching prospective suppliers.
Negotiates final terms and conditions of purchase, awards and administers the procurement contract to conclusion. Maintains accurate lead times for assigned area. Issues purchase orders and agreements that accurately reflect price, schedule, terms, and conditions as negotiated with suppliers. May include orders with international suppliers and/or subcontractors involving import/export trade.
Monitors and evaluates supplier performance. Determines and implements corrective actions to resolve impending supplier failure to fulfill contractual agreements that may delay production or delivery. Resolves shipment quality discrepancies by mediating supplier/manufacturing issues. Facilitates inspections, substitutions, and standardization by arranging and participating in conferences between suppliers and company personnel.
Negotiates and settles damage claims, rejections, losses, return of materials, over-shipments, cancellations, and engineering changes with suppliers.
Monitors and evaluates supplier's ability to meet all company and government or commercial procurement requirements and ensure that the pertinent technical and quality issues receive adequate attention to assure compliance.
Prepares complex reports and analyses by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
Applies continuous improvement techniques and methods to internal processes and systems. Develops, coordinates, and implements improvement initiatives with key suppliers. Recommends actions by analyzing and interpreting data and making comparative analyses. Analyzes proposed changes in methods and materials. May lead or be assigned to a special project team.
Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing trade publications, establishing networks, and/or participating in professional associations.
Complies with federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations; ensures adherence to requirements and advises management on needed actions. Complies with Government/Commercial Practices Manual (GPM/CPM) policies and procedures.
May provide leadership to others in department. Acts as prime contact on high level projects. Establishes goals and objectives required to complete projects. Trains and mentors less experienced employees.
Shares specialized knowledge with others. Represents company on high-level projects. Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed. Work assignments may include cross-functional or project team responsibilities (e.g., continuous improvement).
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor s degree (BA) in Business Administration, or related field, and experience which has provided both theoretical and practical knowledge in the field.
Demonstrated ability to perform the essential functions of the job typically acquired through six or more years of increasingly responsible related experience.
Certificate in Purchasing Management CPM/CPIM or APICS desired but not required.
Training in LEAN, SixSigma quality, Greenbelt helpful but not required.
Experience working in an MRP environment desired
Thorough knowledge of purchasing and negotiating methods, principles, and concepts.
Knowledge of industry practices, general business operations, and policies.
Knowledge of legal and regulatory requirements related to procurement.
Ability to effectively assess and implement continuous improvement principles and techniques.
Proficient with standard business application software and specialized purchasing and/or materials systems (e.g., electronic data interface (EDI) or manufacturing resource planning (MRP) systems).
Ability to work on a variety of problems of diverse scope and complexity where analysis and evaluation of various outcomes require tradeoffs.
Ability to solve a wide range of difficult problems in imaginative and practical ways and evaluate alternative solutions that may require coordination across multiple teams.
Ability to establish goals and objectives to complete projects. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret policies and recommend changes to procedures.
Ability to effectively communicate and present information to suppliers, team members, team leaders, and top management.
Ability to respond to significant inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to negotiate effectively to obtain best prices and terms on products, materials, and services.
Ability to effectively demonstrate team member competencies and participate in goal setting, performance feedback, and self-development activities.
Drug-Free Workplace
In accordance with Parker s policies and applicable state laws, Parker provides for a drug-free workplace. Therefore, all applicants seeking employment with Parker will be subject to drug testing as a condition of employment.
Conditions of Employment
This position is subject to meeting U.S. export compliance and/or U.S. Government contracting citizenship eligibility requirements.

job.title: Recruiter - (Manufacturing)
job.description:
Recruiter – High-Volume Manufacturing
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Employment Type: Contract-to-Hire
Interview Process: Interviews to be scheduled as soon as possible

Position Overview

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and results-driven Recruiter to support talent acquisition efforts in a fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for managing full-cycle recruitment for hourly production, skilled trades, technical, professional, and salaried positions.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing multiple job openings simultaneously, building strong relationships with hiring managers, and meeting time-sensitive staffing needs while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for all levels of the organization, including hourly production, skilled trades, technical, professional, and salaried positions.

  • Partner with hiring managers to identify staffing needs, establish hiring priorities, and coordinate recruitment activities to support operational requirements.

  • Source, screen, and evaluate qualified candidates through various recruitment channels.

  • Coordinate the interview process, including scheduling interviews, communicating with hiring managers and candidates, and ensuring timely follow-up.

  • Manage candidate progression throughout the hiring process, including offer coordination, background checks, drug screenings, and other pre-employment requirements.

  • Monitor recruitment activities, identify potential hiring delays, and proactively communicate updates to hiring managers and HR leadership.

Staffing Coordination & Onboarding

  • Oversee the coordination and onboarding of temporary staffing personnel in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external staffing agencies.

  • Coordinate and conduct new hire orientation, ensuring required documentation is completed and company policies and procedures are communicated.

  • Respond to inquiries from candidates, staffing vendors, employees, and other stakeholders regarding employment opportunities, recruitment processes, and company information.

  • Provide guidance regarding hiring procedures, company policies, and HR programs while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism.

Recruitment Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate recruitment records, employee files, and HR information in accordance with company policies and applicable employment regulations.

  • Prepare and maintain recruitment reports, staffing metrics, and other recurring Human Resources reports.

  • Support departmental goals, continuous improvement initiatives, and other Human Resources activities as needed.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Human Resources Manager.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.

  • Minimum of two (2) years of hands-on recruiting experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple requisitions and meet time-sensitive staffing needs.

  • Experience managing full-cycle recruitment, including candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer coordination, pre-employment screening, and onboarding.

  • Experience recruiting for a variety of positions, including hourly production and professional or salaried roles.

  • Experience working with temporary staffing agencies and coordinating contingent workforce needs.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-demand environment while managing multiple priorities.

  • Strong organizational, time-management, interpersonal, and communication skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS) or Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS).

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee and candidate information with professionalism.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.

  • Experience recruiting skilled trades, maintenance, engineering, and leadership positions.

  • Familiarity with applicable employment laws, hiring practices, and pre-employment screening requirements.

  • Experience tracking recruitment metrics and identifying opportunities to improve hiring processes.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to independently manage multiple recruitment activities while meeting established deadlines.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with hiring managers, employees, candidates, and external staffing partners.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing recruitment challenges.

  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs and staffing priorities.

  • Commitment to providing a positive candidate experience and supporting organizational hiring goals.

job.title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
job.description:
Accounts Receivable (AR) Invoicing Administrator

Position Title: AR Invoicing Administrator
Work Authorization: U.S. Only
Shift: 1st Shift
Schedule: Must be available to work at least two Saturdays per month and occasional overtime

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounts Receivable (AR) Invoicing Administrator to support daily invoicing, accounts receivable collections, financial reporting, and month-end accounting activities.

This position is responsible for processing daily sales invoices, performing month-end dock walk audits, tracking non-invoiced work orders, and preparing daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

The ideal candidate will have experience in accounts receivable, invoicing, collections, ERP systems, and advanced Microsoft Excel, with the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced environment.

This individual contributor will report to the Accounts Receivable Manager and collaborate with Operations, Shipping, Planning, Production Support, Sales, and other internal departments. Occasional customer interaction may be required.

Key Responsibilities

Invoicing & Billing Administration

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and on time using the company's ERP system.

  • Verify purchase orders, contracts, shipping documentation, and order entries before invoicing to ensure billing accuracy.

  • Review and reconcile invoice discrepancies, coordinating corrections with Operations, Sales, and Shipping teams.

  • Track non-invoiced work orders weekly and follow up to ensure timely billing.

  • Perform month-end dock walk audits and support accurate invoicing of completed work.

  • Support month-end close activities related to invoicing and revenue recognition, including cutoffs, accruals, and reconciliations.

  • Ensure invoicing activities comply with company policies, contractual terms, and applicable regulations, including tax and export control requirements.

  • Prepare and maintain documentation for internal and external audits.

  • Identify opportunities to improve invoicing processes, automation, and data accuracy.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Assist with accounts receivable collections and follow up on outstanding customer balances.

  • Collaborate with contract administrators, customers, and the AR team to support timely collections.

  • Contact customers by phone and email regarding past-due balances.

  • Prioritize collection activities based on account aging, payment risk, and customer history.

  • Monitor customer payment commitments and follow up to ensure timely resolution.

  • Review AR aging reports daily and weekly, taking appropriate action on delinquent accounts.

  • Maintain detailed records of collection activities, customer communications, and payment follow-ups.

  • Investigate short payments, deductions, chargebacks, and invoice disputes.

  • Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, Contracts, Operations, and Key Account Managers to resolve billing and payment issues.

  • Gather and provide supporting documentation, including proof of delivery (POD), invoices, and account statements.

  • Provide regular updates regarding collection efforts, high-risk accounts, and anticipated cash receipts.

Note: This position focuses on AR collections and invoicing. Cash posting is not part of the role.

Reporting, Reconciliation & Administrative Support

  • Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly invoicing and accounts receivable reports.

  • Monitor outstanding invoices, non-invoiced work orders, and collection activities.

  • Utilize Microsoft Excel to analyze financial data, reconcile discrepancies, and maintain accurate reporting.

  • Support month-end accounting activities and audit preparation.

  • Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve billing issues and improve operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience in invoicing, accounts receivable, or accounting.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel proficiency required, including:

    • PivotTables

    • VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP

    • INDEX / MATCH

    • Basic formulas and data analysis

  • Experience using ERP systems, billing platforms, and order-to-cash processes.

  • Understanding of invoicing, billing reconciliation, and accounts receivable collections.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry, financial reporting, and reconciliation.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while meeting strict deadlines.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable communicating with internal departments and external customers.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and escalate issues when appropriate.

  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to follow established procedures.

  • Reliable attendance, punctuality, and willingness to work overtime as needed.

  • Must be available to work at least two Saturdays per month.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Experience using Microsoft Power BI or other reporting and data visualization tools.

  • Previous accounting, invoicing, or AR experience within a manufacturing, distribution, or government-contracting environment.

  • Familiarity with billing compliance, tax requirements, and export controls related to invoicing.

  • Experience supporting month-end close, revenue recognition, and financial audits.

job.title: Direct Hire Controls Engineer
job.description:
Direct Hire Controls Engineer — North Kansas City, MO

Nesco Resource has partnered with a growing manufacturing company to fill a Controls Engineer position in North Kansas City, MO. This is an exciting opportunity for a candidate looking for a family friendly organization with career advancement, this might be the opportunity for you.

You'll be the go-to person keeping our automated production lines running and improving. This is a hands-on role, expect to spend most of your time on the plant floor (about 70%), not behind a desk. You'll troubleshoot PLCs, robotics, HMIs, and vision systems, support new equipment launches, and work side-by-side with Maintenance and Production to solve real problems as they come up.

Your involvement spans the full lifecycle, from early project sourcing and RFQ development through equipment launch and beyond. You'll program torque control systems, select error and mistake-proofing devices, and make sure all equipment and process documentation (manuals, BOMs, drawings, spare parts lists, PM schedules) gets handed off cleanly to the plant before start of production. You'll also help track capital budgets, work directly with automation vendors, and support Purchasing in evaluating new suppliers and technologies.

What We're Looking For

Someone who genuinely likes being where the action is. You understand PLC logic, but more than that, you understand how the equipment, the process, and the people on the floor all fit together. You're also comfortable driving lean initiatives (5S, OEE, TPM, Kanban) and enjoy mentoring Maintenance Technicians to help build up the team around you.

Qualifications of the Direct Hire Controls Engineer in North Kansas City, MO

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of Controls Engineering or advanced Maintenance experience in an automated environment
  • 2-4 years of PLC programming experience (Allen-Bradley MicroLogix, SLC 500, ControlLogix 5000) for manual assembly cells, automated assembly cells, and Power & Free conveyor systems
  • 2-4 years of vision system programming experience (Cognex, DVT, or Keyence)
  • 2-4 years of HMI programming experience (AB PanelView / PanelView Plus)
  • Experience with JIT, SPD, ILVS, and batch manufacturing systems, including broadcast analysis from customer trigger through installation
  • Comfort with industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, TCP/IP) and robotics
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, RSLogix 5000/500, and RSView

A Few Benefits Highlights

  • Medical plans with the company covering the majority of premiums, plus an HSA option with company contributions
  • 401(k) match up to 4%, fully vested from day one
  • Tuition support up to $5,250/year through our education partnership program
  • Wellness incentive, EAP, and identity theft protection included
