job.title: Civil Engineer – Industrial
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Civil Engineer to support industrial, refinery, petrochemical, and EPC engineering projects in Houston, TX.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in civil site development, grading, drainage, stormwater management, and underground utility systems. This individual will be responsible for civil engineering calculations, design development, technical documentation, and coordination with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform civil engineering design and calculations for industrial facilities.

  • Develop and review site grading, drainage, stormwater management, and underground utility designs.

  • Prepare civil engineering calculations, specifications, drawings, and technical deliverables.

  • Support the design of industrial access roads, paving, site layouts, and infrastructure.

  • Evaluate elevations, slopes, drainage requirements, and underground utility routing.

  • Coordinate with Civil Designers using AutoCAD Civil 3D.

  • Review civil engineering drawings for technical accuracy and compliance with applicable standards.

  • Collaborate with Structural, Piping, Mechanical, Electrical, and other engineering disciplines.

  • Provide technical direction and guidance to designers and junior engineers.

  • Support FEED, detailed engineering, and construction phases.

  • Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews and resolve engineering conflicts.

  • Provide construction support, including responding to RFIs and addressing field engineering issues.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

  • 5–10 years of civil engineering experience, preferably within industrial or EPC environments.

  • Experience with grading, drainage, site development, and underground utility engineering.

  • Ability to perform and review civil engineering calculations.

  • Familiarity with AutoCAD Civil 3D and civil design deliverables.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and design standards.

  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Strong technical communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting refinery, petrochemical, chemical, or oil and gas facilities.

  • Experience working with an EPC engineering firm.

  • Texas Professional Engineer (P.E.) license or eligibility for licensure.

  • Experience with stormwater management, hydrology, and hydraulic calculations.

  • Familiarity with industrial site layouts, paving, underground utilities, and drainage infrastructure.

  • Experience with greenfield and brownfield projects.

  • Experience providing construction-phase engineering support.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Civil Engineer with strong industrial site development experience who can independently perform engineering calculations, review technical drawings, and coordinate civil design deliverables.

Candidates with refinery, petrochemical, or EPC experience are especially desirable. The successful individual should be comfortable working with civil designers and other engineering disciplines to support projects from initial design through construction.

Regional HR Manager

Regional Support Role | Full-Time | Direct Hire

Eligible candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. and must NOT require current or future sponsorship (including Student Visas).

Build strong leaders, support a growing workforce, and make a meaningful impact across a multi-location organization. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced HR professional who enjoys partnering directly with operational leaders, navigating employee relations challenges, and turning company-wide HR initiatives into practical solutions that work in the field.

Pay & Benefits

  • Salary: $100,000–$120,000 per year, based on experience

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Company-paid life insurance, with additional voluntary coverage

What You'll Do

  • Partner with regional leaders to address workforce needs, strengthen team performance, and support business goals.

  • Coach managers on employee relations, performance management, employee engagement, retention, and difficult workplace conversations.

  • Manage sensitive employee matters, including workplace investigations, conflict resolution, corrective action, documentation, and terminations while maintaining confidentiality and consistency.

  • Bring HR programs to life by implementing company-wide initiatives across regional operations while accounting for local business needs and employment requirements.

  • Develop talent and future leaders through performance coaching, succession planning, workforce planning, and career development initiatives.

  • Experience supporting employees or operations across multiple states.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This role offers the chance to work closely with leaders, influence workforce decisions, and help shape a consistent, positive employee experience across a growing regional operation. You'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond day-to-day HR administration by supporting leadership development, strengthening employee relationships, and improving how HR serves the business.

If you're an HR professional who enjoys being a trusted advisor to leadership while staying connected to the people and operations behind the business, this could be an excellent next step.

Inventory Specialist
Irwin, PA
Starting Wage of $20.50+ based off experience
5am - 3:30pm, Monday - Thursday
4 DAY WORK WEEK!
Only 1 opening available - Apply Immediately if Interested

About the Position

We are hiring an Inventory Specialist in Irwin, PA to support inventory control, order picking, materials management, and tool room operations in a manufacturing environment. In this role, you will help maintain accurate inventory, keep production materials and tooling available, and support on-time customer shipments.

Key Responsibilities

Inventory Control & Order Fulfillment

  • Generate picklists, print sales orders, and pick customer orders to meet scheduled ship dates.
  • Stock shelves, verify quantities, and complete cycle counts to maintain accurate inventory records.
  • Process bin transfers in the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.
  • Monitor inventory discrepancies and work daily with cost accounting to resolve issues.
  • Support the annual financial inventory audit.
  • Process return material authorization (RMA) picklists and return items to the appropriate inventory bins.
  • Incorporate rush orders and items requiring rework into the material flow according to work instructions.
  • Operate forklifts and WAVE material-handling equipment as needed.

Production & Materials Coordination

  • Release and issue production jobs, update quantities and dates, and track work orders throughout the shop.
  • Issue castings and finished parts, and maintain casting inventory.
  • Track upcoming work orders up to three months in advance.
  • Verify surface-finish requirements for polishing work orders.
  • Close production operations, record scrap, and reissue work orders as needed.
  • Provide backup support for production releases and scrap reporting.

Tool Room Management

  • Manage tool room inventory, including purchased products and consignment stock.
  • Order tooling for upcoming jobs through the material requirements planning (MRP) system.
  • Update tooling prices and supplier quotes in MRP.
  • Coordinate the repair or replacement of damaged tools and manage tool grinding and resharpening.
  • Obtain new products for machine shop testing.
  • Provide backup support for saw and paint work centers as assigned.

Training & Continuous Improvement

  • Train Material Coordinators and other employees on assigned tasks.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of the company's inventory items.
  • Follow 5S workplace organization practices to maintain an orderly work area.
  • Identify opportunities to improve material handling efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Complete additional duties within your skill set as assigned by a supervisor or management.

Why You'll Like This Opportunity

  • Monday–Thursday schedule with three-day weekends
  • Early first shift that leaves your evenings open
  • Starting pay of $20.50+ per hour
  • A varied role supporting inventory, manufacturing, and tool room operations
  • Opportunities to share your knowledge, train coworkers, and contribute ideas for process improvements
  • Comprehensive and incredible benefit package

Pre-Employment

job.description:
Leave Management Specialist

Position Overview

The Leave Management Specialist is responsible for administering employee leave and absence programs from initiation through closure. This includes managing all communications and ensuring accurate transactional updates to employee HR records.

This role operates in a high-volume service center environment and is focused on delivering consistent, high-quality employee support.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Leave Administration

  • Provide guidance regarding Leave of Absence policies, guidelines, and applicable legislation.

  • Receive and process all leave requests.

  • Assess, adjudicate, track, and monitor leave claims.

  • Complete and maintain accurate documentation for all leave-related activities.

Payroll & Benefits Coordination

  • Partner with Payroll and Benefits to ensure employees on leave are paid accurately and enrolled in appropriate benefits (as applicable).

Skills & Competencies

job.description:
Job Title: Oracle PeopleSoft Developer – EDI Integrations
Location: Tewksbury, MA
Schedule: M-F 8am - 5pm, Hybrid
Possible travel to Charlotte, NC or Corning, NY (10%)

Position Summary
The Oracle PeopleSoft Developer will design, develop, test, and support PeopleSoft-side interfaces and application enhancements that enable EDI integration between PeopleSoft ERP and IBM Sterling B2B Integrator. Hands-on PeopleSoft development experience is required. *** uses IBM Sterling Services for Sterling-side EDI development; this role will coordinate with that team on interface requirements, end-to-end testing, and production support. The role works with business teams, customers, suppliers, trading partners, and IT teams to support reliable order-to-cash and supply chain integrations.

Key Responsibilities
Develop, enhance, test, and support Oracle PeopleSoft interfaces and application logic for inbound and outbound EDI transactions.
Define PeopleSoft data requirements and interface specifications for EDI transactions, including ANSI X12 and EDIFACT, and coordinate Sterling-side mapping and development with IBM Sterling Services.
Support onboarding customers, suppliers, and logistics partners globally.
Monitor transaction processing, troubleshoot PeopleSoft data and interface errors, and coordinate Sterling-side mapping or communication issue resolution with IBM Sterling Services.
Perform PeopleSoft development testing and support end-to-end integration testing, SIT/UAT, deployments, technical documentation, and process improvements in collaboration with business teams and IBM Sterling Services.

Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or related field.
2–5 years of Oracle PeopleSoft application development experience, including hands-on development and support of inbound and outbound interfaces.
Basic understanding of EDI standards such as ANSI X12 and EDIFACT, B2B integrations, and communication protocols such as SFTP, FTP, AS2, and HTTPS.
Hands-on experience with PeopleSoft development tools and SQL to develop, maintain, and troubleshoot application logic and interfaces.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with IBM Sterling B2B Integrator or Sterling File Gateway and experience coordinating with an EDI services provider.
Exposure to other ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA and Middleware technologies such as MuleSoft.

Key Competencies
Problem solving and attention to detail.
Technical learning agility.
Customer focus, teamwork, and communication.
Continuous improvement mindset.
Success Measures
Successful delivery and validation of PeopleSoft interfaces supporting customer, supplier, and logistics partner onboarding.
Reliable EDI transaction processing.
Timely production issue resolution.
Accurate documentation and effective business/IT collaboration.

job.title: Senior Contracts Administrator - (Aerospace/Defense)
job.description:
Senior Contracts Administrator

Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Position Type: Contract Administration
Industry: Aerospace / Manufacturing

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Contracts Administrator to manage contracts of moderate scope and complexity, ensuring fulfillment of contractual obligations, compliance with applicable regulations, and effective customer relationships.

This position is responsible for administering contracts, evaluating contractual requirements, developing and submitting proposals, negotiating pricing and terms, monitoring contract performance, and resolving contract-related issues.

The Senior Contracts Administrator will also support order management, customer purchase order reviews, contract analysis, demand planning, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) activities.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in contract administration, proposal development, contract negotiations, and regulatory compliance within an aerospace, manufacturing, or similarly regulated environment.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration & Management

  • Administer specialized and major contracts, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, company policies, and applicable regulations.

  • Review and analyze customer purchase orders, Basic Contract Agreements, and Long-Term Agreements.

  • Evaluate contract requirements, including delivery schedules, pricing, terms and conditions, and performance obligations.

  • Monitor contract performance and identify potential risks, compliance issues, or required amendments.

  • Determine when customer-directed changes fall outside the original contractual scope.

  • Coordinate contract amendments, extensions, and modifications as necessary.

  • Maintain accurate contract documentation and ensure compliance with established administrative procedures.

Proposal Development & Bid Management

  • Determine customer contractual requirements for new products, engineering designs, system hardware, and specialized assignments.

  • Develop technically and commercially compliant proposal packages for major customers.

  • Coordinate the bid process by identifying requirements and gathering input from internal departments.

  • Prepare responses to Requests for Proposal (RFPs) of varying complexity.

  • Review material requirements, testing specifications, delivery schedules, and estimated costs.

  • Evaluate material, equipment, and labor-hour estimates to support proposal development.

  • Prepare, review, and submit complex proposals in accordance with customer and contractual requirements.

Contract Negotiations & Compliance

  • Negotiate contract pricing, terms and conditions, delivery schedules, and other commercial requirements.

  • Ensure negotiated agreements comply with legal requirements, company policies, and applicable regulations.

  • Review contract provisions to ensure clarity, accuracy, and alignment with organizational objectives.

  • Identify contractual risks and recommend appropriate corrective actions.

  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations.

  • Support compliance with government contracting requirements, when applicable.

  • May assist with export compliance administration and training to ensure company data and intellectual property meet regulatory requirements.

Order Management & Customer Support

  • Support order management activities, including limited order entry and order modifications.

  • Review and analyze customer purchase orders and contractual documentation.

  • Coordinate schedule changes and maintain customer portal information.

  • Develop and maintain demand plans supporting Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP).

  • Communicate with customers regarding order status, delivery requirements, and contract-related inquiries.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and fulfilled.

Contract Performance & Issue Resolution

  • Monitor contractual performance against established delivery schedules, pricing agreements, and performance requirements.

  • Investigate and resolve customer claims, complaints, and contractual disputes.

  • Collect and analyze relevant information to determine appropriate resolutions.

  • Collaborate with engineering, quality, operations, and other departments to resolve technical or commercial issues.

  • Evaluate proposed changes to methods, materials, and contractual requirements.

  • Analyze business data and recommend improvements to contract administration processes.

Customer Relations & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers regarding assigned contracts.

  • Participate in customer meetings, presentations, and contract discussions.

  • Respond to complex customer inquiries and regulatory requests.

  • Communicate contract requirements and updates to internal stakeholders and management.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support contract execution and customer satisfaction.

  • Provide guidance and specialized knowledge to other contract administrators and business team members.

  • Train and mentor less experienced employees, as needed.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related discipline.

  • Typically requires 6+ years of progressive experience in contract administration, contract management, or a related function.

  • Thorough understanding of contract administration principles, industry practices, policies, and regulatory requirements.

  • Experience managing contracts of moderate to high complexity.

  • Demonstrated experience with contract negotiations, proposal development, and customer contract management.

job.title: Lead Controls Engineer
job.description:
Lead Engineer Controls:

SUMMARY:
This position's primary responsibility is to oversee and provide expert technical direction for technology-based processes. This individual's principal goals are to develop and manage specific technical environments for each department and to attain all IT service level agreements for the user community within the organization. The lead will plan and provide direction and support for IT solutions that enhance mission-critical business operations. This position will work closely with decision makers in other departments to identify, recommend, develop, implement, and support cost-effective solutions for all aspects of the organization. This person will also help to define and implement IT policies, standards, procedures, and best practices. Responsibilities and duties include but are not limited to the following: provide technical direction and recommendations to team members and IS management; understand and ensure compliance to IS standards and methodology; recommend and develop plans for systems development and operations; hardware, software and equipment purchases; negotiate with technical personnel and customers for services, products and direction; review and advise groups in the selection, usage and maintenance of technology solutions; provide direction to the vendors and stay current on the latest technologies of the systems supported by the organization to assist in the future planning of necessary IT initiatives; other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other technical area. Equivalent work experience may be acceptable.

Experience: 6+ years of experience in Information Systems or related area with proven programming experience.

Computer Skills: Strong knowledge of multiple technologies including but not limited to SCADA, 4GL programming, scripting, server based, and SQL.

PLC Skills: Knowledge in programming, commissioning, and troubleshooting PLC-based control systems in industrial environments. Experienced with ladder logic and structured programming, I/O mapping, HMI integration, and interpreting electrical schematics to diagnose faults and restore uptime.

Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience communicating technical information to non-technical team members

Special Skills: Advanced understanding and experience with a System Development Lifecycle Methodology; advanced experience developing, reviewing, and/or modifying specifications, configurations, and programs to meet specified requirements; experience in the following: analyzing and interpreting information systems proposals, evaluating and developing alternative implementation plans, reviewing and developing coding standards and working productively in a cross functional team advanced knowledge of relevant multi-user computer systems, applications, and/or equipment; knowledge of current technology developments and trends; extensive problem-solving skills; experience developing and executing integrated test plans; basic project management capabilities.

PLC / Controls: Strong hands-on PLC troubleshooting and programming experience, with Schneider Electric / Modicon being particularly important. They should be comfortable working in an environment containing both newer and legacy controls.
Plant Automation: Troubleshooting automated production and material-handling equipment in a live manufacturing environment.
Conveyance / Material Handling: Controls experience supporting conveyors, motors/drives, sensors, photo eyes, interlocks, sequencing, and related material-handling equipment.
Scanning / Identification Systems: Experience integrating and troubleshooting industrial barcode/scanning/vision equipment. Our environment includes Keyence, Cognex and SICK, so experience with those platforms would be highly relevant.
SCADA / HMI (Ignition and iFix): Ability to diagnose issues across PLC, HMI/SCADA and connected equipment rather than treating the PLC as an isolated system.
Industrial Networks / Communications: Ability to troubleshoot communications between PLCs, scanners, field devices, HMIs and other plant-floor systems.
Upgrades & Modernization: Comfortable supporting older equipment while also helping with controls upgrades, replacements and modernization efforts.
Plant-Floor Troubleshooting: Strong diagnostic ability someone who can trace a problem across controls, electrical, communications and equipment to determine the actual root cause rather than simply replacing components.

Travel: This position is for onsite presence for Holcomb, KS plant.

Talent Acquisition Recruiter – Manufacturing

Employment Type: Contract (Approximately 6 Months)
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 7:30 AM – 4:00 PM
Primary Focus: High-Volume Manufacturing & Hourly Recruiting
Reporting Structure: Works under the day-to-day guidance of the Talent Acquisition Team Leader

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Recruiter to support a significant increase in hiring needs over the next six months.

This position will be responsible for managing full-cycle recruiting activities, with a primary focus on hourly manufacturing positions, including assemblers, machinists, stockroom associates, shipping personnel, and quality inspectors.

The ideal candidate will have experience recruiting in a manufacturing environment, managing multiple open requisitions, coordinating interviews, facilitating offers, and supporting pre-employment screening and onboarding activities.

This role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to build effective relationships with hiring managers and HR leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting activities for hourly manufacturing positions.

  • Create and manage job requisitions using the company's internal recruiting system.

  • Post open positions internally and through external job boards.

  • Review and screen candidate resumes to identify qualified applicants.

  • Present qualified candidates to hiring managers and department team leaders.

  • Coordinate and schedule panel interviews with hiring teams.

  • Actively participate in panel interviews and candidate evaluations.

  • Assess candidate qualifications against position requirements and hiring team expectations.

  • Maintain communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

Offer Management & Pre-Employment Screening

  • Collaborate with HR Generalists and HR Managers to coordinate employment offers.

  • Prepare and deliver offer documentation to selected candidates using Adobe Sign.

  • Coordinate pre-employment background checks and drug screenings.

  • Track candidate progress through the offer acceptance and screening process.

  • Communicate with HR team members to address outstanding hiring requirements.

  • Ensure accurate documentation and timely completion of recruiting activities.

Recruiting Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate records of open job requisitions and candidate statuses.

  • Track recruiting activity and provide regular hiring updates to HR Generalists and HR leadership.

  • Monitor hiring progress to support staffing goals and deadlines.

  • Organize and maintain recruitment documentation.

  • Prepare new hire orientation binders and related onboarding materials.

  • Support recruiting process improvements and administrative activities as needed.

Hiring Manager & HR Collaboration

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and team leaders to understand staffing requirements.

  • Develop a clear understanding of job qualifications, shift requirements, and operational expectations.

  • Provide timely updates regarding candidate availability, interview scheduling, and hiring progress.

  • Build strong working relationships with HR Generalists, HR Managers, and department leadership.

  • Ensure recruiting activities align with production schedules and workforce needs.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Recruiting Experience

  • Previous full-cycle recruiting experience, with an emphasis on hourly manufacturing positions.

  • Experience recruiting for roles such as:

    • Assemblers

    • Machinists

    • Stockroom and inventory personnel

    • Shipping and receiving associates

    • Quality inspectors

  • Experience creating job requisitions and posting positions through internal recruiting systems and external job boards.

  • Experience reviewing resumes, evaluating candidate qualifications, and coordinating interviews.

  • Familiarity with employment offer processes, background checks, and drug screenings.

  • Ability to manage multiple open requisitions in a high-volume hiring environment.

Manufacturing Industry Knowledge

  • Familiarity with manufacturing operations and production environments.

  • Understanding of workforce requirements involving:

    • Multiple shifts

    • Overtime expectations

    • Attendance requirements

    • Workplace safety standards

  • Ability to understand technical and operational job requirements.

  • Experience supporting hiring needs in fast-paced manufacturing environments.

job.title: Customer Service Rep
job.description:
Customer Service Representative – Call Center

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Work Environment: Fast-Paced Call Center / Distribution Center Support
Location Requirement: Local candidates only; relocation assistance is not available.

Position Overview

We are seeking a customer-focused and detail-oriented Customer Service Representative to support a high-volume, fast-paced call center environment.

This position is responsible for handling inbound customer calls, responding to inquiries, processing orders, and resolving customer concerns through multiple communication channels, including phone and email.

The ideal candidate will have previous customer service or call center experience, excellent computer skills, strong communication abilities, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering exceptional customer service.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service & Call Center Support

  • Handle a high volume of inbound customer calls using a multi-line telephone system.

  • Respond professionally to customer inquiries and requests via phone and email.

  • Provide accurate, timely, and courteous customer service in a fast-paced environment.

  • Assist customers with order inquiries, special requests, and general account-related questions.

  • Research and resolve customer concerns while maintaining a positive customer experience.

  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills when addressing customer issues.

Order Processing & Customer Requests

    • New and existing orders

    • Product substitutions

    • Product pickups

    • Returns and credits

  • Accurately enter and update customer information using computer systems.

  • Ensure customer requests are documented and processed correctly.

  • Provide timely follow-up on outstanding customer requests.

Administrative & Distribution Center Support

  • Assist various departments within the Distribution Center as needed.

  • Perform data entry and maintain accurate customer and order records.

  • Utilize computer applications and communication systems to support daily operations.

  • Collaborate with team members and internal departments to ensure efficient customer service.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.

Experience

  • Minimum of 6 months of experience in a call center environment required.

  • At least 6 months of experience performing data entry in a demanding customer service or call center setting.

  • Previous experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume customer service environment.

job.title: Project Tester - (Banking)
job.description:
Job Description:
This role will support multiple functions and processes within Lockbox in Payment and Deposit Operations, focusing primarily on working with Service and Support teams in procedure development, testing, and creating scripts for testing. Payment and Deposit Operations fosters a culture founded on accountability, teamwork, leadership, intellectual curiosity and a balanced foundation between work and personal life. As an analyst, you will develop industry expertise and detailed product knowledge, and drive execution of strategic initiatives.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Primary responsibility is providing operation support of Lockbox applications, and additional areas of support, as assigned. Job functions of an Operations analyst include:
Create, edit, and test application and operational procedures for Lockbox Operations and Support.
Write and execute test scripts for operational testing of applications in process improvement projects.
Performs business analysis for payment and deposit applications as assigned; applications can include mainframe, PC, distributed systems, databases, and/or web-based applications
Mine data from primary and secondary sources often using complex joins across multiple datasets.
Plays a leadership role in providing ongoing production support within Payment and Deposit Operations applications and processes; acts as first line of contact for user reported inquiries and problems; performs problem reporting, tracking, resolution, root cause analysis and identification of preventative measures.
Delivering high quality support and great service to our internal/external partners and clients.
Active participation and guidance as it relates to Lockbox, and the associated applications/systems, process initiatives and projects.
Translates business needs and requirements to Technology partners; translates technical material to the Loan, Payment, and Operational Services Process Areas and Lines of Business.
More broadly, analysts are expected to display the following skills and competencies:
Strong problem solving through ability to analyze qualitative, operational & financial data
Strong interpersonal, influencing and relationship building skills; must demonstrate the ability to work cross functionally with a variety of different personality types
Ability to concisely and effectively communicate with senior management
High degree of adaptability & intellectual curiosity, comfortable with ambiguity
Exceptional teamwork and collaboration

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience of ideally 2+ years in an operational or support environment
Attention to detail in documenting and implementing requirements
Highly organized, detail-oriented with the ability to thoroughly analyze and resolve issues
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to effectively manage change
Ability to stay on top of task assignments
Strong decision making and analytical skills
Ability to facilitate research and resolution of sometimes less-than-straight-forward issues
Strong aptitude to technology based tools and databases (i.e., Excel, Access, )
Interest, willingness and ability to assimilate information quickly and succinctly
Works well in a team-based environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
1-2 years of Operational Analyst experience
Technically savvy in relation to Windows systems and software
Experience in Excel and Jira with an ability to manage large data sets, creating summary views using pivots tables, data graphs/visualization

The Press Brake Operator is responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining press brake machinery to bend, form, and shape metal components according to specifications and production requirements. The ideal candidate will have experience reading blueprints, using precision measuring tools, and maintaining quality standards in a fast-paced production environment.

  • Conduct quality inspections to ensure parts meet specifications and tolerances.
  • Monitor machine performance and report any mechanical issues to maintenance or supervision.
  • Maintain accurate production records and complete required documentation.
  • Follow all safety procedures, company policies, and manufacturing standards.
  • Keep work area clean, organized, and free of safety hazards.
  • Assist with other production duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Previous experience operating a press brake machine preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings.
  • Experience using measuring tools and understanding tolerances.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Basic math and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to stand for extended periods during the shift.
  • Frequently lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds.

job.title: Accounting Specialist
job.description:
Accounting Specialist – Accounts Payable (AP)

Location: Iron Mountain, MI
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Employment Type: Contract
Contract Duration: Through February 2027

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Accounting Specialist – Accounts Payable (AP) to support daily accounts payable operations, invoice processing, vendor reconciliation, and financial recordkeeping.

Working under the direction of Accounting Coordinators, this position will be responsible for processing supplier invoices, resolving discrepancies, maintaining accurate accounting records, and ensuring timely payments.

The Accounting Specialist may also assist with month-end closing activities, project costing, audits, and special accounting projects. This role requires frequent communication with suppliers, employees, and internal business partners to resolve issues and ensure accurate financial transactions.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable & Invoice Processing

  • Process supplier invoices for payment using the company's ERP system, SyteLine.

  • Review and match supplier invoices with receiving documentation and purchase orders.

  • Perform three-way matching of invoices, purchase orders, and receiving records.

  • Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies related to purchase orders, receiving documentation, or payment amounts.

  • Obtain appropriate approvals for service invoices and non-purchase-order payments.

  • Assign accurate general ledger account codes to non-PO invoices.

  • Voucher invoices for payment in accordance with established accounting procedures.

  • Support weekly accounts payable processing activities.

  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of accounts payable transactions.

Vendor Reconciliation & Communication

  • Verify and reconcile vendor statements to ensure accuracy.

  • Respond to vendor inquiries regarding invoices, payments, and account discrepancies.

  • Research and resolve outstanding payment issues.

  • Collaborate with Purchasing, Receiving, and other internal departments to resolve accounts payable matters.

  • Escalate unresolved issues appropriately and provide timely follow-up.

  • Maintain professional relationships with vendors, employees, and internal business partners.

Accounting Support & Recordkeeping

  • Maintain accurate electronic filing systems for invoices and supporting documentation.

  • Ensure financial records are complete, organized, and accessible.

  • Assist with month-end closing activities as needed.

  • Support project costing and other accounting-related functions.

  • Assist with internal and external audits by gathering documentation and reconciling information.

  • Participate in special accounting projects and process improvement initiatives.

  • Perform additional accounting and administrative duties as assigned.

Education & Experience

  • Associate degree in Accounting or a related field preferred.

  • Minimum of 2 years of office or administrative experience required.

  • At least 1 year of accounting or accounts payable experience preferred.

  • Previous experience processing invoices, reconciling vendor accounts, or supporting accounts payable functions is desirable.

  • Experience working with ERP or accounting software preferred.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook.

  • Experience working with ERP or accounting software.

  • Familiarity with accounts payable processes, invoice processing, and vendor reconciliation.

  • Understanding of purchase orders, invoice matching, and accounting documentation.

  • Strong data entry skills with a high degree of accuracy.

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to research and resolve discrepancies efficiently.

  • Strong time management skills and ability to meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

  • Comfortable communicating with vendors, employees, and cross-functional departments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Infor SyteLine ERP.

  • Previous accounts payable or accounting support experience.

  • Experience with three-way invoice matching.

  • Familiarity with purchase order processing and non-PO invoice approvals.

  • Experience with vendor statement reconciliations.

  • Exposure to month-end close, general ledger coding, or accounting audits.

  • Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
Overview of Role:

The Material Handler receives, stores, picks, and moves materials to support warehouse operations, production, and customer orders. This position maintains accurate inventory records, operates equipment safely, and coordinates with warehouse and production teams to keep materials organized and available when needed.

What you will do:

  • Receive and inspect incoming shipments; verify item numbers and quantities, and report shortages, damage, or other discrepancies.
  • Load and unload vehicles, down-stack and separate mixed shipments, consolidate stock, and put materials away in designated locations.
  • Pick, pack, stage, and deliver materials for production and customer orders within required timeframes; verify items, quantities, and destinations.
  • Collect production returns, verify quantities and condition, and return unused materials to the correct storage locations.
  • Complete inventory transactions and supporting paperwork accurately and promptly when materials are received, moved, delivered, or returned.
  • Perform stock checks and cycle counts, help investigate discrepancies, and support inventory accuracy improvements.
  • Operate stand-up and sit-down forklifts, pallet jacks, and, as needed, a cherry picker when trained and authorized; perform required equipment checks.
  • Selected employees will also drive the company truck between 710 Blue Ribbon Parkway and 1 Sharpie Way for pickups and deliveries between facilities, subject to company driving authorization.
  • Coordinate material priorities with warehouse and production teams; communicate shortages, delays, and changes affecting scheduled work.
  • Maintain clean, organized storage and staging areas; follow health, safety, security, and material-handling procedures and report hazards or equipment damage.
  • Participate in cross-training and assist with other warehouse duties as assigned.

What we need from you:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 1 year of experience in warehouse or production environments.
  • Knowledge of material flow, inventory systems, and stock control.
  • Ability to lift, move, and handle materials safely.
  • Organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.

Work Environment:

This job works in a manufacturing environment, using various manufacturing equipment.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job the employee is required to stand for the entire shift, as well as the ability to bend, twist, push, pull, grasp. The employee is regularly required to speak or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

job.title: Lockbox Extractor - (Banking)
job.description:
Lockbox Operations Specialist – Mail Extraction & Data Entry

Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite – 5 Days per Week
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Experience Required: Entry-Level (0–1 Years)

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Lockbox Operations Specialist to support high-volume banking and payment processing operations.

This position focuses on opening and sorting incoming mail, extracting checks and payment documents, organizing and batching transactions, and performing accurate data entry in a fast-paced, production-driven environment.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong attention to detail, accurate 10-key data entry skills, reliability, and the ability to meet daily production goals while following established procedures.

This is a seasonal, fully onsite opportunity requiring consistent attendance, productivity, and the ability to work effectively within a team.

Key Responsibilities

Mail Processing & Document Extraction

  • Open incoming mail and extract paper invoices, checks, and payment documents.

  • Accurately separate and sort payment and non-payment documents for processing.

  • Review documents to ensure proper handling and organization.

  • Prepare, organize, and batch documents for subsequent processing.

  • Identify and communicate document discrepancies or processing issues to the Workflow Coordinator or Supervisor.

  • Follow established procedures for handling financial documents and sensitive information.

  • Maintain accuracy and efficiency while processing high volumes of incoming mail.

Data Entry & Transaction Processing

  • Perform high-volume data entry and 10-key processing with a high degree of speed and accuracy.

  • Enter, verify, and process transaction information according to established procedures.

  • Support monetary processing functions while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Ensure transactions and documentation are properly recorded, filed, and organized.

  • Meet established daily production, quality, and processing goals.

  • Identify errors or discrepancies and escalate issues appropriately.

  • Navigate multiple computer systems and applications to complete assigned tasks.

Banking Operations & Administrative Support

  • Perform routine operational and administrative tasks supporting banking and payment processing activities.

  • Follow defined procedures for filing, recording, processing, and organizing documentation.

  • Assist with reviewing documentation for completeness and accuracy.

  • Prepare routine reports and maintain processing records as assigned.

  • Support operations across banking functions, which may include:

    • Retail and small business banking

    • Credit card processing

    • Consumer and mortgage lending

    • Collections and recovery

    • Loan origination and auto finance

  • Escalate processing concerns or operational issues to management when necessary.

Cross-Training & Team Support

  • Participate in cross-training to support critical department functions, including:

    • Mail sorting

    • Document extraction

    • Data entry and keying

    • Reassociation

    • Transaction batching

  • Collaborate with team members to maintain workflow efficiency and meet production deadlines.

  • Adapt to changing workloads and departmental priorities.

  • Perform basic scheduled and non-scheduled maintenance functions as assigned.

  • Complete additional operational or administrative duties as needed.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • 0–1 years of experience in banking operations, mail processing, data entry, general office administration, or a related environment.

  • Entry-level candidates with strong attention to detail and data entry abilities are encouraged to apply.

  • Previous experience in a production-driven or high-volume processing environment is beneficial.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in 10-key data entry, with strong speed and accuracy.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when handling financial documents and transactions.

job.title: Blast Line Operator
job.description:
Blast Line Operator

Location: Youngstown, OH
Job Type: Full-Time
Shift: 2nd shift
$16/hr
Industry: Steel Manufacturing / Metal Fabrication

Job Summary

Local manufacturer is seeking a dependable Blast Line Operator to join their manufacturing team in Youngstown, OH. The Blast Line Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring equipment used to clean, prepare, and finish steel components prior to additional processing, painting, or fabrication.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on industrial work, is comfortable working around large steel products and machinery, and takes pride in maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Operate and monitor blast line equipment used to clean and prepare steel products.
  • Load and unload steel components onto and from the blast line.
  • Inspect materials before and after processing to ensure they meet quality standards.
  • Remove rust, scale, dirt, paint, and other surface contaminants from steel.
  • Monitor equipment operation and make basic adjustments as needed.
  • Maintain proper flow of material through the blast line to meet production requirements.
  • Identify equipment issues, abnormal noises, or operating conditions and report them to the supervisor.
  • Perform routine cleaning and housekeeping around the blast line and work area.
  • Follow all safety procedures, PPE requirements, and company policies.
  • Use hand tools and basic equipment as required.
  • Work closely with other production employees to maintain workflow and production goals.
  • Complete production and quality documentation as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Previous manufacturing, steel, production, or industrial experience preferred.
  • Ability to work in a physically demanding manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, and lift throughout the shift.
  • Ability to safely handle and work around large steel components.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Willingness to follow all safety procedures and wear required PPE.

Preferred:

  • Previous blast line, shot blast, abrasive blasting, or steel processing experience.
  • Experience operating industrial machinery.
  • Experience working with steel plate or fabricated steel products.
  • Forklift or overhead crane experience.
  • Experience using measuring tools and basic hand tools.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, and handling of materials.
  • Ability to lift and move materials weighing up to approximately 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to dust, noise, vibration, and varying temperatures.
  • Must be comfortable working around heavy machinery and large steel products.
  • Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment, including safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, and other PPE as required.

Work Environment

This is a heavy industrial manufacturing environment . Employees will work around steel products, production machinery, overhead material-handling equipment, noise, dust, and industrial temperatures. Safety is a priority, and all employees are expected to follow established safety procedures at all times.

job.title: Maintenance Mechanic I
job.description:
SW Title: Maintenance

Top Skills
Strong Mechanical Troubleshooting
Ability to diagnose equipment failures, identify root causes, and perform repairs with minimal supervision.
Strong mechanical reasoning and problem-solving skills are essential.
Hydraulic & Pneumatic Systems Experience
Experience troubleshooting and repairing hydraulic and pneumatic components, including pumps, valves, cylinders, and related systems.
Understanding of industrial fluid power systems and maintenance practices.
Powertrain, Conveyor & Fabrication Skills
Knowledge of chains, gears, bearings, conveyors, and power transmission equipment.
Ability to fabricate, modify, or repair parts and tools when needed to keep equipment running.

Highly Preferred: Previous corrugated manufacturing, paper mill, or industrial production maintenance experience.

Bonus Skills: Boiler experience, forklift operation, and rigging experience.

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Mechanic Technician to join a maintenance team supporting a large corrugated manufacturing operation. This role is responsible for troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining corrugator equipment and supporting systems to ensure safe and efficient production.
The ideal candidate will have strong mechanical troubleshooting skills, experience working with industrial equipment, and the ability to support a variety of machinery rather than specializing in a single area. Candidates from paper mills, corrugated facilities, manufacturing plants, or other industrial maintenance environments are highly encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Troubleshoot and repair production equipment and support systems
Perform preventive maintenance (PMs) and corrective maintenance activities
Maintain and repair hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Diagnose and repair conveyor, chain, gear, bearing, and power transmission equipment
Fabricate or modify tools, machine parts, and components as needed
Support equipment reliability and minimize production downtime
Operate forklifts and assist with occasional rigging activities
Perform maintenance across multiple machine types and production systems
Follow all safety, quality, and maintenance procedures
Top Skills & Qualifications
Required Skills
Strong mechanical troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
Experience with hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Knowledge of conveyors, chains, gears, bearings, and power transmission systems
Mechanical reasoning and root-cause analysis skills
Ability to read equipment issues and implement effective repairs
Preferred Experience
Corrugated manufacturing experience
Paper mill experience
Industrial manufacturing maintenance experience
Experience working on older or legacy equipment
Preventive maintenance experience
Bonus Qualifications
Boiler experience
Forklift experience
Rigging experience
Fabrication and welding experience
Equipment & Work Environment
The facility operates a large corrugator system and various supporting equipment, including:
Corrugator line
Roll stands and splicers
Conveyor systems
Banders
Shredder
Baler
Fanfold equipment
Hydraulic shears and slitters
Starch kitchen systems
Many machines are older and require hands-on troubleshooting, creativity, and fabrication skills to keep equipment operating efficiently.
Compensation
Compensation is based on skills, experience, and testing results under the United Steelworkers union pay structure.
Mechanic Technician: Starting at ***/hour
Mechanic Technician 2: Up to ***/hour
Final pay rate will be determined through an onsite skills assessment and evaluation of experience. This assessment will be completed during the interview.
Interview & Testing Process
One onsite interview with facility tour
Maintenance skills assessment conducted during or shortly after the interview
Testing results will determine placement and compensation level
Additional interview round only if necessary
Schedule
Shift Options
1st Shift: 5:45 AM - 2:00 PM
2nd Shift: 1:45 PM - 10:00 PM
3rd Shift: 9:45 PM - 6:00 AM
All shifts include a 15-minute paid overlap for shift handoff.
Current Hiring Need
The primary need is on 2nd and 3rd shifts, with the current opening focused on 3rd shift. Shift assignment may vary based on business needs and staffing requirements.
Training & Onboarding
All new hires will begin training on 1st shift alongside experienced technicians.
2nd Shift Assignments: Typically 1-2 weeks of training on days
3rd Shift Assignments: Typically up to 1 month of training on days
Training duration may vary based on the employee's experience and readiness to work independently.
What Makes a Strong Candidate?
Successful candidates will be:
Strong troubleshooters who can diagnose equipment issues independently
Comfortable working on a wide range of equipment
Experienced with hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Mechanically inclined and resourceful
Committed to preventive maintenance and equipment reliability
Adaptable in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Willing to learn specialized corrugated manufacturing equipment

Responsibilities also include handling service inquiries from employees, managers, and business-unit stakeholders to provide information and resolve issues.

job.title: Engineering Development Site Coordinator
job.description:
The Engineering Development Site Coordinator will provide coordination services supporting the transition, startup, operational readiness, and ongoing technical operations support activities associated with the Southlake Engineering Development Center. During the initial phase of the assignment, services provided will focus on equipment relocation, equipment installation, facility readiness projects, infrastructure implementation efforts, inventory establishment, material handling activities, and coordination of contractors, equipment suppliers, and service providers supporting the transition to Southlake.

As the Southlake facility becomes operational, the scope of the assignment will transition toward ongoing technical operations support activities that enable engineering development, prototyping, equipment evaluation, and capability-building efforts conducted within the facility. These services will include coordination of equipment logistics, inventory and asset tracking, material receiving and movement, facility organization and housekeeping activities, equipment documentation support, and support of safety and environmental compliance activities.

The role will facilitate coordination among engineering teams, facilities personnel, contractors, equipment suppliers, and service providers to support the execution of planned projects, installations, and operational activities. The assignment may also provide technical documentation support, including maintenance of engineering drawing packages, document retention activities, and support of records maintained within AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor, Vault, or similar engineering documentation systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical operations background and be comfortable working within industrial, manufacturing, pilot, engineering development, or research environments while supporting multiple concurrent projects and initiatives.

This assignment will support transition, relocation, readiness, startup, and ongoing technical operations activities associated with the Southlake Engineering Development Center. Services provided through this assignment include coordination of equipment relocation and installation activities, facility readiness efforts, infrastructure implementation support, material handling, inventory and asset tracking, contractor coordination, engineering documentation support, and safety and environmental compliance support activities. The assignment is expected to evolve from an initial focus on facility transition and readiness efforts toward ongoing support of day-to-day engineering development center operations and capability-building activities.

• Minimum 7 years of experience supporting manufacturing, technical operations, facilities, maintenance, engineering support, industrial project implementation, equipment installation, facility startup, contractor coordination, or industrial infrastructure projects. (Required)

• Experience operating industrial material handling equipment and willingness to obtain required forklift and scissor-lift certifications immediately upon assignment if not currently certified; familiarity with inventory management systems, material logistics, and asset tracking. (Required)

• Working knowledge of industrial safety practices, environmental compliance requirements, waste management processes, and Microsoft Office applications in industrial or technical environments. (Required)

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, Facilities Management, Operations Management, or related technical discipline and experience with AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor, Vault, or similar engineering drawing and document management systems. (Preferred)

Note:
Preference will be given to an Food and Beverage family of companies retiree with an engineering, manufacturing/production operations, maintenance, or facilities background who brings practical industry knowledge and general understanding of the organizational ways of working.

Top 3 Skills:
1) Industrial equipment & facility coordination (equipment moves/installs, facility readiness, infrastructure implementation)
2) Technical operations & material handling (forklift/scissor-lift operation, material receiving & movement, general parts/inventory management & upkeep, assurance and records management for safety & environment requirements)
3) Project coordination & technical documentation (coordination with other contractors/vendors for site efforts, technical project execution for equipment changes)

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Staff Accountant to support accounting operations, month-end close activities, financial analysis, and account reconciliations.

This position will perform accounting activities for an assigned business unit while providing backup support to the Accounting Manager and Cost Accountant. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, and ERP systems, including NetSuite.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, analytical, and capable of managing multiple accounting responsibilities while meeting strict financial reporting deadlines.

Position Details

  • Location: Westbury, NY

  • Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite

  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

  • Employment Type: Temporary to Hire

Key Responsibilities

General Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Support the monthly financial close process for the assigned business unit.

  • Prepare and post journal entries, including:

    • Accruals

    • Depreciation expense

    • Amortization expense

    • Deferred revenue recognition

  • Perform general accounting activities to support accurate financial reporting.

  • Provide backup accounting support for the Accounting Manager and Cost Accountant.

  • Ensure accounting transactions are recorded accurately and in accordance with established procedures.

Account Reconciliations & Financial Analysis

  • Support Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control and compliance requirements.

  • Partner with accounting and finance teams to maintain effective accounting and reporting processes.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen financial controls and improve reporting accuracy.

  • Support the implementation of accounting process improvements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Collaborate with accounting and finance teams across the organization.

  • Provide financial analysis and recommendations to support accounting decisions.

  • Assist with resolving accounting discrepancies and process-related issues.

  • Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills when discussing financial matters.

  • Support improvements to accounting processes and reporting procedures.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting required.

Accounting Knowledge & Experience

  • Strong understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

  • Knowledge of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and compliance requirements.

  • Experience supporting month-end close activities.

  • Experience preparing and posting journal entries.

  • Knowledge of accrual accounting, depreciation, amortization, and deferred revenue recognition.

  • Experience preparing general ledger account reconciliations.

  • Strong financial analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working within an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) environment, including NetSuite.

Technical Skills

  • NetSuite ERP

  • Journal entry preparation and posting

  • Account reconciliations

  • Month-end close procedures

  • Financial transaction analysis

  • GAAP accounting principles

  • SOX internal controls and compliance

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to manage multiple accounting tasks simultaneously.

  • Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies and implement corrective actions.

  • Sound judgment and independent decision-making.

  • Strong collaboration and teamwork skills.

  • Commitment to accounting accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement.

job.description:

job.title: Electrician - 2nd shift
job.description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform a variety of maintenance, repairs, continuous improvement, and new installation functions on plant equipment and machinery with limited direction and guidance. Support manufacturing operations in a spirit of teamwork and cooperation. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely fashion. Safely, professionally and efficiently, complete wiring projects and new installations per electrical line-up and documentation. Competencies:

  • Knowledge of industrial, mechanical and electrical codes, techniques and standards. Familiarity with government regulations for industry, and safe work practices dealing with high voltage circuits.
  • Must have strong background in electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, robotic arms, and overall machine troubleshooting skills.
  • Skilled understanding and experience with electrical schematics and ladder diagrams. Expertise with meters and diagnostic instruments used to evaluate electrical systems, both low and high voltage and AC/DC circuits.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, specify and gather material and complete wiring installation or repairs with minimal supervision.
  • Familiarity with complex machinery, electrical circuits and plant operating equipment. Should maintain a sense of urgency, self-motivation and overall good work ethic while performing tasks in a safe manner.
  • Skilled in interpersonal relations and written and oral communications.


Key Responsibilities/Deliverables:
1. Troubleshoot and repair machinery and equipment with minimal supervision using safe electrical techniques, schematics and diagnostic instruments. Perform mechanical functions and incidental work as needed to achieve assigned task. Verify equipment as functional and leave the area clean and safe.
2. Operate in response to requests by maintenance supervisor or support personnel, and set priorities as required to maximize equipment uptime.
3. Gather and maintain a complete set of required tools, including electrical meters and diagnostic devices. Utilize diagnostic tools and electrical schematics to define problem areas and assist with resolution. Develop PLC skills to troubleshoot controls related issues.
4. Participate in preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve operational uptime and equipment life. Recommend improvements and/or changes to PM systems/tasks when applicable.
5. Follow designated work instructions as outlined for specific functions. These include, but are not limited to; PM work orders, continuous improvement tasks, new installation line-ups and repair/refurbish assignments.
6. Update drawings/prints, suggest spare parts and suitable replacements, run conduit/wire-way and power drops. Build, label and wire panels/boxes in a professional manner per line-up and schematics.
7. Follow standard practices and governmental regulations and laws relating to powered equipment.
8. Perform other related duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and management.

Education Required/Preferred: High School Diploma or equivalent. Electrical Journeyman's card or equivalent work experience. Ability to pass an Electrician aptitude test.

job.title: Coordinator, Administrative Services
job.description:
Project Administrator / Project Coordinator

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Project Administrator / Project Coordinator to provide administrative, financial, procurement, and project coordination support throughout the project lifecycle.

This position is responsible for maintaining project records, tracking budgets and expenditures, supporting procurement activities, coordinating project documentation, and ensuring accurate reporting across project management and financial systems.

The ideal candidate will have experience in project administration, project coordination, procurement, finance, or a related field, along with strong Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

The role also involves independently coordinating equipment-only capital projects, including procurement, scheduling, budget tracking, stakeholder communication, and project closeout.

Key Responsibilities

Project Administration & Coordination

  • Create, update, and maintain project records within project management and financial systems.

  • Support project setup activities, including funding requests and authorization documentation.

  • Maintain project forecasts, expenditure reports, and spending status trackers.

  • Assist project teams with monthly forecasting, budgeting, and financial updates.

  • Coordinate and maintain project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support project closeout activities, including documentation, financial reconciliation support, and records retention.

  • Ensure project information is accurate, organized, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.

Financial Management & Cost Tracking

  • Track project expenditures and maintain financial forecasting spreadsheets.

  • Download, compile, review, and distribute project spending reports.

  • Update financial reports using current expenditure data and forecast information.

  • Process cost transfers and other project-related financial transactions.

  • Monitor project funding approvals, expenditures, and budget status.

  • Identify discrepancies and coordinate with appropriate teams to resolve financial reporting issues.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project financial documentation.

Procurement & Supplier Coordination

  • Create, submit, and track purchase requisitions.

  • Coordinate Service Entry Sheets (SES) and Goods Receipts (GR).

  • Assist with invoice processing, supplier payment inquiries, and purchasing documentation.

  • Partner with Procurement and Finance teams to resolve purchasing and payment issues.

  • Follow up with buyers regarding purchase orders, requisitions, and procurement status.

  • Monitor purchasing approval workflows and help expedite approvals when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate procurement records and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding items.

Systems Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain project data and documentation within SAP, EcoSys, SharePoint, and other project management systems.

  • Create, organize, and maintain project SharePoint sites, folders, and documentation repositories.

  • Generate project status reports, financial reports, and administrative tracking documents.

  • Ensure data consistency and accuracy across project controls, procurement, and financial systems.

  • Support project teams with reporting, document management, and system-related administrative tasks.

Equipment & Capital Project Coordination

  • Independently coordinate equipment-only capital projects from initial purchasing through project closeout.

  • Track project schedules, budgets, procurement activities, and supporting documentation.

  • Communicate project progress, updates, and outstanding action items to stakeholders.

  • Coordinate with Project Management, Procurement, Finance, Operations, and suppliers to support successful project execution.

  • Identify potential project risks, delays, or issues and proactively coordinate resolution.

  • Ensure assigned projects remain organized, properly documented, and aligned with established timelines and requirements.

Required Qualifications

Education

- High school diploma or GED equivalent.

Professional Experience

- Minimum of 2 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Project coordination or project administration

  • Procurement or purchasing support

  • Finance or financial administration

  • Construction administration

  • Facilities management

  • Related administrative or project support functions

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, and SharePoint.

  • Experience maintaining spreadsheets, tracking financial information, and preparing reports.

  • Ability to accurately manage project records, financial data, and supporting documentation.

  • Strong computer skills and ability to navigate multiple business systems.

job.title: Electrician - 3rd shift
job.description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Perform a variety of maintenance, repairs, continuous improvement, and new installation functions on plant equipment and machinery with limited direction and guidance. Support manufacturing operations in a spirit of teamwork and cooperation. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely fashion. Safely, professionally and efficiently, complete wiring projects and new installations per electrical line-up and documentation. Competencies:

  • Knowledge of industrial, mechanical and electrical codes, techniques and standards. Familiarity with government regulations for industry, and safe work practices dealing with high voltage circuits.
  • Must have strong background in electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, robotic arms, and overall machine troubleshooting skills.
  • Skilled understanding and experience with electrical schematics and ladder diagrams. Expertise with meters and diagnostic instruments used to evaluate electrical systems, both low and high voltage and AC/DC circuits.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, specify and gather material and complete wiring installation or repairs with minimal supervision.
  • Familiarity with complex machinery, electrical circuits and plant operating equipment. Should maintain a sense of urgency, self-motivation and overall good work ethic while performing tasks in a safe manner.
  • Skilled in interpersonal relations and written and oral communications.


Key Responsibilities/Deliverables:
1. Troubleshoot and repair machinery and equipment with minimal supervision using safe electrical techniques, schematics and diagnostic instruments. Perform mechanical functions and incidental work as needed to achieve assigned task. Verify equipment as functional and leave the area clean and safe.
2. Operate in response to requests by maintenance supervisor or support personnel, and set priorities as required to maximize equipment uptime.
3. Gather and maintain a complete set of required tools, including electrical meters and diagnostic devices. Utilize diagnostic tools and electrical schematics to define problem areas and assist with resolution. Develop PLC skills to troubleshoot controls related issues.
4. Participate in preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve operational uptime and equipment life. Recommend improvements and/or changes to PM systems/tasks when applicable.
5. Follow designated work instructions as outlined for specific functions. These include, but are not limited to; PM work orders, continuous improvement tasks, new installation line-ups and repair/refurbish assignments.
6. Update drawings/prints, suggest spare parts and suitable replacements, run conduit/wire-way and power drops. Build, label and wire panels/boxes in a professional manner per line-up and schematics.
7. Follow standard practices and governmental regulations and laws relating to powered equipment.
8. Perform other related duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and management.

Education Required/Preferred: High School Diploma or equivalent. Electrical Journeyman's card or equivalent work experience. Ability to pass an Electrician aptitude test.
