job.title: Senior Financial Analyst - Distribution
job.description:
The Financial Analyst - Distribution role serves as a strategic business partner to the distribution and logistics teams. This role drives operational excellence by delivering financial analysis, forecasting, and insights that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and support decision-making across the supply chain. The analyst will play a pivotal role in translating data into actionable recommendations, developing KPI dashboards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners to optimize performance.

Hybrid - (4-in, 1-remote)
Base pay up to $135K based on experience

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely financial reports for supply chain functions (distribution, logistics, and inventory).
  • Conduct variance and trend analyses to identify cost drivers, risks, and opportunities for efficiency/profitability improvements.
  • Conduct variance analyses for freight and duty actuals vs standard
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close processes, including accruals, reconciliations, and variance commentary.
  • Develop Monthly Inventory reporting to capture inventory and SKU data by division by aging bucket including SKU productivity metrics.
  • Develop financial models to evaluate warehouse performance, capital investments, and operational initiatives.

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting for supply chain operations, including operating expenses, capital expenditures, and unit flows by division by order type.
  • Review and update distribution forecasts based on changing supply and demand conditions-unit flows
  • Monitor performance against forecasts, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support long-range financial planning and scenario modeling to assess operational strategies.
  • Assist with warehouse labor planning (permanent and temporary

KPI & Dashboard Development

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards to track KPIs for distribution, logistics, and inventory functions.
  • Partner with IT and operations teams to extract and structure data from multiple sources, ensuring integrity and consistency.
  • Train stakeholders on dashboard use and interpretation to strengthen data-driven decision-making.

Business Partnership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Distribution Center management, logistics leaders, and division finance/sales teams.
  • Implement recurring monthly/quarterly cross functional meetings to review financial performance and KPI's to discuss trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate financial data into insights for non-financial stakeholders, supporting cost savings and operational improvements.
  • Participate in strategic projects, supplier negotiations, and inventory optimization initiatives.

Process Improvement & Operational Support

  • Evaluate and enhance financial reporting and planning processes for efficiency and automation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs, improve service levels, and optimize distribution and operations network.
  • Support compliance, internal controls, and best practices in financial management

Qualifications & Experience

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in financial or operational analysis supporting distribution center operations.
  • Hands-on experience analyzing distribution center KPIs, including cost per unit (CPU), unit flow, throughput, labor productivity, and capacity utilization.
  • Proven ability to analyze and forecast inbound and outbound unit flows across freight and distribution operations.
  • Experience performing SKU-level analysis to evaluate productivity, shipment trends, and operational efficiency.
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, large data sets, dashboard creation) and experience with Power BI or similar BI tools to build operational dashboards and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of distribution, logistics, and inventory flow, including the operational drivers behind cost and efficiency in a DC environment.
  • Experience supporting labor tracking and distribution center optimization initiatives, including monitoring labor productivity and cost per unit metrics.
  • Ability to translate operational data into actionable insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional partners.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with distribution, logistics, inventory planning, and operations teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills with a proactive, continuous improvement mindset.

JOB DESCRIPTION
*** Research Laboratories (MRL) in Cambridge, MA, is a collaborative research hub focused on discovering innovative medicines that improve human health. The Retinal and Vascular Biology group is seeking a motivated bench scientist with strong experimental research experience.
This one-year contractor position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of therapeutics for retinal diseases while working closely with multidisciplinary teams across MRL Cambridge, MRL South San Francisco, and the broader *** research network.
The successful candidate will be an experienced and motivated bench scientist with extensive industry experience in in vitro biochemical and cell-based assay development and execution.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biological Sciences
A minimum of 5 years of industry experience in in vitro biochemical and cell-based assay development and execution, including compound handling and screening workflows.

Strong hands-on laboratory experience in cell culture and cellular biology techniques.
Industry experience in the development and execution of in vitro assays to support compound screening, validation, optimization, data analysis, and interpretation.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong ability to analyze data and communicate scientific findings effectively.
High level of motivation, curiosity, and passion for scientific research.

PREFERRED SKILLS
Familiarity with retinal biology, vascular biology, and inflammation.
Experience with primary endothelial or retinal epithelial cell culture.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES
Perform highly complex in vitro assays to evaluate endothelial biology, including barrier function, transport, angiogenesis, differentiation, and specialization.
Culture and maintain primary and immortalized cells used in in vitro assays.
Routinely test compounds represent diverse mechanisms of action and characterize their pharmacological activity.
Analyze, interpret, and present experimental data to project teams.
Optimize and develop in vitro vascular integrity assays.
Participate in team meetings and scientific discussions related to retinal disease and therapeutic target discovery.
Maintain accurate and detailed records in electronic laboratory notebooks and adhere to safe laboratory practices.

job.title: Accounts Receivable Support Representative
job.description:
Accounts Receivable Specialist (Entry Level)

Location: Framingham, MA (Onsite)

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Openings: 6


Position Overview

We are seeking motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our Accounts Receivable team in an entry-level role. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to transition into accounting or finance from customer-facing positions such as retail, hospitality, restaurants, or call centers.

While prior Accounts Receivable or collections experience is preferred, it is not required. The ideal candidate will possess strong customer service skills, excellent communication abilities, and a desire to build a career in finance.

This is a long-term contract opportunity with the potential for full-time conversion based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Collect payments on outstanding Accounts Receivable balances.
  • Follow up with customers regarding past-due invoices until payment resolution is achieved.
  • Research outstanding balances and reconcile customer payment remittances.
  • Resolve billing discrepancies and Accounts Receivable issues promptly.
  • Escalate complex issues to the Team Lead as appropriate.
  • Minimize bad debt while maximizing cash collections.
  • Adhere to established Accounts Receivable procedures, service level agreements, and departmental goals.
  • Support credit review activities, cash application, and account maintenance.

Customer Service

  • Maintain positive relationships with customers while collecting outstanding balances.
  • Communicate professionally with customers regarding invoices and payment status.
  • Negotiate payment plans or settlements for significantly past-due accounts when appropriate.
  • Deliver outstanding customer service while balancing collection objectives.

Account Analysis & Reporting

  • Perform account reconciliations and investigate payment discrepancies.
  • Conduct root cause analysis to identify and resolve customer account issues.
  • Prepare reports, account statements, and other customer documentation as requested.
  • Present account reconciliation findings to internal teams and customers.
  • Host conference calls with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve outstanding issues.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Service, Credit, and other internal departments to resolve customer issues.
  • Build strong relationships with internal teams and external customers.
  • Develop an understanding of customer ordering platforms and billing processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve billing and collection processes.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 0–2 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit, Collections, Customer Service, or a related field, or an Associate's or Bachelor's degree.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Basic to intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365.

Preferred

  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle or SAP.
  • Experience using collection software (WebCollect, GetPaid, or similar).
  • Understanding of accounting principles.
  • Knowledge of credit management processes.
  • Familiarity with billing and invoicing procedures.

Ideal Candidate

Candidates from the following backgrounds are encouraged to apply:

  • Customer Service
  • Retail
  • Call Center
  • Restaurant
  • Hospitality
  • Banking
  • Administrative Support
  • Office Administration
  • Entry-Level Accounting

job.description:
Job Title: Food Production Line Lead
Location: Missouri City, TX
Shifts: 12 hour shifts 3- 45 Days a week.
Pay: $20.00 – $21.00 / hour (+ Overtime Opportunities)

About the Role
Nesco Resource is hiring a hands-on Food Production Line Lead for a leading food manufacturing facility in Missouri City, TX. In this key floor leadership role, you will guide a line team of roughly 25 associates to keep production running safely, smoothly, and on schedule. If you enjoy working side-by-side with a team, know how to troubleshoot packaging or processing equipment, and take pride in food safety, this is a great step forward in your manufacturing career.
What You'll Do

  • Guide the Team: Train, mentor, and assign daily workstations to ~25 production associates to hit daily output targets.
  • Keep Lines Moving: Assist with line startups, product changeovers, shutdowns, and basic machine adjustments to minimize downtime.
  • Uphold Safety & Quality: Model and enforce Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), HACCP standards, and workplace safety rules on the floor.
  • Coordinate Operations: Communicate with Maintenance, Quality Assurance (QA), and Warehouse teams to resolve bottlenecks quickly.
  • Track Line Performance: Log daily production counts, downtime notes, and shift handoff reports.
Required Qualifications
  • Floor Leadership Experience: 1+ years of experience as a Line Lead, Lead Operator, or Senior Associate guiding teams in food manufacturing, packaging, or high-speed production.
  • Food Safety Knowledge: Solid working understanding of GMPs, allergen controls, and food safety compliance.
  • Hands-On Technical Skills: Ability to operate, clear jams, and perform basic troubleshooting on food processing or packaging machinery.
  • Shift Flexibility: Willingness to work 1st or 2nd shift as production needs require.
  • Communication: Clear communicator with the ability to motivate a diverse floor team in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with HACCP, Lean Manufacturing, or 5S practices.
  • Experience tracking production KPIs and shift output metrics.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a strong plus.

job.title: Automation Technician
job.description:
Automation Engineering Technician Lead $36-$49/hr
Rochester Area

Scope: This role is essential for maintaining the site's manufacturing operations, ensuring equipment reliability, and leading maintenance efforts to improve productivity and minimize operational disruptions.

Job Summary: Primary focus on sustaining site manufacturing processes and leading shift maintenance team members in execution of equipment return to standard and preventive maintenance activities. Is the escalation path for maintenance individuals within the working shift. Conducts smaller scale process improvement projects supporting various site initiatives.

Essential Functions & Accountabilities:

  • Continuous Improvement Initiatives / Activities
    • Understands site Key Business Metrics to drive focused improvements. Applies statistical problem-solving tools to implement robust solutions that are verified and/or validated.
    • Define, Plan, & Execute improvement initiatives within the site and within SOP guidelines. Adherence to verification/validation (IQ, OQ, PQ) protocols is required.
    • Design & dimension component details in support of automated equipment improvements.
    • Works frequently with external vendors, site Engineers & other CooperVision sites to improve site manufacturing processes.
    • Effectively able to understand, and describe, automated process flows to facilitates improvements to automated logic control systems.
  • Troubleshoot, Repair, and Maintenance for all production equipment.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex Electrical, Mechanical, & Controls issues on various automated manufacturing cells.
  • Significant knowledge of various Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC's), with ability to interpret logic in resolving complex equipment and process issues.
  • Interpret and apply written specifications, schematic drawings, parts lists, prints and sketches, to installation, maintenance, and repair of equipment.
  • Effectively communicates, both verbal and written, with shift team, management and other support groups.
  • Minimize lost time incidents through escalation to various support groups, both internal & external.
  • Provides on-shift leadership support to manufacturing maintenance personnel to include, but not limited to, training, employee relations, performance reviews, and discipline. Will provide feedback to Senior Engineering Manager in relation to hiring and termination decisions.
  • Identifies and addresses developmental needs for individuals and provides training and coaching as appropriate. Partners with Human Resources as needed.
  • Direct focus coaching and developing maintenance team members in return to standard and preventive maintenance of automated equipment/processes. Secondary focus on coaching manufacturing technicians in the flow of various automated processes.
  • Ensures shift team members effectively complete preventative maintenance events prior to due dates, supporting all site manufacturing equipment. All related documentation is completed accurately and legibly in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  • Provides documentation updates for electrical and mechanical drawings as needed to sustain accurate prints, in support of various manufacturing cells, including electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and mechanical details.
  • Completes periodic review and/or approval of equipment maintenance SOP procedures, and work instruction. Coaches shift maintenance team individuals in the update and development of SOP procedure.
  • Able to provide leadership support, as needed, for facility related issues, during normal working hours, to sustain, or return flow to key manufacturing processes. (ex. Power Outage, Water leaks, Weather, other...)
  • As business needs dictate, works extended hours to complete daily department goals or tasks to include mandatory overtime.
  • Perform other duties as directed by department manager or shift supervisor.

Travel:
This position does not require travel.

Qualifications
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  • Notable PLC controls experience required, skilled in accessing PLC content to efficiently resolve process/equipment issues. (Allen Bradley preferred)
  • Demonstrated electrical problem-solving abilities. (control up to 480 VAC)
  • MS Office Experience required.
  • Industrial Robots, Vision &/or Laser marking experience preferred.
  • Experience adhering to Standard Operating Procedures and Regulatory requirements in the manufacturing of medical devices is preferred.
  • Machining & Fabrication experience desired.
  • Previous leadership responsibilities desired.
  • Exhibits excellent communication skills – verbal, written, and comprehension of the English language.

Work Environment:
  • Primary environments include clean manufacturing area supporting medical device manufacturing, with secondary office type environment.
  • Exposure to various chemicals or solvents commonly used in sustaining automated equipment.
  • Physical Requirements:
  • Standing, Walking - 50-75%
  • Sitting, Climbing, Bending, Stooping, Kneeling, Crouching, Twisting, Reading overhead
  • Finger/wrist dexterity, Hand/eye coordination, Grasping/pinching
  • Lifting up to 50 lbs.

Experience:
  • 7 - 10 years of experience in resolving and maintain automated equipment processes, including PLC (controls), electrical, mechanical &/or related competencies.

Education: Associate degree or equivalent technical certification (completion of an apprenticeship program, military program or trade school) with 7 years of experience is preferred.

job.title: Civil Designer / Civil 3D Designer
job.description:
We are seeking a Civil Designer or Civil 3D Designer to support industrial engineering and design projects in Houston, TX.

The ideal candidate will have experience with grading, drainage, site layouts, and three-dimensional modeling using AutoCAD Civil 3D. Candidates with a piping design background using CADWorx or AVEVA E3D will also be considered, particularly if they have experience interpreting engineering drawings and modeling piping systems at specified slopes and elevations.

This position is well suited for an early-career to mid-level designer who is technically capable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and modify civil design drawings and 3D models for industrial facilities.

  • Assist with site grading, drainage, and underground utility layouts.

  • Use AutoCAD Civil 3D to develop and revise grading and drainage models.

  • Interpret engineering plans, drawings, elevations, and design specifications.

  • Model piping and underground utility systems at appropriate slopes and elevations.

  • Coordinate with Civil, Piping, Structural, and other engineering disciplines.

  • Review drawings and models for accuracy, consistency, and potential interferences.

  • Incorporate engineering markups and design revisions.

  • Prepare drawings and design deliverables in accordance with project standards.

  • Support senior engineers and designers throughout project development.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–6 years of relevant civil design, piping design, or industrial CAD experience preferred.

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering plans, drawings, and elevation information.

  • Demonstrated ability to accurately model piping or utility systems on a slope.

  • Working experience with at least one relevant 3D design platform, such as Civil 3D, CADWorx, or AVEVA E3D.

  • Understanding of grading, drainage, underground utilities, or piping layout concepts.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Ability to follow design standards and incorporate engineering revisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D for grading and drainage design.

  • Experience with CADWorx or AVEVA E3D for piping and utility modeling.

  • Previous experience supporting industrial, oil and gas, chemical, or EPC projects.

  • Familiarity with underground piping, drainage systems, and site development.

  • Associate degree in Drafting, CAD Technology, Civil Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a practical, hands-on designer who can accurately interpret drawings, understand elevations and slopes, and produce reliable 3D models.

Candidates do not need to be senior-level engineers. We are particularly interested in individuals who have strong CAD skills, can work independently on assigned design tasks, and are comfortable supporting civil or piping-related deliverables.

job.title: Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Marketing Coordinator – Customer Education

Location: Charlotte, NC
Schedule: Hybrid – 3 days onsite / 2 days remote
Hours: 40 hours per week

Position Overview

The Marketing Coordinator – Customer Education supports the development and execution of marketing programs and customer education initiatives that promote product awareness, solutions, and services. These programs include both hands-on and virtual educational offerings designed to increase customer engagement, product adoption, and brand loyalty.

This role works closely with the Manager of Customer Education and cross-functional teams to develop training content, coordinate education programs, manage event logistics, and support marketing initiatives across multiple market segments including In-Building Networks, Data Centers, and Carrier markets.

The Customer Education team operates globally, requiring collaboration across regions to ensure training content and program delivery remain consistent and aligned with business objectives.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Manager, Customer Education

Key Responsibilities

Customer Education Program Support

  • Support the growth and maintenance of the customer training program aligned with global marketing initiatives.

  • Assist with the development and execution of customer education strategies and annual training plans.

  • Coordinate both live and virtual training events supporting sales and marketing initiatives.

Training & Content Development

  • Collaborate with subject matter experts in engineering, product management, and marketing to develop training materials and curriculum.

  • Assist with instructional design and development of educational content.

  • Help maintain product samples and training equipment used for course instruction.

Event Planning & Logistics

  • Coordinate logistics for customer education classes, seminars, and training events.

  • Work with distribution branch managers and sales engineers to organize live training programs nationwide.

  • Support hands-on seminars, paid classes, and field-level education events.

Marketing & Promotion

  • Build promotional campaigns using social media, marketing automation tools, and traditional marketing channels.

  • Promote training events through inbound and outbound marketing initiatives.

  • Assist in maintaining marketing materials and communication assets.

Program Administration & Reporting

  • Maintain training certifications and education records for program participants.

  • Track and report on customer education program performance and outcomes.

  • Support ongoing improvements to program databases and internal processes.

Customer & Partner Support

  • Provide basic support to program members and training participants.

  • Build and maintain relationships with external vendors and partners.

  • Manage event registration and reporting through event management software.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in:

    • Marketing

    • Communications

    • Event planning

    • Training coordination or program support

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with training programs or instructional coordination

  • Familiarity with fiber optic networks is a plus

Required Skills

  • Strong planning and organizational skills

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Ability to analyze data and generate reports

  • Problem-solving and resourcefulness

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams

Technical Skills / Software

Candidates should be comfortable using the following tools:

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • SharePoint

  • Salesforce

  • Marketing Automation Platforms (Marketo)

  • Webinar Platforms (Adobe Connect, WebEx Event Center)

  • Social Media Platforms (LinkedIn)

  • Event Management Software (Cvent)

  • Presentation tools

job.title: 3rd Shift Production Operator
job.description:
Overview

Become an integral part of our team, contributing to the assembly, inspection, and sequencing of panoramic sunroof and roof modules for automotive production. This position involves working in a fast-paced environment closely aligned with vehicle production schedules.

Responsibilities

  • Assembly & Mechanical Work
    • Assemble sunroof components using torque-controlled screwdrivers and pneumatic tools.
    • Apply weatherstripping, seals, and adhesives to glass and frame edges.
    • Secure wiring harnesses and connect sensors/actuators for vehicle network integration.
  • Testing & Quality Control
    • Perform cycle and function testing on assembled roofs using automated test fixtures.
    • Verify glass panel alignment and inspect for leaks and cosmetic imperfections.
  • Sequencing & Material Handling
    • Load finished roof modules into racks or carts, matching the assembly line schedule.
    • Manage sub-components, scan barcodes, and address part defects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a manufacturing or production environment, particularly in the automotive sector.
  • Familiarity with Just-in-Time (JIT) and Just-in-Sequence (JIS) processes.

job.title: Process Engineer
job.description:
PROCESS ENGINEER $75k-$115k Onsite
Rochester Area

Scope: Provides technical support for a variety of manufacturing processes to help achieve the targeted performance levels for the overall site and wider business objectives.

Job Summary: Provides manufacturing process and project engineering support including process development and continuous improvement activities. Supports the wider business in the introduction of new products and automated processes into manufacturing.

Essential Functions & Accountabilities:

  • Supports the installation, development, and validation of manufacturing processes from concept to implementation.
  • Provides on-going support and monitoring to the manufacturing organization in achieving objectives in respect of process performance, yield, cost, and product quality.
  • Identifies process problems to gain root cause, evaluating data from a variety of sources, formulates alternative solutions, selects, and implements the best solution.
  • Undertakes troubleshooting activities where issues arise across various manufacturing disciplines providing corrective action to resolve disruptions.
  • Seeks to identify areas for Improvement in process yield, cost, and product quality. Undertakes improvement activity and the implementation of improvements across manufacturing operations as appropriate.
  • Helps develop and maintain production related documentation, ensuring documents are accurate, up to date and reflect current GMP (cGMP).
  • Supports process and product validation activities including the construction and delivery of validation protocols and reports. Ensures that the validation process and procedures are fit for purpose and compliant with current regulatory requirements.
  • Assists in the receiving of new products and processes into manufacture to ensure the most efficient transfer.
  • Supports manufacturing improvement events driving Lean initiatives to improving processes utilizing various toolbox items. (6S, VSM, Kaizen, Visual Mgmt, Poka-yoke, 3P, ...)
  • Conduct analysis for space optimization and maintains equipment / manufacturing layouts.
  • Always considers the potential business impact of specific actions and decisions for the company, and consistently directs efforts to preserve and enhance its business position.
  • Travel Requirements : Minimal travel may be required but not likely, estimated at 1-2 weeks per year.

Qualifications
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
High volume Manufacturing process engineering and optimization experience.
• Experienced in defining and optimization of manufacturing processes, including creation of appropriate documentation, with demonstrated results in the following areas:
o Lean manufacturing
o Continuous improvement
o OEE
o Risk management
o DMAIC
• Experienced in the installation and transfer of automated manufacturing equipment into production according to medical device regulations.
• Validation experience including FAT, SAT, IQ-OQ-PQ, process characterization, producing detailed reports.
• Knowledge of Quality Assurance and Quality Control systems, ideally from medical device/pharmaceutical industry, GAMP and appropriate regulatory requirements.
• Health and Safety awareness in respect of safe working practice, use of equipment/guarding, mechanical handling, NFPA/OSHA or CE marking.
• Good project management and reporting skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
• Motivated team player with a can-do attitude having the ability to effectively lead projects and improvement activities, delivering workable and sustainable solutions.
• Experience of IT systems hierarchies – ERP, Manufacturing control systems, SCADA, PLC.
• Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, PFD, FMEA / risk assessments, Lean Six Sigma, Design of Experiments and Statistical Process Control.
• Experienced in the use of Mini tab and/or advanced Excel proficiency for data analysis is preferred.
• CAD experience preferred, Solidworks and Autocad platforms a plus.
• IT proficiency Microsoft applications, Outlook, Office, Project, etc...

Work Environment:
  • Flexibility required in supporting CooperVision sites and activities, supporting additional working when required to meet the needs of the business.
  • Based in an office environment and working within manufacturing and areas of specified environmental cleanliness, fast moving machinery, materials and products.
Experience:
  • 2-5 years' experience in engineering and manufacturing support.
  • Knowledge in process design and development, process control and monitoring.
  • Experience with six sigma and lean manufacturing a plus.
  • Experience with medical device manufacturing environments or other highly regulated environments a plus.
Education:
  • B.S. in Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering or related engineering discipline; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Practitioner in Lean Manufacturing and / or Six Sigma – Green Belt or above is preferred.

Join Our Team as a Wirer

We're seeking motivated individuals to join our team as a Wirer. In this role, you'll be responsible for the final wiring and connection of electrical and electronically controlled components, helping ensure our products meet the highest quality and performance standards.

We offer competitive pay, with an additional shift differential available for overnight shifts, along with comprehensive training designed to help you develop specialized wiring skills and advance your career.

job.title: 3DPrinting Technician 1st Shift
job.description:
Printing Technician 3D- Wilmington, MA
Hours: Monday - Friday 830am - 5pm, with flexibility to start early or stay late by 1 hour.
Temp to Hire

Job Overview
Seeking a detail-oriented and hands-on 3D printer technician to support engineering and manufacturing efforts. This role involves the preparation, operation, and maintenance of industrial grade 3D printers, running post process and finishing equipment and maintaining process documentation. The ideal candidate has familiarity with additive manufacturing processes (ideally DLP, SLS, and/or MJF), strong troubleshooting skills, and is skilled in workshop finishing processes.

This is a hands-on job, ensuring high-quality output and innovative solutions for our additive manufacturing processes. We are an entrepreneurial team building a new manufacturing facility and as such everyone is expected to wear multiple hats. We are looking for someone who excels in a dynamic role, effectively balancing multiple responsibilities in addition to3D printer operation, such as helping in the quality lab, shipping/receiving, and general manufacturing where needed.

A Day In The Life
Operate large-format photopolymer (DLP) and polymer powder bed (SLS) 3D printers, including post-processing (support removal, selective curing, surface finishing, ceramic spraying), and raw material handling of polymer powders and resins.
Perform routine and preventive maintenance, calibration, and troubleshooting of printers, furnaces, and related equipment; coordinate with suppliers for upgrades and repairs.
Inspect printed parts for critical dimensions and surface quality using precision tools (e.g., calipers, gauge pins/blocks, 3D scanners, optical comparators, profilometers, hardness testers); generate detailed inspection reports.
Follow the manufacturing schedule closely by setting daily priorities and adhering to production plans to ensure timely product delivery, even under tight deadlines.
Conduct incoming inspection of raw materials to verify quality and conformance to specifications.
Maintain accurate documentation of builds, machine performance, maintenance activities, process parameters, and standard operating procedures.
Support part assembly for production and assist with shipping, receiving, and scheduling to ensure efficient material flow and timely deliveries.
Promote and maintain a safe, organized manufacturing environment and equipment.
Adhere to all local and corporate safety protocols; proactively identify and address unsafe conditions using Stop Work Authority.
Wear required PPE to perform critical duties, including PAPR (Powered Air Purifying Respirator), Tyvek suits, foot protection, gloves, and safely lift items up to 35 lbs.


What will help you thrive in this role?
  • High school diploma or vocational training preferred.
  • 1-2 years of experience in a manufacturing environment required,3D printing experience is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret dimensioned drawings and CAD models. Knowledge of GD&T preferred.
  • Proficiency with CAD software (e.g., Fusion 360, Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks, Materialise Magics/CO-AM).
  • Experience with spray coating (e.g. Cerakote) is a plus.
  • Familiarity with quality control processes and equipment is a plus.
  • Familiarity with SAP is a plus.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Results-oriented, comfortable with uncertainty, and able to work quickly while following established processes.

job.title: CAD Designer
job.description:
Job Summary
The CAD Designer is responsible for the conceptual design, layout, and development of Firefighter Air Replenishment Systems (FARS) for commercial, industrial, institutional, and high-rise building applications. This role creates comprehensive mechanical and electrical system layouts that support system functionality, code compliance, installation efficiency, and customer requirements.

Using AutoCAD, the designer will develop detailed 2D and 3D building layouts that integrate air piping distribution networks, fill stations, monitoring equipment, control devices, power requirements, and communication interfaces. The successful candidate must possess advanced AutoCAD skills, strong technical aptitude, and the ability to manage multiple projects while working under demanding deadlines.
This position collaborates closely with Technical Services, Engineering, Sales, Product Management, Architects, Consultants, Contractors, and End Users to develop practical and effective system designs for complex building environments.

Primary Responsibilities
Develop conceptual and detailed layouts for Firefighter Air Replenishment Systems (FARS) within commercial, industrial, institutional, healthcare, data center, and high-rise building applications.
Create complete mechanical system layouts including piping distribution networks, risers, fill stations, air monitoring equipment, and associated system components.
Develop electrical layouts for system monitoring, annunciation devices, control panels, communication interfaces, and supporting infrastructure.
Produce detailed 2D and 3D AutoCAD drawings including floor plans, riser diagrams, equipment layouts, isometric drawings, installation details, and system schematics.
Coordinate mechanical and electrical system designs with the project management team.
Evaluate building conditions, space limitations, accessibility requirements, and installation considerations to ensure practical and efficient system implementation.
Generate bills of material, equipment schedules, device lists, riser schedules, and supporting technical documentation.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting aggressive deadlines and changing business priorities.
Ensure all drawings and documentation comply with company standards, applicable codes, regulations, and industry practices.
Recommend improvements to design standards, documentation methods, and department processes.
Provide technical guidance on AutoCAD standards and system layout best practices.

Qualifications

Education
Associate Degree in Drafting and Design Technology, Engineering Technology, Architectural Technology, or a related technical discipline required.

Experience
5+ years of CAD design experience preferred.
Experience developing mechanical and electrical system layouts for commercial or industrial building applications.
Experience reading and coordinating architectural, mechanical, and electrical construction drawings.
Experience supporting projects with multiple stakeholders and demanding schedules.
Fire protection, life safety, building systems, telecommunications, controls, security, or industrial systems design experience preferred.

Technical Competencies
Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (2D and 3D required).
Ability to independently develop complete building system layouts from conceptual requirements.
Strong understanding of mechanical piping layouts and electrical device integration within building environments.
Proficiency developing floor plans, riser diagrams, equipment layouts, installation details, and schematic drawings.
Strong spatial visualization and building coordination skills.
Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and technical requirements.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Professional Competencies
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and consistently meet tight deadlines.
Exceptional attention to detail and drawing accuracy.
Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
Effective problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Customer-focused mindset with strong technical consultation skills.
Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn new technologies.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and results orientation.

job.title: Senior Electrical Engineer – Industrial / EPC Projects
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to support complex industrial engineering, design, and construction projects in Houston, TX.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in electrical engineering for large-scale industrial facilities, including oil and gas, refining, petrochemical, chemical processing, or similar heavy industrial environments.

This individual will be responsible for developing electrical engineering deliverables, coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, and ensuring electrical systems meet applicable codes, project specifications, and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead electrical engineering design activities for industrial and process facility projects.

  • Develop and review electrical one-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, electrical schematics, and equipment specifications.

  • Perform electrical load calculations, short-circuit studies, protective device coordination, and arc-flash analysis.

  • Design and specify low- and medium-voltage electrical distribution systems.

  • Prepare electrical equipment specifications and technical evaluations for transformers, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), motors, and variable frequency drives (VFDs).

  • Develop electrical layouts, cable schedules, cable tray routing, grounding, and lighting designs.

  • Review vendor drawings, equipment submittals, and technical documentation.

  • Coordinate electrical engineering activities with Process, Mechanical, Piping, Structural, and Instrumentation & Controls teams.

  • Support electrical equipment procurement, construction, commissioning, and startup activities as needed.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical meetings, and project coordination activities.

  • Ensure compliance with NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and applicable industry standards.

  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and electrical designers.

  • Maintain project deliverable quality while meeting established schedules and budgets.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution.

  • 10+ years of electrical engineering experience, preferably in an EPC or engineering consulting environment.

  • Significant experience supporting industrial, refining, petrochemical, oil and gas, or chemical processing projects.

  • Strong knowledge of low- and medium-voltage power distribution systems.

  • Experience developing electrical engineering calculations, equipment specifications, and construction deliverables.

  • Familiarity with NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, and relevant electrical design standards.

  • Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering and design teams.

  • Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple engineering deliverables and meet project deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  • Experience with ETAP or SKM PowerTools for electrical system studies.

  • Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar electrical design software.

  • Experience with 3D plant design environments and multidisciplinary model coordination.

  • Previous experience with large-scale EPC projects or brownfield facility modifications.

  • Experience supporting electrical equipment procurement and vendor technical evaluations.

  • Familiarity with hazardous area classification and electrical equipment requirements in industrial facilities.

  • Experience mentoring junior engineers or providing technical oversight to electrical designers.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be a technically strong, hands-on Senior Electrical Engineer with extensive industrial EPC experience. They should be comfortable independently managing electrical engineering deliverables, collaborating across disciplines, and supporting complex projects from detailed design through construction.

Candidates with recent experience in refining, petrochemical, oil and gas, or large industrial processing facilities are strongly preferred.

job.title: UX/UI Designer – Web & Digital Experiences
job.description:
Position Overview

We're looking for an experienced UX/UI Designer to help create engaging, intuitive, and accessible digital experiences across websites, landing pages, and other online platforms.

This is a hands-on design position for someone who enjoys taking an idea from early concepts through finished designs and working closely with developers to bring those designs to life.

You'll use Figma to develop wireframes, interactive prototypes, high-fidelity mockups, and reusable design components. You'll also contribute to an established design system, helping create consistent experiences across different websites and digital initiatives. The primary focus is website UX/UI design, with occasional opportunities to support email marketing, digital campaigns, and other online creative projects.

What You'll Be Doing:
  • Design user-friendly, responsive experiences for websites, landing pages, online forms, and other digital platforms.
  • Turn business goals, user needs, and project requirements into wireframes, interactive prototypes, and polished visual designs.
  • Develop clear page layouts, navigation structures, content organization, and calls to action that make websites easier to use.
  • Create designs that work consistently across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Apply accessibility standards and inclusive design principles to improve the experience for users with different needs.
  • Build, update, and maintain reusable UI components, templates, and design patterns within an established design system.
  • Document component variations, interaction behaviors, responsive layouts, content considerations, and accessibility requirements.
  • Partner with developers to ensure designs can be implemented efficiently using reusable, scalable components.
  • Prepare organized Figma files, design specifications, assets, and supporting documentation for development.
  • Review completed website implementations to ensure they match approved designs and meet usability, responsiveness, and accessibility expectations.
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, technical, and business stakeholders to translate feedback into practical design improvements.
  • Use available analytics, usability findings, and stakeholder input to refine existing digital experiences.
  • Occasionally develop supporting creative assets for email marketing, digital advertisements, campaign banners, and other online initiatives.
What We're Looking For:
  • Strong professional experience designing websites, landing pages, and interactive digital experiences.
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma, including component libraries, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff workflows.
  • Experience creating user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
  • Hands-on experience working with design systems, reusable components, interface patterns, and supporting documentation.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, information architecture, navigation, content hierarchy, and interaction design.
  • Experience designing responsive interfaces that provide a consistent user experience across different screen sizes.
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and best practices for creating inclusive digital experiences.
  • Experience collaborating directly with developers and preparing detailed design specifications for implementation.
  • Ability to work across multiple projects, brands, or digital properties while maintaining consistent design standards.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and incorporate constructive feedback.
  • Comfortable managing priorities, working independently, and collaborating with a remote team.
  • Ability to research and source appropriate visual assets, including basic image retouching and color correction.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
Preferred Experience:
  • 3–5+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design, digital product design, or a closely related field.
  • Experience designing for enterprise websites, organizations with multiple brands, or environments supporting several digital properties.
  • Familiarity with enterprise content-management systems and designing interfaces around reusable website components.
  • Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how front-end technologies influence design implementation.
  • Experience working alongside developers, content specialists, digital marketers, and technical platform teams.
  • Experience creating supporting digital assets such as email templates, banner advertisements, and campaign graphics.
  • Bachelor's degree in UX Design, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
Portfolio Requirements:
Candidates must provide a portfolio demonstrating hands-on UX/UI design experience, ideally including:
  • Website and landing-page projects showing both design quality and usability.
  • Examples of user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.
  • Design-system contributions, reusable UI components, or component libraries created in Figma.
  • Responsive designs demonstrating how layouts adapt across devices.
  • Completed digital experiences showing how initial concepts were developed into functional websites or products.

job.title: CNC Programmer - 1st Shift
job.description:
CNC Programmer
Hours: Monday - Friday, 830am - 5pm with flexibility to start early or stay late by 1 hour

Job Overview
Seeking an experienced CNC Programmer to support CNC programming, setup, and machining operations within our additive manufacturing operation. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with CNC programming, setup, tooling, and machining processes, along with the ability to collaborate with Operations and Engineering teams to produce high-quality prototype and production parts.

This is a hands-on role supporting a mix of prototype and production work in a growing manufacturing environment. The CNC Programmer will contribute to machining process development, fixture implementation, quality inspection, documentation, and day-to-day shop activities.

A Day In The Life
  • Create, modify, and optimize CNC programs for prototype and production components.
  • Perform machine setup and operation of CNC Okuma Milling equipment.
  • Select tooling, workholding, and machining parameters to achieve required quality and productivity targets.
  • Support fixture design, fabrication, and implementation for new and existing products.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to review part designs, tolerances, materials, and manufacturability considerations.
  • Troubleshoot machining, tooling, fixturing, and quality issues and support corrective actions.
  • Create and maintain setup sheets, work instructions, tooling documentation, and process records.
  • Inspect parts using calipers, micrometers, gauge pins, optical measurement equipment, 3D scanners, and other metrology tools.
  • Support first-piece inspections and ongoing process verification activities.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, and efficiency.
  • Maintain tooling, consumables, and material inventory for machining operations.
  • Support general manufacturing activities including assembly, shipping/receiving, scheduling support, and material flow as needed.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment.

What will help you thrive in this role?
  • High school diploma or vocational/technical training in machining, manufacturing, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of CNC machining experience, including CNC programming, setup, and operation.
  • Experience with 3-, 4-, or 5-axis milling environments.

job.title: Director of Information Technology
job.description:
DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
This position can sit in several locations: Madawaska (MA), Saratoga (NY), Little Falls (NY)

SCOPE:
The Director of IT is responsible for the strategic direction, leadership, and day-to-day management of the company's information technology environment across all corporate and manufacturing facilities. This role partners closely with business leaders, operations, finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT teams to ensure systems and data solutions support business goals, improve decision-making, and drive operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate is a hand-on technology leader who can operate strategically while appreciating the operational complexities of the manufacturing facilities.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

IT Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute a company-wide IT strategy aligned with business and manufacturing objectives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop IT team members including setting objectives, providing coaching and establishing/managing performance.
  • Establish technology priorities, roadmaps, budgets and IT standards to support current operations and future growth.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to leverage technology to improve productivity, efficiency, quality and profitability.
  • Lead major technology initiatives from strategy and planning through implementation and stabilization.
  • Provide IT leadership for due diligence support for acquisitions, integrations, new facilities and other strategic business initiatives.
  • Manage 3 rd party consultants, vendors and other contractor performance through close monitoring and supervision.

Business Systems & Applications
  • Oversee core business applications, including ERP, MES, reporting, and departmental systems.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify business requirements, improve processes, and prioritize system enhancements.
  • Develop application roadmaps to ensure systems remain scalable, integrated and aligned with business needs.
  • Lead evaluation and selection of technology solutions and software partners.

Infrastructure & Network
  • Provide strategic and operational oversight of the company's technology infrastructure across all corporate and manufacturing locations.
  • Oversee Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls, switches, routers, servers, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, storage, and related technologies.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and scalability of critical IT infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure standards, technology architecture, and lifecycle management strategies.
  • Lead infrastructure planning associated with business growth, new facilities, acquisitions, manufacturing modernization and/or plant expansions.
  • Ensure appropriate redundancy, monitoring, capacity planning, and disaster recovery capabilities.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management
  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy. Oversee cybersecurity controls, including endpoint protection, identity and access management, network security, vulnerability management, email security, and threat monitoring.
  • Establish appropriate access controls, authentication standards, and data protection practices.
  • Lead the response to significant cybersecurity incidents and coordinate remediation efforts.
  • Maintain IT security policies and employee cybersecurity awareness programs.
  • Oversee security assessments, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and related initiatives.
  • Partner with executive leadership, HR, Legal, and other stakeholders on cybersecurity, privacy, and data protection matters.

Required Qualifications
  • 10+ years of progressive IT experience including significant leadership responsibility. Experience in paper manufacturing or packaging.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience leading both IT infrastructure/network operations and business systems/applications.
  • Proven experience developing and executing IT strategy and managing IT operations and capital budgets.
  • Strong project management, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

job.title: Facilities Technician
job.description:
Work for a well-regarded aerospace company in Hauppauge, NY as a Facilities Technician. This position is full time/permanent with excellent benefits!
What you need to know:

  • Starting Pay: $28-$34/hour
  • 100% Onsite role
  • This is an entry-to-junior-level, hands-on role for a technician with prior maintenance experience who is looking to develop their skills under the guidance of the Facilities Supervisor and senior technicians
  • . The Facilities Technician I performs routine maintenance, repairs, preventive maintenance, vendor coordination, and general facility upkeep, including daily cleaning duties. Responsibilities also include maintaining and servicing industrial equipment, compressors, generators, and hydraulic and pneumatic test systems.
Responsibilities of the Facilities Technician
  • Perform routine maintenance and repairs on building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and lighting.
  • Complete scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) tasks on facility equipment, test stands, compressors, and generators, documenting all work in maintenance logs.
  • Perform general maintenance on diesel-powered compressors and generators, including checking and replenishing oil, coolant, and fuel; replacing oil and air filters; servicing water separators; and completing startup and shutdown procedures.
  • Maintain hydraulic and fuel test stands, including replacing leaking hoses, fittings, and other components as needed.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance on pneumatic test stands and processed air systems, including inspecting valves, sensors, piping, and related components.
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues and perform basic repairs, including replacing defective gaskets, valves, sensors, hoses, fittings, and other components.
  • Assist with maintenance and repairs involving hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromechanical equipment.
  • Coordinate with third-party vendors for major equipment repairs and specialized maintenance.
  • Perform basic plumbing and electrical repairs, painting, carpentry, groundskeeping, and snow removal.
  • Respond to routine maintenance requests and escalate complex issues to the Facilities Supervisor or senior technicians.
  • Clean common areas, maintain facility cleanliness, and perform minor property repairs.
  • Visually inspect fire and safety systems and promptly report any issues.
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment servicing, and completed work.
  • Operate company vehicles to transport tools, equipment, and supplies between facilities and job sites, and run occasional errands for parts and materials.
  • Follow all safety regulations, maintenance procedures, and company vehicle policies.
Experience and Skills of the Facilities Technician
  • 1–2 years of experience in building maintenance, facilities support, industrial maintenance, or a related hands-on trade.
  • Basic working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical systems.
  • Familiarity with diesel engines, compressors, generators, hydraulic systems, pneumatic systems, or industrial test equipment is a plus.
  • Basic troubleshooting and repair skills involving mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or electromechanical components are preferred.
  • Ability to use hand and power tools safely.
  • Mechanical aptitude and willingness to learn from senior technicians.
  • Ability to follow instructions, maintain accurate records, and work effectively as part of a team.
  • Good communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to pass pre-employment and random drug and alcohol screenings, as well as a basic background check.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to climb stairs and work in confined spaces, outdoor environments, and varying temperatures.
  • Manual dexterity to handle components and operate tools safely.
  • Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.
  • Frequent use of hand tools and basic repair equipment.
Education, Licenses, and Certifications
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Trade schooling or related coursework is a plus but not required.
  • Valid state driver's license with a clean driving record required.
Compensation and Benefits
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options.
  • 401(k) with 100% match on the first 4%.
  • Paid holidays, vacation, and sick/personal leave accrued from date of hire.

job.title: Production Operator I - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Schedule: 2:30PM-11:00PM

This position is responsible for the production of high quality medical devices within a manufacturing cell. Working under close supervision, may perform a combination of assembly, repair, and test operations on pacemakers, implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs), leads, and related medical device assemblies. Performs routine assignments according to specified and/or standardized procedures. Work is closely and continually reviewed. Ensure that relevant job documentation for cell operations and functions is accurate and up to date. Be able to clearly communicate ideas, problems and solutions to all levels of manufacturing management in both written and oral form. Maintain a positive attitude when interacting with internal customers and external customers such as tours. Follow safety guidelines and utilize appropriate safety devices when performing all operations. Participate in continuous improvement/quality initiatives in order to enhance production processes to achieve quality and profitability metrics. Maintain accurate records to ensure traveler and quality documents are accurate, all parts are traceable and quality issues can be addressed to assure the quality of all products. Demonstrates a basis understanding of Lean Manufacturing. Participate with the Manufacturing Supervisor/Manager in setting and monitoring individual goals and cell performance metrics that continuously seek to improve the quality of operations. Support all Divisional initiatives as identified by divisional management and in support of Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements Ability to read, comprehend, and follow written procedures; understand and follow verbal instructions - Understanding of and ability to utilize electronic data collection systems and computer software packages. Ability to prioritize work by determining the sequencing and timing of different jobs based on precedence and importance. Ability to handle and maneuver small components and parts. Ability to make critical decisions and judgments with minimal supervision. High school degree or equivalent required. Required dress code for tour during interview and on-the job: Clothing must be non-shedding and free of frayed hems or loose threads. Tassels, fringes, glitter, sequins (sewn or glued on), and any other items that could become dislodges are not allowed on clothing. To verify a fabric can be worn: pull at the fabric tightly with fingers, if fibers are dislodged, the garment may not be worn in the production area. Sweaters, sweater vests, loose fiber garments, loose knit, or fleece may not be worn. All clothing must be clean and free of visible contamination (sand, mud, dirt, lint, etc.). All clothing, from the waist up, must fit under the lab coat/gown. Turtle necks or high-necked clothing shall not stick out above the neck of the lab coat/gown. Sleeves shall not stick out beyond the cuff of the lab coat/gown. Caps, hats, scarves or bandanas shall not be worn under the bouffant. Head wraps/scarves worn to accommodate customs: Must be covered with the bouffant and the tail end of the scarf must be fully covered by the lab coat/gown. Must be of tightly woven fabric, be clean, and laundered. Loose fitting clothing shall not be worn around machinery or soldering/brazing torches. Shoes must be worn at all times in the production area. Stockings or socks are required. The heel of a shoe must not be pointed or higher than 2 inches. Sandals, clogs, slippers, open toe, or open heel shoes are not allowed. Shoes with straps or weave where toes can be seen are not allowed. Changing shoes in the production area, other than a gowning room, is not allowed. Torsos, upper arms, and legs must be covered. Pants (above the ankle), skirts (above the ankle), skirts with slits, short shirts (above the navel), and sleeveless tops are not allowed. Skirts at the ankle are allowed, but full-length stockings, leggings, or pants must be worn under them. Nail polish, acrylic, artificial nails, or similar nail coatings are not allowed. Jewelry or body piercings that can pierce gloves or cannot be covered under gowning materials will not be allowed in the production area. Makeup shall not be worn. Lip balm in stick form is acceptable, when applied outside of production areas and prior to hand washing. Scented personal use products shall not be worn, except deodorant. Lotions shall not be applied after hand washing. Cover any open or bleeding wound with a bandage. Dont wear anything that could be offensive.

job.title: Construction Coordinator
job.description:
Construction / Equipment Installation Coordinator

Primary Purpose:
Provide field coordination and installation support for major equipment installation projects. This person will coordinate hourly installation resources and contractors, serve as the connection between field personnel and engineering, and ensure equipment installations are completed safely, correctly, and according to project schedules and engineered documentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide construction coordination for equipment installation projects, including Project North Pole Import/Export equipment installations.
  • Oversee and coordinate hourly field resources performing primary processing equipment installations.
  • Provide weekend and occasional off-shift installation support as required by the project schedule.
  • Serve as the liaison between field installation personnel and Primary Processing Engineering.
  • Coordinate with engineering to resolve field questions, drawing discrepancies, installation issues, and technical concerns.
  • Coordinate contractors and subcontractors to ensure required installation work is completed according to project requirements.
  • Develop, organize, and maintain job plans, work packages, installation documentation, and other project materials.
  • Support the organization and execution of project objectives, milestones, and timelines.
  • Review and interpret engineered drawings, equipment layouts, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Communicate installation requirements and technical information to hourly personnel and contractors.
  • Monitor installation progress and help ensure work stays aligned with the project schedule.
  • Identify field issues and coordinate appropriate resolution with Engineering, Construction, and project stakeholders.
  • Provide hands-on field support when necessary to keep equipment installation activities moving.

What the Hiring Manager Is Really Looking For

The strongest candidates will likely have experience as a:

  • Construction Coordinator
  • Construction Supervisor
  • Equipment Installation Coordinator
  • Installation Supervisor
  • Field Engineer
  • Field Construction Engineer
  • Mechanical Construction Supervisor
  • Mechanical Installation Supervisor
  • Project Coordinator – Construction
  • Construction Manager
  • Equipment Engineer with strong field experience
  • Maintenance/Engineering Supervisor with equipment installation experience

Must-Have Experience

Look for candidates who have:

  1. Equipment installation experience
  2. Construction/field coordination experience
  3. Experience supervising or coordinating hourly/field labor
  4. Contractor/subcontractor coordination
  5. Ability to read engineered drawings
  6. Experience working directly with Engineering
  7. Experience creating or using job plans/work packages
  8. Ability to work weekends/OT when required
  9. Strong field communication and problem-solving skills

Ideal Background

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Nesco Resource is seeking a Sr Accountant in the Fairfax VA area.

Senior Accountant

Position Summary

The Senior Accountant is responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, with primary responsibility for Accounts Payable (AP), general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, financial close activities, and financial reporting support. This position also oversees Accounts Receivable (AR) and billing activities while supporting inventory accounting, audits, internal controls, and continuous accounting process improvements.

The Senior Accountant maintains accurate, complete, and compliant financial records in accordance with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and all applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational accounting requirements.

Position Risk Designation

Selected Risk Designation: Public Trust (High) / Low Risk

This position may involve responsibilities that could substantially affect public trust and may require a background investigation submitted using Standard Form 85P (SF-85P), subject to applicable government requirements.

Other risk classifications, if applicable, will be determined by the requirements of the assigned position and government contract.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

1. Accounting Operations, General Ledger, and Financial Close

  • Perform and oversee daily accounting activities, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), billing, and general ledger (GL) functions.

  • Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close activities in accordance with GAAP.

  • Prepare and post journal entries, reconcile balance sheet accounts, research discrepancies, resolve reconciling items and variances, and prepare account analyses.

  • Assist with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and related financial reports for assigned business entities.

2. Unanet ERP and Contract Accounting

  • Administer and review accounting-related organizational setups and updates within Unanet, including customer and vendor records, contracts, and associated system configurations.

  • Manage contract setup and modifications within Unanet/Deltek to support accurate job cost accounting, compliant billing, and reliable financial reporting.

  • Review accounting data and system configurations to identify and resolve discrepancies affecting contract accounting and financial records.

3. Accounts Payable and Vendor Management

  • Maintain vendor profiles and records and review, code, post, and process vendor invoices and employee business and travel expense reports.

  • Process vendor payments and ensure required documentation, including IRS Form W-9, is collected, maintained, and properly documented.

  • Respond to vendor inquiries concerning accounting records, invoice status, and payment information, as appropriate.

4. Accounts Receivable and Billing Support

  • Maintain customer profiles and prepare, review, and process customer invoices.

  • Submit invoices through applicable government billing portals and other designated billing systems.

  • Monitor accounts receivable and collection activity and investigate outstanding balances or billing discrepancies.

  • Respond to customer inquiries concerning invoices, billing documentation, and account status, as appropriate.

5. Inventory Accounting

  • Maintain inventory accounting records and tracking documentation.

  • Perform periodic inventory reconciliations, variance analyses, and physical inventory counts to ensure inventory balances are complete and accurate.

  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies and related accounting variances.

6. Tax and Regulatory Compliance

  • Prepare and support required tax reporting and documentation, including IRS Form 1099.

  • Review applicable monthly, quarterly, and annual sales tax reporting for accuracy and completeness.

  • Ensure accounting activities comply with applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements.

7. Audits and Internal Controls

  • Support external financial statement audits, internal control reviews, government contract audits, and other required audits or assessments.

  • Assist with the design, documentation, implementation, and execution of accounting controls, policies, and procedures.

  • Maintain appropriate supporting documentation to facilitate audit readiness and demonstrate compliance with applicable requirements.

8. Process Improvement and Organizational Support

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve accounting processes, automation, internal controls, efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

  • Maintain the confidentiality and security of financial, operational, customer, vendor, and organizational information.

  • Support organizational objectives through special projects, process improvements, and other assigned responsibilities.

  • Perform other related accounting duties as needed.

Minimum Qualifications: Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

1. Education and Professional Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Three (3) to five (5) years of progressive accounting experience, including a strong understanding of GAAP, general ledger accounting, and full-cycle accounting processes.

  • At least one (1) year of supervisory or team-lead experience, including responsibility for reviewing the work of others.

2. Accounting Knowledge and Experience

  • Demonstrated experience supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, account analyses, variance resolution, and financial reporting.

  • Hands-on experience with inventory accounting and management, including inventory tracking, reconciliations, variance analysis, and discrepancy resolution.

  • Experience with job cost accounting and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.

  • Ability to navigate accounting systems, extract financial data, and perform detailed analyses to support accurate reporting and decision-making.

3. Systems and Technical Skills

  • Experience with Unanet ERP or Deltek is strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience with reconciliations, large datasets, lookup functions, PivotTables, and financial analysis.

4. Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to independently investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies, reconciliation issues, and financial variances.

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with internal teams, customers, vendors, auditors, and other stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • High levels of accuracy, attention to detail, accountability, and discretion when handling confidential financial and operational information.

5. Government Customer and Security Requirements

  • This position supports U.S. Government customers and may involve access to government systems and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and able to satisfy applicable government-mandated personnel security, suitability, credentialing, background investigation, and system-access requirements.

  • Depending on the applicable contract and assignment, requirements may include obtaining and maintaining a federal security clearance, Public Trust determination, and/or Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential.

  • Employment and system access are contingent upon satisfying the applicable requirements for the assigned position.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Directly supervise one Staff Accountant, providing day-to-day guidance, reviewing assigned work, and supporting training and professional development.

  • Review work prepared by the Staff Accountant and provide timely feedback to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to deadlines.

  • Coordinate assignments and daily workflow, helping prioritize responsibilities during monthly, quarterly, and year-end close periods.

  • Provide constructive performance feedback and participate in performance evaluations.

  • Assist with onboarding, training, and professional development of assigned accounting personnel, as applicable.
