job.description:
Fri-Sun
6am-6pm (some OT as well)



Job Description

Warehouse material handlers essential duties are to perform various tasks in the warehouse such as but not limited to:

  • Inbound: Unload trucks, trailers, containers of freight, counting products, compare to manifest to check all shipments for damage, infestation, or production code dates. Material handlers must report shortages, damages, and mis-shipments on appropriate forms. Also be able to sign for inbound shipments when necessary. All inbound shipments are moved safely to storage locations to be efficiently stacked as store merchandise.
  • Order Picking: Ensure that the correct product number, quantity and type (lot, batch, serial number) of product are picked. Transport orders to shipping locations or delivery platforms with material handling equipment such as but not limited to fork trucks, cherry pickers, or pallet jacks. Materials handlers must be able to label, stencil, tag, mark orders, band, bundle, wrap, over-pack, and palletize as required.
  • Outbound: Compare quantity, labeling and address with order to ensure out-going shipments are complete and correct. Assign signature for outbound as necessary. Efficiently move product, cartons and or pallets into trailers, rail cars or containers.
  • Equipment: Maintain equipment in a neat, clean and orderly fashion. Operate equipment safely and efficiently. Comply with company standards and OSHA requirements.
  • Inventory: Keep accurate records and reports. Assist in physical inventories and cycle counts. Ensure proper stock rotation. May key inventory adjustments in computer.
  • Other Duties: Repack or re-box cases per customer instructions. Repair and consolidate damaged goods as required. Operate shrink-wrap machine. Charge forklift battery as needed; stack and or separate good from bad pallets when necessary; clean railcars, trailers, and truck docks, bays as requested.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience and Certifications)

  • OSHA Forklift and HAZMAT certification a plus

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.   • Must be able to use proper techniques to lift up to 75 pounds. The ability to follow directions with emphasis on safety is extremely important.
  • Must be able to handle stress caused in meeting deadlines with tight scheduling requirements.
  • Must be able to shift priorities easily.
  • Must be able to use hands and feet simultaneously and for repetitive movements.
  • Must have responsible work habits.
  • Must be familiar with warehouse systems.
  • Must be available to work any shift.


LANGUAGE SKILLS:
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret SOPs, coverage, documents, and regulations. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively establish rapport, present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers and the public. Skill and ability to meet people and listen.


MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:
Ability to add and subtract two digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10's and 100's. Ability to perform these operations using units of American money and weight measurement, volume, and distance. Understanding of metric system measurements is beneficial.


REASONING ABILITY:
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed and uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.


OTHER:
Skill and ability to type. Skill and ability to operate a computer. Skill and ability to organize and prioritize work. Skill and ability to meet deadlines and operate office equipment. Skill and ability to use Microsoft office tools and company software.


ENVIRONMENTAL WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL EFFORT (Under Typical Positions)

Position: Network Switch Installation Technician

Job Summary:
Seeking an experienced Network Installation Technician to perform onsite installation, connection, and basic commissioning of a Netgear GS724TP 24-port network switch in an end-customer environment. The technician will serve as the onsite hands-and-eyes for remote network engineers and must be comfortable following technical instructions, using a laptop and console cable, and completing the physical installation accurately and professionally.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install and physically mount or place the Netgear GS724TP 24-port switch.

  • Document completed work, port connections, equipment location, and any issues encountered.

  • Follow onsite safety, security, and customer access procedures.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Prior hands-on experience installing and supporting Ethernet/network switches.

  • Familiarity with Netgear switches, preferably the GS724TP or similar 24-port managed switches.

  • Working knowledge of Ethernet cabling, patch panels, RJ45 connections, VLAN/port concepts, and basic network connectivity.

  • Experience using a laptop and console/serial or USB console connection to access network equipment.

  • Ability to follow remote engineer instructions and technical documentation.

  • Strong cable-management, labeling, documentation, and troubleshooting skills.

  • Professional customer-facing communication and ability to work independently onsite.

Preferred:
CompTIA Network+, CCNA, or equivalent hands-on networking experience is a plus, but practical field experience installing and supporting network equipment is the primary qualification.

Position Summary: The Project Manager acts as the liaison between the Company and its Customers.

They are responsible for the overall delivery and success of their assigned projects by proactively and successfully managing, planning, and coordinating activities within specified cost and time demands.

The Project Manager needs to manage multiple projects and activities simultaneously and must be organized and utilize effective time management strategies. (Laboratory Casework, Furniture, Architectural Millwork)

Minimum Background, Experience, and Requirements:

4-year bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business Management, or similar field of study.

Education

job.title: Optical Fabricators
job.description:
Job Title: Optical Assembly Technician
Multiple positions available!
B-Shift/2nd Shift Opening with hours of 2:00pm-10:30pm
$23-26/hr

About the role:
The Optical Assembly Technician performs advanced optical assembly and alignment operations requiring micron- and sub-micron-level accuracy. This role is responsible for actively aligning optical elements to mechanical housings, verifying optical and mechanical performance, and permanently securing optics using high-precision tools and metrology. Work is performed in a controlled clean-room manufacturing environment and requires significant technical skill, judgment, and independence in the execution of high-performance optical products.

Key Responsibilities:
· Perform active alignment of lenses and optical elements into metal housings using precision fixturing.
· Use alignment and metrology tools such as air-bearing spindles, autocollimators, alignment telescopes, precision stages, and indicators to achieve required tolerances.
· Adjust decenter, tip, tilt, and axial position to meet defined optical and mechanical specifications.
· Apply adhesives and permanently secure optics while maintaining alignment during cure.
· Inspect optical elements for defects including scratches, digs, chips, and coating defects.
· Inspect machined metal housings for burrs, surface damage, and dimensional inconsistencies.
· Evaluate cosmetic and functional acceptability using defined optical inspection criteria.
· Determine fitness-for-use of optics and hardware prior to assembly and escalate issues as required.
· Measure critical features using high-precision metrology tools including micrometers, bore gauges, comparators, and dial indicators.



Job Title: Optical Fabricator
Multiple positions available!
B-Shift/2nd Shift Opening with hours of 2:00pm-10:30pm
$25-28/hr

About the Role
In this role, you will manufacture custom lens assemblies and optical systems that meet precise specifications. The ideal candidate has experience in optical systems and glass fabrication, along with strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis tools.

Key Responsibilities
• Generate precision curves using CNC equipment to meet optical specifications and tolerances.
• Perform CNC centering operations to ensure accurate alignment of optical components.
• Hand bevel and block lenses for grinding and polishing processes.
• Execute hand grinding and CNC/conventional polishing to achieve required surface quality.
• Conduct optical inspection and metrology to verify compliance with specifications.
• Maintain cleanliness of machines, tools, and work areas to ensure quality and safety.
• Plan and schedule work for generation, blocking, grinding, and polishing areas.
• Comply with all health, safety, and PPE requirements.
• Support company values through ethical conduct and integrity in all actions.
• Perform other duties as assigned to support production and continuous improvement.

Equipment Utilized
• CNC and conventional polishing machines
• Optical inspection and metrology equipment
• Personal computer and JDE MRP software
• Personal protective equipment (PPE) and cleanroom attire
• Standard office equipment (calculator, copier, fax, etc.)

Education & Experience
• High school diploma or GED preferred
• Minimum of two years of related optical fabrication experience and/or training
Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities
• Proficiency in operating CNC curve generation machines and CNC centering equipment.
• High degree of accuracy and alertness when using micrometers, interferometers, and high-speed cutting wheels
• Familiarity with optical manufacturing terminology and processes
• Skilled in using conventional polishing machines and performing hand grinding and beveling.
• Ability to perform optical inspection and metrology using precision instruments such as micrometers, interferometers, and other optical measurement tools.
• Familiarity with JDE MRP software and basic computer operations.
• Comfortable using standard office equipment (calculator, copier, fax, etc.).
• Understanding of cleanroom protocols and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
• Knowledge of optical manufacturing terminology and processes.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under high-speed cutting conditions.

Position Summary:

Storeroom Attendant is an individual contributor positioned within a customer's location to fulfil daily receiving, stocking, issuing, and cycle counting of customer and/or company inventory. They are responsible for maintaining a professional, clean and organized work environment.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

•Unloads, receives and puts away incoming product, goods, tools and/or equipment; unpacks bales, crates, and other containers; checks for damage and for discrepancies between goods and invoices.
•Accurately sorts, labels, moves and stores items; places material or items on racks, shelves, or in bins according to predetermined sequence such as size, style, or product codes; arranges storage to optimize crib space.
•Issues product, goods, tools and/or equipment to site employees; documents and maintains accurate records for issued and returned items.
•Enters data into a database or other computerized system to maintain up-to-date stock records; retrieves stored information to respond to inquiries (e.g., inventory levels or delivery schedules.); documents discrepancies on an error log and seeks management advice on appropriate corrective action.
•Requests requisitions to replenish inventory.
•Assists with inventory level maintenance; performs cycle counts and prepares report results.
•Inspects and measures tools/equipment for defects, wear and tear and reports damage or wear to supervisors.
•Prepares periodic inventory or maintains perpetual inventory of supplies and equipment.
•Delivers tools or equipment to associate work locations.
•Investigates and locates lost or misplaced equipment or safety supplies.
•May repair, service and lubricate tools and equipment as required.
•Performs other related duties as requested.

Job Qualifications:

3+ months relevant experience and/or training. High school diploma or equivalent preferred (not required).
Relevant experience and/or aptitude should include:
•Loading, unloading, picking, packing or moving goods in a warehouse environment.
•Demonstrated ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, work orders, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
•Basic computer knowledge and proficiency and/or a demonstrated technical aptitude to learn; preferred technical skills to include but not limited to MS-Office products, Vista, Control, SX.e, Prophet 21.

•Strong communication and customer service skills.
•Ability to work in a team environment and be self-motivated to accomplish assigned tasks and goals.
•Demonstration of attention to detail and is safety minded.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

•May be required to wear various forms of protective equipment (shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.)
•May be required to pass warehouse equipment certifications (written and/or driving).
•Assigned work shifts may vary and/or rotate.
•Overtime may be required; extended day, evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand and may include little to no advanced notice.

•Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus are required.

job.title: Fixed Equipment Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer with experience supporting fixed equipment in refining, petrochemical, or specialty chemical facilities. Equipment may include pressure vessels, heat exchangers, piping, tanks, and fired heaters. This role supports engineering design, equipment procurement, construction, and unit turnarounds.

Responsibilities

  • Develop equipment specifications and data sheets, technical requisitions, bid evaluations, and purchase recommendations.

  • Mechanical engineering experience with fixed equipment in refining, petrochemical, or specialty chemical facilities.

  • Knowledge of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, piping, tanks, and fired heaters.

  • Understanding of risk based inspection, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and strength of materials.

  • Familiarity with applicable API and ASME standards.

  • Ability to prepare and review calculations, specifications, drawings, and technical procurement documents.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with engineering, design, procurement, vendor, and construction teams.

job.title: Legal Operations Specialist
job.description:
Legal Operations Specialist

Position Overview

The Legal Operations Specialist provides comprehensive legal assistance and supports a broad and evolving range of corporate legal functions for the Legal Department and cross-functional business teams.

This position serves as a key liaison between in-house counsel, outside counsel, external organizations, and internal employees. The ideal candidate will be a flexible, solutions-oriented professional capable of supporting commercial transactions, contract administration, corporate records, intellectual property matters, and legal operations and workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Contract & Commercial Support

  • Assist attorneys with drafting, assembling, reviewing, proofreading, and editing contracts, legal agreements, and supporting documentation.
  • Support the full lifecycle of commercial contracts.
  • Track contract execution and maintain executed copies.
  • Coordinate and collect required signatures.
  • Organize and maintain contracts and related documentation within the document management system.
  • Partner with internal commercial teams to ensure stakeholders understand contract terms, requirements, and status.
  • Maintain accurate and organized corporate and legal records.

Legal Operations & Process Improvement

  • Evaluate existing legal processes and identify workflow gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support initiatives designed to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and reduce costs.
  • Assist with evaluating, developing, and scaling legal tools, workflows, templates, and contract playbooks.
  • Support legal technology initiatives and vendor evaluations.
  • Manage legal billing, invoicing, and budget tracking.
  • Assist with cross-functional legal projects and ad-hoc requests.

Legal Intake & Matter Management

  • Serve as the primary intake specialist for new legal requests.
  • Gather and organize required documentation for new matters.
  • Manage multiple legal matters and requests simultaneously.
  • Coordinate schedules and logistics for meetings.
  • Communicate with internal stakeholders, outside counsel, and external organizations as needed.

Intellectual Property & Legal Research

  • Review incoming patent correspondence.
  • Maintain the internal patent docketing database.
  • Track and help ensure critical intellectual property deadlines are met.
  • Conduct project-based legal research at the direction of corporate counsel.
  • Prepare and file legal documentation with appropriate regulatory and government entities.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a legal or corporate environment.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with stakeholders across areas such as Legal, Finance, Technology, IT, Engineering, and other business functions.
  • Foundational knowledge of contracting principles and legal requirements.
  • Experience supporting contracts, legal documentation, or related corporate legal activities.
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • High proficiency in grammar, composition, proofreading, and legal documentation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and appropriately escalate issues when necessary.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with strict discretion.

Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Office, including Excel
  • Google Workspace
  • Adobe Acrobat
  • Corporate document management systems
  • Legal technology and workflow tools

job.title: Administrative Support
job.description:
Administrative / Facilities Coordinator

Position Overview

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Administrative / Facilities Coordinator to provide administrative and space planning support to a Facilities organization.

This position will support workplace planning, facilities data management, reporting, scheduling, and day-to-day administrative activities across a large 1.6 million-square-foot campus. The role requires someone who is comfortable working with data and spreadsheets while also conducting daily field checks throughout the facility.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and able to work effectively with employees and internal business partners.

Position Details

  • Work Model: 100% On-site
  • Schedule: 4/10 – First Shift
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Potential for Full-Time Hire: Yes
  • Overtime Status: Non-Exempt
  • Security Clearance: Not required

Key Responsibilities

Facilities & Space Planning Support

  • Provide administrative and space planning support to the Facilities team.
  • Gather, maintain, track, and verify space, occupancy, employee, and facilities-related information from multiple sources.
  • Conduct daily field checks throughout a large corporate campus to verify space and occupancy information.
  • Update space planning records, floor plans, seating assignments, and related databases.
  • Support effective utilization of workplace and facility resources.
  • Coordinate and track space requests, employee moves, seating changes, and other workplace activities.
  • Ensure facilities and space planning information remains accurate and up to date.

Data Management & Reporting

  • Compile, organize, and analyze facilities-related data.
  • Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations, timelines, tables, and other materials.
  • Maintain accurate records and databases used for facilities planning and decision-making.
  • Identify inconsistencies or missing information and assist with maintaining data accuracy.
  • Support reporting and analysis related to space utilization, occupancy, and workplace planning.

Administrative Support

  • Manage calendars and schedules for the Facilities team.
  • Coordinate meetings, appointments, site visits, and other team activities.
  • Provide administrative support for Facilities projects and meetings.
  • Assist with internal communications and day-to-day department operations.
  • Coordinate business travel as needed.
  • Prepare and process expense reports.
  • Maintain documentation and assist with other administrative activities as required.

Process & Employee Support

  • Assist with developing and improving administrative and facilities processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow, data accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide employees and internal business partners with information regarding Facilities processes and procedures.
  • Assist with questions regarding space assignments, workplace services, and related Facilities activities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure requests and workplace activities are completed accurately and efficiently.

Required Qualifications

  • Administrative, facilities, workplace coordination, space planning, or related experience.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience maintaining records, databases, spreadsheets, or tracking systems.
  • Ability to compile information and prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and other business materials.
  • Experience coordinating calendars, meetings, appointments, or workplace activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal teams.
  • Comfortable conducting daily field checks and walking throughout a 1.6 million-square-foot campus.
  • Ability to work 100% on-site.

job.title: Corporate Recruiter
job.description:
Corporate Recruiter Job in Cleveland, OH:

Onsite Position in Cleveland, OH
Full-Time, Direct Hire
 

Are you ready to bridge the gap between talent and opportunity and play a key role in a candidate’s career? You can do just that as a Corporate Recruiter with Nesco Resource.

The Corporate Recruiter will source, interview, select, and place applicants for all internal Nesco Resource roles across both lines of business. Working closely with hiring managers throughout the organization, this person will build sourcing strategies, manage candidates from first contact through offer, and support a wide variety of HR tasks, including compensation, benefits, and contract negotiations.

Key Responsibilities of the Corporate Recruiter Job in Cleveland, OH:

Sourcing and Recruiting

  • Independently source and recruit applicants through job boards, social media, corporate career sites, and other channels.
  • Screen and interview candidates, and select qualified applicants to move forward in the process.
  • Anticipate future openings and build talent pipelines through frequent contact with hiring managers across the organization.
  • Lead campus recruiting and connect with civic, social, and professional groups to share job opportunities.

Hiring Manager Partnership

  • Hold strategy sessions with hiring managers to define job requirements and establish sourcing strategies.
  • Interpret job descriptions and translate them into targeted candidate searches.

Candidate Management and Offers

  • Negotiate salary, wages, and benefits between hiring managers and candidates.

Recruiting Operations

  • Enter pre-qualified candidates, job postings, and notes into the company’s candidate database.
  • Maintain accurate data and documentation throughout the hiring process.
  • Participate in implementing new recruiting technology, such as applicant tracking systems and screening tools.

job.title: C/C++ Embedded Software Engineer - (Active Secret Clearance Required)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a C/C++ Software Engineer to support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of secure processing applications and embedded software for mission-critical platforms. This role operates in a classified environment and requires an active Full Secret security clearance.
The engineer will work closely with hardware and software teams to develop embedded solutions, support firmware integration, maintain software quality standards, and contribute to automated build and deployment processes.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, develop, debug, and maintain modern C++ applications and legacy software used across multiple projects.
• Develop low-level C/C++ software for bare-metal and RTOS environments, including FreeRTOS and VxWorks.
• Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate software with microcontrollers, ASICs, FPGA subsystems, and embedded platforms.
• Develop and maintain firmware, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers for mission-critical systems.
• Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins and GitLab CI.
• Utilize build systems including CMake and Make, and automate workflows using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
• Enforce coding standards including MISRA C/C++ and C++ Core Guidelines through reviews and development practices.
• Conduct peer reviews, unit testing using GoogleTest, and maintain comprehensive test suites.
• Develop software verification procedures, test plans, verification matrices, and compliance reporting documentation.
• Create technical documentation including design documents, interface specifications, and maintenance guides.
• Participate in Agile activities including stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
• Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Education Level
•Bachelors Degree + 9-15 years of experience OR Master's Degree + 7-13 years of experience

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 6+ years of professional C/C++ software (Embedded Systems) development experience
• 1-2 years of experience developing and executing software verification procedures, including creation of test plans, verification matrices, and compliance reporting.
• Active Full Secret security clearance required.
• Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++14, C++17, and C++20) and C.
• Experience developing software for embedded systems, including bare-metal and RTOS environments.
• Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills utilizing hardware tools such as JTAG, SWD, and logic analyzers.
• Experience with Git version control.
• Ability to diagnose, analyze, and resolve complex technical issues.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Bare-metal and low-level driver development for microcontrollers or SoCs.
• Hardware driver development for ASICs, FPGA interfaces, and peripheral devices.
• Embedded C/C++ development experience.
• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar tools.
• C# development experience for tooling, test harnesses, or GUI applications.
• Familiarity with Xilinx and PolarFire FPGA families.
• Experience with Vivado, Libero, Vitis, or SoftConsole development environments.
• Scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• C++ Institute certification, Xilinx certifications, or related security clearance training.

Work Details

job.title: Contracts Administrator
job.description:
Contracts Administrator

Position Overview

We are seeking a Contracts Administrator to support the front-end contract administration process for aftermarket products. This position will administer contracts of moderate scope and complexity, ensuring contractual obligations, customer requirements, pricing, delivery schedules, and terms and conditions are properly managed.

The Contracts Administrator will serve as a key point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders and will support contract review, proposals, RFPs, negotiations, compliance, and contract performance.

The ideal candidate will have 1–2 years of contracts administration experience, preferably supporting military, government, aerospace, or defense contracts, along with strong customer communication skills.

Position Details

  • Employment Type: Temp-to-Hire
  • Shift: 1st Shift
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday
  • Hours: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM or 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration

  • Administer contracts of moderate scope and complexity to ensure fulfillment of contractual obligations.
  • Review and analyze customer purchase orders, including orders issued against Basic Contract Agreements and Long-Term Agreements.
  • Evaluate:
    • Performance requirements
    • Delivery schedules
    • Pricing
    • Terms and conditions
    • Other contractual provisions
  • Monitor contract performance and ensure compliance with customer and company requirements.
  • Determine when customer-directed changes fall outside the existing scope of work.
  • Prepare and coordinate contract amendments or extensions as required.

Proposals & RFPs

  • Develop technically and commercially compliant proposal packages in response to customer and contractual requirements.
  • Evaluate performance requirements, delivery schedules, material costs, equipment requirements, and labor-hour estimates.
  • Initiate and coordinate the bid process by gathering requirements and input from cross-functional teams.
  • Develop responses to Requests for Proposal (RFPs).
  • Review material, testing, delivery, pricing, and other requirements associated with customer requests.
  • Prepare and submit proposals in accordance with established procedures.

Contract Negotiations

  • Negotiate contracts within assigned scope and authority while complying with legal requirements and company policies.
  • Negotiate:
    • Pricing
    • Terms and conditions
    • Delivery requirements
    • Other contractual and business matters
  • Ensure contractual provisions are clearly defined and consistent with company policies.
  • Support negotiations for follow-on requirements to obtain favorable pricing, terms, and conditions.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for customers regarding assigned contracts.
  • Proactively contact customers to review contract details, obtain required information, and provide status updates.
  • Participate in customer meetings and presentations.
  • Investigate and resolve customer claims, questions, and complaints.
  • Coordinate with internal teams regarding technical issues, quality concerns, data requirements, delivery requirements, and other business matters.

Contract Performance & Compliance

  • Monitor contract financial performance and delivery status.
  • Maintain accurate contract documentation and records.
  • Support export compliance administration and implementation of applicable export compliance requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, government procurement, and aerospace industry regulations.
  • Review regulatory requirements and advise management regarding necessary actions.
  • Utilize Lean principles to develop and implement standardized work and process improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related discipline.
  • 1–2+ years of contract administration, contract management, or directly related experience.
  • Experience supporting contracts within military, government, aerospace, defense, or another regulated environment strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of contract administration principles, practices, policies, and procedures.
  • Understanding of legal and regulatory requirements related to contracts and government procurement, where applicable.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret moderately complex contract terms and conditions.
  • Experience supporting proposals, bids, RFPs, pricing, and contract negotiations.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, including the ability to proactively contact customers regarding contract requirements and status updates.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple contracts, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Proficiency with standard business applications and contract/customer management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contract Management certification completed or currently in progress.
  • Experience with military or government contracts.
  • Aerospace or defense industry experience.
  • Knowledge of government procurement requirements.
  • Experience with export compliance.
  • Familiarity with Lean principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Membership or familiarity with professional organizations such as the National Contract Management Association (NCMA) or similar contract management organizations.

job.title: Associate Manager, Technical Accounting & SEC Reporting
job.description:
Associate Manager, Technical Accounting & SEC Reporting

Position Overview

The Associate Manager, Technical Accounting & SEC Reporting is responsible for researching and applying U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements to complex business transactions and financial reporting matters.

This position will support quarterly and annual SEC reporting, including the preparation of disclosures and footnotes for Forms 10-K and 10-Q, as well as the development of clear, well-supported, audit-ready technical accounting memoranda and work papers.

The Associate Manager will collaborate with Finance, Legal, Operations, external auditors, and other key stakeholders to evaluate accounting, disclosure, control, and reporting implications. The role will also leverage financial reporting systems, automation tools, and emerging technologies to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, consistency, and control effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Accounting & U.S. GAAP

  • Research and interpret complex U.S. GAAP accounting guidance.
  • Analyze complex business transactions and determine appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Evaluate accounting and reporting implications of business activities and transactions.
  • Prepare clear, comprehensive, and audit-ready technical accounting memoranda.
  • Develop and maintain supporting accounting work papers and documentation.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external auditors regarding technical accounting conclusions.

SEC Reporting

  • Support the preparation of quarterly and annual SEC filings.
  • Prepare assigned disclosures and footnotes for:
    • Form 10-K
    • Form 10-Q
  • Support financial statement tie-outs and disclosure reviews.
  • Ensure SEC disclosures are accurate, complete, consistent, and supported by appropriate documentation.
  • Research and apply applicable SEC reporting requirements.

Controls, Compliance & Governance

  • Support SOX and disclosure control requirements related to financial reporting.
  • Assess accounting, disclosure, control, and reporting implications in partnership with Finance, Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain strong documentation and governance throughout the reporting process.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen reporting controls and processes.

Reporting Systems & Process Improvement

  • Utilize financial reporting systems and technology to support quarterly and annual reporting activities.
  • Leverage automation tools and emerging technologies to improve:
    • Reporting accuracy
    • Process efficiency
    • Reporting consistency
    • Control effectiveness
  • Identify opportunities to streamline financial reporting processes and strengthen governance.
  • Experience with Workiva, Oracle FCCS, or similar financial reporting platforms is preferred.

Project & Deadline Management

  • Manage multiple time-sensitive deliverables during quarterly and annual reporting cycles.
  • Prioritize competing responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure reporting requirements and deadlines are met.
  • Effectively manage multiple accounting and reporting workstreams simultaneously.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience within:
    • Public accounting, and/or
    • SEC reporting
    • Technical accounting
    • Consolidations
    • Fortune 500 corporate accounting environments
  • Demonstrated ability to research and apply complex U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements.
  • Experience preparing or supporting SEC filings, disclosures, footnotes, and financial statement tie-outs.
  • Experience drafting audit-ready technical accounting memoranda and supporting documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and with external auditors.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight quarterly and annual reporting deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • U.S. CPA strongly preferred, or active progress toward CPA certification.
  • Experience with SOX and disclosure controls.
  • Experience with financial reporting systems such as:
    • Workiva
    • Oracle FCCS
    • Similar consolidation or financial reporting platforms
  • Experience utilizing automation tools or emerging technologies to improve financial reporting processes.

job.description:
The Data Center Chief Engineer provides maintenance support and management for the assigned Data Centers. Maintains all mechanical, electrical, and IT systems in the facilities. Provides general project management direction over all data center facility repairs and change/ install/ expansion efforts. Enthusiastic about learning new systems, openness to improving upon existing practices, and have a goal-oriented mindset.

The Data Center Chief Engineer reports directly to the Facility Manager.

Essential Job Functions

  1. Maintain 100% uptime in Colocation data center critical facility.
  2. Draft and Maintain Standard Maintenance Requirements (SMRs) and periodicities each datacenter, building, or campus based on local and other code requirements, OEM recommendations, and Industry "Best Practices.”
  1. Ensures operating parameters and SMR processes, procedures, and frequencies are completed as prescribed.
  2. Responsible for efficiency and maintaining reliability of all mechanical systems.
  1. Contribute to creating tracking and maintaining operational budget for facility.
  2. Estimate time and materials needed to complete repairs and new projects.
  3. Assist in the change management process including maintaining associated documentation.
  4. Establish maintenance contracts with vendors as necessary for performance of all required maintenance.
  5. Directs, oversees, and inspects the work performed by outside contractors.
  6. Responsible for working within our teams, creating project plans and budgets for internal projects and presentation to management.
  7. Draft and Maintain Method of Procedures (MOPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) governing preventative maintenance of critical equipment.
  8. ICW associated site Facility Manager, Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCAs) efforts for applicable problems and malfunctions involving critical infrastructure. Including determining details/timeline of the incident, all contributing factors, developing and tracking all associated corrective actions and process improvements associated with event.
  9. Complies with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agency, and company directives related to building operations and work safety.
  10. ICW site Facility Managers, Responsible for managing maintenance work order and asset tracking software, including uploading new work orders and processes as required.
  11. Write and maintain operational procedures and standards for all critical infrastructure.
  12. Train staff on all critical infrastructure and emergency operating procedures
  13. Responsible for building management system control and coordinating efforts with controls contractors.
  14. Communicate complex technical information to multiple people with various levels of technical knowledge.
  15. Best efforts to be available via phone for off hours emergencies that require technical assistance.
  16. Risk analysis and creation of scopes of work related to preventative maintenance and resolution needs on building and facility equipment.
  17. Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) planning and tracking to assess all possible risk to the facility.

  19. Communicate to visitors, vendors, contractors, customers, and management daily as required.

Education:
  1. High school diploma or general education degree (GED), bachelor's degree and/or professional/technical certification in related field strongly preferred.

Experience:
  1. Comprehensive knowledge of industrial HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical systems, Fire/Life safety systems, and control systems with a heavy emphasis on mechanical. EPA Section 608 Technician Certification - Universal Type is highly desired.
  1. 5 years of experience in a Data Center environment.

  1. 5 years' experience with building automation systems.

Skills and Abilities

job.title: Manufacturing Qualification Specialist
job.description:
Execution of qualification activities (IQ/OQ/PQ) for manufacturing equipment, processes, and Materials within Enterprise Quality – Change Management & Systems. Supports the Change Control & Qualification team's protocol execution, documentation, traceability and record management workload. Day-to-day direction from Manager

This is a hands-on execution role supporting equipment and process qualification activities within a manufacturing environment. The contractor will draft, execute and close out Installation, Operational and Performance Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) protocols for manufacturing equipment and systems. They will generate qualification reports, document results and ensure full traceability of records in accordance with internal procedures and applicable regulatory requirements. The role requires close coordination on the factory floor with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality and Project teams to complete qualification testing around production windows. The contractor will also support documentation remediation, record management and change-control linkage for qualified equipment. This is an execution role, not a strategy or program-design role; success is measured by timely, right-first-time completion of qualification deliverables.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (equivalent hands-on qualification experience considered in lieu of degree)
5+ years executing equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) and process validation in a GMP or otherwise regulated manufacturing environment
Demonstrated experience authoring and executing protocols and writing summary reports, including deviation/discrepancy documentation and traceability
Working proficiency with electronic quality systems (e.g., TrackWise or comparable eQMS), document management systems and MS Office/Excel; validation or quality certification (CQE, CQA, ASQ or similar) preferred

Top 3 Skills:
1. Hands-on equipment qualification and process validation execution (IQ/OQ/PQ)
2. Technical writing - protocol authoring, report generation and GMP-compliant documentation
3. Cross-functional coordination and self-directed execution in a live factory environment

job.title: Machine Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a Maintenance Technician to oversee the upkeep, troubleshooting, and repair of our equipment and facilities. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in general mechanical maintenance, with a specialized background in electrical systems or welding/fabrication considered a major advantage. In this role, you will play a critical part in minimizing downtime and ensuring a safe, efficient operational environment.

Key Responsibilities
General Mechanical & Facility Maintenance
Perform routine inspections and preventive maintenance on machinery, conveyor systems, and facility infrastructure.
Diagnose and repair mechanical breakdowns swiftly to minimize production or operational downtime.
Manage work orders through our digital maintenance tracking system, accurately logging parts used and time spent.
Follow safety protocols strictly, including OSHA guidelines, PPE requirements, and lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures.
Electrical Responsibilities (Strong Plus)
Troubleshoot electrical components, including motors, relays, switches, circuit breakers, and control panels.
Read and interpret electrical schematics and wiring diagrams to safely isolate and resolve complex faults.
Assist with minor wiring installations and the replacement of faulty electrical hardware up to code.
Welding & Fabrication Responsibilities (Strong Plus)
Fabricate and repair metal structures, brackets, frames, or equipment guards using MIG, TIG, or Stick welding techniques.
Operate shop equipment safely, including torches, grinders, plasma cutters, and drill presses.
Modify or reinforce existing machinery to improve structural integrity and operational safety.

Qualifications & Skills
Experience: 2–5 years of experience in industrial, manufacturing, or commercial facility maintenance.
Technical Skills: Strong mechanical aptitude with a solid understanding of hydraulics, pneumatics, and hand/power tools.
Electrical Preferred: Valid electrical certification, or proven hands-on experience troubleshooting low-to-medium voltage systems.
Welding Preferred: Welding certification (AWS) or strong structural welding and metal fabrication skills.
Physical Demands: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs, climb ladders, and stand or kneel for extended periods.

job.title: IT Business Analyst
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an experienced IT Business Analyst to support manufacturing operations and IT initiatives across multiple factory locations. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring technology solutions align with operational needs and business objectives.
The ideal candidate will bring experience in manufacturing environments, strong business analysis skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects while delivering well-documented requirements, testing, training, and process improvement initiatives in a regulated manufacturing setting.

Core Responsibilities
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements for IT solutions supporting manufacturing operations.
• Create Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), process flows, use cases, test cases, and other project documentation.
• Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment of business needs and technology solutions.
• Lead small projects or workstreams, managing scope, schedule, and costs from initiation through completion.
• Facilitate meetings with internal teams, vendors, and third-party partners throughout the project lifecycle.
• Support system testing and validation activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ, while ensuring compliance with quality standards.
• Perform functionality and usability testing, develop and execute UAT scenarios, document results, and manage defect resolution prior to go-live.
• Develop and implement process improvement initiatives by identifying gaps, defining requirements, and optimizing workflows with cross-functional teams.
• Partner with support teams to transition projects into operational maintenance and provide post-implementation support.
• Own project transition deliverables, including system configuration documentation, support guides, knowledge transfer materials, and end-user training.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
• 5 to 8 years of experience as an IT Business Analyst or Project Manager developing, supporting, or implementing IT solutions.
• Experience working in a manufacturing environment.
• Strong ability to write clear and comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and related project documentation.
• Experience performing user acceptance testing (UAT), functionality testing, and system validation activities.
• Proven ability to lead small projects and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly.
• Strong collaboration, influencing, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and proactively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with regulated environments.
• Experience with manufacturing systems.

Work Details
• Support IT projects for manufacturing facilities located in Nashville, TN, Hopkinsville, KY, and Clarksville, TN.

job.title: Production Operator - 3rd Shift
job.description:
Production Operator - 3rd Shift 3rd shift: 7:00PM - 5:30AM (Monday night through Thursday night) -
possible Sunday OT

(training to start on 1stshift) Monday - Friday
Temp to Perm Position

Position
Entry-level position within the manufacturing area, primarily responsible for performing weigh-up or packaging duties within the production department. Ensures the highest quality product at the lowest possible cost and meets customer specifications and delivery requirements in accordance with *** policies and procedures.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
Obtains the correct documentation for the batch. Ensures the correct ingredients are
delivered to the work area. May be required to obtain the correct ingredients for mixing and weigh out the ingredients to meet the recipe specifications.
Sets up and starts any weigh-up or packaging machinery, checking all controls for
adherence to operating/safety procedures.
Notifies appropriate personnel of any issues, problems or concerns in a timely manner.
Safely and neatly processes, batch off, screen, cut up, package and/or skid material
to correct size/container according to customer specifications.
Accurately supplies/supports Production Operators with appropriate materials/functions to
efficiently keep all equipment operational.
Performs all required machine cleaning.
Completes and maintains required paperwork and/or documents.
Follows and complies with all safety and work rules and regulations. Maintains
departmental housekeeping standards.
Other duties as assigned.

Physical/Environ. Demands
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; talk and/or hear.
Occasionally required to sit.
The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 55 pounds and occasionally handle up to 250 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Requires the use of safety equipment as dictated by the work area such as
safety glasses and shoes, dust mask, hard hat, respirator, face shield, hearing protection, chemical suit, gloves, aprons, etc. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate with the exception of high noise areas. Proper personal safety equipment needs to be used while performing this job and that equipment is dictated by the plant safety guidelines. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, dust, fumes, airborne particles, chemical dust, and risk of

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Exciting career opportunity for an experienced Quality Engineering professional to join an excellent team of hard-working professionals at one of the islands finest defense / aerospace manufacturers. This is a well-established yet rapidly growing company that offers a very generous benefits package, flexible work schedule and awesome work culture!

We are seeking a highly motivated Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will provide quality assurance support to customers, suppliers, product development and manufacturing teams, resolving defects and ensuring products meet both customer and regulatory specifications. This role requires collaboration throughout the production lifecycle to ensure compliance with quality standards and continuous improvement of processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure products meet both customer and regulatory specifications
  • Develop and implement quality control plans and procedures
  • Conduct quality audits and inspections to identify defects and non-conformities
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues, including root cause analysis and corrective actions
  • Monitor and analyze quality performance metrics to identify areas for improvement
  • Participate in design and process reviews to ensure quality requirements are met
  • Provide training and support to production teams on quality standards and procedures
  • Create test procedures and quality plans to ensure product scope, requirements, and product functions are clearly defined, recommending improvements where needed.
  • Ensure products meet organizational, customer, and industry quality standards, including AS9100, AS9102, and other relevant aerospace regulations.
  • Support product development and operations teams by providing analysis and expertise during inspection and quality control stages.
  • Collaborate on root cause and corrective action plans to prevent recurrence of defects or process deviations and ensure timely responses from responsible parties.
  • Generate and Analyze quality data to identify trends, with the goal of reducing defects and improving product reliability.
  • Coordinate and support First Article Inspection (FAI) per AS9102 requirements to ensure products meet both internal and external quality standards.
  • Assist in supplier quality activities including developing inspection plans for purchased products and parts, reviewing supplier first articles and performing on-site audits.
  • Lead quality planning efforts while collaborating with design engineering on new product development, including quality control strategies and ensure timely and compliant project execution.
  • Develop inspection plans for purchased products and parts.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement within the Quality Management System through procedural and product internal audits, supporting customer and 3rd party audits.
  • Support or lead internal, customer and 3rd party audits.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field
  • Strong knowledge of quality control methodologies and tools
  • Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action processes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of, or the ability to learn, the organization's production processes and quality management systems (QMS).
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across departments, including developers, project managers, and customer support teams.
  • Proficient in, or the ability to learn, root cause analysis and corrective action methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Desired Experience:

  • Experience with root cause – corrective action investigation.
  • Knowledge about First Article Inspection Reports per AS9102.
  • Familiarity with Material Review Board (MRB) processes.
  • Quality certifications such as CQE (Certified Quality Engineer), CQA (Certified Quality Auditor), or similar.
  • Experience with AS9100, ISO 9001, FAA or NADCAP regulations.
  • Experience with quality inspection tools such as Net-Inspect, InspectionXpert, or similar software preferred

This position involves exposure to projects and contracts subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). As a result, only U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents (Green Card holders) are eligible for employment in this role. Applicants must meet these requirements to be considered.

job.title: Shipping Inventory Clerk
job.description:
Responsibilities
The primary goal is to satisfying customer requirements of quality, quantity, and delivery, in a safe manner, while maximizing productivity. Specifically, the Shipping and Inventory Clerk is responsible for all job activities required to support production processes. These activities include but are not limited to: assisting in a variety of warehouse duties, including shipping and receiving, building pallets/crates and packaging materials for shipping, monitoring and maintaining inventory; preparing work to be accomplished by studying assembly instructions, blueprint specifications, and parts lists; gathering parts, subassemblies, tools, and materials (kitting).

Other responsibilities:

  • Maintains supplies inventory by checking stock to determine inventory level; anticipating needed supplies; placing and expediting orders for supplies; verifying receipt of supplies
  • Package, secure and load product
  • Track and prepare documents for product while monitoring database activity for inventory
  • Communicate effectively with vendors when necessary, both verbally and in writing.
  • Maintains dock and storage facilities in an organized manner; receives, unpacks, and delivers goods; restocks items as necessary; labels shelves
  • Maintains all necessary associated documentation to support shipping and inventory activity
  • Follows all plant safety guidelines; practices and procedures. Must be aware of activity in the work surroundings and maintain a clean and safe work area
  • Properly use personal protective equipment when required
  • Positions parts and subassemblies by using templates or reading measurements
  • Supports all departments with inventory needs
  • Perform other tasks as assigned

Qualifications
Prior manufacturing experience is highly preferred. Any technical or vocational education/training in relation to skills listed below is also desirable.
  • Blueprint reading knowledge preferred
  • Must have basic computer skills (primarily Microsoft Excel)
  • Must have basic measurement and math skills; must have knowledge of basic hand tools and measuring instruments
  • Forklifts and Overhead crane experience preferred (in-house training available)
  • SAP experience desirable
  • Must be able to pass a background check and pre employment drug test
  • Team player - must be able to work with others and/or alone
  • Must have and maintain a high sense of urgency to meet and exceed all production goals
  • Attentive to detail watching for material defects, quality issues, inventory levels
  • Physically capable of standing, walking, bending, pushing, pulling, reaching and twisting throughout shift
  • Capable of repetitively lifting 25-50 lbs.
  • Must maintain regular attendance – have reliable transportation
  • Candidates must be flexible to work overtime as needed, which may include weekends and/or holidays

Work Environment
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee works in typical manufacturing environment with overhead cranes and forklifts.
  • Overhead LED lights throughout the workspace create a bright workspace for employees to safely perform their work.
  • Normally clean work environment where the process creates some grinding dust, heat/cold, fumes/odors, and vibration. Housekeeping is performed as needed throughout the day and at the end of each shift.
  • The noise level in the work environment is normal to manufacturing processes with air tools, grinders, and other tools. Yearly audiometric testing is provided by the company to monitor areas for improvement.
  • Non-climate-controlled facility in the summer, each work area is provided with fans to help keep cool. In the winter it is heated.


Education and Experience
High School Diploma or equivalent
Entry level experience (training may be provided)

Required Equipment
Steel Toe Shoes/Boots

job.title: Credit Representative
job.description:
Credit Representative

Position Overview

The Credit Representative provides operational, administrative, and reporting support to the Credit Department within an invoice factoring environment. This position works closely with Credit Analysts and Credit leadership to ensure information is accurate, organized, current, and readily available to support effective portfolio monitoring and credit risk management.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with large amounts of data, and proficient in Microsoft Excel. While the primary focus of the position is administrative and reporting support, analytical aptitude and an interest in developing credit and risk management skills are highly valued.

This position is well suited for someone who enjoys working with data, identifying discrepancies, improving processes, and supporting a fast-paced team where accuracy and timely information are critical.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Credit Team & Administrative Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to Credit Analysts and Credit leadership.
  • Assist analysts with gathering, organizing, and maintaining:
    • Client information
    • Debtor information
    • Accounts receivable data
    • Credit-related information
  • Maintain accurate documentation and departmental records.
  • Assist with routine account maintenance and data updates within applicable systems and tracking tools.
  • Coordinate and track requests, follow-ups, and outstanding action items.
  • Prepare information and supporting materials for recurring:
    • Credit reviews
    • Portfolio reviews
    • Debtor reviews
    • Leadership reviews
  • Document meeting discussions, decisions, and action items as requested.
  • Follow up with appropriate team members to help ensure outstanding items are completed.
  • Support Credit leadership with special projects, data requests, research, and departmental initiatives.

Key Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong organizational and administrative skills.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ability to work with large amounts of data.
  • Ability to gather, organize, maintain, and track financial and credit-related information.
  • Strong analytical aptitude with the ability to identify discrepancies and data inconsistencies.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, requests, and follow-up items in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Credit Analysts, Credit leadership, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Interest in developing knowledge of credit analysis, portfolio monitoring, accounts receivable, and credit risk management.
  • Previous experience within credit, accounts receivable, finance, banking, lending, factoring, or financial services is beneficial.

job.title: Sheet Metal/LO Coater Technician - Secret Clearance
job.description:
Description:
Read and interpret aircraft engineering drawings, technical manuals, structure repair manuals, understanding symbols, flags, and general notes - Identify aircraft locations by station, butt-line, and waterline as shown on engineering documentation and technical orders. Work with precision measuring instruments, micrometers, calipers, tape measures, and standard scales. Utilizes tools to include but not limited to drills, angle motors, shears, drill press, and pneumatic riveter. Fabricate detail parts such as shims, splices, gussets, angles, brackets, doublers, stiffeners, and patches - Use shop aids to facilitate assembly and installation as required.

Bonding of aircraft parts, assemblies and materials on complete and incomplete aircraft where methods and operational sequences are not established, complete information is not readily available, and tooling is not provided or is inadequate, exercising a complete knowledge of bonding practices, procedures, makes layouts and locates parts and material for exacting fit where critical surface contours, edge distances or coordinated dimensions must be established and maintained; completes all bonding operations exercising ingenuity in determining the most efficient fabrication and assembly methods; verifies application/condition of installed materials for conformity to specifications and determines material and time required to perform repairs; removes, takes corrective action and makes reinstallations where design and modification changes. Sets up and operates various types of material testers and mixers.

Record data and procedural information for future use by others. Improvises shop aids to facilitate fabrication, application or assembly operations. Fabricates shims, brackets and plates as required and performs assembly operations such as trimming, filing, drilling, riveting, reforming and fitting of parts and details, and removing burrs or other surface imperfections as required.
Work in a safe and efficient manner while maintaining a clean, FOD-free work area.

These positions are mostly working LO restore and some modifications. Workers will be require to utilize full face respirator, Tyvek suits, gloves, etc. to complete daily duties.

- 5th Generation Fighter Aircraft Sheet Metal Experience, and or Low Observable Coatings application experience and training, 5 or 7 Skill level USAF AFSC, Navy NEC, or Marine MOS discipline rating or an equivalent Air frame and Power Plant, FAA certificate or equivalent 5 years experience
Desired--F-22/F-35 Experience Low Observable Coatings application experience and training.
Workers will be require to utilize full face respirator, Tyvek suits, gloves, etc. to complete daily duties.
This position requires a government security clearance, you must be a US Citizen for consideration.

job.description:
POSITIONS KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

The Research Technician provides technical laboratory support for the R&D Department in support of product and process development initiatives. This role performs routine tasks and assignments up to moderate complexity with limited supervision, applying sound judgment, attention to detail, and critical thinking to execute work effectively. The Research Technician interfaces periodically with internal partners (e.g., R&D, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, QA, Operations) to support project milestones and deliverables.


Primary Responsibilities:

Technical Support (70%)

Completes routine and non-routine R&D tasks and assignments under limited supervision of Product Development Scientists by organizing, prioritizing, and executing tasks aligned to business objectives.

Prepares prototypes and samples of dessert food products (including cakes, cheesecakes, cookies, donuts, and ice cream) in support of new product development and product or process improvements.

Adheres to approved methodologies to ensure validity and reliability of experiments and analyses.

Documents laboratory work, tests conducted, and results in lab notebooks or designated computerized systems.

Supports product cuttings by preparing samples and assisting with session setup.

Demonstrates the ability to manage daytoday priorities, adjust to changing project needs, and escalate issues as appropriate.

Requests, prepares, uses, cleans, and stores laboratory equipment and supplies required for assignments. Uses equipment according to established instructions and procedures; performs minor, user-level checks as part of regular use.

Maintains a sanitary, safe, and organized work environment in compliance with safety, food safety, and quality standards.

Experiments & Analysis (30%)

Provides support for basic laboratory and pilot plant experiments in support of dessert food product and process development or improvement initiatives, independently or in collaboration with other associates.

Accurately evaluates, records, and communicates results to project team members.

Uses established methods and procedures, making appropriate adjustments during experimentation (e.g., ingredient levels, sampling techniques) based on observations and direction.

Take accurate measurements from laboratory and pilot plant experiments.



Skills/Experience:

Associates degree in culinary science, food science, food preparation, or related field OR 1+ year of job-related experience in hands-on food preparation in a high-volume or production-based food environment (e.g., R&D kitchen, commercial kitchen or bakery) or food-related product development.

Hands-on food preparation experience, with a preference for experience making dessert items (including cakes, cheesecakes, cookies, donuts, and ice cream).

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, hands on test kitchen environment.

Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and documentation standards.

Ability to apply basic critical thinking skills to routine technical problems.

Ability to extract and record data following standard procedures.

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a cross functional environment.

Physical & Work Requirements

Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds frequently; occasional lifting up to 50 pounds.

Prolonged periods of standing and walking between workstations.

Frequent bending, stooping, reaching, pushing and pulling; occasional climbing of steps and/or ladders.

Use of hand tools and precision instruments requiring fine motor skills.

Exposure to food ingredients, chemicals, cleaning agents, and varying temperatures.

Onsite, regular, and predictable attendance as scheduled is required.



Required Skills:

Additional Information: This is an entry level temporary role only, contract will likely conclude the end of December. Looking to start the person ASAP. The work hours are M-Th 8am to 5pm, F 8am to 1pm, work will be done onsite. Virtual interviews will be required, possibly in person for second interviews. Background screen required, drug screen is waived.

job.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer – Sustaining
job.description:
Sustaining Engineering Manager Job Description

Location: Edinboro, PA
Position Type: Full-Time

Position Overview

We are seeking a Sustaining Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for supporting released products throughout their entire lifecycle. This position will provide technical leadership and people management while ensuring products remain reliable, manufacturable, compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with customer and business requirements.

The manager will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, Customer Support, and New Product Development to resolve technical issues, improve existing products, manage engineering changes, and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Sustaining Engineers.
  • Provide technical direction for released products throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Lead root cause analysis, failure investigations, corrective actions, and CAPA activities.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to resolve production issues, improve yield, and reduce costs.
  • Oversee engineering changes, deviations, ECOs/ECNs, and technical documentation.
  • Support customer escalations and field issues through engineering analysis and corrective solutions.
  • Ensure products maintain compliance with applicable industry standards, safety requirements, and regulatory certifications.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, reliability, manufacturability, cost reduction, and product performance.
  • Manage engineering priorities, workload, resources, and project assignments.
  • Coach and develop engineers through technical guidance, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Partner with New Product Development and ETO teams to ensure smooth transition of new products into sustaining engineering.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve long-term product health and operational performance.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership experience.
  • Background in sustaining engineering, product engineering, manufacturing engineering, or related engineering disciplines.
  • Experience with root cause analysis, failure investigations, CAPA, and corrective action processes.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
  • Experience working with Manufacturing, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and/or Product Management.
  • Experience with engineering change management, ECO/ECN processes, and technical documentation.
  • Experience with 3D CAD and PLM systems.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical problem solving with team leadership and resource management.

Ideal Candidate Background

Look for candidates with titles such as:

  • Sustaining Engineering Manager
  • Engineering Manager
  • Sustaining Engineering Lead
  • Product Engineering Manager
  • Product Development Manager
  • Manufacturing Engineering Manager
  • Engineering Supervisor
  • Senior Manufacturing Engineer
  • Senior Product Engineer
  • Sustaining Engineer
  • Product Engineer

Key differentiators: Candidates who have managed engineers and have hands-on experience with manufacturing issues, RCA/CAPA, engineering changes, product reliability, and lifecycle management.

job.title: IT Technical Lead - (Banking)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking an IT Technical Lead to provide technical leadership for technology platforms supporting Commercial Real Estate (CRE) lending operations. This role is responsible for the architecture, development, integration, implementation, support, and continuous improvement of solutions across the commercial real estate lending lifecycle.
The IT Technical Lead partners with business stakeholders, architects, product owners, engineers, and vendors to design scalable, secure technology solutions aligned with business strategy and enterprise architecture standards. The role also drives engineering excellence, mentors development teams, and ensures system reliability, security, and performance.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and modernization initiatives for Commercial Real Estate originations applications and integrations.
• Design scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions supporting commercial real estate lending processes.
• Define application architecture standards, integration patterns, and engineering best practices.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve operational efficiency and reduce technical debt.
• Lead development, enhancement, implementation, and support activities across the technology ecosystem.
• Collaborate with product owners and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
• Review and approve technical designs, code, deployment plans, and implementation strategies.
• Establish and enforce coding standards, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, and security requirements.
• Participate in design reviews, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support activities.
• Serve as the technical subject matter expert for Moody's CreditLens and related lending applications.
• Support integrations between CreditLens and internal lending, workflow, document, and data platforms.
• Drive technical solutions supporting deal intake, underwriting, financial spreading, credit approvals, covenant tracking, and portfolio management processes.
• Partner with business and vendor teams to evaluate platform capabilities and roadmap opportunities.
• Mentor developers and engineers while fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
• Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to project teams.
• Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex technical issues.
• Establish performance, availability, resiliency, and monitoring standards for supported applications.
• Promote Agile delivery practices and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• 8+ years of application development, systems integration, or software engineering experience.
• 3+ years of technical leadership experience leading development teams or large-scale technology initiatives.
• Experience designing and supporting enterprise applications in complex environments.
• Strong experience with .NET / C# development.
• Strong experience with REST APIs and service-oriented architectures.
• Strong experience with SQL and relational databases.
• Strong experience with system integrations and middleware technologies.
• Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• Strong experience with cloud and SaaS application architectures.
• Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or similar toolsets.
• Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and engineering best practices.
• Excellent problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Commercial lending or Commercial Real Estate lending technology experience.
• Experience with Moody's CreditLens or other commercial credit underwriting platforms.
• Knowledge of CRE origination, underwriting, credit approval, and portfolio management processes.
• Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms with enterprise applications.
• Familiarity with enterprise data integration, cloud platforms, and modern API architectures.
• Experience supporting regulatory, risk, and compliance requirements within financial services.
• Architecture certification or advanced technical certifications.
