job.title: Dispatcher
job.description:
Position Overview

The Dispatcher provides Call Management System scheduling and coordination support to customers, Service Delivery Team Members, Field Associates, and Business Management Team Members. This position shares responsibility for meeting customer service performance expectations while also providing focused support for special projects involving high-visibility customers.

The ideal candidate is self-directed, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced service environment. The position requires flexibility to work varied shifts, including evenings and weekends.

Key Responsibilities

Dispatch & Scheduling

  • Review incoming service calls, determine urgency, and schedule calls appropriately.
  • Dispatch service calls to technicians and Flex Labor Partners and monitor assignments through completion.
  • Coordinate with technicians, internal business teams, and customers regarding scheduling and service needs.
  • Contact customers with estimated technician arrival times as necessary.
  • Utilize knowledge of technician coverage and geographic territories to improve scheduling and resource efficiency.
  • Coordinate parts ordering and shipments with technicians and schedule service calls accordingly.
  • Identify duplicate service calls and bundle them when appropriate.

Call Management & SLA Monitoring

  • Monitor the Call Management System in real time to ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are being met.
  • Ensure available technicians are actively assigned to service calls.
  • Monitor scheduling gaps or white space to maximize technician productivity and resource utilization.
  • Monitor incomplete service calls and escalate issues until they are resolved.
  • Document technician unavailability within the Call Management System during emergency situations according to established procedures.
  • Communicate technician availability issues to the appropriate internal teams.

Customer Service & Issue Resolution

  • Proactively identify and resolve scheduling and service-related issues.
  • Escalate urgent customer service needs and technician-related issues or concerns to the appropriate management team.
  • Document customer dissatisfaction and field-related issues and communicate them to the appropriate team for follow-up.
  • Document positive customer feedback and recognize technicians for strong performance.
  • Maintain professional communication with customers, technicians, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in conference calls regarding service operations and customer needs.
  • Provide analysis and updates related to:
    • Call volumes
    • High-priority customers
    • Known service issues
    • Technician availability
    • Service performance
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in customer service, call center operations, dispatching, scheduling, or a related environment.
  • Ability to work independently and be self-directed.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to use logic and understand operational and business efficiencies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively interact with customers, suppliers, technicians, and internal stakeholders at various organizational levels.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft applications and general PC systems.

Education

  • Associate degree preferred, or relevant equivalent experience.

Schedule & Travel

  • Must be available to work varied shifts, including evenings and weekends, as scheduled.
  • Minimal business travel may be required.

job.title: Commercial Operations & Analytics Specialist
job.description:
Nesco Resource is in search of a Commercial Operations & Analytics Specialist to join our client’s team based in Shelton, CT.
 
POSITION SUMMARY
This is a multifaceted administrative role supporting the sales department. The Commercial Operations & Analytics Specialist establishes and maintains the processes, systems, information, analytics, and follow-through required to effectively manage our client's commercial activities. The role provides reliable visibility across customers, opportunities, pipeline, quotes, projects, orders, SROs, commitments, actions, and results while transforming commercial and operational data into actionable business insights.
 
ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own day-to-day Commercial Operations discipline by documenting and improving workflows, ownership, handoffs, priorities, due dates, escalation paths, playbooks, standard work, and data definitions.
  • Maintain CRM discipline and data quality; ensure customer, contact, lead, opportunity, activity, next-action, and other required commercial information is complete, current, and accurate.
  • Maintain reliable opportunity and pipeline visibility; prepare reviews; identify stalled, aging, incomplete, high-priority, or at-risk opportunities; and support sales forecasting and forecast-accuracy analysis.
  • Establish visibility and accountability for quote requests, orders, major customer projects, SRO intake/tracking, customer commitments, milestones, open actions, exceptions, and follow-through.
  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, aging/exception reports, KPIs, and a Weekly Commercial Priorities View covering top customers, opportunities, pipeline, projects, quotes, SROs/issues, overdue actions, and decisions required.
  • Analyze revenue, bookings, backlog, customer/product/market performance, opportunity conversion, win/loss, purchasing patterns, retention, inactive customers, lead progression, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Identify bottlenecks, duplication, incomplete handoffs, and repeatable work that can be eliminated, simplified, standardized, delegated, automated, or supported through AI/RPA.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Application Engineering, Product Management, Sales Administration, Customer Service/Returns, Finance, and Operations to improve commercial execution and decision-making.
 
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related discipline preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • 2–5 years of experience in commercial/sales operations, business analytics, business operations, project coordination, CRM administration, financial analysis, or a related field preferred; manufacturing, industrial, B2B, or technical sales experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong Excel skills required; Power BI or similar BI tools preferred. CRM reporting experience required; HubSpot beneficial. ERP/business systems experience preferred; Infor/SyteLine beneficial. Power Query, SQL, AI, workflow automation, or RPA experience is a plus.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; highly organized and detail-oriented; persistent follow-through; process-driven mindset; business acumen; ability to translate data into actionable recommendations; strong project-management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills; initiative, accountability, curiosity, and comfort learning new business systems and manufacturing processes.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
  • 3 month temp to hire opportunity (benefits available)
  • 1st shift, Monday – Thursday, 7:30am – 5pm (30 min lunch) and Friday, 7:30am – 11:30am
  • Pay range $30 – 33.50/hour; $70K range upon conversion to perm
  • Offers opportunity for advancement

job.title: IT Support Specialist
job.description:
Entry-Level IT Help Desk / Support

Glens Falls, NY | $18-19/hour to start | Temp-to-Hire | Fully Onsite | M-F, 9am-5pm

Looking to break into IT but don't have formal IT experience yet?

We’re working with a growing technology-driven company in Glens Falls that is looking for an Entry-Level IT Help Desk / Support team member. This is a great opportunity for someone who is naturally tech-savvy, enjoys figuring things out, and has strong customer service skills — even if your experience has been in retail, call center, hospitality, service, or another customer-facing environment rather than IT.

Once fully trained, employees also have flexibility in choosing their regular schedule within the team's available hours, with options such as 8:00 AM–4:00 PM, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, or 10:00 AM–6:00 PM.

Why this role?

The company develops and supports its own technology, including customer-facing web applications and proprietary tools used in the transportation and logistics industry. This means you'll get exposure to real technology and troubleshooting while learning from an experienced IT team.

This could be a particularly good fit if you:

  • Have always been the person friends, family, or coworkers come to when they need help with technology
  • Have built or upgraded your own computer
  • Enjoy troubleshooting and figuring out why something isn't working
  • Have taken IT, networking, computer science, or other technology-related coursework
  • Have an IT certification such as CompTIA A+ or Network+
  • Have customer service experience and are comfortable talking with people by phone, email, and online chat
  • Want to turn your technical know-how into an actual IT career

What you'll do

You'll be the first point of contact for customers and internal employees who need help with technology and web-based applications. You'll learn the company's systems and help users navigate, troubleshoot, and resolve issues.

Responsibilities include:

  • Provide phone, online chat, and general customer support
  • Respond to customer questions and troubleshoot issues with web-based applications
  • Help customers understand and navigate new technology
  • Troubleshoot and document IT issues
  • Provide first-level support for software and web applications
  • Assist internal employees with workstation and other IT-related issues
  • Support network and user Help Desk requests
  • Help test web application updates before they go live
  • Document solutions and communicate technical information clearly

This is a temp-to-hire opportunity, with the goal of moving successful employees into a permanent position. Upon conversion, the company offers a pay increase and a strong benefits package.

job.title: EHS Specialist
job.description:
Position Summary
The Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist provides temporary coverage for Design & Engineering (D&E) laboratory operations during an employee maternity leave. The position supports laboratory safety, regulatory compliance, incident management, safety programs, industrial hygiene activities, reporting, and stakeholder communication for the Silicon Valley site.

Key Responsibilities
1. Incident Management and Investigation
Lead investigations of near misses, incidents, injuries, good catches, and safety observations.
Conduct root cause analyses and define corrective and preventive actions.
Coordinate and track corrective actions through closure.
Prepare investigation reports and communicate findings to D&E management.
Manage incident records and workflows in Intelex.
2. Laboratory Safety and Compliance
Conduct monthly D&E laboratory inspections.
Track findings, corrective actions, and closure status.
Support compliance assessments against internal requirements and applicable regulatory standards.
Participate in management assessments and audits.
Arrange annual inspection for lifting equipment
3. Safety Program Administration
Review and approve chemical requests, PPE requests, hazard assessments, and related EHS submissions.
Support work permit review and approval activities.
Update and maintain Level 4 (L4) EHS procedures and supporting documentation.
4. Industrial Hygiene and Exposure Monitoring
Coordinate and perform industrial hygiene sampling for lead, beryllium copper, noise, radiation, and other exposure assessments as required.
Maintain monitoring records and communicate results to relevant stakeholders.
Support follow-up actions arising from sampling activities.
5. Training and Safety Engagement
Coordinate required EHS training activities and track completion and attendance.
Support contractor safety engagement activities.
Deliver or facilitate safety communications and awareness sessions.
6. Reporting and Stakeholder Communication
Prepare monthly EHS performance reports.
Present safety metrics, inspection results, incident trends, and action status at D&E Staff meetings and D&E Lab Owner Safety meetings.
Coordinate with site EHS and D&E leadership on emerging risks and mitigation plans.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Health, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of EHS experience in laboratory, engineering, manufacturing, semiconductor, or technology environments.
Experience conducting incident investigations and root cause analysis.
Knowledge of OSHA requirements and EHS management systems.
Experience with industrial hygiene sampling programs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting semiconductor or high-tech R&D laboratories.
Familiarity with Intelex or an equivalent EHS management system.
Familiarity with 3E chemical management systems.
Experience supporting radiation, chemical, and electrical safety programs.
CIH, CSP, CHMM, or equivalent certification.
Expected Outcomes
Incident investigations, reports, and corrective-action tracking completed in a timely manner.
Monthly laboratory inspections completed, with findings and actions tracked to closure.
Monthly EHS performance reporting prepared and communicated.
EHS requests, including chemical, PPE, hazard assessment, and work permit requests, reviewed within established service expectations.
Industrial hygiene sampling records, results, and follow-up actions maintained.
L4 procedures and supporting documentation kept current.
EHS training coordination records and attendance tracking maintained.
Other:
4 days per week onsite

job.title: Project Manager - (Payments & Deposits)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Project Manager to lead the delivery of a Payments & Deposits Services Modernization initiative. This role will drive a portfolio of automation, AI, and workflow transformation efforts across the Payments & Deposit Services organization, overseeing project governance, financial management, and cross-functional coordination.
The Project Manager will partner with operations, technology, risk, and vendor teams to modernize check processing, wire and RTP, ACH, lockbox, cash vault, virtual item processing, and reconciliation platforms. The role focuses on delivering measurable cost savings, reducing operational risk, and improving the client experience.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate multiple concurrent modernization workstreams from intake through delivery, ensuring milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and timely issue resolution.
• Drive project governance and reporting, providing clear status updates, metrics, and escalations to leadership and business partners.
• Manage financial forecasting, budgeting, invoice tracking, and benefit realization, including cost savings and FTE efficiency tracking.
• Coordinate project scope, requirements, dependencies, and resource planning across operations, technology, risk, and vendor teams.
• Monitor cost, schedule, and technical performance across initiative components, identifying and escalating risks and issues as needed.
• Partner with process owners and subject matter experts to prioritize opportunities, develop business cases, and manage initiatives through funding checkpoints.
• Define and manage project scope, objectives, deliverables, and value propositions across stakeholders and lines of business.
• Develop integrated project plans, manage the critical path, and report progress against milestones and target outcomes.
• Ensure client and operational impacts are considered throughout planning, solution design, and change management activities.
• Support vendor engagement and contract management activities, ensuring adherence to obligations and performance expectations.
• Lead communication planning and stakeholder engagement across teams, leadership groups, and delivery partners.
• Follow established organizational processes for work delivery, change control, and project artifact management.
• Champion continuous improvement and operational excellence throughout the initiative lifecycle.
• Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support organizational priorities.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Demonstrated project or program management experience, preferably within financial services or banking operations.
• Working knowledge of payments and deposit operations, including ACH, wire/RTP, check processing, lockbox, and reconciliation processes, and/or technology modernization programs.
• Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, project financial planning, and benefit tracking.
• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences.
• Strategic thinking with the ability to define and communicate initiative vision, priorities, and outcomes.
• Strong leadership, collaboration, execution, financial management, and risk management capabilities.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or Agile certifications such as CSM or PSM.
• Experience delivering automation, RPA, or AI-enabled transformation initiatives.
• Experience managing initiatives within Commercial Banking, Payments, or related operational domains.
• Familiarity with vendor management, business case development, and cost-benefit or TCO modeling.

Work Details
• General office environment with prolonged sitting, frequent use of a PC or laptop, communication in person and by phone, and occasional lifting of items up to 10 pounds.

job.title: Transmit Core Developer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a developer to design, develop, configure, and support customer identity and authentication solutions leveraging the Transmit Security and Mosaic platforms. This role partners with cybersecurity, digital banking, fraud, authentication, and application development teams to deliver secure and seamless customer onboarding and login experiences.
The position focuses on identity orchestration, passwordless authentication, multi-factor authentication, risk-based authentication, and integration with banking applications while supporting secure customer identity management initiatives.

Core Responsibilities
• Design and implement authentication and identity management solutions using Transmit Security.
• Build and maintain customer identity journeys, including registration, login, MFA enrollment, and account recovery flows.
• Integrate Transmit Security APIs and SDKs into web and mobile applications.
• Configure identity orchestration workflows and adaptive authentication policies.
• Support passkey and passwordless authentication initiatives.
• Collaborate with cybersecurity, fraud, risk, and digital banking teams to enhance security and user experience.
• Troubleshoot authentication issues, integration defects, and production incidents.
• Participate in architecture reviews and ensure compliance with security and banking standards.
• Create technical documentation, support procedures, and implementation standards.
• Assist with vendor engagement and platform upgrades.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
• 8+ years of Transmit Core development experience.
• 10+ years of software development experience.
• Experience with Transmit Security and the Mosaic Platform.
• Strong knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML.
• Experience with Java, JavaScript, .NET, or similar enterprise development platforms.
• Expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM).
• Experience with MFA, FIDO2, WebAuthn, and passkey technologies.
• Knowledge of API security, token management, and encryption technologies.
• Experience working with AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud environments.
• Experience with Agile development and DevSecOps practices.

Preferred Skills or Experience

• Experience with customer authentication and fraud prevention solutions.
• Experience supporting customer onboarding and KYC integrations.
• Experience with identity orchestration platforms.
• Experience with vendor platforms such as Okta.

job.description:

This position will lead the development and execution of Global Supply Management (GSM) Strategic Sourcing strategies, policies, tactics and objectives for assigned complex global commodities that align and are linked with the business units, commercial, supply chain and manufacturing strategies.

Key Responsibilities
Project Procurement Management – Planning & Strategy Development
Develop and/or assist with Strategic Sourcing plans and objectives (short & long term) based on forecasts of future demand and taking into account economic and currency trends and conditions that affect GSM, the business, and the global commodity sourced.
Apply a thorough understanding of the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) model, including cost of acquisition, use/administration, maintenance, transaction processing, and disposal of a given item or service.
Develop and use Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) by subdividing major project deliverables (from contract documents, scope of work, and historical contract data) into smaller, more manageable work packages.
Ensure well-developed Statements of Work (SOW) to provide clarity and accountability.
Understand and apply funding stage-gate processes to ensure alignment with project objectives.
Identify risks and develop comprehensive risk management plans to mitigate them.

Bid & Tender Process
Develop Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs) for capital equipment, services, and facilities.
Lead pre-bid and post-award reviews and execute Decision Analysis to facilitate supplier selection and optimal procurement decisions.

Manage various contract types, including:
Firm Fixed Price
Lump Sum
Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP)
Turnkey
Cost-Plus Fixed Fee
Time & Material
Unit Price
Shared Savings Contracts
Define and monitor performance schedules, ensuring sufficient detail to track critical milestones and assess project progress.
Ensure scope is delivered as agreed and meets the required levels of performance and quality.
Ensure both parties adhere to the conditions of the contract.
Ensure relationships between parties remain open, constructive, and collaborative.
Lead the full lifecycle of Contract Management, including contract planning, tendering (RFP/RFQ processes), statements of work, and overall project plans (scope, risk, procurement, quality, schedule, cost, and safety management).

A Leading formulator and manufacturer of specialty coatings, adhesives, and sealants serving the building and construction end markets. Founded in 2015 by a private equity firm, has scaled rapidly through organic and acquisition growth into one of the largest coatings, adhesives, and sealants companies in North America providing products which encompass the building envelope from roof to flooring and outdoor spaces. The technician collaborates closely with Client Support Labs, operating locations, product centers, and the [strong style= "white-space: pre-wrap; "]InTouch repository to ensure seamless communication and continuous improvement.

Service Deliverables — Ensure all job deliverables are accurate, complete, and delivered on schedule.

job.title: Transmit Security Engineer (Banking)
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Customer Identity & Authentication Engineer to design, develop, configure, and support customer identity and authentication solutions using the Transmit Security and Mosaic platforms. This role partners with cybersecurity, digital banking, fraud, authentication, and application development teams to deliver secure, frictionless customer onboarding and login experiences.
The position focuses on identity orchestration, passwordless authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), risk-based authentication, and integration with banking applications. The engineer will support customer identity journeys while helping maintain security, compliance, and user experience standards.

Core Responsibilities
• Design and implement authentication and identity management solutions using Transmit Security.
• Build and maintain customer identity journeys, including registration, login, MFA enrollment, and account recovery processes.
• Integrate Transmit Security APIs and SDKs with web and mobile banking applications.
• Configure identity orchestration workflows and adaptive authentication policies.
• Support passkey and passwordless authentication initiatives.
• Collaborate with fraud, risk, cybersecurity, and digital banking teams to enhance customer security and user experience.
• Troubleshoot authentication issues, integration defects, and production incidents.
• Participate in architecture reviews and ensure compliance with security and banking standards.
• Create technical documentation, support procedures, and implementation standards.
• Assist with vendor engagement and platform upgrades.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• 5+ years of software engineering, IAM, CIAM, or authentication experience.
• 2+ years implementing customer authentication platforms.
• Experience with Transmit Security and the Mosaic Platform.
• Strong knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML.
• Experience with Java, JavaScript, .NET, or similar enterprise development platforms.
• Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions.
• Knowledge of MFA, FIDO2, WebAuthn, and passkey technologies.
• Experience with API security, token management, and encryption technologies.
• Experience with cloud technologies, including AWS, Azure, or hybrid environments.
• Familiarity with Agile development and DevSecOps practices.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Banking or financial services experience.
• Experience with customer authentication and fraud prevention solutions.
• Experience integrating customer onboarding and KYC solutions.
• Experience with identity orchestration platforms.
• Experience with vendor platforms such as Okta.
• Security certifications such as CISSP, IAM certifications, or cloud certifications.

Work Details
• Collaborates with Digital Banking, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Fraud Prevention, AML/Risk teams, and Mobile and Online Banking development teams.

job.title: Tool & Die Maker
job.description:
Tool & Die Maker

Schedule & Pay

  • 1st Shift: Monday–Thursday, 6:00 AM–4:30 PM

  • Pay: $31–$38/hour, with flexibility for the right candidate

  • 4-Day Workweek

Why You’ll Want This Opportunity

Great pay, a 4-day workweek, and a strong overall package! This is an opportunity to put your Tool & Die expertise to work on complex tooling projects while having your Fridays off. The company offers a benefits package, PTO, annual profit sharing, and flexibility on compensation for the right candidate—all while giving you the opportunity to work on challenging tooling projects from start to finish.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Tool & Die Maker to join our team. This position is approximately 80% Tool & Die work, with a strong focus on building, repairing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and reverse-engineering complex tooling and die rings.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working with complex tooling and be comfortable taking projects from start to finish. Experience with older equipment and troubleshooting challenging tooling issues is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, repair, maintain, and troubleshoot complex tooling and die rings.

  • Reverse-engineer tooling and develop solutions for tooling issues.

  • Read and interpret detailed blueprints and tooling drawings.

  • Set up and operate various machines and equipment.

  • Perform grinding, machining, setup, and tooling adjustments.

  • Troubleshoot tooling and equipment issues to identify root causes and make repairs.

  • Work with dies, punches, fixtures, forming tools, and related tooling.

  • Support progressive, draw, trim, and pierce tooling.

  • Work with tooling projects from initial setup through completion.

  • Perform machine setups and offsets as needed.

  • Work effectively with older machinery and equipment.

  • Maintain quality and accuracy throughout the tooling process.

Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of hands-on Tool & Die experience preferred.

  • Candidates with 1–2+ years of relevant experience may be considered for the right fit.

  • Strong blueprint reading and interpretation skills.

  • Hands-on machine setup and offset experience.

  • Experience with grinding and tooling repair.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

  • Experience working with complex dies, punches, fixtures, and forming tools.

  • Experience with progressive, draw, trim, or pierce tooling is highly valuable.

  • Ability to work tooling projects from start to finish.

  • Comfortable troubleshooting older equipment and complex tooling issues.

  • CNC programming is not required and can be trained; machine setup and offset experience are more important.

job.title: Strategic Sourcing Analyst III
job.description:
Location: Richardson, TX
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Strategic Sourcing Analyst III

This role is responsible for independently owning global sourcing activities for after-market parts across our Home Comfort Solutions and Building Climate Solutions segments with a typical aggregate annual dollar buy of $300+ million per year. The position drives procurement cost savings across company expenditures, identifies and implements tariff mitigation and source optimization strategies, and develops both short- and long-term sourcing plans for complex, high-impact, and high-risk categories.

What You Will Be Doing

This strategic sourcing subject matter expert. The role is highly execution-oriented, with responsibility for negotiating complex supplier agreements, managing commercial terms, and driving cost reductions through data-backed analyses and structured sourcing strategies. This person will evaluate and challenge supplier price increases through detailed cost modeling and market benchmarking, while proactively identifying new suppliers, qualifying and onboarding them, and implementing dual-source strategies to improve resilience and competitiveness. Additionally, the role will focus on tariff mitigation, supply base optimization, and long-term category planning, leveraging cross-functional collaboration with category management, supply chain planning, and operations to ensure continuity of supply, quality performance, and alignment with business objectives.

Knowledge & Market Expertise

· Execute a comprehensive understanding of the company's global manufacturing and distribution footprint, product portfolio, served markets, and value proposition of each business unit.

· Build deep category expertise, including all components within category spend, their applications, and their impact on final products.

· Monitor and analyze indexes related to your categories and global market trends to inform sourcing decisions and communicate insights to internal stakeholders and suppliers.

· Continuously research and track developments in the HVAC industry to strengthen decision-making and stakeholder discussions.

Strategic Sourcing

· Develop and execute a global sourcing strategy for assigned categories aligned with organization's business goals.

· Present sourcing strategies and progress during annual roadmap reviews, outlining achievements and forward-looking plans (3–5 year horizon).

· Identify opportunities for cost optimization, supply base improvement, and risk mitigation.

Stakeholder & Supplier Relationships

· Act as the primary liaison between Category Management, Engineering, and manufacturing operations to ensure alignment on sourcing strategies and initiatives.

· Collaborate cross-functionally to support productivity initiatives, Category Management projects, and new product introductions.

· Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, including regular communication and performance management.

· Conduct data-informed analyses to assess and communicate the validity of supplier price increases.

· Develop a deep understanding of supplier capabilities, geographic footprint, financial health, and operational strengths.

· Lead negotiations and manage contracts and commercial agreements to align with company objectives.

· Establish and execute a structured plan for supplier visits and internal engagement to maintain close collaboration.

Execution & Results

· Deliver against financial targets, including achieving net Material Cost Reduction (MCR) goals.

· Ensure continuity of supply by maintaining on-time delivery, quality standards, and appropriate inventory levels to support production needs.

· Manage supplier-related issues, including claims, rejections, returns, over-shipments, cancellations, and category management changes.

· Drive competitive sourcing processes through regular spend-analysis and supplier benchmarking.

· Develop and implement dual sourcing strategies and tariff mitigation plans to reduce risk and enhance supply resilience.

Qualifications

· Requires a bachelor's degree or equivalent and professional experience in the manufacturing industry.

· At least 4 years of total experience in strategic sourcing and global procurement (experience specifically in industrial parts and supplies sourcing is a plus).

· An independent executor who is intrinsically motivated.

· A strong sense of ownership, reliability, and responsiveness.

· Flexibility and creativeness in finding solutions under critical business situations.

· Excellent negotiation abilities: exceptional verbal and written communication skills including with executives and in international contexts.

· Requires knowledge of raw materials, production processes and quality control.

· Must have knowledge of economic principles and financial markets. Competent in computerized procurement systems.

job.title: Senior Design Verification Engineer
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Design Verification Engineer to support the development and verification of high-performance IPs, including compute arrays, DMA engines, Networks-on-Chip (NoCs), crossbars, and memory subsystems.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining scalable SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, along with deep knowledge of AXI protocols, performance verification, regression analysis, and coverage closure.

This program is already in execution, so we are looking for someone who can quickly integrate into the team and contribute in a fast-paced environment with evolving processes and limited documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments and testbenches for complex, high-performance IP. Perform verification of AXI-based interfaces, NoC/Crossbar architectures, DMA engines, compute arrays, and memory subsystems. Develop verification strategies focused on functional correctness, performance, and system-level behavior. Execute and analyze regression testing, including failure triage, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
  • Drive functional and code coverage closure and support overall verification sign-off.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and validate performance requirements across complex IP and subsystem designs.
  • Work effectively within established customer tools, flows, and verification methodologies.
  • Adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment where processes and documentation may still be evolving.
  • Collaborate with verification, design, architecture, and other engineering teams to achieve verification milestones.
  • Provide clear daily and/or weekly progress updates to customer and project stakeholders.
  • Support overall verification closure and ensure high-quality project delivery.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5–15 years of relevant experience in ASIC design verification, SoC verification, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with SystemVerilog and UVM.
  • Experience developing and maintaining complex, scalable UVM testbench environments.
  • Strong knowledge of AMBA AXI protocols and interface verification.
  • Experience verifying NoC, Crossbar, DMA, compute, and/or memory subsystem architectures.
  • Strong experience with regression execution, failure triage, debugging, and coverage closure.
  • Experience with performance-focused verification and analysis.
  • Working knowledge of scripting and automation using Python, Perl, Make, or similar tools.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute effectively within a highly technical engineering team.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical progress and issues effectively to customer stakeholders.
  • Experience working on large-scale ASIC/SoC verification programs.
  • Experience with high-performance compute, networking, or memory-related IP.
  • Experience working in fast-paced or start-up-style engineering environments.
  • Familiarity with customer-specific verification tools, flows, and methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive verification activities through coverage and sign-off closure.

job.title: Project Management Specialist - Biotech/Pharma
job.description:
Client is seeking a Project Manager to provide strategic and operational project leadership across API external manufacturing, supporting the management of commercial supply and related initiatives at a contract manufacturing organization (CMO). This role integrates activities across quality, supply chain, engineering, regulatory, and finance, translating program strategy into disciplined execution to ensure reliable commercial supply of key therapeutics.

Responsible for facilitating and supporting CMO oversight and project delivery, including the following:
Manage scope and support creation of an integrated project plan that articulates the strategy for the CMO relationship and its key initiatives, and provides the foundation for operational objectives and milestones.
Coordinate cross-functional obligations between Lilly and the CMO, including quality oversight, supply coordination, deviation/CAPA and change-control interfaces, and contract and governance commitments.
Create and execute project plans and drive delivery of project milestones across the initiative lifecycle.
Develop and implement team communication plans and drive communication of key decisions, risks, and results to stakeholders and leadership.
Monitor and prioritize project and supply risks, suggest ways to avoid or mitigate risks, and initiate contingency plans as needed.
Bring forward areas for continual process improvement to strengthen schedule discipline, reduce cost, and improve reliability of commercial supply and project delivery.
Drive development of an integrated project budget and support financial governance, ensuring alignment with functional representatives, finance, and leadership.
Proficient in self-management and organizational skills; able to manage workload, set personal and team priorities, and adjust as needed in a dynamic, multi-workstream environment.
Strong interpersonal and team-building skills; able to develop effective teamwork between Client and CMO team members with diverse styles and across organizational boundaries.

Qualifications:
-Bachelor's degree in engineering, a scientific field, or a related technical discipline, and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical operations.
-Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., MS, MBA, Master's in Project Management, PMP, or a commissioning/qualification/validation credential) preferred.

job.title: Quality Inspector - 2nd shift
job.description:
FIRST COUPLE OF WEEKS WILL BE ON AM SHIFT FROM 6am-2:30pm

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Job Summary:
The Quality Inspector will check the quality of all products as well as production procedures. The role will be an advocate for quality in our business. The Quality Inspector will ensure that products are made of flawless materials in compliance with customer specifications.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Inspect, test and measure materials or products and accurately record inspection and test data. This includes measuring products using rulers, calipers, gauges, coordinate measuring machines (CMM), thread gauges, gauge pins, optical comparator, surface testers, height gauges or micrometers to monitor operations to ensure they meet quality standards.
• Accept or reject finished products including tagging or identifying all products and material that fail to meet specifications.
• Read, interpret, and follow basic blueprints, diagrams, engineering drawings and other written
instruction. This includes understanding and applying Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD & T) symbology.
• Recommend adjustments to the assembly or production process to improve quality.
• Calibrate or verify test instruments.
• Adhere to all safety procedures and promote continuous improvement.

Education and Experience (required):
• High School diploma or equivalent.
• 1 year of inspection experience with common hand gages or equivalent.

Education and Experience (preferred):
• 1 year of experience programing and operating a Direct Computer Controlled (DCC) CMM.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (required):
• Knowledge of computers and electronics.
• Ability to calibrate or verify test instruments and keep detailed records.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact across multiple departments.
• Proficient computer skills including MS Office.
• Ability to analyze and problem solve with attention to detail.

Skills, Knowledge and Abilities (preferred)
• Working knowledge and comprehension of quality standards.
• American Society for Quality (ASQ) certified.
• Ability to work overtime as needed including weekends.

Additional Information:
Direct Reports: None Travel Requirements: 5%
License and Certification Requirements: None

Physical Requirements:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to perform physical activities that require significant use of your arms and legs and moving your whole body, such as climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, stooping, standing for extended periods of time and handling of materials. The employee is required to lift up to 50 pounds on a regular basis. The employee is subject to loud noise, dirt, dust, grease, gases and odors and is required to wear personal protective equipment such as safety glasses and ear protection in required area. Typical vision abilities include close up for fine detailed work and
computer work, distance vision and ability to focus. Regular and predictable attendance is required.

job.title: Customer Service Specialist
job.description:
Customer Service & Military Pricing Coordinator

Position Overview

The Customer Service & Military Pricing Coordinator is responsible for maintaining customer satisfaction by providing timely and accurate product, service, account, quotation, and pricing support.

This position serves as the primary point of coordination for customer quotations and pricing requests, partnering closely with sales, contracts, divisions, and other internal teams to ensure quotes are accurate, competitive, and delivered on time. The role typically supports moderately complex or well-established customer accounts.

Employee Classification: Nonexempt
Citizenship Requirement: U.S. Citizen

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service & Account Support

  • Administer customer accounts by reviewing service and spare product requirements against existing purchase order terms, conditions, and maintenance agreements.
  • Establish and maintain strong customer relationships through courteous and efficient handling of customer requests.
  • Prepare and submit correspondence in response to customer inquiries.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality regarding customer and company information.
  • Respond to customer pricing inquiries, service concerns, and related requests.

Pricing, Quotations & RFQ Coordination

  • Coordinate the end-to-end pricing and quotation process.
  • Log incoming Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and verify completeness against customer requirements.
  • Complete cost and pricing analysis and route requests to appropriate divisions for cost development within established turnaround times.
  • Review draft quotations and proposals for:
    • Pricing reasonableness
    • Accuracy
    • Formatting
    • Consistency
  • Maintain price lists, quote logs, pricing history, rate sheets, and customer-specific pricing agreements.
  • Track open quotations and proactively follow up to prevent expired or outdated pricing.
  • Communicate quote status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with sales, price estimating, contracts, and other functions to keep the quotation process moving efficiently.

Order & Production Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal departments including:
    • Quality
    • Shipping and receiving
    • Accounting
    • Order entry
    • Planning
    • Shop personnel
  • Release repairs to production once customer approval is received.
  • Submit work orders to scheduling and update sales orders with delivery dates and repair costs.
  • Develop action plans to address past-due items.
  • May provide oversight of order entry and shipping activities for spare products.

Pricing Data & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate pricing and quotation records within applicable ERP and quoting systems.
  • Ensure pricing files, rate sheets, and customer-specific agreements remain current and consistent with approved pricing guidance.
  • Monitor customer accounts and prepare reports, including open-quote status reporting.
  • Collect and analyze data to support pricing and customer-service decisions.
  • Calculate discounts, proportions, percentages, and quote pricing as needed.

Process Improvement & Compliance

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Recommend opportunities for cost reduction and improvements to service quality and quoting efficiency.
  • Develop knowledge of:
    • Procurement practices
    • FAA regulations
    • Government procurement requirements, when applicable
    • Products and manufacturing processes
    • Pricing policies and procedures
  • Support cross-functional and project teams, including pricing and proposal initiatives.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • One to two years of related college-level coursework, certificate completion, or related job training in:
    • Business
    • Finance
    • Economics
    • Engineering
    • Data Analytics
    • Related field
  • Typically 4+ years of related experience in one or more of the following:
    • Customer service
    • Pricing
    • Quotation administration
    • Administrative support
    • Marketing/customer support
    • Product support

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Knowledge of customer service, pricing, and quotation administration practices.
  • Understanding of FAA regulations and government procurement requirements when applicable.
  • General understanding of manufacturing, inspection, and repair processes.
  • Ability to work independently on moderately complex assignments.
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, and draw conclusions.
  • Ability to calculate discounts, percentages, proportions, and pricing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly communicate pricing, technical, and customer information.
  • Proficiency with standard business software applications.
  • Experience with specialized spreadsheet, quoting, database, ERP, and MRP systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple departments and functions.

Pricing Coordination Skills

  • Working knowledge of RFQ intake, quotation preparation, pricing analysis, and pricing workflow coordination.
  • Experience maintaining accurate pricing files, quote logs, rate sheets, and customer-specific pricing agreements.
  • Ability to track open quotes and proactively follow up on expiring pricing.
  • Experience coordinating between sales, contracts, price estimating, and other internal teams.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing quotations for accuracy and consistency before customer submission.
  • Familiarity with aerospace regulatory and compliance requirements, including FAA and applicable government contracting requirements.

job.title: Service Manager
job.description:
SERVICE MANAGER

LOCATION: Amsterdam, NY (Fully onsite)
SCHEDULE: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
SALARY: $100-130K

Some service departments need a manager.

Others need someone who can see the whole picture, figure out where things are getting stuck, and jump in to fix it.

We’re looking for the second kind.

Our client is a growing manufacturer of specialized industrial equipment looking for a hands-on Service Manager to take ownership of a multifaceted service operation. This person will oversee field service, parts, and installation coordination—and needs to be comfortable stepping into any of those areas when a customer, employee, or job needs help.

This is not a “stay in your lane” kind of role. It’s an opportunity for someone who understands how service, parts, installations, engineering, and operations all connect and enjoys making the entire operation work better.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:
• Lead and develop the service operation, including field service, parts, and installation coordination
• Oversee the Field Service Manager, Parts Coordinator, parts/shipping function, and Installation Coordinator
• Jump in to troubleshoot problems and keep jobs moving when issues cross departmental lines
• Handle escalated customer issues and provide technical guidance when needed
• Identify gaps between service, parts, installation, engineering, and operations and build better processes
• Develop procedures, performance metrics, and accountability measures
• Work alongside engineering and operations to solve technical and workflow issues
• Support installations or parts needs when necessary to stay connected to the operation
• Continually look for practical ways to improve the department and customer experience

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
• 5+ years of management/leadership experience
• 7+ years in service operations, technical service, industrial equipment, project management, customer support management, or a related environment
• Strong technical aptitude—mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, or industrial equipment experience is valuable
• Someone who can manage people while also understanding the equipment and service issues they’re dealing with
• Experience building or improving processes and workflows
• Comfortable handling customers, including escalated or frustrated customers
• ERP/CRM/service ticketing experience

WHO MIGHT FIT?

Maybe you started as a field technician and worked your way into service or branch management.

Maybe you’ve managed a service operation for an industrial equipment company.

Maybe you’re the person everyone calls when something goes wrong—and you’ve developed the leadership background to go along with the technical knowledge.

The experience can vary. What matters is that you know how to lead people, understand the technical side, and make a complicated operation run better.

BENEFITS:
• Medical, dental and vision
• Company-paid $50K life insurance
• Company-paid long-term disability
• 401(k) with up to 4.5% company match
• Annual performance bonus opportunity
• Referral bonus

job.title: Mechanical Engineer
job.description:
Nesco Resource is in search of a Mechanical Engineer to join our client’s team in Lincoln, RI.
 
Position Summary:
We are seeking an Engineer with a degree in Mechanical Engineering or Structural Engineering to join our client's interdisciplinary design team. This team is responsible for designing location-specific structures for mounting ceiling-suspended operating room equipment such as surgical lights, anesthesia booms, and air circulation systems.
 
Primary Responsibilities:

  • Analyze construction documents and building plans to gather design criteria.
  • Assist in the development of building information models (BIM) to identify clashes with existing and planned construction.
  • Consult and collaborate with in-house and external engineers, architects, project managers, and general contractors to ensure designs meet expectations.
  • Conduct structural analyses through calculations and finite element analysis (FEA).
  • Model structures in 3D CAD programs using multi-component assemblies and parameterization.
  • Create as-designed and as-built technical drawings for fabrication and construction.
  • Support our in-house team of field service technicians before, during, and after installation.
  • Assist with the research and development of design alternatives and modifications to optimize performance and installation.
Required Skills:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or equivalent with at least 1 year of experience.

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
Structural Engineer – Industrial Refining

Position Overview

Hargrove is seeking an experienced Structural Engineer to support a large-scale industrial refining project. This individual will provide structural engineering expertise through design development, engineering calculations, structural analysis, technical documentation, and multidisciplinary project coordination.

The ideal candidate will have extensive structural engineering experience within industrial environments, particularly refineries, petrochemical facilities, chemical plants, oil and gas facilities, or other heavy industrial projects.

Candidates must have an active Professional Engineer (PE) license and demonstrated experience performing dynamic structural analysis. Strong technical capabilities, engineering judgment, and communication skills are essential for success in this position.

This is a 100% remote opportunity. Candidates may work from anywhere in the United States. Preference will be given to candidates located near a Hargrove office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, review, and approve structural engineering calculations, designs, and technical deliverables.

  • Perform structural engineering analysis, including dynamic structural analysis.

  • Design and evaluate structural systems supporting industrial equipment, process units, buildings, platforms, and facilities.

  • Develop structural design criteria, specifications, calculations, reports, and engineering documentation.

  • Review structural drawings, layouts, 3D models, and engineering documents.

  • Evaluate equipment and vendor loads and incorporate them into structural designs.

  • Coordinate structural engineering requirements with Piping, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Process, and Civil disciplines.

  • Review vendor drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Participate in engineering design reviews, constructability reviews, and technical resolution meetings.

 

Important: PE licensure and demonstrated dynamic structural analysis experience are mandatory requirements. Candidates without both qualifications should not be submitted.

Additional Candidate Preferences

Candidates located near a Hargrove office are preferred.

Experience supporting large-scale industrial refining projects.

Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Experience with structural analysis and complex industrial structures.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in the following environments are strongly preferred:

Oil & Gas

Industrial Refining

Petrochemical

Chemical Processing

EPC / EPCM Engineering Projects

Heavy Industrial Facilities

Process Plants

Industrial Equipment and Support Structures

Required Qualifications – Non-Negotiable

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Active Professional Engineer (PE) license required.

Extensive professional experience in structural engineering.

Professional structural engineering experience within industrial facilities.

Demonstrated experience performing dynamic structural analysis.

Strong knowledge of applicable structural engineering codes, standards, and design practices.

Experience developing structural designs, engineering calculations, drawings, and technical documentation.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, project management, construction, and vendor teams.

Must be able to work remotely from within the United States.

  • Identify and resolve structural engineering issues throughout project design and execution.

job.description:
Solder/Assembly l
Orlando
7AM-3:30PM

Duties:

  1. Advanced Soldering Techniques: Apply advanced soldering techniques to assemble high-precision frequency control devices, including oscillators, filters, and frequency synthesizers, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

  8. Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of soldering processes, calibration procedures, and quality control records, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and quality management systems.
  9. Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives, contributing insights and recommendations to enhance soldering processes, efficiency, and overall product quality.

job.description:

Pay: $20–$27 per hour, depending on experience
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:30 PM
Overtime: Overtime opportunities are likely based on production needs
Employment Type: Direct Hire

Quality Inspector

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Inspector to join a growing manufacturing team. This position is responsible for inspecting incoming materials, in-process components, and finished products to ensure they meet established specifications and quality standards.

The ideal candidate has manufacturing or quality inspection experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to use precision measuring tools and read technical drawings. This is a great opportunity for someone looking for a long-term career in a quality-focused manufacturing environment supporting aerospace and other highly regulated industries.

Responsibilities

Qualifications

  • Experience using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other inspection tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and work instructions.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify defects and non-conforming products.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to accurately maintain quality documentation.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively with production and quality teams.
  • Experience with FAI, receiving inspection, final inspection, or aerospace quality requirements is a plus.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

Why Consider This Opportunity?

job.title: System Integration Lab Engineer
job.description:
Description:
The System Integration Lab Engineer provides hands on technical support and engineering expertise to Sikorsky's Flight Controls Autonomy & Electrical (FCA&E) organization. Reporting to the FCA&E Lab Lead, the incumbent will contribute to the design, development, integration, and verification of high fidelity hardware in the loop (HWIL) and closed loop test facilities and capabilities within the System Integration Laboratories (SILS). This role blends systems engineering, test bed design / operation, and collaborative problem solving in a fast paced, cross functional environment. The engineer will help ensure laboratory activities align with business objectives, program priorities, and Sikorsky technical standards while driving continuous improvement initiatives that increase lab productivity and capability.

looking for candidates with more schematic and experience designing the facilities/labs where tests will be conducted.
Not interested in electrical test engineers
Must have minimum 4+ years with Zuken

Core Responsibilities
•HWIL/Closed Loop Development: Assist the FCA&E Lab Lead in designing, building, integrating, and testing HWIL and closed loop configurations within the SILS, ensuring compliance with design specifications, safety standards, and Sikorsky engineering practices.
•Hardware Integration: Receive, stage, and integrate hardware from subsystem teams; manage interface control documents; and coordinate cross functional wiring, power, and data connections across system, segment, and supporting engineering groups.
•Technical Collaboration: Participate actively in technical interchange meetings, provide clear status updates, and contribute to the preparation of deliverables for internal and external customers.
•Risk & Issue Management: Track laboratory level risks and issues, maintain issue logs, and promptly elevate concerns to the FCA&E Lab Lead or program management while proposing mitigation actions.
•Metrics & Reporting: Capture key performance indicators (KPIs) for SILS activities, generate concise status reports, and assist in metrics dashboards that reflect progress, resource utilization, and test outcomes.
•Equipment & Facility Support: Help manage procurement of capital equipment, support facility modification projects, and assist with laboratory infrastructure planning (e.g., power distribution, network cabling, shielding, cooling).
•Logistics Management: Order, receive, and track parts and consumables required for lab activities; maintain accurate inventory records; and coordinate with vendors and internal supply chains to ensure timely availability of components.
•Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline lab processes, update work instructions, and adopt new tools or methodologies that enhance test efficiency and data quality.
•Documentation: Produce and maintain engineering documentation—including schematics, block diagrams, procedures, results, and lessons learned packages—in accordance with Sikorsky configuration control requirements.
•Design Tools: Develop detailed schematics and system block diagrams using industry standard tools such as Microsoft Visio, Mentor Graphics, Zuken, and Siemens NX/3DX.


Technical Skills:
•Proficiency with real time simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, LabVIEW, NI VeriStand).
•Strong understanding of hardware integration, signal conditioning, power distribution, and data acquisition systems.
•Familiarity with aerospace standards and specifications (e.g., Arinc-429, MIL-STD-1553, DO 160, MIL STD 810, ARP 4754).
•Ability to create schematics and block diagrams using Visio, Mentor Graphics, Zuken, and 3DX.
•Experience managing parts logistics—ordering, receiving, inventory control, and vendor coordination

job.title: Electrical Engineer
job.description:
Electrical Engineer – Industrial / EPC

Job Description

Nesco Resource is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to support a large-scale industrial engineering and capital project in Houston, TX. This position will work onsite and collaborate closely with electrical designers, engineers, project managers, procurement, construction, and other engineering disciplines.

The ideal candidate will have strong industrial electrical engineering experience with a background supporting EPC, chemical, petrochemical, refining, manufacturing, energy, or other heavy industrial projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and review electrical engineering deliverables for large industrial and capital projects.
  • Develop and review single-line diagrams, power distribution systems, electrical equipment layouts, and electrical design packages.
  • Perform electrical calculations including load flow, voltage drop, short-circuit, and protective device coordination.
  • Design and support low- and medium-voltage electrical systems.
  • Develop electrical specifications and data sheets for switchgear, MCCs, transformers, motors, VFDs, and related equipment.
  • Perform cable, wire, and conduit sizing and associated electrical calculations.
  • Review vendor drawings, equipment documentation, and technical submittals.
  • Develop and review electrical construction and installation specifications.
  • Coordinate electrical engineering activities with designers and other engineering disciplines.
  • Support equipment selection, procurement activities, and technical bid evaluations.
  • Provide technical support during construction, startup, and commissioning.
  • Ensure electrical designs comply with NEC, applicable codes, project specifications, and engineering standards.
  • Work closely with project teams to resolve technical issues and maintain project schedules and deliverables.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • 6+ years of electrical engineering experience, preferably in industrial environments.
  • Strong experience with industrial electrical power systems and distribution.
  • Previous EPC, engineering consulting, or large capital-project experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience in chemical, petrochemical, refining, manufacturing, energy, or heavy industrial environments.
  • Strong knowledge of NEC and applicable electrical codes and standards.
  • Experience with low- and medium-voltage power distribution.
  • Experience developing electrical calculations, equipment specifications, engineering deliverables, and construction documentation.
  • Strong multidisciplinary coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, or similar electrical engineering analysis software.
  • Experience supporting construction, commissioning, and startup.
  • PE registration is a plus, particularly for senior-level candidates.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidates will be industrial Electrical Engineers who have worked on EPC or major capital projects and can independently handle electrical engineering deliverables from design through construction/commissioning.

job.title: CCA Design Engineer
job.description:
CCA Design Engineer – Aerospace & Defense

Location: Orlando, FL
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Industry: Aerospace & Defense

Please do not submit any candidates that were submitted to this manager's previous Request #21637.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced CCA Design Engineer to support the design and development of advanced aerospace and defense products. This position will focus on the design of Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs), including component and connector selection, layout, engineering documentation, and coordination of testing and integration activities.

The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of hands-on CCA design experience using Creo Parametric and Zuken, along with experience applying IPC standards within aerospace and defense product development environments.

This is an engineering design position not a CAD/drafting role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) for aerospace and defense applications.
  • Perform connector and component selection and layout on CCAs.
  • Create and release IDX files and associated engineering documentation.
  • Develop detailed layouts, sketches, drawings, and design documentation.
  • Release drawings and documentation through Windchill.
  • Design major components and portions of functional systems and advanced prototypes.
  • Develop and improve products while supporting manufacturing operations.
  • Evaluate designs for manufacturability, material availability, interchangeability, replaceability, strength-to-weight efficiency, cost, and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate design development with engineering, manufacturing, and other affected organizations.
  • Review completed layouts and drawings for accuracy, completeness, clarity, and compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
  • Identify design errors, omissions, and deficiencies and recommend appropriate design improvements.
  • Produce high-quality engineering documentation.
  • Support and guide test and integration activities.
  • Apply applicable IPC standards throughout the design process.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on Circuit Card Assembly (CCA) design experience.
  • 3+ years of Creo Parametric experience specifically related to CCA design.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Zuken experience.
  • 3+ years of experience working with IPC standards.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting aerospace and/or defense product development cycles.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality design documentation.
  • Ability to support and guide testing and integration activities.
  • Ability to work 100% onsite in Orlando, FL.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Zuken E3 and electrical harness design.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing and product improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working within structured engineering documentation and release processes.

Important Note

This position is specifically seeking candidates with CCA design engineering experience. Candidates whose backgrounds are primarily CAD, drafting, or general mechanical/electrical design without substantial CCA design experience will not be considered.

If you have hands-on CCA design experience with Creo Parametric and Zuken and have worked within aerospace/defense product development, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Purchasing Buyer
job.description:
Position Summary:
Directs the activities associated with the SCMG managed global spend for a designated commodity category. Responsible for identification and evaluation of North American opportunities within the commodity category for reduction of spend, consolidation of process, function and continuity of supply. Manages the Client contracts within the commodity category and reports the metrics associated with them. Delivers continuous improvement in cost processes and services within the commodity category. Will be responsible for requests for information (RFI) or quotes (RFQ). Generates recommendations based on Total Cost of Ownership comparisons. Monitors and reports on activities associated with named commodity categories. Major Duties and

Responsibilities:
Formulate annual business plans for achievement of cost reductions and year-over-year performance improvement.
Obtains and analyzes quotes to determine best value, then recommends global sourcing solutions based on data and facts collected.
Can layout and explain a commodity strategy. Follows and tracks to the strategy for basic commodities. Understands all aspects of commodity strategy templates. Can create a strategy but may be limited to current state (static) and not completely global. May be limited to more basic commodities. Utilizes capability matrices to develop strategy.
Provides proper documentation for review at sourcing councils, including total landed cost analysis taking into account duty, freight, packaging, surcharge, payment terms, and other financial factors. Includes understanding of SSA status and any financial risk. Consistently utilizes IPOs in quoting new business. Considers global spending for all suppliers.
Ability to maintain control of multiple projects to meet timing and anticipate and resolve 'roadblocks' for successful part PPAP and launch. Monitors technical review progress with cross-functional teams; ensures OISRs are updated and tracks to program milestones.
"Ability to clearly understand the financial and strategic impacts of agreed to 'gives' and 'gets' to optimize the value to Client and negotiate complex supplier issues with little to no supervision. Understands tactics to position Client with the most leverage possible.
Consistently sends out and reviews complete RFQ packages and negotiates the basic terms of a contract to support an agreement. Understand what type of contract is required. Understands key points to leverage beyond price. Understands Client's standard Terms and Conditions.
Monitors supplier(s) performance, audits results and elevates issues within the supplier's organization for resolution. Understands and review the corrective actions for sustained results. Holds regular performance review meetings with key stakeholders and measures compliance to agreements. Tracks Savings projects and reports accurate forecasts and actuals in the Savings Tracker. Understands supplier surcharge mechanisms.
Works proactively with other departments to find ways of reducing the need for inventory.
Manages the supply chain to ensure optimum workflows and takes active steps to remove non-value-added work. Challenges the status quo and engages help and support from other functional groups. Makes specific and comprehensive recommendations for process improvements. Understands DOS and can lead improvement activities with assistance.
Is able to lead Benchmarking, VA/VE, Lean, Resourcing, LPP analysis, Value Stream mapping events with no assistance. Thinks creatively about using what is learned from the savings toolbox to generate a range of improvement options for the business. Promotes cost reduction activities with key suppliers and shares best practices

Minimum Qualifications
Four-year degree in Business (Supply Chain Management or Purchasing is preferred) or four year degree in Engineering (Product or Manufacturing)
Professional Supply chain certification preferred
3-5 years of experience in procurement, preferred
Strong team player, able to work effectively on cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication skills, verbal and written.
Maintains an organized and professional manner when representing Client.
Willing to travel as required (estimate 10%).

Required Skills:
Ability to work on tasks along with prioritizing work and managing deadlines.
Understands interactions that affect outcomes for problem-solving. Uses analytical abilities to distill complex issues into workable parts for themselves. Anticipates consequences of alternative options.
Possesses and uses appropriate levels of intellectual ability to achieve objectives and maximize results. Demonstrates a determined, engaged, thoughtful approach to doing day-to-day work. Applies knowledge of global organizational issues to his/her own work.
Can identify areas of deficiency in processes and employ resources to optimize.
Can support and personalize the needed change within the group/dept./organization.

Directs the activities associated with the SCMG managed global spend for a designated commodity category. Responsible for identification and evaluation of North American opportunities within the commodity category for reduction of spend, consolidation of process, function and continuity of supply.
