job.title: Measurement Systems Software Engineer
job.description:
Overview
Client is seeking a Measurement Systems Software Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and deployment of software for industrial measurement and inspection systems used in manufacturing environments. This role focuses on C#/.NET software development, hardware integration, and the delivery of reliable, production-ready measurement solutions.
The engineer will work with distributed software applications that coordinate imaging, motion, I/O, sequencing, and data handling for product inspection and quality control. The role also includes evaluating and applying AI-assisted software development practices to improve engineering workflows and productivity.

Core Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, maintain, and support software for industrial measurement and machine vision systems using C#/.NET.
• Develop and support distributed measurement system applications, including software communication, coordination, configuration, and data handling.
• Support software build, release, deployment, system integration, and technology transfer activities from development into manufacturing.
• Evaluate, adopt, and apply AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering efficiency.
• Contribute to best practices for incorporating AI development tools into day-to-day software engineering activities.
• Create and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications and support documentation.
• Train engineering, maintenance, and operations personnel on the use, support, and maintenance of deployed systems.
• Provide remote and onsite troubleshooting for software and integrated measurement systems.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• BS, MS, or PhD preferred in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
• Experience developing software applications in C#/.NET for production use, system integration, or industrial applications.
• Experience designing, developing, and troubleshooting software for distributed, multi-process, or integrated systems.
• Familiarity with software communication and messaging methods such as publish/subscribe architectures, message queues, or similar approaches.
• Experience with source control, software versioning, and build/release workflows using tools such as Git, GitLab, automated build systems, and package management tools.
• Experience supporting software deployment, troubleshooting, and long-term support in development or manufacturing environments.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Interest in applying AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering productivity.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with WPF user interface development frameworks in .NET.
• Experience with motion control systems, cameras, image acquisition hardware, and integrated imaging platforms.
• Hands-on experience working with imaging hardware, cameras, measurement equipment, or related instrumentation.
• Experience applying machine learning or computer vision methods to inspection, classification, or measurement problems.
• Familiarity with databases, containerization, or high-performance computing environments.
• Experience evaluating, adopting, or helping define best practices for AI-enabled software development workflows.
• Knowledge of machine vision and image processing methods such as feature extraction, edge detection, morphology, classification, inspection, and metrology.
• Experience with machine vision or image processing libraries such as Halcon, OpenCV, LabVIEW, or similar tools.

Work Details
• 40 hours per week with a flexible schedule as needed.
• Up to 10% to 30% domestic and international travel may be required, with trips ranging from one day to several weeks.
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer-Entry Level
job.description:
Manufacturing / Process / Design Engineer

Position Overview
We are seeking a Manufacturing/Process/Design Engineer to support engineering activities related to manufacturing processes, production systems, and product/design applications. Under direct supervision, this position performs a variety of engineering tasks designed to build experience and familiarity with company engineering methods, practices, standards, and programs.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with technical data, engineering documentation, and established procedures to develop practical solutions to routine engineering problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support manufacturing, process, and design engineering activities.
  • Perform routine engineering assignments under the direction of experienced engineers.
  • Review engineering drawings, specifications, procedures, and other technical references.
  • Use established engineering methods, standards, and readily available references to resolve straightforward technical problems.
  • Collect, organize, and evaluate engineering and manufacturing data to support decision-making.
  • Assist with developing engineering plans, procedures, and recommendations for assigned projects.
  • Support the design and application of engineering solutions to manufacturing and production challenges.
  • Assist with evaluating existing processes and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare engineering documentation, reports, calculations, and presentations as required.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, design, and other engineering teams.
  • Follow company engineering standards, procedures, safety requirements, and quality practices.
  • Gain familiarity with the company's engineering programs, processes, tools, and best practices.

What They're Really Looking For

The strongest candidates will have:

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Internship, co-op, or early-career experience in manufacturing, process engineering, product design, or production engineering.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
  • Experience working with engineering/manufacturing data.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with CAD/design software is beneficial.
  • Understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering principles.
  • Ability to work under the guidance of senior engineers while progressively taking on more responsibility.

Seniority Level

Entry-Level / Junior Engineer approximately 0–3 years of engineering experience, although relevant internship/co-op or hands-on manufacturing experience can be highly valuable.

job.title: Test Technician
job.description:
Test Technician
We are looking for a collaborative, detail oriented professional who thrives in a mission critical environment. This role offers direct impact on product performance and reliability, giving you the chance to shape the quality of systems that protect our nation. If you are proactive, analytical, and passionate about delivering excellence, you will find a purpose driven home here.

As the Test Technician you will start by preparing documentation and performing the setup fixture that is necessary for the testing of accelerometers. You will be responsible for initiating and maintaining specific test operations from start to completion. This will include all rate table and vibration related testing. After internal testing, you will move on to final testing of the product by performing similar tests on the customer's equipment as the final validation before delivery.
• Prepare accurate documentation related to test preparation as well as maintaining detailed daily process logs for all tests being performed and all related faults or anomalies.
• Collaborate with the electrical engineer and the production manager regarding testing strategies, troubleshooting, and planning of all test related matters.
• Finalizing the product - i.e. disassemble from test fixture, cleaning, etc.
• Prepare the product for final inspection - gather and validate paperwork and database routing before delivery to the customer.
• Perform other production related tasks during periods of testing that doesn't require observation.

Basic Qualifications:
• High School diploma or equivalent
• Previous test experience or equivalent education
• MUST BE A U.S. PERSON

Desired Skills:
• IPC J-STD-001 certification
• Technical degree in electronics related curriculum
• Work experience in production, test, or related fields
• Electrical and/or mechanical troubleshooting
• Computer skills: MS Outlook, Excel, Word, Access
• Knowledge of Electrostatic Discharge and ESD mitigation principles
• Ability to troubleshoot electrical issues using a standard digital multimeter (DMM)
• Team player with demonstrated initiative and accountability
• Effective interpersonal skills and communication skills

Value: 4/10-1st Shift

job.title: CNC Operator
job.description:
CNC Operator

We are seeking an experienced CNC Operator/Machinist to join a growing manufacturing team. This position is ideal for someone with strong machining experience who can independently set up and operate CNC equipment while producing high-quality precision components. Candidates should be comfortable working from blueprints, maintaining tight tolerances, and contributing to a safe, team-oriented production environment.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate CNC lathes and/or mills to manufacture precision machined parts.

  • Read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and work instructions.

  • Edit machine programs, speeds, and feeds as needed to optimize production.

  • Perform precision measurements using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other measuring equipment.

  • Maintain close tolerances of ±0.001 " or better while ensuring product quality.

  • Perform machine setup changes for a variety of part configurations and production runs.

  • Operate secondary equipment such as drill presses, saws, tapping machines, and punch presses.

  • Deburr, clean, and inspect finished parts.

  • Troubleshoot machining issues and communicate production concerns to supervision.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

  • Assist with training less experienced machinists when needed.

  • Follow all company safety policies and quality standards.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of CNC machining experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience setting up and operating CNC lathes and/or mills.

  • Working knowledge of G-Code and M-Code programming.

  • Ability to read blueprints and accurately interpret dimensions and tolerances.

  • Experience using precision measuring instruments including calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and gauges.

  • Basic computer skills for data entry and machine interface.

  • Ability to make minor program edits at the machine.

  • Experience operating manual machining equipment is a plus.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to work independently while meeting production goals.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

  • Ability to stand for extended periods throughout the shift.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Willingness to work overtime as needed.

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Technical school or machining certification preferred but not required.

Why Apply?

  • Competitive pay based on experience

  • Stable first-shift opportunity

  • Opportunity to work with precision machining equipment

  • Growth potential within a well-established manufacturing environment

  • Team-focused workplace with an emphasis on quality and safety

job.description:

Key responsibilities include:

  • Effectively supporting the Preventative Maintenance (PM) program with a goal of continually reducing unscheduled downtime.
  • Analyzing problems and interpreting technical information necessary to make required repairs, including troubleshooting equipment issues.
  • Performing mechanical and electrical maintenance and repairs on production machinery and facility support equipment.
  • Inspecting, operating, and testing machinery or equipment to diagnose machine malfunction and validate work performed.
  • Ensuring safety by following all company policies, including safety rules, procedures, Lock-out/Tag-out procedures, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP's), personal safety standards, food safety standards, as well as OSHA standards.
  • Troubleshooting PLC controlled equipment and all plant electrical and mechanical systems, including motors, instrumentation, distribution, and feed control systems, and developing sustainable solutions accordingly.
  • Completing all assigned work orders within the time allotted.
  • Maintaining complete records of work performed using software, work orders, and detailed logs, and having good communication skills across all groups/departments.
  • Assisting with equipment changeovers and line startups, troubleshooting issues as needed.
  • Identifying required parts and maintaining current inventories and parts reorder lists.
  • Assuring that all products are manufactured to the highest standard of quality.
  • Participating in Continuous Improvement, providing suggestions to improve processes, and participating in team projects.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to lift 50-80 lbs. Performs highly repetitive motions, stand for eight plus hours, talk, and hear.
  • Ability to climb ladders, stairways, use a manlift/scissorlift at ceiling heights or above with proper safety equipment, and work in a non-air conditioned environment.
  • While performing job duties, the associate will frequently walk, use hands to feel or handle, and reach with hands and arms. Frequent exposure to oils and greases or coolants.
  • While performing job duties, the associate will occasionally sit, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, and smell. Occasional exposure to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; extreme heat; and vibration.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer - CATIA V5 (Secret)
job.description:
Description:
This position supports all Flight Test Instrumentation based out of the LM Aero Marietta site.

Responsibilities will include instrumentation mechanical design and support for AMMM and Advanced Development Programs. Primary responsibility will be drafting mechanical drawings for C-130 aircraft.

Candidate will design, develop, document, and support the installation and operation of data acquisition systems for aircraft flight testing. Daily tasks will include mechanical and hardware design and system integration. Designs for instrumentation will include, but are not limited to, strain gages, thermocouples, pressure transducers, accelerometers, displacement transducers, synchro's, microphones, calibration methods, and aircraft test instrumentation racks. Will coordinate with the Electrical instrumentation and Systems engineers on the solutions to data acquisition products. Will work with union-represented technicians and mechanics to fabricate and install instrumentation designs. Implement designs with CATIA V5 and CCD (CADAM Computer Drafting).

•Minimum of 5 years of experience in part design, assembly design, and drawing in CATIA V5.
•Minimum of 5 years of experience with CADAM Computer Drafting (CCD) or other 2D drafting software
•Minimum of 3 years of experience with test instrumentation (strain gages, pressure transducers, accelerometers, thermocouples, etc.)
•Must be able to obtain DoD Security clearance at a minimum level of Secret

Desired Skills
•Minimum of 2 years with C-130 or other aircraft structural design
•Experience working in a machine shop with fabrication mechanics
•Minimum of 1 year of experience with CAD Datanet
•DoD Security clearance at a Secret level or higher

The Inventory Control Clerk is responsible for the performance of inventory control functions to maintain the accuracy and integrity of data and ensure the proper storage of materials per internal and external requirements. They will perform record keeping activities, auditing, data entry activities, and coordinate information among related departments, monitor inventory, report problems, and meet company and department objectives.

Why join?

Job Summary

  • Performs visual verification of material items, monitors inventory levels, and reports or anticipates problems and shortages.

job.title: Project Engineer – Modular Data Center Infrastructure
job.description:
Position Overview

Our team is seeking an experienced Project Engineer to support the engineering, design, and delivery of modular data center infrastructure projects. This position is ideal for a hands-on Mechanical Engineer or Electrical Engineer with 7+ years of engineering and design experience, particularly within data centers, industrial facilities, large-scale infrastructure, or complex manufacturing environments.

The Project Engineer will take ownership of key technical aspects of projects from initial design through construction, commissioning, and final delivery. The role requires strong mechanical and piping knowledge, the ability to interpret and approve engineering documentation, and the communication skills necessary to work directly with clients and cross-functional project teams.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Engineering Leadership

  • Support the Engineering Manager in delivering complex data center projects.
  • Take ownership of assigned engineering and technical workstreams.
  • Coordinate with Project Management, Sales, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Construction, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Lead technical discussions and provide guidance to engineering team members.
  • Assist with onboarding and mentoring engineers as project demands increase.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Engineering Design & Technical Oversight

  • Review and approve engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and technical documentation.
  • Ensure designs meet customer requirements, applicable codes, safety regulations, and engineering best practices.
  • Develop engineering scopes of work, execution plans, schedules, and technical deliverables.
  • Coordinate designs across multiple projects and customers.
  • Identify technical issues and develop practical engineering solutions.

Mechanical & Piping Engineering

Develop and review engineering deliverables including:

  • Equipment lists
  • Valve lists
  • Piping layouts and line lists
  • Mechanical equipment datasheets
  • Pipe sizing calculations
  • Pipe stress analysis
  • Piping load information for structural engineering
  • Mechanical system specifications
  • Technical requisitions for mechanical equipment and systems

Support the engineering and design of:

  • Mechanical systems
  • Industrial piping systems
  • Fire protection and fire suppression systems
  • Equipment mounting and installation systems
  • Modular infrastructure and related mechanical systems

Client & Construction Support

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for customers and project stakeholders.
  • Participate in customer meetings, design reviews, site visits, and commissioning activities.
  • Answer technical questions and provide engineering support during construction.
  • Troubleshoot engineering and installation issues in the field.
  • Review and manage engineering changes and technical documentation.
  • Support projects through construction, startup, and commissioning.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, cost, and project execution.
  • Stay current with data center technologies, engineering practices, and industry trends.
  • Evaluate coatings, mounting systems, installation methods, and other technical solutions.
  • Promote engineering best practices and lessons learned across projects.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • 7+ years of mechanical engineering and design experience.
  • Experience supporting industrial facilities, large infrastructure projects, data centers, manufacturing facilities, or similar complex environments.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical and piping systems.
  • Experience with fire protection/fire suppression systems.
  • Experience supporting construction and commissioning activities.
  • Ability to review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong understanding of engineering codes, standards, and regulations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities.

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with the following software is preferred:

  • SolidWorks
  • Autodesk Revit
  • AutoCAD
  • BIM 360
  • Navisworks

Experience with the following codes and industry standards is highly desirable:

  • AISI – American Iron and Steel Institute
  • ANSI – American National Standards Institute
  • ASME B&PV Section VIII, Section IX, and B31.3
  • ASTM – American Society for Testing and Materials
  • AWS – American Welding Society
  • IBC – International Building Code
  • MFMA – Metal Framing Manufacturers Association
  • Client – Manufacturers Standardization Society
  • OSHA – Occupational Safety and Health Administration
  • NACE – National Association of Corrosion Engineers
  • NFPA – National Fire Protection Association
  • PFI – Pipe Fabrication Institute

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior-level, hands-on engineer who can bridge the gap between engineering design, project execution, construction, and the customer. They should be comfortable taking technical ownership, reviewing engineering work, solving field issues, and communicating with both internal teams and external clients.

Candidates with backgrounds in data centers, industrial facilities, process/manufacturing plants, modular construction, piping engineering, mechanical infrastructure, EPC projects, or large-scale capital projects are encouraged to apply.

Additional Requirements

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to engineering quality and safety.

job.title: PLM Process/Systems Architect
job.description:
PLM Process/Systems Architect

Overview
Client is seeking a PLM Process/Systems Architect to lead the technical execution of planning, development, and integration of advanced manufacturing technologies that support the resolution of manufacturing challenges and the evolution of next-generation Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.

This role serves as a technical authority across the manufacturing value stream, translating strategic operational objectives into business requirements and defining the product digital thread for manufacturing. The position collaborates closely with Supply Chain, IT, Quality, Engineering & Technology, Sustainment, and Digital Transformation teams.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead the planning, development, and integration of advanced manufacturing technologies to support manufacturing operations and resolve complex manufacturing challenges.
• Define and develop manufacturing process elements within the product digital thread by translating strategic operational objectives into business requirements.
• Serve as a technical authority across business functions, bridging complex manufacturing processes and system architectures throughout the value stream.
• Collaborate with Supply Chain, IT, Quality, Engineering & Technology, Sustainment, and Digital Transformation teams to coordinate manufacturing system initiatives.
• Support the development and integration of PLM, ERP, and MES solutions that enable digital manufacturing capabilities.

Education Level
Bachelors' and 16 years of Experiences or Masters' and 14 years of experience

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive effective solutions in fast-paced implementation environments.
• Working knowledge of system design, architecture, and manufacturing applications.
• Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), including integrations across these platforms.
• Experience in aerospace manufacturing systems, business processes, and/or manufacturing methods, with the ability to apply that knowledge to digital manufacturing system development.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Skills or Experience
• Experience with PLM platforms such as Teamcenter and/or 3DX and ERP solutions including OneAero, ERP4C, and/or S/4HANA.
• Experience supporting manufacturing applications involving production scheduling, complex assembly bills of material, process planning, condition of supply, tooling, configuration management, and workflow processes.
• Cross-functional experience supporting the product digital thread.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams to identify and implement business solutions.
• Ability to effectively partner with IT teams to support manufacturing technology initiatives.

Work Details
• Onsite, full-time position.
• Work schedule: 4/10-A.
• Ability to obtain a security clearance; clearance is not required to start.
• Access to Export Controlled Information (ECI) is required.

job.title: Quality Technican
job.description:
We are seeking a Quality/Supplier Quality professional to support manufacturing operations by monitoring incoming supplier products and in-process materials to ensure parts are available for production and meet established quality requirements. This position will identify and resolve issues involving nonconforming parts, documentation discrepancies, shipping problems, and supplier-related quality concerns.

The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of experience in quality inspection, supplier quality, quality assurance, or aerospace/manufacturing, with the ability to read complex engineering drawings and use inspection equipment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor incoming supplier products and in-process materials for quality, documentation, and availability issues.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve day-to-day product discrepancies and nonconformances.
  • Review parts and associated paperwork to determine whether materials can be released for manufacturing.
  • Communicate directly with suppliers to resolve quality, documentation, delivery, and product issues.
  • Support nonconforming material processes and assist with product containment activities.
  • Help validate supplier and internal corrective actions and follow up on resolution effectiveness.
  • Coordinate with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other internal teams to resolve production-impacting issues.
  • Review First Article Inspection (FAI/FAIR), PPAP, and other supplier quality documentation.
  • Assist with customer-returned material and coordinate related internal and external activities.

job.title: Machinist Weekend/Swing Shift
job.description:
Machinist Technician – CNC Machinist

Direct Hire | 60 Openings | Ogden, UT

Company: Parker Hannifin – Commercial Flight Controls Division
Location: Ogden, Utah
Employment Type: Direct Hire / Full-Time
Openings: 60
Pay Range: $20–$40/hour, depending on skills and experience
Relocation Assistance: Up to $7,500 gross relocation assistance; approximately $5,000 after taxes
Experience Level: Experienced CNC Machinists Only

Position Overview

Parker Hannifin's Commercial Flight Controls Division is seeking highly skilled and experienced CNC Machinists to join its manufacturing operation in Ogden, Utah. These are direct-hire opportunities supporting the production of precision components for the aerospace industry.

This opportunity is designed for experienced machinists who can do more than simply operate a machine. Successful candidates should be comfortable with machine setup, tooling, offsets, process adjustments, blueprint interpretation, precision inspection, troubleshooting, and machining close-tolerance components with limited supervision.

The ideal candidates will have a strong background in CNC machining, with particular interest in individuals experienced with Swiss lathes, grinding, CNC mills, and/or manual machining. Candidates should be able to independently evaluate machining conditions, troubleshoot production issues, make adjustments, and maintain the quality and efficiency of their work.

This is NOT an Entry-Level Machine Operator Position

We are specifically seeking experienced CNC Machinists who can independently perform complex setups and machining operations.

Strong candidates may have experience with:

  • CNC Swiss lathes
  • CNC turning
  • CNC milling
  • Precision grinding
  • Manual machining
  • Complex machine setups
  • Tight-tolerance aerospace components
  • Tooling and fixture setup
  • CNC offsets and adjustments
  • Process troubleshooting
  • Precision inspection and measurement

Compensation

Desired Pay Range: $20–$40/hour DOE

Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's skills, machining experience, technical capabilities, and overall qualifications.

Important Recruiting Note: Share the $20–$40/hour range with candidates. Do not tell a candidate they are guaranteed a specific hourly rate.

Available Shifts

Weekend Shift

Friday–Sunday | 5:00 AM–5:00 PM

  • 36 hours per week
  • $6/hour shift differential
  • Three-day work schedule

Swing Shift

Monday–Thursday | 3:00 PM–1:30 AM

  • Four-day work schedule
  • Shift differential applies

Candidates should be clearly informed of the schedule and applicable shift differential during the initial conversation.

Relocation Assistance

Relocation assistance is available for qualified candidates relocating to the Ogden, Utah area.

Relocation Assistance: Up to $7,500 gross
Approximate after-tax amount: $5,000

Target Relocation Markets

Prioritize experienced CNC machinists currently located in:

  • Idaho
  • Utah
  • Nevada
  • Arizona
  • Wyoming
  • New Mexico
  • Colorado
  • Montana

Utah candidates: Relocation assistance may be available for candidates living more than 50 miles from Ogden.

Key Benefits

Parker Hannifin offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Benefits beginning Day 1
  • Up to $10,000 per year in tuition reimbursement
  • Shift differentials for applicable shifts
  • 401(k) vested Day 1
  • 5% company 401(k) match
  • Onsite cafeteria
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement

Position Responsibilities

The Machinist Technician will set up and operate a variety of conventional and numerically controlled machining centers while working on complex, close-tolerance production components.

CNC Machine Setup & Operation

  • Set up, adjust, and operate CNC and conventional machining equipment.
  • Perform complex setups involving multiple workpiece stations and standard or custom workholding devices.
  • Run multiple machines efficiently, including simultaneous operations when required.
  • Select and install appropriate tooling, fixtures, and workholding.
  • Make necessary machine adjustments and offsets within established procedures.
  • Monitor machining operations and make process adjustments to maintain quality and productivity.
  • Adapt or modify tooling when necessary to achieve required machining results.

Precision Machining

  • Machine components requiring tight dimensional tolerances, complex contours, dimensional relationships, and specific surface-finish requirements.
  • Apply strong knowledge of production machining techniques, tooling, materials, and shop practices.
  • Work with a variety of production machines, materials, tooling, and machining processes.
  • Develop or refine machining processes when documentation is limited.
  • Troubleshoot machining problems and determine appropriate corrective actions.

Blueprint & Engineering Interpretation

  • Read and interpret:
    • Blueprints
    • Complex engineering drawings
    • Engineering specifications
    • Planning sheets
    • Quality requirements
    • Charts and tables
    • Sketches
    • Verbal instructions
  • Understand dimensional requirements, tolerances, surface finishes, and other manufacturing specifications.
  • Identify potential drawing or process issues and communicate them appropriately.

Engineering & Process Support

  • Interface directly with Engineering to resolve drawing discrepancies and manufacturing issues.
  • Recommend potential design or process improvements.
  • Assist Engineering with developing effective manufacturing processes.
  • Provide input regarding tooling requirements and may assist with tooling design.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve production efficiency, quality, and cost.

Quality & Inspection

  • Machine and inspect parts to ensure they meet customer and engineering specifications.
  • Perform in-process and final inspection using precision measuring equipment, including:
    • Calipers
    • Micrometers
    • Precision gauges
    • Comparators
    • Surface plates
    • Other inspection equipment
  • May operate or utilize CMM equipment.
  • Monitor dimensions and tolerances throughout the machining process.
  • Ensure inspection equipment is properly calibrated and used according to requirements.
  • Perform statistical process control (SPC) activities as required.

Equipment Maintenance

  • Routinely maintain machining equipment to support cleanliness, accuracy, reliability, and production performance.
  • Identify equipment issues and troubleshoot problems when appropriate.
  • Maintain tools, fixtures, machines, and work areas in proper operating condition.

Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

  • Actively participate in Lean manufacturing initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve:
    • Productivity
    • Quality
    • Efficiency
    • Cost
    • Safety
    • Workflow
  • Recommend and implement process improvements within the work area.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and operational goals.

Team Support & Leadership

  • Work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively within a team environment.
  • Help coordinate workload priorities based on business demand.
  • Provide guidance and technical assistance to less-experienced machinists.
  • Train and mentor other team members as needed.
  • Serve as a technical resource within the machining area.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of directly related machining experience in a high-technology manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong CNC machining experience is required.
  • Experience with complex machining setups strongly preferred.
  • Aerospace, defense, medical device, or other precision manufacturing experience is highly desirable.

Technical Skills

Candidates should be proficient in several of the following:

  • CNC machining
  • CNC setup
  • CNC turning
  • CNC milling
  • Swiss machining
  • Grinding
  • Manual machining
  • Tooling
  • Fixtures and workholding
  • Machine offsets
  • Process troubleshooting
  • Precision inspection
  • GD&T/tolerancing
  • Blueprint interpretation
  • Shop mathematics
  • Trigonometry
  • SPC
  • Lean manufacturing

Blueprint & Mathematics

  • Ability to read and interpret complex blueprints and engineering drawings.
  • Ability to understand engineering specifications and manufacturing documentation.
  • Working knowledge of advanced shop mathematics.
  • Ability to apply trigonometry when required.
  • Strong understanding of dimensions, tolerances, and precision machining requirements.

Communication & Teamwork

  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other team members.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a production environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to train and mentor less-experienced employees.

Physical & Work Environment

The position requires the ability to:

  • Stand, walk, and sit for extended periods.
  • Use hands and demonstrate strong manual dexterity when operating machinery and handling components.
  • Maintain close visual attention to machining operations and precision measurements.
  • Work safely around CNC machinery, tooling, materials, and production equipment.
  • Lift up to 50 pounds when required.
  • Maintain regular attendance and reliable work performance.
  • Work cooperatively and professionally with other team members.

Reasonable accommodations may be available for qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a career-level machinist, not someone whose experience is limited to loading and unloading CNC machines.

The strongest candidates will be able to explain:

  • How they perform a CNC setup from start to finish
  • How they select and change tooling
  • How they establish or adjust offsets
  • How they troubleshoot dimensional or machining problems
  • How they read complex blueprints
  • How they inspect precision components
  • How they determine whether a part is within tolerance
  • How they work with Engineering to resolve manufacturing issues
  • What types of CNC equipment they have personally operated
  • Their experience with Swiss lathes, mills, grinders, and manual machines
  • The tightest tolerances and most complex components they have machined

Recruiter Prescreen Questions

Before submitting a candidate, confirm:

  1. How many years of hands-on CNC machining experience do you have?
  2. How much of your experience is as a CNC Machinist versus Machine Operator?
  3. What CNC machines have you personally set up and operated?
  4. Do you have experience with Swiss lathes?
  5. Do you have experience with CNC mills?
  6. Do you have experience with grinding or manual machining?
  7. Can you independently perform a complete CNC setup, including tooling, fixtures, offsets, and adjustments?
  8. What types of materials and components have you machined?
  9. Have you worked with tight-tolerance or precision components? Please provide examples.
  10. Are you comfortable reading complex blueprints and engineering drawings?
  11. What precision measuring equipment have you used?
  12. Do you have experience with CMM, SPC, or other quality-control processes?
  13. Have you worked directly with Engineering to troubleshoot machining or drawing issues?
  14. Are you comfortable working with minimal supervision?
  15. Which shift are you interested in?
  16. Are you open to relocating to Ogden, UT?
  17. If relocating, where are you currently located and approximately how far are you from Ogden?

Sourcing Direction

Please prioritize highly skilled, experienced CNC Machinists over general machine operators.

Do not limit searches to candidates with the exact title "CNC Machinist." Strong candidates may have titles such as:

  • CNC Machinist
  • Senior CNC Machinist
  • CNC Technician
  • Machinist Technician
  • Precision Machinist
  • CNC Setup Machinist
  • Swiss Machinist
  • CNC Mill Machinist
  • CNC Lathe Machinist
  • Manufacturing Machinist
  • Aerospace Machinist
  • Tool & Die Machinist
  • Journeyman Machinist

job.title: Learning Architect
job.description:
Learning Architect (LA)

Position Overview

The Learning Architect (LA) is responsible for platform-specific curriculum design, development, and ongoing maintenance within the GMQLD operating model. This role partners closely with site Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Platform Leads, and the Center of Excellence (COE) to ensure learning content remains current, compliant, and aligned with manufacturing processes and business needs.

The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of Learning & Development/instructional design expertise and experience within a GxP-regulated manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Curriculum Design & Development

  • Design and develop platform-specific training content within COE governance frameworks and global standards.
  • Address approximately 90% platform-level content and 10% site-specific content, as assigned by the M2/P4 Platform Lead.
  • Partner with site SMEs to develop curricula that accurately reflect current manufacturing processes.
  • Apply process-based curriculum principles, organizing learning content by manufacturing process with task-level qualifications.
  • Ensure curricula align with the three-layer content model: Global, Platform, and Site.
  • Leverage global COE content as the foundation for platform-specific curriculum development.

Content Governance & Quality

  • Develop and maintain training content in accordance with COE standards, governance frameworks, quality requirements, and regulatory expectations.
  • Identify content gaps and site-specific needs and escalate them to the Platform Lead and COE for resolution.
  • Support learning equivalency, exception, and substitution decisions in alignment with the Quality system.
  • Ensure learning materials remain current, accurate, compliant, and aligned with manufacturing requirements.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with the Platform Lead (M2/P4) on Learning & Development strategy and business priorities across platform sites.
  • Interface with the COE to ensure alignment with global standards, governance requirements, and cross-platform initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Learning Execution Partners (LEPs) to understand site-specific execution needs and incorporate feedback into curriculum updates.
  • Work cross-functionally with teams including Quality, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing.
  • Represent the platform in cross-functional forums, audits, and governance reviews.
  • Collaborate effectively across multiple sites and time zones.

Continuous Improvement

  • Support Time to Qualification optimization initiatives by identifying training burden, content redundancies, and qualification bottlenecks.
  • Contribute to On-the-Job Training (OJT) standardization across platform sites.
  • Use data and qualification outcomes to identify opportunities to improve curriculum effectiveness.
  • Recommend enhancements to learning content, processes, and qualification programs.

Basic Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; OR
  • Minimum of 10 years of equivalent relevant experience in lieu of a degree.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a GxP-regulated environment.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Learning & Development
    • Instructional Design
    • Manufacturing Operations
    • Quality Operations
  • Experience with curriculum design, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and GMP training requirements.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • GxP requirements
    • Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
    • Regulatory requirements
    • Compliance training
  • English proficiency, both written and verbal.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes such as:
    • Prefilled Syringes (PFS)
    • Cartridge manufacturing
    • DAP/EM
    • Chemical manufacturing
    • Biologics
  • Experience developing process-based or competency-based curriculum architectures.
  • Experience supporting learning programs across multiple manufacturing sites.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Quality, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
  • Experience with digital learning tools and methodologies.
  • Experience with Digital OJT (DOJT), OJT programs, or OJT standardization.

job.title: Head of Product - Commercial Lending
job.description:
Head of Product – Commercial Lending Technology

Location: Remote – United States
Employment Type: Full-Tim

The Opportunity

We are seeking a senior Product leader with deep commercial lending and LOS experience to help shape and build the next generation of a commercial lending platform. This person will own product strategy and roadmap priorities, bring strong knowledge of the full commercial lending lifecycle, and work closely with Engineering to turn market and business needs into scalable product capabilities. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set direction, understand the competitive landscape, and stay close to the details as the product is built.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for a commercial lending technology platform.
  • Bring deep commercial lending expertise across origination, underwriting, credit approval, monitoring, and portfolio management.
  • Use market trends, competitive intelligence, customer needs, and business priorities to guide product decisions.
  • Translate lending workflows and business requirements into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and development priorities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering throughout planning, development, testing, and release.
  • Lead and develop a small Product team while remaining hands-on in the day-to-day work.
  • Help establish practical Product processes around requirements, roadmap management, prioritization, and product validation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and create stronger differentiation in the commercial lending market.
  • Participate in customer or prospect conversations when Product expertise is needed.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • Significant Product Management experience within commercial lending technology, commercial loan origination systems, banking technology, or a closely related fintech environment.
  • Deep knowledge of the end-to-end commercial lending lifecycle.
  • Experience owning a commercial lending product, product line, or significant product portfolio.
  • Previous leadership responsibility for Product professionals or a Product function.
  • Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, and prioritization.
  • Ability to understand market dynamics and competitive positioning within lending technology.
  • Experience translating business requirements and complex financial workflows into scalable software capabilities.
  • Strong history of partnering directly with Software Engineering teams.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with detailed, hands-on Product work.
  • Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working directly for a commercial LOS, lending software, banking technology, or fintech provider.
  • Product experience involving commercial credit underwriting, financial spreading, credit decisioning, portfolio management, or loan workflow technology.
  • Experience building or launching a new product or substantial new platform capability.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, bank cores, and third-party financial technology.
  • Experience introducing stronger Product processes within a smaller or growing software organization.
  • Experience working in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can change quickly and leaders wear multiple hats.

Work Environment

  • Remote position within the United States
  • Candidates should be comfortable maintaining meaningful overlap with Pacific Time business hours
  • Limited travel expected, primarily for occasional company meetings or strategic in-person sessions
  • Small, distributed Product and Engineering organization
  • Highly collaborative environment with direct access to company leadership

Why This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful influence on the development of a commercial lending product rather than simply inherit and maintain an established roadmap.
The person selected will bring commercial lending knowledge that is critical to the next phase of the platform, helping determine what gets built, how the product should compete, and how technology can improve the commercial lending process.
For someone who understands commercial lending deeply and enjoys building products in a smaller, hands-on environment, this role offers significant ownership and visibility.

A Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or other technical discipline is preferred.

Position Summary
The Production Supervisor is responsible for leading the daily activities of the manufacturing team to ensure assembly operations are completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and to the highest quality standards. This role provides hands-on leadership, coaching, and support to production employees while driving continuous improvement in quality, throughput, and overall team performance.
The ideal candidate brings strong manufacturing knowledge, proven leadership capabilities, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments. job.title: Sr. DevOps/Deployment Engineer
job.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer with strong experience building and improving software deployment and release processes in Linux environments. This role is best suited for someone who understands the full software delivery lifecycle — not just how to maintain an existing pipeline. You should be comfortable designing deployment solutions, working through complex technical problems independently, and understanding how decisions made within a pipeline or deployment process impact the broader application environment.

The immediate focus will be on Linux virtual machine deployments, release automation, application packaging, and CI/CD. Longer term, the environment is expected to continue evolving toward greater use of containerization.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and YAML.
  • Develop reusable pipeline templates and deployment processes that can support multiple applications and environments.
  • Create and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, and automation workflows.
  • Build and support automated application deployments into Linux virtual machine environments.
  • Package and deploy applications using Debian-based deployment methods.
  • Support the build, packaging, versioning, release, and deployment of .NET applications and services.
  • Develop deployment solutions appropriate to different .NET frameworks and application architectures.
  • Help establish consistent release, versioning, and deployment practices across technical teams.
  • Support deployments across environments with varying levels of connectivity, including restricted or disconnected environments.
  • Troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, application builds, package deployments, configuration issues, and release failures.
  • Work closely with software engineering, infrastructure, QA, database, and other technical teams to improve the overall deployment process.
  • Research technical issues through product documentation and other authoritative resources and independently develop solutions.
  • Contribute to the organization's longer-term transition toward containerized and orchestrated application deployments.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of DevOps, Release Engineering, Deployment Engineering, Infrastructure Automation, or comparable experience.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Ansible, including creating and maintaining playbooks and roles.
  • Strong experience working within Linux environments.
  • Direct experience building and/or deploying Debian packages to Linux virtual machines.

job.title: Customer Outreach Representative
job.description:
Customer Outreach Representative

Location: Framingham, MA
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite

Position Summary

We are seeking highly motivated Customer Outreach Representatives to support a strategic customer adoption initiative within an Accounts Receivable organization.

This position will focus on conducting high-volume outbound calls to customers who have already been enrolled in an online payment portal but are not actively using it. The primary objective is to educate customers on the benefits of the portal, encourage adoption and engagement, answer basic questions, and assist with registration and initial navigation.

The ideal candidate enjoys speaking with customers, can quickly build rapport, is comfortable influencing customers to take action, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Success will be measured through outreach activity, customer engagement, portal adoption, and accurate documentation of customer interactions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct high-volume outbound calls to targeted customers.
  • Perform approximately 150–200 productive calls per day once fully ramped.
  • Promote awareness, enrollment, and ongoing usage of an online payment portal.
  • Educate customers on portal features, benefits, and available payment options.
  • Assist customers with basic portal registration, login, and navigation questions.
  • Clearly communicate value propositions and encourage customers to utilize self-service payment solutions.
  • Build rapport with customers and positively influence portal adoption.
  • Follow established call scripts, outreach procedures, and escalation guidelines.
  • Accurately document call activity, customer feedback, and outcomes in designated systems.
  • Identify customer concerns and route inquiries outside the scope of the project to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Follow established transfer procedures when customers require additional assistance.
  • Maintain a professional, positive, and customer-focused approach during all interactions.
  • Quickly learn processes and expectations to achieve productivity and customer engagement goals.

Qualifications

  • Excellent customer service and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls throughout the workday.
  • Friendly, confident, and professional phone presence.
  • Ability to quickly establish rapport with customers.
  • Strong influencing and persuasion skills with the ability to encourage customers to take action.
  • Ability to clearly explain products, services, features, and benefits.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document customer interactions.
  • Basic computer proficiency.

Preferred Experience

Previous experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

  • Customer Service
  • Customer Support
  • Call Center
  • Outbound Calling
  • Inside Sales
  • Customer Outreach

job.title: Maintenance Manager
job.description:
Maintenance Manager

Reports to: Plant Manager
Location: Farmingdale and Amityville, New York (On-Site)
Pay: From $100,000 per year

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Maintenance Manager to lead maintenance and reliability across two Long Island manufacturing facilities. This position is responsible for leading the maintenance team, improving equipment reliability, managing preventive maintenance programs, overseeing repairs and projects, maintaining regulatory compliance, and controlling maintenance-related spending.

This is not strictly an administrative position. The Maintenance Manager must be comfortable working directly with equipment, leading complex troubleshooting, reading prints and manuals, identifying and sourcing components, and ensuring critical issues are resolved effectively.

A key initial priority will be establishing and driving consistent use of a newly implemented Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), including equipment and parts data, preventive maintenance programs, work-order standards, and maintenance reporting.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Maintenance Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, schedule, coach, and develop maintenance technicians and mechanics supporting multiple shifts and two facilities.
  • Establish daily and weekly priorities based on safety, production needs, equipment criticality, labor, and parts availability.
  • Set clear expectations for workmanship, attendance, documentation, housekeeping, shift handoffs, and communication.
  • Evaluate team performance, identify skill gaps, provide technical coaching and cross-training, and address performance concerns in coordination with HR.
  • Maintain appropriate shift and emergency coverage and ensure open repairs and production risks are communicated effectively.

CMMS & Maintenance Planning

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing administration of the maintenance department's CMMS.
  • Maintain accurate equipment records, asset hierarchy, preventive maintenance schedules, parts information, manuals, drawings, and equipment history.
  • Establish effective work-order standards, priorities, scheduling, downtime reporting, and closeout procedures.
  • Develop and continuously improve preventive and predictive maintenance programs for production equipment, utilities, buildings, and safety systems.
  • Use CMMS reporting to manage PM completion, maintenance backlog, recurring failures, equipment history, parts usage, and maintenance performance.

Troubleshooting & Equipment Reliability

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership during complex or high-impact equipment failures involving mechanical, electrical, controls, pneumatic, hydraulic, refrigeration, boiler, steam, and facility systems.
  • Troubleshoot automated production and packaging equipment, including batching and cooking systems, pumps, mixers, fillers, cappers, conveyors, coding and labeling equipment, and related utilities.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for significant breakdowns and recurring problems and ensure corrective actions are completed and effective.
  • Maintain accurate electrical and mechanical drawings, equipment documentation, control-system backups, and records of equipment changes.
  • Partner with Production and Quality during equipment startup and turnover to ensure repairs meet safety, quality, and performance expectations.

Parts, Vendors & Contractors

  • Identify, research, cross-reference, and source mechanical, electrical, controls, and facility components, including obsolete and long-lead parts.
  • Develop and maintain a critical spare-parts program based on equipment risk, failure history, lead time, and cost.
  • Maintain accurate parts inventory and storeroom records.
  • Build strong relationships with manufacturers, distributors, repair services, and technical contractors.
  • Obtain and compare quotations, coordinate contractor work, and ensure outside work meets established expectations.

Safety, Food Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with OSHA requirements, safety policies, LOTO, machine guarding, electrical safety, and other applicable requirements.
  • Ensure repairs meet cGMP, sanitary design, food safety, allergen control, foreign-material, and sanitation standards.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready maintenance, inspection, calibration, contractor, and corrective-action records.
  • Support customer, regulatory, GFSI, and internal audits.

Projects, Budgeting & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or support equipment installations, upgrades, capital projects, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Develop project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and risk assessments and monitor project costs and progress.
  • Manage maintenance labor, parts, repair, service contract, and capital spending.
  • Use downtime, maintenance, quality, safety, and cost data to identify reliability and continuous-improvement opportunities.
  • Provide plant leadership with clear updates on equipment condition, major breakdowns, staffing, PM status, projects, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Work closely with Production, Quality, Safety, Sanitation, HR, and plant leadership to coordinate priorities and support uninterrupted operations.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive industrial maintenance experience, including at least 4 years supervising or managing maintenance employees in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in food, beverage, pharmaceutical, or another regulated, sanitation-sensitive manufacturing environment; food manufacturing strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading a multi-shift maintenance team and improving maintenance execution and equipment reliability.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, building out, or significantly improving a CMMS, including asset data, PMs, work orders, equipment history, parts, backlog management, and reporting.
  • Strong experience leading complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis on automated production and packaging equipment.
  • Proven ability to identify, research, cross-reference, and source mechanical, electrical, controls, and facility components.

Education & Technical Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred. Technical education, recognized trade training, or an equivalent combination of education and substantial hands-on experience will be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial mechanical and electrical systems, motors, pumps, gearboxes, pneumatics, hydraulics, sensors, instrumentation, VFDs, PLC diagnostics, and HMI fault information.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, manuals, specifications, and parts diagrams.
  • Working knowledge of plant utilities, preventive and predictive maintenance, root-cause analysis, OSHA requirements, cGMPs, and food manufacturing safety standards.
  • Strong computer skills, including CMMS administration, Microsoft Excel, data analysis, and written reporting.

Leadership & Work Style

  • Calm and decisive under production pressure with strong organizational and follow-through skills.
  • Fair, direct, and professional when setting expectations and addressing performance concerns.
  • Able to earn the respect of experienced tradespeople through technical credibility, consistency, and hands-on leadership.
  • Strong communicator who can explain technical issues and business risks to employees, leadership, vendors, and nontechnical personnel.

SCHEDULE & WORK REQUIREMENTS

  • Full-time, on-site position with regular work at both the Farmingdale and Amityville facilities.
  • Must be available to support multiple shifts and respond to urgent plant issues outside normal working hours when required.
  • Must be able to work safely in an active manufacturing environment and comply with all required PPE, hygiene, safety, and food safety requirements.

BENEFITS

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Paid time off

The ideal candidate will have experience in customer service, supply chain, order management, logistics, or customer account management within a corporate, manufacturing, industrial, chemical, petrochemical, or oil & gas environment.

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and increased efficiency

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a corporate B2B environment
  • Experience in customer service, supply chain, order management, logistics, customer operations, inside sales support, or a related field
  • Strong customer-facing experience via phone and email
  • Ability to manage customer relationships rather than solely process transactions
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization, multitasking, and follow-through
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and basic math skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

Highly Preferred

  • SAP or other ERP experience
  • Manufacturing, industrial, chemical, petrochemical, plastics, or oil & gas experience
  • Supply chain and order fulfillment experience
  • Experience analyzing customer demand, buying patterns, KPIs, or order trends

The strongest candidate will be someone who can say, "I own the customer relationship and make sure their orders and needs are handled from beginning to end.”

We're looking for someone who is proactive, comfortable picking up the phone and contacting customers, understands how customer service connects with supply chain and operations, and can use data to anticipate customer needs—not someone whose experience is limited to simply entering orders.

job.title: Process Designer - Aveva P&ID
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Process Designer with advanced AVEVA P&ID experience to support industrial process engineering and design projects. This position will focus on creating, updating, and maintaining Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) while working closely with Process Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of process design principles, industrial facility operations, and experience developing engineering deliverables within a fast-paced project environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, revise, and maintain Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) using AVEVA P&ID.
  • Support Process Engineering teams with process design documentation and project deliverables.
  • Create and update process flow diagrams (PFDs), line lists, equipment information, and associated process documentation.
  • Incorporate engineering markups and field changes into existing process drawings.
  • Ensure design deliverables comply with project standards, client requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Coordinate with Process Engineers, Instrumentation Designers, Piping Designers, and other project stakeholders.
  • Participate in design reviews and interdisciplinary coordination meetings.
  • Maintain drawing accuracy, consistency, and document control throughout project execution.
  • Assist with as-built documentation updates and Management of Change (MOC) activities.
  • Support both capital projects and facility modification efforts.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Process Design within industrial, chemical, refining, petrochemical, manufacturing, energy, or related industries.
  • Advanced proficiency with AVEVA P&ID software.
  • Demonstrated experience creating and revising P&IDs in an engineering environment.
  • Strong understanding of process engineering concepts, equipment, instrumentation, piping systems, and control systems.
  • Ability to interpret engineering specifications, process flow diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering and design teams.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting project deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting EPC, consulting engineering, or owner-operator projects.
  • Familiarity with AVEVA Engineering, AVEVA E3D, AutoCAD, SmartPlant P&ID, or similar design platforms.
  • Experience with Management of Change (MOC) processes.
  • Knowledge of chemical processing, refining, manufacturing, specialty chemicals, pulp & paper, or industrial facilities.
  • Associate Degree in Design Technology, Engineering Technology, Drafting, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

job.title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, develop, and support firmware for IoT and video-streaming products. This role will own major firmware components throughout the product lifecycle and collaborate with hardware, cloud, mobile, QA, and manufacturing partners to deliver reliable, production-ready devices.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware for IoT and video-streaming products.
  • Own major firmware components and features from initial design through production.
  • Develop and integrate device drivers, communication protocols, RTOS components, and platform firmware.
  • Collaborate with hardware, cloud, mobile, QA, and original design manufacturer partners on system integration and product delivery.
  • Troubleshoot complex firmware, hardware, and system-level issues.
  • Optimize firmware for performance, memory usage, power consumption, resource utilization, and reliability.
  • Review board schematics, component datasheets, and hardware documentation to support development and debugging.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and root-cause analysis.
  • Evaluate SoCs, image sensors, wireless modules, and other components for future products.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and process improvements.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 7+ years of embedded firmware development experience.
  • Strong Embedded C and C++ programming skills.
  • Software development experience across RTOS and Embedded Linux platforms.
  • Understanding of real-time multimedia applications, including video and audio processing, compression, and streaming technologies such as H.264 and H.265.
  • Multithreaded and multitasking embedded software development experience.
  • Experience developing and debugging embedded device drivers.
  • Strong embedded-system debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Experience optimizing embedded software for performance and resource utilization.
  • Working knowledge of TCP, UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, RTP, RTSP, SIP, and WebRTC.
  • Experience with Wi-Fi, BLE, and LTE wireless technologies.
  • Familiarity with IoT communication architectures and cloud-connected devices.
  • Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
  • Experience using Git or a comparable source-control system.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Firmware development experience involving consumer IoT, smart-home, networking, or video-streaming products.
  • Experience with Zigbee, Z-Wave, Thread, or Matter.
  • Knowledge of Linux memory management, file systems, and bootloaders such as U-Boot.
  • Python, Perl, or Lua scripting experience.
  • Experience supporting products through manufacturing and production.

Work Details

  • Remote role within California, USA

job.description:
Systems Integration & Test Engineer (LabVIEW / TestStand)

***please do not submit the same candidate(s) to request #17280/17295/17349/17928/18128/18424/18427/18996/20163***

Position Overview

This role is for a Systems Integration & Test Engineer responsible for designing, developing, integrating, testing, and validating complex hardware/software systems, subsystems, and components. The engineer will support both in-house developed and commercial/government off-the-shelf (COTS/GOTS) solutions, ensuring systems meet customer requirements, technical specifications, and performance expectations.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, system-level testing, electrical measurements, troubleshooting, and hardware/software integration. Experience with RF/Microwave systems, test equipment development, and aerospace/defense environments is highly preferred.

Clearance Update:
Due to limited candidate flow, the client is now accepting candidates who are able to obtain a security clearance. The supplier will initiate the interim clearance process at the offer stage.

please do not submit the same candidate(s) to request #17280/17295/17349/17928/18128/18424/18427/18996/20163***

Key Responsibilities

Systems Integration & Testing

  • Plan, execute, and support integration and test activities for complex systems, subsystems, and components.
  • Develop test solutions based on customer requirements while balancing technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
  • Integrate hardware and software components to ensure overall system functionality.
  • Define system inputs, outputs, interfaces, and performance requirements.
  • Troubleshoot hardware/software interface issues during integration activities.

Test Development & Execution

  • Develop, modify, and maintain automated test programs using:
    • LabVIEW
    • NI TestStand
  • Create and execute comprehensive test plans, procedures, and schedules.
  • Develop test strategies to verify and validate system performance.
  • Analyze test results and generate detailed technical reports.
  • Perform regression testing after software, hardware, or subsystem updates.

Requirements & Documentation

  • Translate system and customer requirements into test procedures and validation methods.
  • Develop technical documentation including:
    • Test procedures
    • Work instructions
    • Status reports
    • Engineering documentation
    • Test results and evaluation reports
  • Identify discrepancies between drawings, requirements, and actual hardware configurations.
  • Support corrective and preventative action activities.

Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

  • Analyze test failures and identify root causes.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to:
    • Test equipment
    • Software
    • Hardware interfaces
    • Fixtures
    • Units under test (UUT)
  • Develop corrective actions and verify fixes through testing.

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Systems Engineering
    • Electrical Engineering
    • Software Engineering
    • Manufacturing
    • Program Management
    • Test teams
  • Lead and coordinate test activities to support program milestones.
  • Provide technical updates and presentations regarding issues, solutions, and test results.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in one of the following:

  • Electrical Engineering
  • Computer Engineering
  • Computer Science
  • Related technical discipline

Equivalent professional-level experience may be considered.

Required Experience

Software & Test Development

  • 5+ years experience with LabVIEW
    • Writing, editing, and maintaining existing software code
    • Developing test applications
    • Supporting automated test environments
  • 3+ years experience with NI TestStand
    • Developing and maintaining test sequences
    • Supporting automated test programs
    • Debugging test failures

Engineering Experience

  • 3+ years experience troubleshooting and resolving technical problems.
  • Experience analyzing test data and determining root cause.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities independently.
  • Experience working in a team-based engineering environment.
  • Experience supporting milestone-driven projects.

Communication Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to create technical documentation and reports.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with the following experience are highly desired:

RF / Microwave Background

  • 5+ years as a subject matter expert in:
    • Radio Frequency (RF)
    • Microwave systems
    • RF subsystems
    • Signal measurement techniques

Advanced Test Development

  • 3+ years developing complex automated test systems using TestStand.
  • Experience designing electrical test solutions for:
    • Components
    • Circuit boards
    • Subassemblies
    • Integrated systems

Test Equipment & Hardware

  • Experience selecting and integrating test equipment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues down to:
    • Test instrument level
    • Fixture level
    • Software level
    • Unit under test level

Engineering Documentation

Experience creating:

  • Assembly drawings
  • Block diagrams
  • Parts lists
  • Test documentation
  • Engineering change documentation

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Corrective Action / Preventative Action (CAPA) experience.
