job.title: Welder
job.description:
Welder / Fabricator

Location: Tulsa, Oklahoma
Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

A growing Tulsa-area manufacturer is seeking experienced Welders/Fabricators to support the production of custom industrial equipment and fabricated assemblies.

This position is responsible for fitting, welding, and assembling structural components according to drawings and production specifications. The ideal candidate can read fabrication prints, produce quality welds, and work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fit, weld, and assemble fabricated metal components and structural assemblies.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, weld symbols, and dimensional specifications.
  • Perform welding using MIG and flux-core processes.
  • Measure, position, align, and secure components before welding.
  • Inspect materials and completed welds for accuracy, quality, and conformance to specifications.
  • Use grinders, saws, torches, clamps, measuring devices, and other fabrication tools.
  • Complete tack welding, final welding, grinding, and finishing as required.
  • Verify dimensions using tape measures, squares, levels, and other inspection tools.
  • Identify drawing discrepancies, material issues, or fabrication concerns and communicate them to supervision.
  • Follow established welding procedures, production instructions, and quality requirements.
  • Maintain an organized and safe work area.
  • Assist with general fabrication, material handling, and assembly duties as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous welding or metal fabrication experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency with MIG or flux-core welding.
  • Ability to read and interpret fabrication drawings and weld symbols.
  • Experience fitting and welding structural steel or fabricated assemblies.
  • Ability to accurately read a tape measure and use basic inspection tools.
  • Understanding of weld preparation, joint fit-up, and distortion control.
  • Ability to pass a hands-on welding test.
  • Ability to work safely with minimal supervision.
  • Reliable attendance and the ability to meet production deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Vocational or technical training in welding.
  • Experience welding carbon steel.
  • Experience fabricating frames, skids, platforms, enclosures, or similar industrial assemblies.
  • Familiarity with fillet welds, groove welds, multi-pass welds, and out-of-position welding.
  • Experience using overhead cranes, hoists, forklifts, or other material-handling equipment.
  • Familiarity with welding procedure specifications and manufacturing quality standards.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, bend, kneel, climb, and work in different positions throughout the shift.
  • Ability to lift and move materials and equipment commonly used in a fabrication environment.
  • Ability to work around welding fumes, sparks, heat, noise, and moving equipment.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment.

Work Environment

This position is based in an industrial manufacturing and fabrication facility. Employees will work around welding equipment, machinery, fabricated steel, cranes, and material-handling equipment.

job.description:
PAY RATE ***/hr
***am - 3:30pm Monday - Friday
Position Summary:
Responsible for performing routine product support duties following well defined procedures and processes in one or more of the following functions: parts identification, shipping, receiving, warehouse, stock handling, parts handling, etc. Position requires close supervision with detailed instruction and training.
Primary Responsibilities/Essential Functions:
PARTS IDENTIFICATION
1. Identify parts using simple and proper identification methods and equipment indicated by the pick list or WIP, blueprint and/or customer requirements.
SHIPPING
2. Prepare parts and/or materials to assure safe handling for shipment including the completion of the necessary paperwork.
3. Prepare packaging per specifications for shipment including computer input for necessary labels.
WAREHOUSE
4. Check and identify parts by type or part number.
5. Prepare parts for storage and place stock in proper location as directed.
6. Select parts from stock to fill orders according to parts lists.
7. Maintain and access necessary records utilizing a computer. If applicable, execute some advanced CICS functions such as issue requisition, release requisition, edit and fill shortage requisitions.
PARTS HANDLING
8. Following route/route sheet instructions, move parts between functions or teams using a forklift or other moving devices.
9. Package or repackage parts to prevent damage during movement or handling.
10. Request and stage tooling required to support team schedules.
11. Audit material storage areas to support inventory location and count accuracy.?
Secondary Responsibilities/Non Essential Functions:
1. Maintains appropriate knowledge and ability levels to efficiently perform all assigned work and utilizes this knowledge base to become proficient on new/unfamiliar assignments
2. May be required to assist in sub-assembly area.

4. Actively participates in lean/continuous initiatives by identifying and providing suggestions on areas for improvement. Applies lean concepts and tools in work areas.

4. Able to use job specific software applications.
5. The person in this position frequently communicates with co-workers about work product and processes and must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. Must be able to read and understand written instructions, procedures, forms and specifications. Demonstrates effective interpersonal communication skills as well as the ability to work in a team environment.
6. For Parker employees in this position, participation in and completion of Powerlift Operator Training Program (forklift) is required.
7. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
8. May be required to operate moving equipment and saw equipment and meet OSHA safety qualifications.

Typical Mental and Physical Demands:
The person in this position needs to frequently move about inside the plant to prepare parts for shipment, storage, fill orders, count inventory, and move materials. The team member frequently operates computers and office productivity machinery; occasionally ascends/descends a ladder to retrieve or store parts or materials; and frequently moves materials weighing up to 50 lbs. Frequently is exposed to noise, dust, gas and fumes and works near hazardous equipment or machinery.

job.title: MES Software Developer
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking an MES Software Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and support Siemens Opcenter Execution solutions across a global manufacturing environment. This hands-on role combines software engineering, manufacturing operations, and system integration to support reliable shop floor operations and major MES initiatives.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and support MES applications using .NET, C#, ASP.NET, and Web APIs.
  • Configure and enhance Siemens Opcenter Execution solutions based on manufacturing and business requirements.
  • Build and maintain integrations between MES, enterprise applications, and shop floor equipment.
  • Implement and support messaging technologies such as MSMQ, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or similar middleware.
  • Maintain reliable and consistent data flow across integrated applications and platforms.
  • Partner with manufacturing stakeholders, business teams, and IT colleagues to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance on solution design, implementation approaches, and MES system improvements.
  • Support major system changes, enhancements, upgrades, and integration initiatives.
  • Troubleshoot complex production and non-production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions.
  • Test and validate applications, integrations, and system changes for performance, stability, and business readiness.
  • Contribute to project planning, technical estimates, and delivery schedules.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation and provide user support and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in an on-call support rotation after onboarding and training.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience using .NET, C#, and ASP.NET.
  • Experience building and supporting enterprise applications using RESTful APIs and modern integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with MSMQ, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging middleware.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals and the Software Development Life Cycle.
  • Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, TFS, or similar source control and development platforms.
  • Strong relational database experience with Oracle or SQL Server.
  • Experience supporting systems within a 24/7 manufacturing, industrial, or operational environment.
  • Ability to independently manage complex technical work and contribute to large-scale system changes.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Experience with Siemens Opcenter Execution Designer and Portal, formerly Camstar.
  • Experience with other Manufacturing Execution System platforms.
  • Experience supporting significant system implementations, upgrades, or integration initiatives.
  • Familiarity with test-driven development, CI/CD, and automated deployment practices.
  • Experience with GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Experience working within Scrum or Agile teams.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools.

Work Details

  • Remote role requiring residence within a 1–2 hour commute of the Client's Charlotte, North Carolina office.
  • Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
  • No overtime anticipated.
  • Up to 15% travel based on project needs.
  • One-hour panel video interview.
  • Possibility of extension based on demand.
  • Participation in an on-call rotation after onboarding and training.

job.title: Welder- 1st shift
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Certified Welder to join an aerospace manufacturing team supporting the fabrication and welding of high-performance components and assemblies. This role requires strong hands-on experience with manual GTAW/TIG and orbital GTAW welding, particularly working with exotic aerospace alloys.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of aerospace welding standards, welding procedures, equipment setup, inspection requirements, and the ability to consistently produce high-quality welds in a safety- and quality-driven manufacturing environment.

Key Requirements

Candidates must have the following technical experience to be considered for an interview:

  • Manual GTAW (TIG) certification to AWS D17.1, Group IIb, IIIB, VII, 1G position, or equivalent. 1G certification is the required minimum.
  • Hands-on experience setting up, programming, and operating orbital GTAW equipment, such as Orbitalum, AMI, or equivalent.
  • Experience welding exotic aerospace alloys, including:
    • Haynes 188
    • Hastelloy X (HAST-X)
    • Inconel 718
    • L-605 / Cobalt alloys
  • Experience with purge systems and backing gas control.
  • Knowledge of post-weld inspection methods.
  • Experience working from and executing WPS, WPQ, and QTR documentation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot welding equipment and adjust welding parameters within established procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate manual and automated welding systems according to work instructions, procedures, and established welding practices.
  • Set up fixtures, attachments, and workpieces using visual inspection, hand tools, and measuring equipment.
  • Adjust welding parameters within approved procedural limits to achieve required quality standards.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, weld symbols, procedures, and quality requirements.
  • Perform proper pre-weld cleaning, preparation, and handling of aerospace components.
  • Inspect completed and in-process hardware using visual inspection and measuring equipment.
  • Perform welding equipment setup, troubleshooting, and basic maintenance.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and FOD-free work environment.
  • Maintain all required welding qualifications and certifications.
  • Follow all applicable safety, quality, and manufacturing procedures.
  • Assist and provide guidance to less-experienced welders when needed.
  • Support welding skill development, safety, and technical training.
  • Work with Engineering to develop welding processes and resolve welding-related issues.
  • Troubleshoot welding equipment and collaborate with team members to maintain production requirements.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 8+ years of welding or related experience, or demonstrated ability to successfully perform the responsibilities of the position.
  • Aerospace welding experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with exotic aerospace alloys required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required AWS D17.1 welding qualifications.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, weld symbols, WPS/WPQ/QTR documentation, and quality requirements.
  • Strong manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations and apply machine-shop mathematics.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Effective English verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Pre-Employment & Job Requirements

This is a safety-sensitive position and is subject to random drug testing.

Candidates must be able to successfully complete:

  • Eye examination
  • FAA drug test
  • Manual welding performance test
  • Company-administered welding qualification/WPS-QTR testing

Candidates must be able to successfully complete the required company welding performance qualification within two weeks.

Required Prescreen Questions

Candidates must have answers to the following questions included on their resume at the time of submission:

  1. Are you AWS D17.1 certified? If yes, which groups and positions?
  2. How many years of hands-on welding experience do you have, including total welding experience and experience specifically with aerospace/exotic alloys?
  3. Have you programmed and operated Orbitalum or AMI orbital GTAW systems? Yes/No
  4. Can you read and work from WPS and WPQR documents? Yes/No
  5. Are you able to pass a company-administered weld performance qualification (WPS/QTR) within a two-week period? Yes/No

Interview Instructions

Candidates should arrive no more than 5 minutes before their scheduled interview. There is no lobby/waiting area, so candidates will need to remain outside until they are welcomed into the facility.

Important: Candidates should be prepared for the eye exam, FAA drug testing, and manual weld test requirements associated with this position.

job.title: Welder-3rd shift
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Certified Welder to join an aerospace manufacturing team supporting the welding and fabrication of high-performance aerospace components and assemblies.

This position requires strong hands-on experience with manual GTAW/TIG and orbital GTAW welding, including experience working with exotic aerospace alloys. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of aerospace welding standards, welding procedures, equipment setup, inspection requirements, and quality requirements.

This is a 3rd-shift position, working Sunday through Thursday from 11:00 PM–7:00 AM. New hires will be required to train on 2nd shift, Monday–Friday, 3:00 PM–11:00 PM, for several weeks before transitioning to the regular 3rd-shift schedule.

Key Technical Requirements

Candidates must have the following experience to be considered for an interview:

  • Manual GTAW (TIG) certification to AWS D17.1, Group IIb, IIIB, VII, 1G position, or equivalent.
    • 1G is the required minimum certification.
    • Equivalent 1G–6G certifications may be considered.
  • Hands-on experience setting up, programming, and operating orbital GTAW equipment, including Orbitalum, AMI, or equivalent systems.
  • Experience welding exotic aerospace alloys, including:
    • Haynes 188
    • Hastelloy X (HAST-X)
    • Inconel 718
    • L-605 / Cobalt alloys
  • Experience with purge systems and backing gas control.
  • Knowledge of post-weld inspection methods.
  • Experience executing WPS/WPQ/QTR requirements.
  • Ability to troubleshoot welding equipment and adjust welding parameters within established procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate manual and automated welding systems according to work instructions and established welding practices.
  • Position and adjust fixtures, attachments, and workpieces using hand tools and measuring equipment.
  • Fine-tune welding processes within established procedural limits to achieve conformance requirements.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, weld symbols, procedures, and quality requirements.
  • Perform proper pre-weld cleaning, preparation, and handling of aerospace components.
  • Inspect hardware using visual inspection techniques and measuring equipment.
  • Set up, operate, and troubleshoot welding equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and FOD-free work environment.
  • Maintain required welding qualifications and certifications.
  • Follow all applicable safety, quality, and manufacturing procedures.
  • Provide guidance to less-experienced welders as needed.
  • Assist with welder training, skill development, and safety initiatives.
  • Work with Engineering to develop welding processes and resolve welding-related issues.
  • Troubleshoot welding equipment while working collaboratively to support production requirements.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 8+ years of welding or related experience, or demonstrated ability to perform the responsibilities of the position.
  • Aerospace welding experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with exotic aerospace alloys required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required AWS D17.1 qualifications.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, weld symbols, WPS/WPQ/QTR documentation, and quality requirements.
  • Strong manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations and apply machine-shop mathematics.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Effective English verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Schedule

Regular Schedule – 3rd Shift:
Sunday–Thursday
11:00 PM–7:00 AM

Required Training Schedule:
Monday–Friday
3:00 PM–11:00 PM
Training will be required for several weeks before transitioning to the regular 3rd-shift schedule.

Candidates must be comfortable working both schedules.

Safety & Pre-Employment Requirements

This is a safety-sensitive position and is subject to random drug testing.

Candidates must successfully complete:

  • Eye examination
  • FAA drug test
  • Welding performance test
  • Required company welding qualification/WPS-QTR testing

Interview/Submission Requirements

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate their welding qualifications and hands-on experience during the interview and welding test process.

Recruiter Prescreen Questions

Please confirm the following with every candidate before submission:

  1. Are you AWS D17.1 certified? If yes, which groups and positions?
  2. How many years of hands-on welding experience do you have? How many years specifically in aerospace/exotic alloys?
  3. Have you programmed and operated Orbitalum or AMI orbital GTAW systems? Yes/No
  4. Can you read and work from WPS and WPQR documents? Yes/No
  5. Are you able to pass a company-administered weld performance qualification (WPS/QTR) within a two-week period? Yes/No
  6. Are you able to work 3rd shift, Sunday–Thursday, 11:00 PM–7:00 AM?
  7. Are you able to train on 2nd shift, Monday–Friday, 3:00 PM–11:00 PM, for several weeks before moving to 3rd shift?

Important: The candidate must be comfortable with the required 2nd-shift training period and permanent 3rd-shift schedule before being submitted.

job.title: CNC Programmer/Toolmaker
job.description:
Nesco Resource is looking for a CNC Programmer/Toolmaker located in Bethel, CT. This is a temp to perm opportunity for the right candidate.

Shift: Monday-Friday 7AM-3PM

Pay: $31-$49/hour depending on experience

Position Overview: Are you an experienced CNC Programmer/Toolmaker looking to work with advanced machining equipment and challenging, precision-driven projects? We are seeking a skilled professional to program, set up, and operate a variety of CNC machines while supporting prototype development, process improvements, and precision manufacturing. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong programming experience, particularly with 5-axis machining, who enjoys solving complex manufacturing challenges and producing high-quality parts.

Responsibilities

  • Program, set up, and operate CNC milling machines (3-axis and 5-axis), CNC lathes, Wire EDM, and waterjet equipment.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and work instructions to develop efficient machining processes.
  • Manufacture complex, tight-tolerance precision components using a variety of materials.
  • Select, preset, adjust, and replace cutting tools to optimize machining performance.
  • Design and build custom fixtures and work holding solutions to improve production efficiency.
  • Inspect finished parts using precision measuring equipment, including micrometers, calipers, indicators, gauges, and optical inspection equipment.
  • Troubleshoot machining issues and implement corrective actions to improve quality and productivity.
  • Provide design-for-manufacturability (DFM) feedback to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with engineers and production teams to develop and improve manufacturing processes.
  • Create labor and material estimates from engineering drawings.
  • Complete manufacturing documentation and in-process inspections accurately.
  • Train and support machinists and operators as needed.
  • Perform routine maintenance on machines, tooling, and fixtures.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while following all quality and safety standards.
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Associate degree in a machining or manufacturing-related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of CNC programming and machining experience.
  • Strong experience programming 5-axis CNC machines.
  • Experience with CNC mills, lathes, Wire EDM, and/or waterjet equipment.
  • Proficiency with CAD/CAM software such as Mastercam, GibbsCAM, or Esprit.
  • Strong understanding of G-Code, M-Code, GD&T, blueprint reading, and machinist math.
  • Experience using precision inspection equipment, including micrometers, calipers, indicators, gauges, microscopes, and optical measuring equipment.
  • Ability to design tooling, fixtures, and work holding solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with tight-tolerance precision machining.
  • Knowledge of ISO quality systems or regulated manufacturing environments is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

job.title: Client Support Specialist
job.description:
Nesco Data Center & Infrastructure is seeking a Client Support Specialist in the Greater Columbus OH area.

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Client Support Specialist to support a confidential enterprise client and an internal Project Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys customer service, mobile technology, and solving technical challenges while building a long-term career in project management.

The position begins as a full-time, in-office role to ensure comprehensive training and client support. After approximately six months, there is potential to transition to a hybrid schedule based on successful performance, demonstrated proficiency, and client satisfaction.

This role offers significant career development opportunities. Successful candidates will receive cross-functional training in Customer Service, Help Desk Operations, Product Implementation, Project Management, Logistics, and Client Support. Individuals who excel in this position will have the opportunity to advance into a Project Management Support role, with long-term potential to become a Project Manager.

Key Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Professional and customer-focused
  • An excellent verbal and written communicator
  • Reliable with outstanding attendance and dependability
  • Comfortable handling customer service calls and resolving client issues
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Passionate about technology, particularly mobile devices and enterprise mobility solutions

Essential Responsibilities

Mobile Device Ordering & Asset Management

  • Receive and process mobile device requests for new hires.
  • Create and submit wireless device orders through carrier and customer portals.
  • Track device shipments and coordinate delivery prior to employee start dates.
  • Maintain inventory and manage backfill device stock.

Device Activation & Customer Support

  • Provide Tier 1 support for mobile device activations and activation troubleshooting.
  • Activate new devices and manage personal-to-corporate account transfers.
  • Deliver Tier 2 support for mobile device configuration, corporate email setup, and authentication issues.
  • Educate users on self-service tools and available support resources.

Technical & Administrative Support

  • Configure and support enterprise mobile devices.
  • Install and troubleshoot Microsoft Authenticator, Microsoft Intune, and related applications.
  • Support Mobile Device Management (MDM) enrollment and configuration.
  • Assist users with portal access, account issues, and authentication problems.
  • Serve as a liaison between internal IT teams and wireless carriers, including Telecommunication and Telecommunication.
  • Maintain documentation, knowledge articles, and SharePoint resources.

Client & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate mobile device offboarding activities with Human Resources and internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in recurring client and project meetings.
  • Support customer training sessions and informational workshops.
  • Assist Project Managers with ongoing initiatives, special projects, and operational activities.
  • Support emergency response and Continuity of Operations (COOP) activities when required.

Wireless Service Management

  • Manage wireless device and service requests.
  • Process upgrades, replacements, cancellations, and service modifications.
  • Generate wireless reporting, including active line reports and usage information.
  • Coordinate monthly cancellation activities for inactive services.

Compliance

  • Follow all client policies, security requirements, and operational procedures.
  • Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

 

Technical Skills

  • Experience activating and supporting mobile devices.
  • Working knowledge of Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms, preferably Microsoft Intune.
  • Experience supporting Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), including Microsoft Authenticator.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience using Microsoft Teams, WebEx, or similar collaboration platforms.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems is preferred.

Professional Skills

  • Outstanding customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and clients.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and safeguard sensitive information.

Career Growth Opportunity

This position is designed as a career development role for individuals interested in advancing into Project Management. High-performing employees will receive exposure to multiple business functions, including:

  • Customer Service & Help Desk Operations
  • Product Implementation
  • Logistics & Asset Management
  • Client Success
  • Project Coordination
  • Project Management

job.title: Industrial Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Industrial Maintenance Technician — Rochester, NY Direct Hire | Full-Time | A-Shift

Presented by Nesco Resource

$22.00 – $32.00/hour | Mon–Fri, 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM | Overtime eligible

A growing Rochester manufacturer is looking for a mechanically sharp Maintenance Tech ready to own a wide variety of hands-on challenges — from troubleshooting production equipment and repairing pumps and motors to supporting installs and facility upgrades. If you like variety, problem-solving on the fly, and going home on time most days, this one's worth a look.

Why this one stands out:

  • Direct hire from day one — no temp period, no waiting
  • Day shift, consistent Monday–Friday schedule
  • Overtime available when you want the extra hours
  • Centrally located in Rochester

What you'll work on:

  • Maintain and repair production machinery, pumps, motors, and mechanical systems
  • Diagnose issues using schematics, wiring diagrams, and diagnostic tools (multimeter, etc.)
  • Perform preventative maintenance on electrical and mechanical equipment
  • Support installation and commissioning of new equipment
  • Collaborate on facility improvement and capital projects
  • Operate forklifts, cranes, and other mobile equipment safely

job.title: Mechanical Equipment / Piping Engineer- Direct Hire
job.description:
Position Snapshot

Job Title

Mechanical Equipment / Piping Engineer

Location

Houston, TX

Employment Type

Direct Hire / Full-Time

Compensation

$90,000–$135,000 base salary + 10%–20% performance-based bonus

Important recruiting requirement: Salary expectations must be added to the top of the candidate's resume in this format:

Base Salary Expectation: $XXX,XXX + Bonus Expectation: XX% | Total Desired Compensation: $XXX,XXX

Candidate Requirements

  • Must be a local Houston candidate
  • No relocation
  • No sponsorship
  • U.S. work authorization requirements should be confirmed during screening
  • 3–15 years of experience considered
  • Priority given to candidates with 5+ years
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred
  • PE license is not required, but strongly favored for senior candidates
  • EPC experience strongly preferred
  • Modular engineering/design experience required
  • Strong piping stress and mechanical equipment experience required
  • Subsea experience is not required
  • Subsea is considered an analogous background
  • Data center experience is ideal but not mandatory

Important Submission Restriction

This is a refresh posting for 1SLBJP00003284.

Do not resubmit any candidate who previously interviewed or was rejected.

What This Engineer Will Actually Do

The engineer will own or support the mechanical equipment and piping scope for large-scale data center modules.

They will be involved in:

Design → Engineering → Procurement → Manufacturing → Assembly → Testing → Installation → Commissioning

This is important because the engineer must understand how a design works in the real world.

They are not just sitting in front of CAD software creating drawings.

They will also:

  • Review designs
  • Check calculations
  • Review vendor equipment
  • Support manufacturing
  • Help resolve construction problems
  • Respond to RFIs
  • Support installation
  • Assist with commissioning
  • Interact with customers
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers

Core Technical Focus

1. Piping Engineering

This is one of the most important areas of the role.

The candidate should understand:

  • Piping system design
  • Pipe routing
  • Piping layout
  • Line sizing
  • Piping components
  • Specialty items
  • Valves
  • Fittings
  • Supports
  • Brackets
  • Fasteners
  • Bolting
  • Mounting systems
  • Piping insulation
  • Coatings and painting systems

The engineer will prepare or review:

  • Valve lists
  • Equipment lists
  • Piping line lists
  • Piping layouts
  • Piping calculations
  • Piping specifications
  • Piping stress studies

2. Piping Stress Analysis

This is a major technical requirement.

The engineer will perform or check:

  • Pipe stress analysis
  • Flexibility analysis
  • Thermal expansion analysis
  • Piping loads
  • Equipment nozzle loads
  • Support loads
  • Seismic loads
  • Wind loads
  • Pressure loads
  • Thermal loads
  • Operating loads
  • Occasional loads

The engineer will also provide piping load information to structural engineering.

Key software:

  • CAESAR II
  • NozzlePro
  • FEPipe

A candidate with strong piping stress experience but no direct data center background could still be highly relevant.

3. Mechanical Equipment

The engineer will work with and design around critical mechanical equipment such as:

  • Chillers
  • Cooling towers
  • Direct evaporative cooling systems
  • Indirect evaporative cooling systems
  • Pumps
  • Fans
  • Vessels
  • Valves
  • Coolers
  • Mechanical control systems
  • Other critical data center mechanical equipment

The candidate needs to understand how equipment interacts with the piping systems around it.

For example:

  • What are the equipment connection requirements?
  • What are the nozzle loads?
  • How does thermal expansion affect the system?
  • What type of supports are required?
  • What are the vibration concerns?
  • How will the equipment be installed and maintained?

4. EPC Experience

The ideal candidate has worked in an EPC environment.

They should understand the relationship between:

Engineering

Designing and calculating the system.

Procurement

Preparing technical requisitions, reviewing vendor quotes, and specifying equipment.

Construction

Supporting field installation, RFIs, and construction issues.

This is a full project lifecycle role.

5. Modular Engineering

This is a particularly important part of the position.

The company produces modular data center infrastructure.

The engineer must understand how equipment and piping will be:

  • Designed
  • Fabricated
  • Assembled
  • Transported
  • Installed
  • Tested
  • Commissioned

This means designs must consider:

  • Space limitations
  • Modular assembly
  • Transport requirements
  • Equipment access
  • Maintenance access
  • Piping connections
  • Structural support
  • Installation sequence

Candidates with experience in the following may transfer well:

  • Modular construction
  • Skid packages
  • Packaged equipment
  • Offshore modules
  • Subsea systems
  • Oil & gas modules
  • Process skids
  • Industrial equipment packages
  • E-houses
  • Fabricated mechanical systems

Subsea Experience

Subsea experience is not mandatory.

However, it is considered analogous because subsea engineers often work with:

  • Complex mechanical systems
  • Piping
  • Pressure systems
  • Equipment interfaces
  • Tight design tolerances
  • Stress analysis
  • Reliability requirements
  • Harsh operating environments
  • Complex fabrication and assembly

A strong subsea engineer with piping stress and mechanical equipment experience could be a very strong candidate.

Technical Documents and Deliverables

The engineer will prepare, review, or approve:

Equipment Lists

Including:

  • Equipment identification
  • Equipment specifications
  • Capacity
  • Materials
  • Operating conditions

Valve Lists

Including:

  • Valve type
  • Size
  • Pressure rating
  • Materials
  • Service

Piping Line Lists

Including:

  • Line number
  • Size
  • Service
  • Design pressure
  • Design temperature
  • Material
  • Insulation requirements

Piping Stress / Flexibility Studies

Including:

  • Load cases
  • Stress results
  • Equipment loads
  • Support requirements

Mechanical Equipment Datasheets

Used to define:

  • Equipment requirements
  • Operating parameters
  • Design conditions
  • Vendor requirements

MTOs

Material Take-Offs for:

  • Piping
  • Valves
  • Fittings
  • Supports
  • Mechanical equipment

BOMs

Detailed Bills of Materials supporting manufacturing and assembly.

Design Basis Responsibilities

The engineer may create or review the project-specific Design Basis document.

This document may incorporate:

  • Applicable codes
  • Client specifications
  • Company scope of supply
  • Approved exceptions
  • Project design requirements

The Design Basis helps establish the technical rules used throughout the project.

Vendor and Procurement Support

The engineer will support procurement by:

  • Preparing Technical Requisitions
  • Reviewing vendor quotations
  • Reviewing vendor technical data
  • Evaluating equipment against specifications
  • Providing feedback to procurement
  • Supporting equipment selection

This means the candidate needs to understand both:

What the equipment needs to do and how to evaluate whether a vendor's equipment meets the requirement.

Manufacturing and Plant Support

The engineer will support the manufacturing plant during production.

They may:

  • Review fabrication issues
  • Answer technical questions
  • Clarify drawings
  • Resolve design conflicts
  • Review as-built conditions
  • Support assembly teams
  • Assist with manufacturing changes

This is an excellent role for someone who enjoys being connected to the physical product rather than working exclusively on design documents.

Construction and Commissioning Support

The engineer will provide technical support during:

  • Construction
  • Installation
  • Testing
  • Commissioning

They may:

  • Respond to RFIs
  • Troubleshoot piping issues
  • Resolve equipment problems
  • Attend site visits
  • Participate in project meetings
  • Support commissioning teams
  • Review as-built drawings
  • Re-run or verify calculations

Customer-Facing Responsibilities

The engineer may represent the company during customer meetings.

Responsibilities include:

  • Presenting technical information
  • Responding to customer questions
  • Explaining design decisions
  • Addressing concerns
  • Supporting design reviews
  • Maintaining strong customer relationships

Strong communication is important because this role requires explaining complex technical information clearly.

Codes and Standards

The candidate should have experience with or familiarity with relevant industry standards, including:

  • AISI
  • ANSI
  • ASME
    • Section VIII
    • Section IX
    • B31.3
  • ASTM
  • AWS
  • IBC
  • MFMA
  • Client
  • OSHA
  • NACE
  • NFPA
  • PFI

The strongest candidates will have experience applying codes to real-world design and engineering decisions.

Education

Preferred

Bachelor of Science in:

  • Mechanical Engineering

Other degrees may be considered:

  • Industrial Engineering
  • Mechatronics Engineering
  • Other engineering disciplines

However, candidates with non-mechanical degrees should have stronger relevant experience in:

  • Mechanical equipment
  • Piping
  • Stress analysis
  • Data center infrastructure
  • EPC engineering

Software Requirements

Most Important Software

CAESAR II

Critical for piping stress and flexibility analysis.

NozzlePro

Used for equipment nozzle and local stress evaluation.

FEPipe

Used for piping analysis and stress evaluation.

These three are among the strongest technical screening tools for this role.

Additional Software

The candidate may also have experience with:

  • SAP engineering modules
  • SolidWorks
  • AutoCAD
  • Revit
  • BIM 360
  • Navisworks Manager
  • Navisworks Freedom
  • 3E Plus
  • Pipe Data Pro
  • COMPRESS
  • Microsoft Office 365
  • Adobe
  • Foxit

Strong Candidate Backgrounds

Best Fit

  • Mechanical Engineer
  • Piping Engineer
  • Mechanical Equipment Engineer
  • Piping Stress Engineer
  • Mechanical Design Engineer
  • Senior Piping Engineer
  • Mechanical Project Engineer

Strong Industries

  • Data centers
  • EPC
  • Oil & gas
  • Petrochemical
  • Client
  • Subsea
  • Offshore
  • Power generation
  • Industrial manufacturing
  • Chemical processing
  • Heavy industrial
  • Modular construction

Job description
The role of Electrical Engineer is to support the Engineering Lead and Product Engineering Manager. They will be accountable for the electrical scope and systems in large scale data centers across the design, construction, assembly, testing, installation, and commissioning phases. The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for checking and approving drawings / designs; interface communication, and ensuring the accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and safety of the electrical scope of work for Hyperscale Data Center Modules meets customer's requirements and Industrial Standards.

The Electrical Engineer will play a critical role with supporting the plant during the manufacturing stage. They will also be assisting various stakeholders in troubleshooting site installation and commissioning problems.

Roles and Responsibilities
The Engineer will support the goals and programs established by the management team. These roles and responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Checking and approving drawings, information, and documentation which meets Industrial standards to enable the manufacturing group and other departments to produce Data Center Infrastructure Modules.
Attend and initiate Design and Development Planning and Review session to meet customer's and industry's need.
Prepare TRs (Technical Requisitions) for electrical systems, fire systems, and various components.
Review vendor quotations and provide feedback to procurement team.
Prepare and complete various electrical engineering deliverable drawings, documents, and calculations such as electrical load list, cable sizing / schedule, single line diagrams.
Design and complete earthing protection systems.
Design and complete lighting studies and system.
Prepare bulk MTOs (Material Take Offs) and detailed BOMs (Bill of Materials).
Ability and willingness to think outside of the box to find creative and innovative solutions to reduce costs while managing impact to quality, cost, or schedule.
Keeps informed of new developments and requirements affecting the organization for the purpose of recommending changes in programs and applications.
Interprets, organizes, executes assignments in a self-driven and self-sufficient manner.
Makes decisions independently on technical problems and methods and represents the organization in meetings to resolve important questions.
Applies advanced or state-of-the-art knowledge and experience to resolve crucial issues and/or unique conditions. The knowledge and expertise required for this level of work usually results from progressive experience.
Supervision received is essentially administrative, with assignments given in terms of broadgeneral objectives and limits.

POSITION DESCRIPTION
Analyze electrical systems to identify and resolve issues, including load balancing, capacity planning, and power consumption optimization.
Stays up to date with advancements in electrical engineering and data center technologies
and recommend new technologies to improve the reliability and efficiency of our data center product line.
Represent company with customers during review meetings. Act as the primary point of contact for clients, responding to their inquiries and concerns in a timely and professional manner.
Provide technical support during the construction phase, responding to RFIs and addressing any issues that arise.
Attend job site visits, project meetings, and commissioning activities as needed.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

Educational:
Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.
Professional Engineering License (Strongly Preferred)

Experience:
2 to 10 years' experience in electrical design and/or electrical engineering, with a focus on data center infrastructure.
Ability to produce drawings/sketches to illustrate design/ideas.
General knowledge and direct experience with the construction, operation, and maintenance of data center or building electrical systems.
Experience with high-density data centers and hyperscale environments
Understand the principle of electrical power and its components, procedures, and standards for power system equipment sizing and design.
Understands the purpose of electrical system for facility.
Knowledge of industry standards, codes, and regulations, including but not limited to
o IEC – International Electrotechnical Commission
o IBC – International Building Code
o OSHA – Occupational Safety and Health Administration
o NEC – National Electric Code
o NFPA – National Fire Protection Association
Experience working with computer-aided design (CAD) and building information modeling (BIM) software.
Fast track design/build projects and or multiple significant upgrade projects
Detailed understanding of UPS (uninterruptable power sources), diesel generators, medium and low voltage electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, electrical control systems, low voltage rectification systems, and other critical electrical equipment found within data centers.
Familiarity with medium and high voltage power distribution systems design
Basic understanding of mechanical equipment and system design within data center driving or affecting electrical scope.
Direct experience in negotiating with regulatory agencies regarding departures from code and ultimately achieving design approval and permitting.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Microsoft Office 365 Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint)

ETAP
Dialux
Operational knowledge in:

Solid Works

Navisworks Manager / Freedom

General:
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

Extremely comfortable with task switching as priorities change.
Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients.
Ability to think creatively and identify opportunities to enhance the client experience.
Extreme work ethic and maintains high level of quality of work and due diligence.

job.title: Jr. Systems Test Analyst
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a motivated junior Systems Test Analyst to join an Advanced Engineering team. This role will support platform requirements analysis, test workflow evaluation, test automation using Python and Robot Framework, and Power BI dashboard development for automotive software platform testing.

Core Responsibilities

  • Analyze automotive software platform requirements, workflows, and system capabilities to identify automation and process improvement opportunities.
  • Review current test procedures and scheduling limitations, and recommend solutions using Robot Framework and Python.
  • Work with software engineers and system architects to understand user requirements and translate them into structured automated test cases.
  • Evaluate and document defects, system anomalies, and workflow gaps found during testing.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders to support timely defect and issue resolution.
  • Assess test coverage, system reliability, and execution efficiency, and propose improvements based on findings.
  • Participate in design reviews for test automation solutions.
  • Contribute to standardized test automation best practices across the platform team.
  • Analyze and interpret test execution data from automotive software platform runs.
  • Design and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards for test results, pass/fail metrics, and platform quality KPIs.
  • Present data-driven findings and system analysis recommendations to engineering teams and management.
  • Evaluate patterns and anomalies in platform data to identify system quality risks and recommend corrective actions.
  • Define data models and metrics frameworks to support ongoing platform systems analysis and continuous quality improvement.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Master's degree in Information Technology Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Basic working knowledge of Python programming.
  • Familiarity with data manipulation using pandas or similar libraries.
  • Exposure to Power BI or comparable data visualization tools such as Tableau or Grafana.
  • Awareness of test automation concepts.
  • Foundational understanding of software workflows and testing principles, including unit, integration, and regression testing.
  • Ability to analyze platform data, test results, defects, anomalies, and workflow gaps.
  • Ability to summarize findings for mixed technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Robot Framework or pytest.
  • Exposure to automotive software, embedded Linux, or connected vehicle systems.
  • Basic familiarity with Git.
  • Awareness of CI/CD concepts.
  • Coursework or project experience in statistical modeling, data analysis pipelines, or anomaly detection.
  • Awareness of automotive or safety standards such as ISO 26262 or ASPICE.
  • Experience in an Agile/Scrum team setting, including internships or academic group projects.

Work Details

  • Onsite role.

job.title: Quality Assurance Technician - (Food Manufacturing)
job.description:
6 am to 02:30 pm Monday through Friday. Occasionally 6 am to 06:30 pm. However, can also be required to work weekends.

PURPOSE STATEMENT:
Performs the activities related to microbiological, analytical, performance and sensory evaluation using established methods and procedures. Understands, trains in and enforces BRC Global Standards for Food Safety including but not limited to formula control, data integrity, HACCP, GMPs, process monitoring, communication and document control, customer specifications, regulatory, RPC Quality and reliability standards

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Monitors and audits product and processes from receiving through shipping to ensure all food safety and quality requirements are met.
  • Supports and adheres to all company safety rules and programs to provide safe working conditions for all associates.
  • Conducts microbiological, analytical, performance and organoleptic testing on ingredients, packaging, work in process and finished products to ensure all materials meet standard quality requirements.
  • Assists in maintaining database of required lab data.
  • May be required to observe processes and work closely with plant personnel and Corporate R&D to develop and maintain detailed and accurate plant floor work instructions for formulas and product specifications.
  • May help train batch operators, filling operators and other plant personnel on formula and specification requirements, GMPs, processing, laboratory and evaluation procedures.
  • Verifies that process controls, weight control, HACCP and finished product specifications are adhered to by regularly auditing procedures and paperwork.
  • May assist plant and R&D personnel to test and commercialize new products or changes to existing products, collect and send process data and product samples to authorized RPC associates and external customers.
  • Initiates, documents and tracks changes to products and processes, including those related to supplier changes for ingredients & packaging material and engineering changes to equipment and/or processes.
  • Demonstrate high moral character and ethics.
  • Adheres to company codes of conduct.
  • Works closely with plant Production Teams to monitor product runs, investigate and solve product quality issues, ensure compliance to GMP practices, sanitation programs, BRC Standards, product safety and all RPC, Kosher/Halal and regulatory requirements.
  • Initiates holds of ingredients or finished products that do not meet RPC product safety or quality requirements.
  • Ensures that the Hold and Release program is properly followed.
  • Recommends improvements in manufacturing methods, sanitation practices, laboratory practices, testing methods and equipment to the management team.
  • Keeps informed of latest manufacturing technologies, systems, and quality control practices.
  • Maintains a comprehensive understanding of all products manufactured by the plant as well as the raw materials, packaging materials, and operations required in the manufacturing process including quality specifications and standards.
  • Participates in QA 6S meetings and PIT (Process Improvement Teams) to discuss quality and sanitation issues and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Helps set goals and establish timetables to meet project guidelines and business objectives.
  • Performs other related responsibilities, as needed, to support *** Corporation's business objectives.
  • Notifies management of all deviations.


Skills/Experience:
Degree in Biology, Food Science, Food Technology or related field preferred.
3+ years experience in a food-processing, pharmaceutical or chemical manufacturing industry.
Experience in Dairy or Non-Dairy manufacturing is HIGHLY desired.
Demonstrated knowledge and application of quality assurance techniques and tools and quality management principles in a food, chemical or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment
Demonstrated knowledge of efficient and safe manufacturing operations to include GMPs, HACCP, product and associate safety, product quality, and cost control (minimizing downtime and waste, optimizing yield)
Demonstrated ability to train associates as well as plan, monitor and schedule tasks and projects
Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems
Demonstrated ability to formulate and understand basic statistical analysis.
Proficient using Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook. Proficient or ability to become proficient in Microsoft Access, MiniTab, QAD, SAP, OPTIVA.

Food Safety Responsibilities

  • Follow all GMPs, food safety, and quality policies.
  • Ensures all GMP and all Food hygiene and Food safety standards are in compliance.
  • Report all food safety incidents such as GMP violations, ingredient and product contamination, metal detector, screen, or magnet deficiencies, glass breakage, and pest harborage.
  • Review food defense and quality records for precision, accuracy, and conformance to document control procedures, providing written verification as required.
  • Ensure employee compliance in the areas of food defense, food regulations, and product / process quality; provide adequate coaching as needed.
  • Provide immediate and long-term corrective action in the event of non-compliance to food defense and quality policies.
  • Record accurate and legible results on documentation
  • Provide adequate housekeeping at all times.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Will be required to perform tasks such as lifting up to 25 Kilograms (55.12 pounds), walking, standing, climbing, reaching, stooping, pulling, pushing, grasping, and balancing as part of production activities out on the floor. Will be required to see and hear well enough to understand associates questions and respond to their concerns, answer phones and greet customers, vendors, Corporate Associates, etc. Will be required to work in both warm and cold environments, near noisy machinery, and near confined spaces as part of daily production activities.

job.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Project Manager I is responsible for overseeing all aspects of multiple medium to large projects with moderate to high complexity. This role takes projects from original concept through completion, serving as the single point of accountability and ensuring alignment with established project controls and standards.

The Senior Project Manager I demonstrates a strong commitment to stakeholder relationships by proactively communicating, identifying risks and issues, and facilitating timely, effective resolutions. Moderate travel may be required depending on project needs.

  • Develop and facilitate strategic documents such as Project Charters, Education and Communication Plans, and detailed project plans.

  • Present project updates and progress reports to business owners and stakeholders.

  • Clearly define and manage project scope while motivating team members.

  • Manage relationships with multiple business owners and team members to accomplish project objectives.

  • Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, and cross-project dependencies.

  • Monitor and report project activities and status within established timelines.

  • Coach team members to clarify task assignments, milestones, and deliverables.

  • Facilitate the creation of toolkits to support field-based implementations.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Organization

  • Maintains focus and proactively prioritizes initiatives

  • Effectively manages tasks and resources

  • Demonstrates strong scheduling and multi-tasking abilities

Project Management

  • Applies structured project controls to define scope, goals, timelines, and performance metrics

Gaining Commitment

  • Effectively leverages project controls to manage initiatives

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency or willingness to learn:

    • Microsoft Office (OneNote, OneDrive, Excel, Word, Access, Visio, Outlook, PowerPoint including Office Timeline add-on)

    • Project management and scheduling tools (Microsoft Project, MS Planner, Agile tools, or equivalent systems)

Core Competencies

Integrity

  • Acts honestly and follows through on commitments

  • Maintains consistency between actions and words

Compassion

  • Demonstrates empathy and professionalism, even in challenging situations

  • Actively listens and anticipates the needs of others

Accountability

  • Takes ownership of outcomes and impact

  • Builds strategic relationships across the organization

  • Supports cross-departmental collaboration

  • Demonstrates awareness of organizational dynamics

Respect

  • Treats all individuals with dignity

  • Embraces diversity

  • Listens attentively and seeks to understand different perspectives

Excellence

  • Takes initiative to improve service, quality, and performance

  • Pursues ongoing personal and professional development

  • Collaborates effectively to exceed expectations

Education

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of project management experience

  • Experience within hospital systems, supply chain, workforce management, financial services, or technical/systems environments is a plus

job.title: UX Designer II

Client is seeking a UX Researcher to lead mixed-method research across a complex hardware and software ecosystem, including consumer IoT applications, heavy-equipment controls, and technical B2B portals. This role will own the full research lifecycle and translate qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable product insights.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative UX research initiatives.
  • Design research plans, methodologies, study materials, and participant recruitment strategies.
  • Conduct contextual inquiries, user interviews, usability testing, and other mixed-method studies.
  • Research diverse B2B and B2C user groups across digital interfaces and physical environments.
  • Analyze and synthesize research data into clear findings, recommendations, and actionable insights.
  • Communicate findings through data-driven storytelling to Product, Engineering, and UX Design teams.
  • Support research involving consumer IoT applications, smart devices, heavy-equipment controls, and technical portals.
  • Champion user needs and accessible design practices throughout the product development process.
  • Maintain and manage research findings within a centralized research repository.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Hands-on UX research experience across the complete research lifecycle.
  • Experience designing and conducting qualitative and quantitative research.
  • Experience with contextual inquiry, usability testing, user interviews, participant recruitment, and research synthesis.
  • Experience researching both B2B and B2C user populations.
  • Experience working across integrated hardware and software experiences.
  • Experience studying IoT, smart device, connected product, or physical control workflows.
  • Ability to translate complex research data into actionable product recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and UX Design teams.
  • Experience managing or contributing to a centralized research repository.
  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive design practices.

Work Details

  • Onsite role.

job.title: Electromechanical Engineer II
job.description:
Onsite role

POSITION SUMMARY
This position supports the design, development and testing of induction and permanent magnet motors used in fans, pumps and compressors requiring innovative engineering solutions that enhance new product performance and reliability. The successful candidate will apply strong electromechanical engineering fundamentals, analytical expertise, and a collaborative mindset to support our customers' needs.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Supports the department's Subject Mater Expert (SME) in the sizing, design, mechanical drawings and testing of electric motors operating at speeds up to 70,000 rpm used in our fans, pumps and compressors.
Performs electromagnetic, thermal, and mechanical analysis using simulation tools (FEA/CFD).
Creates detailed CAD models, drawings, and manufacturing documentation.
Develops motor performance specifications and validation test plans. Conducts performance testing (efficiency, torque, speed, thermal, vibration, noise).
Analyzes and optimize motor efficiency.
Works closely with manufacturing to ensure design for manufacturability
Solves problems related to the assembly, repair and testing of development and production hardware.
Works with colleagues in the department and in other departments.
Writes reports as required.
Presents designs to peers, other engineers and customers.

QUALIFICATIONS
Education: Bachelor's degree (BS) in Mechanical, Electrical, or a related technical discipline from accredited college or university required.
3 to 5 years of experience in electric motor design and development.
Strong knowledge of electromagnetic theory and motor design principles.
Experience with motor simulation tools.
Hands-on experience with motor teardown.
Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor)
Understanding of winding techniques, lamination stacks, magnets, and insulation systems.
Familiarity with motor manufacturing processes and materials.
Ability to interpret and create detailed engineering drawings applying ASME Y14.5M.
Works under constant supervision. Performs assignments of mild complexity and assists other Engineers.
Must have knowledge of drawing and drafting standards.
Experience in the development of military or aerospace equipment is a strong plus.
Understanding of military specifications, environmental specifications, and test specifications a plus.
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
Hands-on test and hardware experience is required. General machine shop experience is a plus.
Must be a US Citizen.

Job Description

Client Point of Care is a global leader in providing critical medical diagnostic and informatics products for rapid blood analysis that are intuitive, reliable, and cost-effective. Our i-STAT System is an advanced, portable diagnostic tool that provides real-time, lab-quality results within minutes to accelerate patient-care decision-making as well as optimize resource utilization for our customers and the patients that they serve. The i-STAT System has the industry's most comprehensive menu of tests in a single, with-patient platform, including tests for respiratory,
metabolic, coagulation, hematology, glucose, and cardiac function. By delivering lab-quality results in minutes, on just a few drops of blood, our i-STAT System fosters a collaborative, patient-centered environment while driving improved operational performance.

Client Point of Care has a new opening for a Sr. Financial Analyst. This role will support the Division FP&A HQ team with providing financial planning & analysis for the business by building and managing financial reports, preparing analysis for business reviews and other adhoc request.

Responsibilities include:
  • Prepare financial analysis and reports (such as Plans, Latest Best Estimate (LBE's) and Long Range
  • Projections (LRP)) for P&L and balance sheet metrics that meet the timing and quality of presentation requirements, facilitate management review and decision making while ensuring integrity of data and compliance with GAAP as well as Client's operating policies

  • Support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process by managing the reporting of monthly financial performance metrics such as: sales and expense variances, cash conversion cycle (CCC), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), etc

  • Prepare and analyze daily and weekly sales reporting / projections

  • Perform adhoc requests and drive cross-business analytic projects for senior management, with financial modeling, data mining and presentation support
Education Requirements:
Bachelor's degree, preferably in accounting or finance, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • Position requires 7+ years of finance experience to include roles of increasing responsibility in accounting and/or finance

job.title: Financial Coordinator
job.description:
Position Summary

The Transplant Financial Coordinator is responsible for collecting financial and insurance information from pre-transplant patients, verifying insurance coverage, obtaining required pre-certifications, and serving as a financial resource throughout the transplant process. This role works closely with insurance case managers, transplant patients, the Transplant Social Worker, and the transplant team to ensure appropriate financial planning, coverage verification, and authorization management.

The coordinator also reviews patient bills for inclusion in the Kidney Acquisition Cost Center (KACC), provides financial counseling, manages provider contracts, and supports patient-specific care standards while maintaining service excellence and patient satisfaction.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Insurance Verification & Benefits Coordination

  • Obtain and review patient healthcare coverage information.
  • Collect and verify insurance information from transplant patients.
  • Verify transplant and living donor benefits with insurance carriers.
  • Determine whether pre-certifications are required for evaluations, transplant admissions, follow-up care, and related services.

Pre-Certification Management

  • Obtain required pre-certifications from insurance companies.
  • Communicate directly with insurance case managers regarding authorization requirements.
  • Submit necessary patient information and supporting documentation for review.
  • Notify case managers of transplant committee listing decisions when applicable.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with insurance case management throughout the transplant process.
  • Secure authorizations for post-transplant services and follow-up care.
  • Provide business office staff and other providers with insurance and authorization information at the time of admission.

Financial Communication & Case Coordination

  • Keep the transplant team informed of patient financial status and progression through the transplant process.
  • Coordinate with physician offices and hospitals regarding living donor billing procedures.
  • Notify managed care departments of patients who may require special contracting arrangements before evaluation or transplantation.
  • Collaborate with the Transplant Social Worker and Department Director on complex financial cases.

Kidney Acquisition Cost Center (KACC) Management

  • Review patient bills for eligibility and inclusion in the Kidney Acquisition Cost Center.
  • Conduct initial bill reviews for KACC suitability.
  • Enter applicable charges into the financial database.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly reports to the Director and Accounting department.

Patient Financial Counseling

  • Meet individually with pre-transplant patients to develop personalized financial plans.
  • Educate and counsel patients regarding financial responsibilities associated with transplantation.
  • Assist patients with planning for transplant-related expenses.
  • Refer patients to the Transplant Social Worker for financial assistance programs and additional support resources when needed.

Contract Management

  • Ensure provider contracts are established before appointments are scheduled and claims are processed.
  • Conduct basic contract discussions with providers.
  • Escalate complex negotiations to the Department Director.
  • Maintain contract records and documentation within the contract management system.

Compliance & Service Excellence

  • Demonstrate conduct consistent with organizational values and the Code of Conduct, Ethics, and Compliance Program.
  • Adhere to Service Excellence standards in all patient, provider, and team interactions.
  • Support patient-centered care initiatives and organizational quality standards.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Knowledge of healthcare insurance verification and authorization processes.
  • Understanding of HIPAA, HITECH, and healthcare compliance requirements.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage sensitive financial information with discretion and confidentiality.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including:
    • Excel
    • Word
    • Outlook
  • Experience utilizing insurance verification systems and databases.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary healthcare teams.

Education & Experience

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Intermediate computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and insurance verification databases.

Preferred

  • Experience in:
    • Patient Registration
    • Financial Counseling
    • Medical Insurance Verification
    • Healthcare Revenue Cycle Operations
    • Transplant Services or Specialty Healthcare Programs

Reporting Structure

Reports To:

  • Transplant Manager
  • Director of Transplant Services

job.title: Contracts Administrator
job.description:
Position Summary

The Sr. Contract Administrator is responsible for administering assigned contracts of moderate scope and complexity to ensure fulfillment of contractual obligations and compliance with customer requirements. This role supports proposal development, contract negotiations, pricing, terms and conditions management, contract performance monitoring, and order management activities.

The position also supports customer communications, demand planning, sales and operations planning (S&OP), portal management, purchase order review, and contract analysis. The ideal candidate will have experience managing commercial and/or government contracts, developing proposals, negotiating contract terms, and supporting aerospace or manufacturing environments.

Reporting Structure

  • Individual Contributor Role
  • Reports to a Contract Manager or Contract Lead
  • No Direct Reports
  • Regular interaction with internal stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and customers

Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration

  • Administer specialized and major contracts by analyzing customer purchase orders, Basic Contract Agreements, and Long-Term Agreements.
  • Review contract requirements including pricing, delivery schedules, terms and conditions, and performance obligations.
  • Monitor contract compliance and ensure contractual commitments are fulfilled.
  • Determine when customer-directed changes fall outside contract scope and support contract modifications as needed.

Proposal Development & Bid Management

  • Develop technically and commercially compliant proposal packages for customers.
  • Evaluate performance requirements, delivery schedules, labor estimates, material costs, and equipment requirements.
  • Coordinate proposal inputs from engineering, operations, finance, and other functional teams.
  • Prepare responses to Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and other customer solicitations.
  • Submit complex proposals in accordance with customer and company requirements.

Contract Negotiation

  • Negotiate pricing, terms and conditions, delivery schedules, and other business provisions.
  • Ensure contract language aligns with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Support resolution of contractual issues and customer concerns.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned contracts.
  • Participate in customer meetings and presentations.
  • Communicate contract status, requirements, and changes to internal and external stakeholders.

Claims & Issue Resolution

  • Investigate and resolve customer claims, complaints, and contract-related issues.
  • Gather and analyze information to determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with technical, quality, engineering, and business teams as needed.

Order Management & Planning

  • Support order entry activities and schedule management.
  • Manage customer portals and communications.
  • Review and analyze customer purchase orders and contracts.
  • Develop demand plans as part of the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.

Compliance & Regulatory Support

  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations.
  • Support export compliance administration and training activities when applicable.
  • Protect company data and intellectual property in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze contract data and business information to identify trends and recommend actions.
  • Evaluate proposed process, material, or methodology changes.
  • Support operational improvements and contract administration best practices.

Leadership & Mentoring

  • Provide guidance and support to less experienced team members.
  • Share specialized contract knowledge and best practices.
  • Act as a primary contact on high-level projects and assignments.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or a related field required.
  • Contract Management certification preferred:
    • NCMA (National Contract Management Association)
    • IACCM (International Association of Commercial Contract Management)
  • Certification requirement may be waived for candidates holding a JD or MBA.

Experience

  • 2–5 years of progressive contract administration experience.
  • Experience managing commercial and/or government contracts.
  • Experience reviewing, negotiating, and administering contract terms and conditions.
  • Proposal development and RFP response experience preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of contract administration principles, regulations, and industry practices.
  • Knowledge of government contracting regulations, when applicable.
  • Understanding of legal and regulatory requirements related to contracts.
  • Knowledge of export control regulations preferred.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret contracts, policies, and procedures.
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to present information effectively to customers, management, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong customer relationship management skills.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and standard business software.
  • Experience with ERP systems, customer portals, and contract management tools preferred.
  • Ability to work with specialized internal and customer systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • NCMA, IACCM, or similar contract management certification.
  • Export Compliance Training Institute (ECTI) training or certification.
  • Aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or government contracting experience.
  • Experience supporting Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes.

job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking a Test Data Management Engineer to support QA testing teams with data mining, test data provisioning, data validation, and automation. This role requires strong SQL skills, API testing experience, and the ability to support complex test environments. Exposure to mainframe systems and hands-on automation experience are strong pluses.

Core Responsibilities

  • Complete data mining requests to identify, extract, and validate test data needed by project teams.

  • Build and enhance automated solutions to streamline test data setup, delivery, and reuse.

  • Support root cause analysis and resolution of data issues impacting delivery timelines.
  • Identify use cases for test data automation.
  • Document processes, reusable solutions, and best practices related to test data management.

  • Experience supporting test data needs for QA testing teams.

  • Hands-on API testing experience using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or similar solutions.
  • Ability to work across multiple test environments and manage competing data requests.
  • Exposure to mainframe applications, data structures, or testing processes.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Experience with automation frameworks or scripting used to support test data creation and validation.
  • Familiarity with industry-standard Test Data Management tools.
  • Experience working in regulated or large enterprise environments with complex data dependencies.
  • Understanding of data masking, data virtualization, data subsetting, and synthetic data creation.
  • Experience with Unix/Linux command-line operations.
  • Exposure to Docker or containerized environments.

Work Details

  • Hybrid role.

This individual will also have responsibility for floor layouts as well as costing and obtaining quotes.
