  • Minimum of five (5) years of industrial experience in Reliability Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, or a related engineering role within a manufacturing environment. Experience in the chemical, petrochemical, or process industries is preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of maintenance and reliability best practices, including predictive and condition-based maintenance technologies, asset management, and reliability improvement methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex technical issues and develop practical, data-driven solutions.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with personnel at all organizational levels, including plant leadership, engineering, operations, and maintenance teams.
  • Ability to build trust and credibility through responsive, professional interactions and effective management of stakeholder expectations.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret financial and operational data and clearly communicate the economic impact of reliability and maintenance decisions.
  • Knowledge of Process Safety Management (PSM) requirements and their application within a manufacturing environment is preferred.
  • Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) certification is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a Reliability subject matter expert and champion the implementation of maintenance and reliability best practices across supported facilities.
  • Develop, optimize, and sustain asset care strategies using reliability-centered methodologies, including Risk-Based Maintenance (RBM), Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), and Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
  • Lead efforts to improve equipment reliability, availability, and maintainability through systematic analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Facilitate and lead equipment failure investigations utilizing Root Cause Analysis (RCA), 5-Why, and other structured problem-solving techniques.
  • Partner with maintenance, operations, engineering, and technical resources to identify and resolve chronic equipment and process reliability issues.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on equipment maintenance, precision maintenance practices, repair techniques, and equipment installation standards.
  • Evaluate reliability improvement opportunities and develop business cases that balance risk, cost, and operational performance objectives.
  • Analyze equipment performance data, maintenance history, and condition monitoring results to identify improvement opportunities and prioritize reliability initiatives.
  • Develop, review, and update maintenance and reliability procedures to ensure alignment with industry standards and evolving best practices.
  • Support site reliability and continuous improvement programs through training, coaching, and knowledge sharing with maintenance and operations personnel.
  • Collaborate with multiple manufacturing sites to standardize reliability processes, leverage best practices, and drive sustainable improvements in asset performance.

job.title: Document Specialist
job.description:
Inventory Documentation Specialist / Warehouse Clerk

Job Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Inventory Documentation Specialist / Warehouse Clerk to join our warehouse operations team. This hands-on role is responsible for maintaining accurate inventory records, documenting incoming equipment, photographing items, and preparing inventory data for upload into company systems and online sales platforms, and occasional loading and unloading of incoming merchandise. 

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced warehouse environment, has strong attention to detail, and can work independently while supporting cross-functional teams. This position plays a critical role in ensuring inventory accuracy, researching discrepancies, and maintaining organized documentation for all managed equipment and client projects.

This role reports directly to the Warehouse Operations Manager or Regional Director.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately document, photograph, catalog, and track incoming and existing inventory items
  • Enter inventory data into company systems while maintaining speed and accuracy goals
  • Research and collect item details and specifications for online listing preparation
  • Review and verify inventory documentation submitted by other team members before system uploads
  • Audit inventory, perform cycle counts, and investigate discrepancies when needed
  • Maintain organized records and inventory tracking reports
  • Assist in training warehouse team members on proper documentation and inventory procedures
  • Ensure customer and client inventory tagging systems are properly maintained
  • Keep customer inventory organized and separated from production materials and tools
  • Support warehouse and administrative operations as needed
  • Assist customers during pickup days when required

Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills required
  • Ability to multitask and analyze data efficiently
  • Previous warehouse, inventory, administrative, or documentation experience preferred
  • Experience with warehouse management systems or databases is a plus
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Word, Excel, spreadsheets, and multiple computer programs
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Professional attitude with a safety-focused mindset
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs and operate a pallet jack
  • English fluency required; Spanish bilingual skills are a plus

Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Restaurant equipment knowledge is a plus
  • Previous experience with inventory management, warehouse operations, documentation, or administrative work preferred

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay Range: $19.00

Schedule

  • Monday – Friday
  • Core hours: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
  • Occasional weekends based on business and client needs

job.title: Mechanical Engineer II
job.description:
Onsite (not remote)

JOB SUMMARY
The Mechanical Engineer will carry out engineering assignments concerned with the planning, design and testing of mechanical equipment, systems, and processes. Works cooperatively with other departments. Supports higher level engineers for medium level complexity projects.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Designs mechanical equipment, systems and processes. Performs calculations and analyses to ensure suitability of design. Solves problems related to the assembly, repair and test of environmental control systems. Under general supervision, performs assignments which involve responsibility for a secondary project or a part of a major project. Defense or aerospace industry experience desired. Experience in the development of thermal systems is a strong plus. Experience with electrical circuits and control theory a plus. May give directions and/or guidance to junior level engineers, designers and drafters. Works with colleagues in the department and in other departments. Writes reports as required. Presents designs to peers, other engineers and customers. Works under supervision, performs assignments of medium complexity and may assist senior engineers with more complex assignments.

QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree (B.S.M.E) from four-year College or University.
Two to five years of experience with design, analysis and development of industrial equipment.
Knowledge of applied thermodynamics and mechanical design.
Knowledge of drawing and drafting standards a plus.
Capable of carrying out assignments concerned with mechanical equipment.
Understanding of military specifications, environmental specifications, and test specifications desired.
Hands-on test and hardware experience is required. Requires strong oral/written communication skills and must be capable of conducting effective oral presentations to customers.

Must be a US Citizen.

At Nesco, we don’t just place talent; we build relationships, solve customer problems and drive business growth! We’re seeking a high-energy, strategic Regional Sales Manager to lead and inspire a team of Business Development Managers in delivering top-notch staffing solutions. If you thrive on coaching sales teams, building strong client relationships, and driving measurable results, this role is your opportunity to make a real impact in a dynamic, growth-focused organization.

Role Overview

As a Regional Sales Manager at Nesco, you’ll lead a team of talented sales representatives in your territory and cultivate relationships with key decision-makers in your market. You’ll combine industry expertise with leadership acumen to train and develop, drive accountability and revenue growth, expand market share, and ensure your team exceeds targets, all while representing Nesco as a trusted staffing partner. job.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
job.description:
Position Summary:

The Research Coordinator is responsible for coordinating multiple research protocols and serving as a liaison between investigators, sponsors, and site personnel. Under supervision, this role develops a foundational understanding of research operations, compliance standards, and human subject research regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate daily operational activities across multiple research studies.

  • Serve as the primary contact between site research teams, sponsors, and supervisors.

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as finance, administration, and the local IRB.

  • Manage study timelines from feasibility submission through study closeout.

  • Review study design, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and ensure accurate informed consent.

  • Maintain data integrity through detailed source document review and accurate data entry.

  • Create study-specific documentation tools when not provided by sponsors.

  • Manage shipment tracking for drugs, devices, and study supplies.

  • Document and report adverse events, deviations, and protocol violations.

  • Attend investigator meetings, site visits, and clinical research coordinator (CRC) meetings.

  • Review and address monitoring or audit findings in collaboration with supervisors.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) certification preferred.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Working knowledge of organizational policies and research procedures.

  • Basic understanding of ICH guidelines, CFR regulations, and medical terminology.

  • Strong communication, organizational, and time management skills.

  • Proficiency in routine clinical trial procedures such as ECGs, phlebotomy, specimen handling, and shipping.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Self-motivated with strong interpersonal and problem-solving abilities.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must adhere to the organization's Code of Conduct and Mission & Values.

  • Completion of assigned training modules by designated deadlines.

  • Demonstrate competency in required clinical tasks (e.g., ECG, specimen processing), with ongoing evaluation and training as needed.

Title: HR Representative (Shared Services)

Job Title: HR Shared Services Representative

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM EST
Work Hours: Flexible shifts within core business hours
Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Overview

The HR Shared Services Representative provides comprehensive Human Resources support and advisory services through phone, email, case management, audits, and HR system transactions, with a strong focus on first-contact resolution and adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

This role supports a wide range of internal and external customers, including U.S. vendors, applicants, candidates, current and former employees, retirees, managers, HR Business Partners, and internal HR Centers of Excellence. The position ensures all interactions are handled in a confidential, compliant, and customer-focused manner in accordance with company policies and applicable laws.

Primary areas of responsibility include onboarding support (offer letters, I-9 processing, pre-employment administration), HR systems maintenance and troubleshooting, performance management support, document management, compliance auditing, legal and subpoena requests, and HR help desk operations.

Key Responsibilities

HR Services & Administration

  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of HR Shared Services operations, processes, systems, and applicable policies and employment laws.

  • Plan, prioritize, and manage workload to meet established service level agreements.

  • Provide guidance and support to employees, managers, HR Business Partners, and Centers of Excellence on topics including:

    • Careers and recruiting systems

    • Performance management, appraisal, and merit processes

    • Timekeeping (Kronos)

    • HR systems administration and company policies

  • Use effective verbal and written communication to identify underlying issues and provide accurate resolutions.

  • Apply empathy, diplomacy, and tact to promote positive employee engagement.

  • Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant application of HR policies and procedures.

  • Maintain HR data accuracy by creating, updating, and resolving cases within HR systems (HR Cloud, Kronos, Careers, OnBase).

  • Execute and analyze audit reports; partner with appropriate teams to resolve discrepancies and maintain data integrity.

  • Provide additional HR field support as requested.

HR Tools & Service Level Agreements

  • Document all requests in the HR case management system and escalate issues to appropriate teams as needed.

  • Promote and support self-service by guiding employees, managers, and HR Business Partners through HR portals and tools.

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a business-related field

Required

  • Minimum of 1 year of Human Resources or customer service experience

job.title: Pipeline Technician
job.description:
Join Our Team as a Pipeline Technician in Jourdanton!

Are you ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role in the heart of the energy sector? We are looking for a dedicated individual to repair and maintain pipelines, ensure cathodic protection, and manage right of way control. This full-time position includes a company truck, laptop, and cell phone, alongside a comprehensive benefits package.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and operate facilities including pipelines, valves, filters, pumps, gas compressors, storage tanks, and pump station equipment efficiently and in compliance with regulations.
  • Perform oil and gas pipeline pigging and purging.
  • Conduct cathodic protection surveys, leak surveys, and ROW patrols.
  • Oversee third-party contractors during construction and anomaly work, including pipeline blowdowns and assisting in launching and receiving smart tools.
  • Conduct damage prevention activities such as pipeline patrols, one-calls, and line crossing inspections.
  • Maintain knowledge of regulatory requirements and complete necessary documentation (OSHA, DOT, EPA, etc.).
  • Coordinate with landowners, public agencies, contractors, utilities, and other pipeline operators.
  • Participate actively in safety programs, provide leadership, and follow policies and procedures.
  • Provide on-call support on a rotating basis and comply with safety policies.
  • Perform energy isolation lockout/tagout procedures (LOTO).

Required Education and Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Valid driver's license with a safe driving record.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with the ability to work in a group environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and exercise good judgment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Mechanical aptitude with the ability to learn and perform maintenance tasks.
  • Proficiency with computers, including MS Office applications and other computer-based work applications.

Working Conditions and Requirements

  • Frequent exposure to heat, cold, and other adverse weather conditions.
  • Work in industrial and construction settings, requiring appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Frequent heavy lifting and adherence to safe work procedures.
  • Subject to call-outs for operational issues and emergencies, including nights and weekends.
  • Reliable attendance and occasional overnight travel may be required.

job.title: HR Business Partner - Change Management/Transformation
job.description:
Role Summary
The Change Management Partner plays a critical role in enabling successful transformation by representing the people side of change across assigned business units and leading the change strategy for the enterprise agile transformation.

For business led transformation initiatives, this role partners with and supports the designated business change leader, ensuring people impacts, readiness, adoption, and engagement are addressed. For the agile transformation, this role leads the end to end change management approach, shaping mindsets, behaviors, and leadership practices required to sustain agile ways of working.

This role works closely with HR Business Partners (HRBPs), transformation leaders, and agile leaders to integrate change management, HR strategy, and agile principles into a cohesive, human centered change experience. The ideal candidate brings experience as both an HR Business Partner and a change management practitioner, with hands on experience supporting agile environments.

Key Responsibilities
Business Transformation Change Enablement (Support Role)
Partner with business side change leaders to support the people side of transformation initiatives (e.g., operating model changes, digital initiatives, process redesign).
Provide structured change management guidance and tools, including stakeholder mapping, impact assessments, readiness insights, and adoption strategies.
Advise leaders on anticipated people impacts, resistance risks, and mitigation strategies.
Support the development of clear, consistent messaging focused on "what's changing, why it matters, and what it means for me.”
Monitor adoption and engagement indicators; surface insights and recommendations to business change leaders and HRBPs.
Agile Transformation Change Leadership (Lead Role)
Design and lead the change management strategy for the enterprise agile transformation.
Design and execute comprehensive change plans to support shifts in mindset, leadership behaviors, decision making, and ways of working.
Partner with Agile Coaches, Product leaders, and Transformation teams to embed change practices into agile delivery rhythms.
Enable leaders and teams to understand and adopt agile values such as empowerment, transparency, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Define and track adoption and sustainability measures for agile ways of working; adjust strategies based on insights and feedback.
HRBP Partnership & People Strategy Alignment
Work in close partnership with HR Business Partners to represent the people side of change for assigned business units.
Ensure change approaches are aligned with broader people strategies, including performance management, talent, learning, engagement, and organizational design.
Equip HRBPs and people leaders with guidance, tools, and talking points to lead authentic and effective change conversations.
Leader & Manager Enablement
Coach leaders and managers on their role in leading themselves and others through change.
Develop leader and manager toolkits, adoption playbooks, and reinforcement strategies.
Support leaders in modeling behaviors that reinforce transformation and agile principles.
Collaboration & Integration
Partner with Transformation, Technology, Operations, Communications, and HR COEs to ensure change efforts are integrated and cohesive.
Participate in transformation governance forums, providing insight on readiness, adoption, and workforce impacts.
Apply consistent change frameworks while flexing approaches based on business context and maturity.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business, or a related field
8+ years of experience in change management and/or HR Business Partnering.
Proven experience supporting the people side of complex, cross functional transformation initiatives.
Strong working knowledge of change management methodologies (e.g., ADKAR, Prosci).
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and partner effectively with senior leaders.

Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience as an HR Business Partner.
Experience leading or heavily supporting an agile transformation.
Familiarity with agile frameworks and product centric operating models (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban).

Capabilities & Attributes
Strong systems thinking and business acumen.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving transformation environments.
High emotional intelligence and credibility with leaders.
Ability to flex between advisory and hands on execution roles.
Clear, compelling communicator with a human centered approach to change.

Requirements:
**OPEN TO REMOTE BUT WOULD PREFER SOMEONE WHO CAN BE ON-SITE AT THE DUBLIN, OH OFFICE**

MANAGER NOTES: They need an HRBP that has delt with transformations and supported IT before that can lead the project, they can teach the change management piece

job.title: Technology Physical Layer Engineer/Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description:

Candidates for this position will be responsible for the design, engineering and installation of structured cabling systems based on industry and Bank standards. They will work with Bank Corporate Real Estate, Bank Network Engineering, outside architecture and engineering firms, cabling contractors and electrical contractors in a design-build construction environment. This person will help define and implement cabling standards, prepare technical specifications and bid documents, identify and select qualified vendors and contractors and will provide technical support and project management from project start to finish. They will also be responsible for day-to-day management and execution of non-project physical layer activity at Bank sites.

The candidate must be able to manage multiple projects and activities at the same time and must be able to read and understand technical drawings, floor plans and network diagrams. They must be able to work independently, interact with a variety people and levels within the company, travel to project sites as needed and identify risks and solve problems.

Structured cabling systems are based on the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) and the Electronics Industry Association/Telecommunications Industry Association (EIA/TIA) standards. Client also standardized on the use of the Siemon Cabling System and all contractors must be Siemon Certified Installers.

Qualified candidates must have at minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience with design and installation of structured cabling systems using the following cable types and supporting the following platforms and standards:

ANSI/EIA/TIA 568 – Telecommunications Cabling
ANSI/EIA/TIA 569 – Pathways and Spaces
NEC – National Electric Code
IEEE 802.3 – Ethernet
IEEE 802.11 - WiFi

Cat 6 Copper Cable
Cat 6A Copper Cable
Cat 5e Copper Cable
Multimode Fiber Optic Cable
Single Mode Fiber Optic cable
RG6 Coax Cable
RG11 Coax Cable

Local Area Networking (LAN) - Wired
Local Area Networking (WLAN) – Wireless
Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP)
AV/CATV/Video
Analog Voice – POTS/Fax

job.title: AI Sr. Engineer – LLMOps & MLOps
job.description:
Overview

Client is seeking an AI Senior Engineer focused on LLMOps and MLOps to own the production lifecycle of enterprise AI initiatives. This is a hands-on engineering role responsible for building the operational backbone that connects legacy data environments with modern AWS and Azure AI services. The ideal candidate will bring strong multi-cloud engineering experience and a proven ability to deploy, monitor, scale, and secure LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and traditional machine learning models in production.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain automated CI/CD and continuous training pipelines across AWS and Azure AI platforms
  • Design and operationalize Retrieval-Augmented Generation environments, including vector database integration and semantic search optimization
  • Engineer secure data pipelines from legacy systems such as mainframes, SQL Server, and on-prem databases into cloud-native AI workflows
  • Implement automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs and traditional ML models prior to production release
  • Establish monitoring for model drift, hallucination risk, latency, and token consumption to improve quality and manage cost
  • Manage AI infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Partner with analytics and data platform teams to support reliable data flow between production models and platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Palantir
  • Work closely with IT and Security teams on IAM, networking, firewall, and access configurations in a multi-cloud environment
  • Optimize model serving and inference endpoints for scale, resiliency, and performance using containers, Kubernetes, and serverless patterns
  • Create version control standards for prompts, model artifacts, and data snapshots to support auditability and rollback
  • Automate feature engineering, feature store workflows, and the transition from notebook-based experimentation into production services
  • Implement security guardrails and automated scanning to reduce prompt injection and data leakage risk

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
  • 6+ years of engineering experience, including at least 3 years focused on MLOps or LLMOps in production
  • Strong hands-on expertise with both AWS and Azure AI ecosystems
  • Experience configuring services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, and Azure OpenAI
  • Expert-level Python and SQL skills, with strong PySpark experience
  • Deep experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Kubeflow, or Step Functions
  • Experience building and supporting RAG pipelines, vector search, and semantic indexing
  • Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as OpenSearch, Pinecone, or Azure AI Search
  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or WhyLabs
  • Strong understanding of model evaluation, validation metrics, and production monitoring
  • Experience using Terraform or CloudFormation for repeatable and secure infrastructure deployment
  • Ability to work effectively across Data Science, IT, Security, and enterprise platform teams

Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Master's degree in a quantitative discipline
  • Experience integrating with Databricks, Snowflake, or Palantir environments
  • Background supporting legacy data modernization in large enterprise environments
  • Experience with Bedrock Guardrails, Azure Content Safety, or similar AI security frameworks
  • Strong exposure to prompt versioning, model versioning, and production rollback strategies
  • Ability to operate with urgency in a transformation-focused environment while navigating enterprise governance

job.title: IT Support Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated individual to provide world-class assistance and support to our end users. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of technical support, Active Directory, Windows device management, Mac and iOS support, and network printer management. This role will also involve inventory management and hardware recycling.

Core Responsibilities

  • Technical Support:
    • Identify and diagnose user issues related to hardware, software, network connectivity, and peripherals.
    • Assist users with installing, configuring, and troubleshooting common applications (e.g., Office suite, email client, antivirus, MFA, collaboration tools).
    • Provide support via phone, email, remote access tools, and in-person troubleshooting when necessary.
    • Document all support incidents, track resolutions, and escalate complex issues to senior technicians or IT specialists.
    • Provide setup and technical assistance for presentations, meetings, and classrooms, ensuring proper functionality of projectors, sound systems, and video conferencing tools.
  • Active Directory:
    • Assist users with password resets and account lockouts, maintaining a secure password reset process.
    • Investigate and resolve basic Active Directory-related issues, such as authentication problems or access errors.
    • Effectively communicate with senior IT staff regarding Active Directory issues that require further expertise.
  • Windows Device Management:
    • Configure new employee devices with necessary software, accounts, and security settings.
    • Maintain and deploy standardized system images for consistent configuration across devices.
    • Keep device drivers updated to ensure optimal performance and security.
    • Apply critical Windows updates and security patches in a timely manner.
    • Perform basic hardware troubleshooting and diagnostics. Replace defective components like HDDs, RAM, and keyboards.
  • Mac and iOS Device Support:
    • Troubleshoot common issues with macOS and iOS devices, including connectivity, software, and hardware problems.
    • Assist users with basic Mac and iOS configurations and settings.
    • Maintain awareness of updates and security vulnerabilities for Apple devices.
  • Network Printer Management:
    • Troubleshoot printing issues, such as paper jams, connectivity problems, and driver conflicts.
    • Maintain an inventory of network printers and toner cartridges.
  • Inventory and Recycling:
    • Maintain accurate records of all IT hardware and peripherals.
    • Track device lifecycles and schedule replacements.
    • Coordinate secure data wiping and proper disposal of retired hardware.
    • Implement eco-friendly recycling practices for obsolete equipment.
  • Additional Responsibilities:
    • Participate in IT projects and initiatives as assigned.
    • Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and industry trends.
    • Adhere to company policies and procedures.
    • Maintain a professional and positive attitude.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • 3 - 5 years of desktop support experience in a business or corporate environment.
  • Knowledge of Office 365 Administration, scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python), Active Directory, Windows device setups, troubleshooting, and hardware replacements.
  • Experience troubleshooting macOS and iOS devices.
  • Experience with network printers.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Demonstrates a customer orientation; strength in analytical, math, and reasoning skills.
  • Competent in the latest Windows and Microsoft Office suite of products.
  • Demonstrated ability to prepare and maintain documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide advanced desktop hardware and software support.
  • Understanding of HTTP, TCP/IP, and related protocols.

job.title: Civil Structural Engineer
job.description:
Education:
Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited university is required. Structural coursework is required for structural engineering positions.

Registration:
Professional Engineering registration in Louisiana.

Experience:
This position requires 6 to 10 years of relevant industrial experience in civil/structural engineering.

Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to:
• Familiarity with and utilizing department design and drafting standards.
• Familiarity with project scope, specifications and design criteria upon assignment to a project task
team.
• Developing conceptual layouts and cost studies as necessary to determine the simplest, most
efficient approach to solving engineering tasks at hand.
• Producing estimate level preliminary designs and material take-offs suitable for the level of the
estimate being performed on a project.
• Producing detail design calculations and sketches for materials of construction associated with the
project. Calculations produced will be neatly prepared and organized for efficient checking by
others and efficient use by drafters/designers for preparing drawings and as a deliverable when
required.

Job Description
Producing designs with efficient use of construction materials with an overall emphasis on ease of
construction and completed product meeting the expectations of the client.
• Checking calculations made by other engineers to ensure accuracy, conformance to codes,
specifications, design criteria and conformance to good engineering practice.
• Assisting the drafting group in resolving routine layout and detailing problems. Responsibility to
furnish sufficient sketches and details necessary for completion of engineering drawings.
• Consulting with design leaders from other disciplines to ensure the smooth flow of vital information
necessary for the scheduled completion of the project.
• Advising the senior engineer concerning design or scope changes, which have been identified.
• Assisting other engineers in developing and assembling scopes, drawings and specifications into a
"package”, enabling civil/structural purchase inquiries to be issued for procurement of materials or
subcontract pricing.
• Reviewing and checking vendor drawings and other discipline drawings for civil/structural input.
• Developing construction specifications.
• Reviewing fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for conformance to engineering
drawings and specifications.
• Performing fieldwork necessary to gather field data, check tie-ins and provide construction support.
• Providing technical guidance to less experienced drafting and engineering personnel in the
department.
• Ability to lead small to large size teams in coordinating civil/structural efforts and keeping the team
focused on scope, schedule and budget.
• Ability to identify and develop work sharing packages for interoffice execution support. Provide
leadership to ensure communication and execution of work within scope, schedule and budget.
• Estimating and scheduling professional service hours and assessing the progress and quality of
civil/structural work.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:
• Knowledge and application of the International Building Code and associated standards (ASCE, AISC, ACI, etc.)
• Expertise with civil/structural analysis software including operating and interpreting results
• Knowledge of the discipline specific methods, practices and techniques required to engineer, design and construct process and manufacturing projects
• Active Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in the state of Louisiana – required
• Able to lead a small to large team to deliver on commitments
• Able to deliver convincing presentations of Engineers + Constructors services
• Working knowledge of CAD software, either AutoCAD, Microstation or both
• Proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook
• Good communication skills, both verbal and written
• Virtual team skills and cross divisional relationships are developed, and able to provide interoffice execution leadership and support
• Valid Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) card is a plus

job.title: Forklift Operator - 1st shift
job.description:
Schedule: Monday-Friday - 8-9AM until 4:30-5:30PM

Must pass Stand Up and Sit Down Forklift test.

General Purpose:
As a Forklift Operator, you would be responsible for operating and managing industrial trucks (forklifts) to load, unload, transport, and store materials safely and efficiently within the warehouse, loading docks, and storage areas. You support distribution and production operations by ensuring materials are moved accurately according to schedule and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Store products properly and transport them to the appropriate warehouse or distribution zones.

  • Weigh and record product weights and other data for inventory control and labeling.

  • Monitor and maintain inventory accuracy in assigned areas.

  • Maintain work area and equipment cleanliness (remove empty pallets and debris).

  • Follow safety standards and regulatory compliance to foster a safe working environment.

  • Perform forklift maintenance tasks, including pre- and post-operation inspections, troubleshooting minor issues, and recommending repairs.

  • Study production and shipping schedules to coordinate material movement.

Typical Requirements

  • Good communication and teamwork skills.

  • Good physical condition and ability to follow operating instructions and safety policies.

Work Environment

  • Typically onsite in a warehouse or distribution center environment.

  • May require shift work and occasional overtime based on operational needs.

job.title: Application Engineer BigID
job.description:
Job Description:

 

BigID Engineer Position Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated BigID Engineer with hands-on experience in developing and implementing solutions using BigID, along with strong foundational knowledge of cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The ideal candidate will work on data discovery, classification, and privacy initiatives, contributing to our data governance and compliance strategy. BigID Engineer – Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain BigID integrations with enterprise systems (databases, cloud storage, data warehouses, APIs) for automated discovery and classification of sensitive data.
  • Customize BigID data discovery policies, classifiers, and connectors to meet regulatory, privacy, and security requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
  • Implement and optimize data discovery workflows using BigID's configuration tools, APIs, and scripting capabilities for scalability and performance.
  • Develop and manage custom metadata enrichment rules to improve data context, tagging, and governance.
  • Work closely with data governance, privacy, and security teams to align BigID solutions with business compliance frameworks.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to BigID platform performance, data ingestion, classification accuracy, and connector reliability.
  • Write and maintain technical documentation for BigID configurations, custom scripts, and integration patterns.
  • Lead code reviews and mentor junior team members on BigID best practices, scripting, and API usage.
  • Collaborate with BigID product support and vendor teams to escalate and resolve platform-level issues or request feature enhancements.
  • Stay updated with BigID platform updates and emerging data privacy regulations, applying changes to maintain compliance and technical efficiency.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent
  • Proven experience with BigID platform (development, configuration, deployment).
  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies – primarily GCP and AWS.
  • Knowledge of data classification, data governance, and privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Hands-on experience with data connectors, APIs, and cloud storage integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud basics, including IAM, networking, and storage fundamentals.
  • Ability to work in an agile environment with minimal supervision.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • BigID Certification (extra credit).
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python or Shell.
  • Prior experience working in data privacy or security-focused projects.

job.title: Take-off Specialist
job.description:
HVAC Take-Off Specialist

Position Summary

Our client is seeking a detail-oriented Take-Off Specialist to serve as the critical link between mechanical designs and the manufacturing floor. This role is responsible for reviewing commercial HVAC mechanical plans, identifying the appropriate roof curbs, adapters, and accessories required for each project, and generating accurate material lists and pricing quotes for customers.

The ideal candidate has experience reviewing construction drawings, performing take-offs, and working with HVAC equipment specifications.

Key Responsibilities

Blueprint Analysis

  • Perform comprehensive take-offs from commercial mechanical (M-series) and architectural drawings.

  • Review project plans and specifications to identify required materials and components.

Product Identification

  • Cross-reference HVAC unit model numbers (Carrier, Trane, Lennox, etc.) with the appropriate curb and adapter footprints.

  • Ensure all components align with project specifications and mechanical requirements.

Estimating & Quoting

  • Calculate material requirements including sheet metal gauge, insulation, and related components.

  • Estimate labor and material costs to generate accurate and competitive customer quotes.

Technical Collaboration

  • Partner with sales and production teams to ensure custom-manufactured parts meet project specifications.

  • Provide technical insight to help resolve design or specification questions.

Data & Documentation

  • Maintain organized records of quotes, take-offs, and project details within internal tracking systems.

  • Ensure all project documentation is accurate and accessible.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in one of the following areas:

    • Construction estimating

    • HVAC parts distribution

    • Sheet metal fabrication

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in reading blueprints and construction drawings.

  • Experience with take-off software such as Bluebeam or PlanSwift is highly preferred.

Knowledge

  • Basic understanding of HVAC equipment and commercial roofing terminology.

  • Familiarity with HVAC brands such as Carrier, Trane, Lennox, or similar manufacturers.

Core Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies in drawings that could impact manufacturing or installation.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

job.title: IT Support Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated individual to provide world-class assistance and support to our end users. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of technical support, Active Directory, Windows device management, Mac and iOS support, and network printer management. This role will also involve inventory management and hardware recycling.

Core Responsibilities

  • Technical Support:
    • Identify and diagnose user issues related to hardware, software, network connectivity, and peripherals.
    • Assist users with installing, configuring, and troubleshooting common applications (e.g., Office suite, email client, antivirus, MFA, collaboration tools).
    • Provide support via phone, email, remote access tools, and in-person troubleshooting when necessary.
    • Document all support incidents, track resolutions, and escalate complex issues to senior technicians or IT specialists.
    • Provide setup and technical assistance for presentations, meetings, and classrooms, ensuring proper functionality of projectors, sound systems, and video conferencing tools.
  • Active Directory:
    • Assist users with password resets and account lockouts, maintaining a secure password reset process.
    • Investigate and resolve basic Active Directory-related issues, such as authentication problems or access errors.
    • Effectively communicate with senior IT staff regarding Active Directory issues that require further expertise.
  • Windows Device Management:
    • Configure new employee devices with necessary software, accounts, and security settings.
    • Maintain and deploy standardized system images for consistent configuration across devices.
    • Keep device drivers updated to ensure optimal performance and security.
    • Apply critical Windows updates and security patches in a timely manner.
    • Perform basic hardware troubleshooting and diagnostics. Replace defective components like HDDs, RAM, and keyboards.
  • Mac and iOS Device Support:
    • Troubleshoot common issues with macOS and iOS devices, including connectivity, software, and hardware problems.
    • Assist users with basic Mac and iOS configurations and settings.
    • Maintain awareness of updates and security vulnerabilities for Apple devices.
  • Network Printer Management:
    • Troubleshoot printing issues, such as paper jams, connectivity problems, and driver conflicts.
    • Maintain an inventory of network printers and toner cartridges.
  • Inventory and Recycling:
    • Maintain accurate records of all IT hardware and peripherals.
    • Track device lifecycles and schedule replacements.
    • Coordinate secure data wiping and proper disposal of retired hardware.
    • Implement eco-friendly recycling practices for obsolete equipment.
  • Additional Responsibilities:
    • Participate in IT projects and initiatives as assigned.
    • Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and industry trends.
    • Adhere to company policies and procedures.
    • Maintain a professional and positive attitude.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies

  • 3 - 5 years of desktop support experience in a business or corporate environment.
  • Knowledge of Office 365 Administration, scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python), Active Directory, Windows device setups, troubleshooting, and hardware replacements.
  • Experience troubleshooting macOS and iOS devices.
  • Experience with network printers.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Demonstrates a customer orientation; strength in analytical, math, and reasoning skills.
  • Competent in the latest Windows and Microsoft Office suite of products.
  • Demonstrated ability to prepare and maintain documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide advanced desktop hardware and software support.
  • Understanding of HTTP, TCP/IP, and related protocols.
  • Certification in a relevant field, such as A+ or Microsoft.
  • Bachelor's Degree required.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Skills or Experience

  • Ability to be creative and innovative in a complex technical environment.

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
1st or 2nd shift

MAJOR JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (List in order of importance)

Warehouse material handlers essential duties are to perform various tasks in the warehouse such as but not limited to:

  • Inbound: Unload trucks, trailers, containers of freight, counting products, compare to manifest to check all shipments for damage, infestation, or production code dates. Material handlers must report shortages, damages, and mis-shipments on appropriate forms. Also be able to sign for inbound shipments when necessary. All inbound shipments are moved safely to storage locations to be efficiently stacked as store merchandise.

  • Order Picking: Ensure that the correct product number, quantity and type (lot, batch, serial number) of product are picked. Transport orders to shipping locations or delivery platforms with material handling equipment such as but not limited to fork trucks, cherry pickers, or pallet jacks. Materials handlers must be able to label, stencil, tag, mark orders, band, bundle, wrap, over-pack, and palletize as required.

  • Outbound: Compare quantity, labeling and address with order to ensure out-going shipments are complete and correct. Assign signature for outbound as necessary. Efficiently move product, cartons and or pallets into trailers, rail cars or containers.

  • Equipment: Maintain equipment in a neat, clean and orderly fashion. Operate equipment safely and efficiently. Comply with company standards and OSHA requirements.

  • Inventory: Keep accurate records and reports. Assist in physical inventories and cycle counts. Ensure proper stock rotation. May key inventory adjustments in computer.

  • Other Duties: Repack or re-box cases per customer instructions. Repair and consolidate damaged goods as required. Operate shrink-wrap machine. Charge forklift battery as needed; stack and or separate good from bad pallets when necessary; clean railcars, trailers, and truck docks, bays as requested.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience and Certifications)

  • High School education or GED preferred

  • OSHA Forklift and HAZMAT certification a plus


KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those necessary to perform the job competently)

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Must be able to use proper techniques to lift up to 75 pounds. The ability to follow directions with emphasis on safety is extremely important.

  • Must be able to handle stress caused in meeting deadlines with tight scheduling requirements.

  • Must be able to shift priorities easily.

  • Must be able to use hands and feet simultaneously and for repetitive movements.

  • Must have responsible work habits.

  • Must be familiar with warehouse systems.

  • Must be available to work any shift.


LANGUAGE SKILLS:
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret SOPs, coverage, documents, and regulations. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively establish rapport, present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers and the public. Skill and ability to meet people and listen.


MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:
Ability to add and subtract two digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10's and 100's. Ability to perform these operations using units of American money and weight measurement, volume, and distance. Understanding of metric system measurements is beneficial.


REASONING ABILITY:
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed and uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.


OTHER:
Skill and ability to type. Skill and ability to operate a computer. Skill and ability to organize and prioritize work. Skill and ability to meet deadlines and operate office equipment. Skill and ability to use Microsoft office tools and company software.


ENVIRONMENTAL WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL EFFORT (Under Typical Positions)

The work environment characteristics and physical effort described here are representative of those an associate encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the associate is exposed to an industrial warehouse environment. The associate works near moving mechanical machinery and noise level in the work environment is usually loud. The job requires working in heights, exposure to changes in temperature, driving equipment, and maybe exposed to dust, fumes, or gases.


The associate is required to stand and walk for the majority of the working day. The physical requirements of the job are for associates to talk, hear, bend/stoop, squat, crawl, climb height, reach above shoulder height, crouch, kneel, balance, and push/pull. Furthermore, the job requires associates to lift/carry/push or pull up to 75 pounds with or without assistance. Associates use both hands for repetitive actions such as grasping and manipulating as well as both feet for repetitive movement operating foots controls. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Maintenance Technician II - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Job Description:

Our client is at the forefront of advancing power solutions, charged and driven by a committed, dynamic team, tackling complex challenges, and creating innovative solutions. We're looking for motivated, driven, and talented individuals eager to be part of the future of power. Safety and integrity aren't just buzzwords, they are the north star guiding us as we aspire to wow our customers every day. We've created power solutions that are not only durable and unique but are also the result of exciting teamwork from every corner of our organization. Individually and collectively, every team member plays for each other and strives to deliver unmatched value and 100% accuracy to our customers every single day. Our cutting-edge headquarters is in Faribault, MN, a facility that is partially solar- and wind-powered by our own microgrid! You'll find that we're also pushing boundaries across the country at our additional facilities in Troy, MI; Houston, TX; Merrimack, NH; Burnsville, MN; and Charolette, NC.

Our team members are our most important asset, we are in search of a Maintenance Technician - II for our Faribault, MN facility. This role is critical to achieving our strategic objectives and supporting our mission to deliver unmatched value and reliability to our customers.

Under the direction of the Maintenance Manager, the Maintenance Technician II will complete preventive maintenance (PM's), troubleshoot, repair, and rebuild company equipment without direct supervision. They will also document the work being done on equipment.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Performs duties in a safe manner using all approved safety equipment as instructed.
  • Identifies equipment for repairs and upgrades.
  • Able to troubleshoot without direct supervision.
  • Able to contact equipment manufacturer technical service for troubleshooting guidance, as needed.
  • Perform PM's as required.

job.title: Performance Insights Consultant(Fully Remote)
job.description:
Position Overview

The Performance Insights Consultant will play a critical role in transforming operational and financial data into clear, actionable insights that support key business decisions. This position is responsible for designing and maintaining dashboards, monitoring performance indicators, and helping business partners understand trends that impact fulfillment, logistics, financial health, and overall operational efficiency. The ideal candidate is proactive, highly analytical, and able to convert complex information into decision-ready recommendations. Experience in fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain environments is strongly preferred.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain performance dashboards and visual reports used across operational and business teams.

  • Partner with with business and operational leaders to understand reporting needs and deliver concise, actionable recommendations.

  • Analyze data to identify trends in fulfillment metrics, financial performance, and operational efficiency.

  • Enhance decision-making by improving how information is structured, visualized, and communicated.

  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliable reporting pipelines.

  • Clearly communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences through strong data storytelling.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Business, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in an analytics-focused role (e.g., Business Analyst, Data Analyst).

  • Proficiency with dashboarding and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or QuickSight.

  • Strong SQL skills for querying, cleaning, and transforming data.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex analyses into clear insights and business recommendations.

  • Solid understanding of performance metrics and data storytelling.

Preferred Experience

  • Background in fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain analytics.

  • Hands-on application of ML/AI techniques in business intelligence (predictive dashboards, anomaly detection, demand forecasting).

  • Familiarity with cloud data ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake).

  • Understanding of data modeling concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data governance best practices.

  • Curiosity and passion for exploring how AI can enhance BI, automation, and business decision-making

job.description:
PURPOSE STATEMENT:
The primary role of this position is to serve as a crucial liaison between business associates and legal counsel, facilitating the effective management of contract processes and documentation throughout the organization. This position encompasses overseeing the Enterprise's Contract Lifecycle Management systems, ensuring compliance with legal standards, and supporting cross-functional projects related to contracts, all while providing guidance on legal operations and maintaining the integrity of critical contract data. The role is a full-time temporary role. The hours are Monday to Thursday 8-5 and Friday 8-1. The role is hybrid due to the applicant must be available to work in person to facilitate document signature. Looking to start a person ASAP and interviews are required for this role

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Acts as liaison between internal clients (at all levels of the organization) and attorneys on all legal documents.

Responds to inquiries from internal clients regarding contracts (with attorney supervision)

Supports additional company projects related to contracts (for example with Finance and Procurement) at various times of the year as needed.

Evaluate Legal IS software on the market as available.

Stewards and manages the Enterprises Contract Lifecycle Management systems

Counsels business associates on legal operations, including contract review procedures, legal request protocols, and data and documentation requirements.

Conducts video and in-person tutorials for internal business associates on using the Enterprises Contract Lifecycle Management systems.

Evaluates electronic legal review requests to ensure compliance with data and documentation requirements for effective review and processing.

Reviews agreements and associated documents for terms necessary for contract lifecycle management.

Controls the input of data used by Enterprise to track all legal agreement expirations and renewals.

Oversees integrity and management of critical contract data repository.

Coordinates and oversees the execution of all final documents and archival function, ensuring compliance with legal requirements.

Creates and generates reports from the Enterprises Contract Lifecycle Management system as requested.


KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/EXPERIENCE :

Understanding of the structure of legal documents, legal language; legal provisions and the process of preparing documents for signature. Strong ability to evaluate contracts, identify key terms and assess compliance with legal and organizational requirements,

Excellent verbal and written communication skills for liaising with internal clients.

Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines while coordinating with various departments.

High level of accuracy in reviewing documents and managing contract data.

Familiarity with contract lifecycle management systems and legal information systems.

Strong organizational skills to maintain records, track contract lifecycle and manage deadlines.

Proficiency in Word, Adobe, Excel and Outlook.

Ability to demonstrate professionalism, confidentiality and flexibility.

Ability to manage own time effectively and efficiently.

When legal documents are ready for execution
Interpretation of legal documents

job.title: HR Specialist(Manufacturing)
job.description:
Job Purpose
The HR Specialist supports day-to-day HR operations in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, ensuring smooth employee lifecycle processes from onboarding to offboarding. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate employee records, supporting recruitment and training activities, coordinating benefits and payroll processes, and ensuring compliance with labor laws, the Collective Bargaining Agreement, and company policies.

Job Facts and Figures
Monroe has an average of 100 employees, working across one shift

Key responsibilities
Serve as the first point of contact for employee HR inquiries, directing them to the appropriate resources or escalating as needed.
Support HR initiatives that promote a positive and productive work environment.

Principal Activities
Employee Support & Relations
Assist with conflict resolution and provide guidance on HR policies and procedures.

Recruitment & Onboarding
Post job openings, coordinate interviews, and assist with candidate screening.
Prepare offer letters, new hire packets, and coordinate pre-employment requirements (e.g., drug screens, background checks).
Facilitate new hire orientation and ensure completion of onboarding documentation.

HR Records & Compliance
Maintain accurate and confidential employee files (digital and paper).
Track and update attendance, disciplinary actions, certifications, and training records.
Assist with compliance reporting for OSHA, EEOC, and state/federal regulations.
Support workers' compensation claims and return-to-work programs.

Payroll & Benefits Administration
Process payroll changes (new hires, terminations, pay adjustments, deductions).
Assist employees with benefits enrollment, changes, and questions.
Maintain time and attendance records, ensuring accuracy and addressing discrepancies.

Maintain training logs and certifications for all employees.

Planning and Organization
Support HR projects and initiatives such as engagement programs, recognition events, and policy rollouts.
Assist with special projects and reporting as assigned by the SR. HR Manager.

Scope of Decision Making
The scope of decision-making typically involves routine yet essential administrative and personnel-related tasks. This includes assisting in the recruitment process, scheduling interviews, maintaining employee records, processing payroll and attendance data, and ensuring compliance with labor laws, the Collective Bargaining Agreement, and company policies. While strategic decisions are usually made by senior HR staff, the HR Specialist plays a critical role in implementing policies, addressing basic employee inquiries, and supporting day-to-day HR operations.

Experience of working in a manufacturing environment and supporting shop floor employees.

We are seeking a Social Media Specialist to join a Corporate Communications team focused on telling compelling stories across social media platforms that highlight how the organization serves its patients, colleagues, and communities.

Reporting to the Communications Manager of Social Media, this role supports enterprise-wide social media strategy by discovering, developing, and distributing engaging content across branded social media channels. Content Strategy & Creation

job.title: Electrical Controls Technician
job.description:
Job Description:
Supports the design and implementation of controls-based solutions for Client future processing equipment, specifically fiber making and cable process equipment, in the optical waveguide and cabling manufacturing processes. These controls solutions will enable manufacturing systems to deliver and transform raw materials to product, convey ware between discrete processing steps, and/or measure and characterize ware created and/or processed by these Client manufacturing methods.

Day to Day Responsibilities:
· Integrate field devices for flow control, material handling and metering, motion control, temperature control, and associated safety systems based the system design package enabling a fully functional equipment platform.

· Work closely with controls engineers to implement control sequence logic (both time-based and event-based), fail-safe states, and process /equipment recovery sequences.
· Implement specified field devices to accomplish desired process / equipment functions, and compatible / compliant with site standards.
· Accurately estimate timeframe to complete assigned project work once scope of work is adequately defined and then complete work to agreed-to timeline.
· Participate in engineering project teams that are responsible to deliver robust, cost effective automation and process machine systems to ***'s manufacturing plants and processes.
· Work within project teams to support the solving of difficult automation problems, resolution of project related issues, and development of fundamental understanding of technical / process requirements critical to system success.
· Drive the deployment of defined control architectures, control system standards, and system integration that will satisfy process and manufacturing requirements.
· Interface with external system integrators and machine builders to enable project deliverables.
· Actively participate in project fabrication, off-line integration and testing, drawings and documentation, installation, production start-up support, training of plant personnel, and technology transfer.
· Report to project leader on assigned project activities on a pre-determined basis.

Required Years and Area of Experience: • 3+ years equipment/controls experience

Required Skills:
· Experience integrating field devices for flow control, material handling and metering, motion control, temperature control, and associated safety systems into an overall controls package enabling a fully functional equipment platform.
· Experience with PID control loop tuning and techniques.
· Experience working closely with IT & process engineers to implement control sequence logic (both time-based and event-based), fail-safe states and process / equipment recovery sequences.
· Experience with graphical user interface and human machine interface.
· Experience working within engineering project teams.
· Accurately estimates timeframe to complete assigned project work, once scope of work is adequately defined, then completes work to agreed-to timeline.
· Understanding of electrical design practices, machine / motion control systems, electro-mechanical systems, robotics, programming, and system integration.
· Demonstrated ability to support the development and delivery of fully integrated machine and motion control, automation, and process machine systems and solutions within a manufacturing environment.
· Familiar with state-of-the-art technologies in the following areas: control systems integration, controls architectures, PLC's, motion control systems, electro-mechanical drive systems, robotics, part sensing, vision, risk assessment, and safety systems.

· Possesses an understanding of general mechanics and ability to apply that understanding during troubleshooting and system implementation.
· Sound problem solving and decision-making skills.
· Highly motivated, results oriented, customer focused, with a high commitment level.

Desired Skills:
· Experience preferred with Allen-Bradley, Beckhoff, LabVIEW, Safety PLCs, iFIX SCADA.

· Able to work with external machine builders and system integrators for build, and integration of later stages of system implementation.

job.title: Scheduling Coordinator
job.description:
Scheduling Coordinator

Position Overview

The Sleep Scheduling Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for scheduling sleep-related appointments for new and existing patients. This role supports practices, hospital departments, and ancillary services across the health system. The Coordinator relays patient concerns, processes medication refill requests, and communicates with clinical and office staff per protocol through the designated EMR system.

This position requires a strong customer service mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex scheduling requests while maintaining compliance with HIPAA and regulatory standards. Coordinators must remain calm in stressful situations, prioritize patient needs effectively, and ensure accuracy when entering patient information, verifying insurance, and coordinating care.

Clerical medical experience is a plus but not required.

Essential Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling & Coordination

  • Coordinate and schedule appointments for sleep consults, sleep studies, follow-ups, daytime studies, and home sleep testing.

  • Utilize department software systems (Cerner Scheduling, Excel, PowerChart, PowerChart Ambulatory, RevCycle, and other systems as required).

  • Manage cancellations, reschedules, and related communication with patients and providers.

  • Fill open and same-day appointment slots in accordance with department guidelines.

  • Collaborate with clinical team leaders to identify appropriate scheduling options.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Use ICD-10 and CPT codes to verify medical necessity.

  • Coordinate with internal teams regarding insurance authorizations.

  • Process medical record requests and maintain accurate documentation.

2. Customer Service & Communication

  • Deliver high-quality customer service to patients, community members, and internal teams.

  • Answer incoming calls and respond to inquiries professionally.

  • Greet patients courteously in person and over the phone.

  • Use appropriate tone and clearly identify oneself during phone communication.

  • De-escalate difficult situations and escalate concerns appropriately.

  • Demonstrate strong active listening and clear verbal/written communication skills.

  • Meet or exceed established service standards and patient satisfaction guidelines.

3. Medical Records Management

  • Process medical record requests and release of information forms.

  • Adhere to regulatory standards regarding medical record releases.

  • Document all communication and actions related to medical record requests.

4. Patient Check-In & Check-Out

  • Ensure all required paperwork is completed and properly documented.

  • Confirm and update patient demographics and insurance information.

  • Register patients and obtain required consents.

  • Ensure patient understanding of rights, responsibilities, and privacy policies.

  • Prepare provider charts with updated documentation and records.

  • Schedule follow-up appointments per provider orders.

5. Insurance Authorization Support

  • Work closely with the authorization team to ensure sleep studies are approved.

  • Provide necessary documentation and information for authorization.

  • Schedule and reschedule appointments according to authorization guidelines.

  • Communicate authorization updates or changes to patients.

  • Verify and update insurance information as needed.

6. Additional Responsibilities

  • Support departmental operations by completing additional duties as assigned.

Workplace Standards

  • Maintain professional appearance and demeanor.

  • Uphold corporate compliance and confidentiality standards.

Behavioral Standards

  • Practice professional workplace etiquette.

  • Communicate with clarity, courtesy, and respect.

  • Demonstrate teamwork and a strong sense of ownership.

  • One (1) year of experience in a customer service role or healthcare setting

  • Two (2) years of experience in customer service or healthcare

  • None required

job.title: Oil Measurement Analyst
job.description:
About the Role:
We are seeking a skilled Analyst to ensure accuracy, integrity, and timely reporting of volumetric and quality data for oil, gas, and liquid hydrocarbons. This role involves validating flow data, reconciling system imbalances, and ensuring all measurement activities comply with contractual and regulatory standards.

This role requires the candidate to work on-site at our clients' office in San Antonio, TX.

Responsibilities:
  • Data Validation & Editing: Utilize FLOWCAL to monitor, validate, and edit hourly and daily measurement data from field devices (RTUs, Flow Computers).
  • System Balancing: Analyze and maintain Lost & Unaccounted (L&U) gas records. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between field SCADA, accounting systems, and custody transfer points.
  • Monthly Closing: Coordinate the month-end closing process by finalizing volumetric data for billing and revenue accounting.
  • Quality Analysis: Review gas sampling results to ensure BTU values and hydrocarbon compositions meet contract specifications.
  • Field Support & Troubleshooting: Act as a liaison for field technicians to troubleshoot equipment issues, such as transmitter failures or communication gaps in SCADA.
Requirements:
Required
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Good critical thinking and communication skills
  • Achieving 100% on-time completion of monthly volumetric closings with the capacity to meet strict deadlines.
Preferred
  • Education: Bachelor's or associate degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business, Finance, or a related technical field; a High School Diploma with relevant work experience will also be considered .
  • Mastery of MS Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data analysis).
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software: FLOWCAL, SCADA (CygNet/Ignition), or TESTit.
  • Knowledge of measurement hardware: Orifice meters, Ultrasonic meters, and Coriolis meters.
  • Proficient in scripting languages such as SQL, Python, R
  • Creating Dashboards using Data Vizualization software e.g. Power BI, Tableau


This is an exciting opportunity to work directly with a Fortune 200 oil and gas company. If you are a passionate and motivated Data Analyst, we encourage you to apply for this position.

job.title: CNC Machine Operator - 1st Shift
job.description:
Monday-Thursday 5am-3:30pm

Overview

We are seeking a skilled CNC Machine Operator to join a fabrication team focused on producing high-quality components in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This role plays a critical part in ensuring precision, efficiency, and consistency across machining operations.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical ability, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Machine Setup & Operation

  • Set up and operate CNC and manual machining equipment, including CNC mills, manual lathes, drill presses, end mills, and laser welders
  • Load tools, fixtures, and materials; ensure machines are calibrated and aligned for accurate operation
  • Execute machining processes such as milling, turning, and drilling according to specifications

Programming & Technical Execution

  • Load and modify CNC programs using G and M code as needed
  • Interpret blueprints and technical drawings to determine setup, tooling, and machining requirements
  • Read and work from SolidWorks drawings for accurate part production

Quality Control

  • Inspect finished parts using precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges)
  • Ensure all components meet required tolerances and quality standards

Material Handling & Production

  • Load and secure raw materials properly for machining
  • Monitor production runs to maintain efficiency and address any issues in real time

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Perform routine maintenance on machines and tooling
  • Identify and resolve machining issues such as tool wear, misalignment, or equipment malfunctions

Documentation & Reporting

  • Accurately document production data, machine settings, and maintenance activity
  • Complete daily reports, including production counts and scrap tracking

Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve cycle times, efficiency, and product quality
  • Follow and contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs)

Safety

  • Follow all safety protocols and properly use required PPE
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment

Qualifications

Basic Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum 2 years of CNC machining experience, including setup and operation
  • Experience in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings
  • Working knowledge of CNC programming fundamentals (G-code)
  • Experience operating both CNC and manual machines
  • Proficiency with precision measuring instruments
  • Understanding of common materials (aluminum, steel, stainless steel, copper, etc.)
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs regularly
  • Ability to read, write, and follow instructions in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical or trade school education
  • Experience with SolidWorks and/or Mastercam
  • Strong mechanical aptitude
  • Basic math skills for interpreting measurements and production data

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Frequent standing, bending, lifting, and reaching
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment
  • Must comply with all PPE and safety requirements

Benefits

  • 401(k) with company match
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Disability insurance
  • Paid time off (PTO) and sick time
  • Paid holidays
  • Employee appreciation programs
