job.title: CNC Machine Operator
job.description:
The CNC Machine Operator proficiently operates a manual lathe & mill, CNC mill, laser welder, end mill, and drill press. Has knowledge of G and M codes. Has strong problem-solving skills, and high attention to detail. CNC Machine Operator will have knowledge and experience with a wide variety of hand tools.

  • Machine Setup: Prepare and set up CNC machines by loading the appropriate tools, fixtures, and materials. Ensure the machine is properly calibrated and aligned for precise operation.
  • CNC Program Use: Modify, or load CNC programs into the machine's control system, specifying the dimensions, shapes, and tolerances required for the specific components.
  • Material Handling: Load and secure raw materials onto the machine's worktable, ensuring proper positioning and alignment for accurate machining.
  • Machining Operations: Operate CNC machines to perform milling, turning, drilling, or other machining processes, following the programmed instructions.
  • Quality Control: Conduct regular inspections of finished parts using precision measuring instruments, such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges, to verify accuracy and quality.
  • Tool Maintenance: Perform routine maintenance tasks on CNC tools and replace worn or damaged cutting tools to ensure optimal performance and minimize downtime.
  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues that may arise during the machining process, such as tool wear, material irregularities, or machine malfunctions.

Job Requirements:

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma
  • 2 years of experience in CNC machine operation, programming, set up, and mechanical ability and aptitude to understand how manufacturing equipment works together in a line to produce high quality products
  • 2 years of experience working in a manufacturing environment or have general knowledge of metalworking, bending and tooling.
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and work instructions to determine machine setup, tooling requirements, and part specifications.
  • Ability to operate both manual and CNC Machines (Manual lathe & Mill, CNC Mill)
  • Understanding of G code and CNC Programming Basics, experience editing programs is a plus.
  • Skilled in the use precision measuring instruments and inspection techniques.
  • Knowledge of different materials and their properties. (Aluminum, steel, stainless steel, copper, & Fiber board)

job.title: Chemical Operations Technician
job.description:
This position starts with day shifts for a month and then rotates to 12-hour day/night shifts. The schedule is rotational.

Candidates must have chemical manufacturing experience.

Position Overview

This is a contractor position reporting directly to the Torrance Operations Manager. The primary responsibility is the packaging and shipment of Finished Goods. Additional duties include loading, unloading, and cleaning equipment, packaging products, maintaining a safe and orderly work area, assisting other production areas as needed, and overall plant housekeeping.

Activities

  • Yard responsibilities: sampling, weighing and inspecting loads, loading and shipping trucks, railcars, and iso-containers, filling and packaging drums & totes, and general plant housekeeping.
  • Follow Operating Discipline principles, procedures, and practices to ensure safe and efficient operation.
  • Operate and field check process equipment. Monitor process conditions, equipment, and control systems.
  • Perform tasks assigned to operations (e.g., field checks, equipment preparation, samples, etc.).
  • Ensure operational activities and process performance are aligned with plant and business goals.
  • Use troubleshooting skills to resolve process-related deviations and problems; initiate work requests in SAP as needed.
  • Use process knowledge and skills to make improvements in plant performance and Operating Discipline.
  • Perform process equipment troubleshooting, improvements, and preventative maintenance utilizing appropriate processes and disciplines.
  • Expected to use or develop computer skills and participate in procedure writing/verification and other AIMS activities.
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills to identify issues and report them for repair (e.g., small leaks, replace valves, steam traps, etc.).
  • Participate in Immediate Response Training and the IR team as required.
  • Support BU safety initiatives and programs.
  • Participate on EH&S improvement teams and complete related action items as required.
  • Identify potential safety issues, communicate hazards, and complete follow-up actions to mitigate.
  • Complete Operator Minor Maintenance activities to reduce maintenance costs and production loss events.
  • Contribute to the Business and Site AIMS Initiative.
  • Improve Unit Operating Efficiencies and reduce energy consumption by monitoring equipment and recognizing abnormal situations.
  • Ensure waste material/hazardous waste is disposed of properly and receive annual RCRA training.
  • Maintain a healthful and safe working environment and participate in HSEQ activities provided by site management.
  • Identify and communicate potential gains and possible improvements related to the work environment and management system through employee suggestion programs, during group meetings, or through other identified communication tools.
  • Remain in compliance with the rules, standard procedures, and work instructions related to the specific job title and site location.
  • Complete assigned training through the learning management system or attendance at assigned Web-Ex or Instructor Led Training (ILT) classes.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Context and Environment

This is a plant-based position located in Torrance, CA. This job requires working scheduled and unscheduled overtime.

Accountabilities

This role is generally the first to see a truck when it arrives at the site and the last to see a truck when it is ready to depart. The role generally resides at the truck entry point to the loading/receiving site and confirms loading has been completed to the greatest extent possible.

Key Competencies

  • Responsible Care: Work safely, protect the environment, and fully participate in the plant's EH&S program.
  • Initiative: Self-starters who seek out work and improve the plant will do well in this role.
  • Work Process Discipline: Access and utilize well-documented plant safety and operating procedures.
  • Productivity Focus: Improve the productivity of the plant by being close to the process.
  • Teamwork: Share the workload, effectively communicate with many people, and participate in achieving the team's goals.

Qualifications/Experience Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous chemical or manufacturing experience and computer skills are preferred.
  • Must be able to follow written and verbal instructions, have good math skills, work independently, execute strenuous physical activities, work indoors and outdoors, and work any shift.

HSEQ Responsibilities

  • Comply with the HSEQ Policy.
  • Comply with Regulations, Legal, and Internal Requirements as made known by the site and by the business unit (BU).
  • Comply with the rules of the specific location to which one is assigned as well as the rules set by the business unit (BU) and the company.
  • Comply with all standard procedures and work instructions to ensure productivity, quality assurance, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Review work areas for potential losses and report hazards to the direct supervisor.
  • Report Near Misses to the direct supervisor.
  • Report Incidents or Accidents to the direct supervisor.
  • Identify and communicate potential gains or possible improvements to the management system.

job.title: Distribution Associate II (Forklift)
job.description:
Temp to hire

Safety minded

PIT/Forklift experience with a good track record of successfully loading and unloading dry van and flatbed trucks
RF Scanner experience (SAP)
Desk top computer experience (Word, Excel, MS Teams, email)
Detail oriented
Punctual – Reliable transportation
Self-motivated
Customer centric (external and internal)
Personable (work well in a small group)

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Under general supervision, performs manual and clerical duties related to the shipment and receipt of materials, supplies, equipment and finished products.
Receives goods, verifies items against the record of shipment, and inspects condition. Gathers, verifies, and packs items for shipment according to specifications and the transportation method used.
Records received and shipped items according to established procedures.
Routes materials, supplies and equipment to inspection or stock areas.
Completes written and computerized documentation.

Requires a high school diploma or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Requires at least 1 year related experience.
Prefer forklift certification.
Knows typical shipping and receiving procedures and can handle some exceptions. Requires basic reading, writing and numerical ability.
Valid drivers license with good driving record may be required.
Able to operate powered equipment such as forklift or hydraulic jack lift.
Effective verbal communication skills.
Able to lift up to 50 pounds.

Job Responsibilities

  • Gathering, verifying, and packing items for shipment according to specifications and transportation methods

  • Recording received and shipped items in accordance with established procedures
